/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.HilbertAction
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.CoefficientHom
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Operator.Calkin

/-!
# The actual Hilbert factor homomorphism and full compact restriction

The original completed Hilbert-factor operators preserve the original zero,
addition, product, complex scalar and Hilbert adjoint operations. Their pure
values and actual pure-span density prove the required homomorphism fields.
Restrict the resulting homomorphism along the actual closed star ideal of
compact operators on the same arbitrary complete Hilbert space.

These are indispensable factors of the elementary A tensor K(H) action in
Blackadar, K-Theory for Operator Algebras, Theorem10.1.2. The restricted factor
still has the actual adjointable-operator target. Compactness of the elementary
coefficient/compact-factor product and the minimum norm comparison are separate
constructor obligations. No countable replacement or target model is used.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder RightActions
open CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uH uA

variable (H : Type uH) (A : Type uA)
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The actual completed Hilbert factor bundled with its original algebra and Hilbert adjoint laws. -/
def hilbertHom :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    (H →L[ℂ] H) →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact
    { toFun := hilbertOperator H A
      map_zero' := by
        apply operator_ext_pure H A
        intro ξ b
        rw [hilbertOperator_pure, zero_apply, AdjointableOperator.zero_apply]
        change completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm 0) b = 0
        simp only [map_zero, completedPure, balancedPure_zero_left]
      map_add' := fun T S => by
        apply operator_ext_pure H A
        intro ξ b
        rw [hilbertOperator_pure, AdjointableOperator.add_apply,
          hilbertOperator_pure, hilbertOperator_pure, add_apply]
        change completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (T ξ + S ξ)) b =
          completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (T ξ)) b +
            completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (S ξ)) b
        rw [map_add]
        exact completedPure_add_left (scalarSelfHom A)
          ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (T ξ)) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (S ξ)) b
      map_mul' := fun T S => by
        apply operator_ext_pure H A
        intro ξ b
        rw [hilbertOperator_pure, AdjointableOperator.mul_apply,
          hilbertOperator_pure, hilbertOperator_pure]
        rfl
      map_smul' := fun c T => by
        apply operator_ext_pure H A
        intro ξ b
        rw [hilbertOperator_pure, AdjointableOperator.smul_apply,
          hilbertOperator_pure, smul_apply]
        change completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (c • T ξ)) b =
          c • completedPure (scalarSelfHom A) ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (T ξ)) b
        rw [map_smul]
        exact completedPure_smul_left (scalarSelfHom A) c ((ScalarRight.equivL H).symm (T ξ)) b
      map_star' := fun T => by
        apply operator_ext_pure H A
        intro ξ b
        rw [hilbertOperator_pure, AdjointableOperator.star_apply,
          hilbertOperator_adjoint_pure, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint] }

/-- The bundled Hilbert factor retains its exact original completed operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem hilbertHom_apply (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    hilbertHom H A T = hilbertOperator H A T := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  rfl

/-- The actual Hilbert factor has the original first-factor pure value. -/
theorem hilbertHom_pure (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ : H) (b : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    hilbertHom H A T (pure H A ξ b) = pure H A (T ξ) b := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact hilbertOperator_pure H A T ξ b

/-- The original Hilbert operator norm bounds the actual bundled Hilbert factor. -/
theorem hilbertHom_norm_le (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    ‖hilbertHom H A T‖ ≤ ‖T‖ := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact hilbertOperator_norm_le H A T

/-- Restrict the actual Hilbert factor to the original full-H compact closed star ideal. -/
def compactHilbertHom :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact (hilbertHom H A).comp
    (NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype (R := ℂ)
      (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier)

/-- The restricted factor retains the literal original compact operator as its source. -/
@[simp]
theorem compactHilbertHom_apply
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    compactHilbertHom H A T = hilbertOperator H A (T : H →L[ℂ] H) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  rfl

/-- The actual compact factor changes only the original Hilbert vector on pure tensors. -/
theorem compactHilbertHom_pure
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) (ξ : H) (b : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    compactHilbertHom H A T (pure H A ξ b) =
      pure H A ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) b := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact hilbertOperator_pure H A (T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ b

/-- The original compact operator norm bounds the restricted completed factor. -/
theorem compactHilbertHom_norm_le
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    ‖compactHilbertHom H A T‖ ≤ ‖T‖ := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact hilbertOperator_norm_le H A (T : H →L[ℂ] H)

/-- The two actual homomorphism factors commute, as required for the algebraic tensor action. -/
theorem compactHilbertHom_commutes_coefficientHom
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) (a : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    Commute (compactHilbertHom H A T) (coefficientHom H A a) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  exact hilbertOperator_commutes_coefficientOperator H A (T : H →L[ℂ] H) a

end

end CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.InducedCompletion
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.CompactRangeDense

import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.StarAlgHom
import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Isometry

/-!
# The actual onto comparison for the induced compact tensor completion

The original algebraic tensor images are dense in actual compacts and are
values of the existing completed homomorphism on its canonical core. That
completed map is already an actual isometry, so its complete source gives
closed range. Density and closedness therefore give surjectivity, and the
stock bijective star-hom constructor yields an actual star-algebra equivalence.

Its original core values, inverse core values and norms are retained. This
compares the actually induced seminorm completion with its actual compact
module presentation. Raw injectivity and equality with the original least
C-star cross norm remain separate required minimum bridges; no terminal
Takai or minimum faithfulness proof is inferred.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder RightActions TensorProduct Topology

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uH uA

variable (H : Type uH) (A : Type uA)
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original dense algebraic compact images lie in the actually constructed completion-map range. -/
theorem denseRange_compactTensorCompletionToCompacts :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    DenseRange (compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A) := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  have hsubset : Set.range (algebraicCompactTensorHom H A) ⊆
      Set.range (compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A) := by
    rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨toCompactTensorCompletion H A z, compactTensorCompletionToCompacts_apply H A z⟩
  exact (denseRange_algebraicCompactTensorHom H A).mono hsubset

/-- Actual isometry, completeness and dense image make the existing completed star hom bijective. -/
theorem bijective_compactTensorCompletionToCompacts :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    Function.Bijective (compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A) := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  have hi := isometry_compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A
  have hclosed : IsClosed (Set.range (compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A)) :=
    hi.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
  have hdense : Dense (Set.range (compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A)) :=
    denseRange_compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A
  have hrange : Set.range (compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A) = Set.univ :=
    hclosed.closure_eq.symm.trans hdense.closure_eq
  refine ⟨hi.injective, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hx : x ∈ Set.range (compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A) := by
    rw [hrange]
    trivial
  exact hx

/-- The genuine bijective completed star hom as an actual equivalence of the original two carriers. -/
def compactTensorCompletionEquiv :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    CompactTensorCompletion H A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] CompactAlgebra H A := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  exact StarAlgEquiv.ofBijective (compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A)
    (bijective_compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A)

/-- The equivalence retains the same actual completed homomorphism value on every element. -/
theorem compactTensorCompletionEquiv_apply (x : CompactTensorCompletion H A) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    compactTensorCompletionEquiv H A x = compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A x := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  rfl

/-- Every original canonical raw image has its unchanged actual compact tensor value. -/
theorem compactTensorCompletionEquiv_toCompletion (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    compactTensorCompletionEquiv H A (toCompactTensorCompletion H A z) =
      algebraicCompactTensorHom H A z := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  exact compactTensorCompletionToCompacts_apply H A z

/-- The actual inverse sends each original algebraic compact image back to its canonical completion image. -/
theorem compactTensorCompletionEquiv_symm_algebraic (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    (compactTensorCompletionEquiv H A).symm (algebraicCompactTensorHom H A z) =
      toCompactTensorCompletion H A z := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  have h := (compactTensorCompletionEquiv H A).symm_apply_apply (toCompactTensorCompletion H A z)
  rw [compactTensorCompletionEquiv_toCompletion] at h
  exact h

/-- The actual equivalence preserves the norm computed from the same original compact-action seminorm. -/
theorem norm_compactTensorCompletionEquiv (x : CompactTensorCompletion H A) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    ‖compactTensorCompletionEquiv H A x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  exact norm_compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A x

end

end CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.AlgebraicTensorHom
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.SeminormPullback
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.SeminormNonUnitalCompletionHom

/-!
# The actual completion induced by the original compact tensor action

Pull back the actual CompactAlgebra H A norm along the verified original
algebraic tensor homomorphism. Reuse the existing same-seminorm nonunital
separation/completion engine for its carrier, dictionaries and canonical map.
The same actual homomorphism extends into the original compact algebra; its
completed norm equality follows from the dense original canonical images.

This computes strict carrier/hom/norm prerequisites of the original spatial
minimum target in Blackadar10.1.2. It does not identify the induced seminorm
with the source's least cross norm, select a supplied minimal tensor model,
or prove raw faithfulness, compact range density or the terminal Takai theorem.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder RightActions TensorProduct Topology

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uH uA

variable (H : Type uH) (A : Type uA)
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original compact-action norm as a genuine C-star seminorm on the same raw tensor. -/
def compactTensorSeminorm : CStarSeminorm (A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  exact CStarSeminorm.ofNonUnitalStarAlgHom (algebraicCompactTensorHom H A)

/-- Every induced seminorm value is exactly the original algebraic compact-action norm. -/
theorem compactTensorSeminorm_apply (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    compactTensorSeminorm H A z = ‖algebraicCompactTensorHom H A z‖ := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  rfl

/-- The existing literal same-seminorm separation quotient followed by ordinary completion. -/
abbrev CompactTensorCompletion := (compactTensorSeminorm H A).NonUnitalCompletion

/-- The existing same-seminorm completion dictionary on this actual carrier. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) :=
  (compactTensorSeminorm H A).nonUnitalCompletionCStarAlgebra

/-- The canonical raw-tensor map is the existing separation/completion map for this actual gauge. -/
def toCompactTensorCompletion :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CompactTensorCompletion H A :=
  (compactTensorSeminorm H A).toNonUnitalCompletion

/-- The canonical completed source norm is the original compact-action norm on every raw tensor. -/
theorem norm_toCompactTensorCompletion (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    ‖toCompactTensorCompletion H A z‖ = ‖algebraicCompactTensorHom H A z‖ := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  exact ((compactTensorSeminorm H A).norm_toNonUnitalCompletion z).trans
    (compactTensorSeminorm_apply H A z)

/-- The original canonical raw-tensor images are dense in the constructed same-gauge completion. -/
theorem denseRange_toCompactTensorCompletion :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    DenseRange (toCompactTensorCompletion H A) := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  exact (compactTensorSeminorm H A).denseRange_toNonUnitalCompletion

/-- Extend the same original compact-action hom through its actually induced completion. -/
def compactTensorCompletionToCompacts :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    CompactTensorCompletion H A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CompactAlgebra H A := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  exact (compactTensorSeminorm H A).fromNonUnitalCompletion (algebraicCompactTensorHom H A)
    (fun z => (compactTensorSeminorm_apply H A z).ge)

/-- Every original completed canonical image has its unchanged original compact-action value. -/
theorem compactTensorCompletionToCompacts_apply (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A (toCompactTensorCompletion H A z) =
      algebraicCompactTensorHom H A z := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  exact (compactTensorSeminorm H A).fromNonUnitalCompletion_apply (algebraicCompactTensorHom H A)
    (fun z => (compactTensorSeminorm_apply H A z).ge) z

/-- The existing extended star hom is continuous on this actual same-seminorm completion. -/
theorem continuous_compactTensorCompletionToCompacts :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    Continuous (compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A) := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  exact (compactTensorSeminorm H A).continuous_fromNonUnitalCompletion
    (algebraicCompactTensorHom H A) (fun z => (compactTensorSeminorm_apply H A z).ge)

/-- The actually induced completed map is isometric in norm, derived from its dense raw images. -/
theorem norm_compactTensorCompletionToCompacts (x : CompactTensorCompletion H A) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    ‖compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  refine (denseRange_toCompactTensorCompletion H A).induction_on x
    (isClosed_eq (continuous_compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A).norm continuous_norm) ?_
  intro z
  rw [compactTensorCompletionToCompacts_apply, norm_toCompactTensorCompletion]

/-- The completion comparison embeds its actual same-gauge carrier isometrically into original compacts. -/
theorem isometry_compactTensorCompletionToCompacts :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    Isometry (compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A) := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  exact AddMonoidHomClass.isometry_of_norm (compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A)
    (norm_compactTensorCompletionToCompacts H A)

end

end CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.AlgebraicTensorHom

/-!
# Actual coefficient-valued tensor matrix entries

Original Hilbert matrix entries are linear functionals on the full-H compact
ideal. Their neutral tensor lifts give actual A-valued entries of the original
algebraic compact action. The actual pure inner formula recovers those entries
from its original module action. A zero action has every entry zero by genuine
C-star square definiteness on the original coefficient algebra.

These are prerequisites of raw algebraic tensor injectivity, needed to build
definite cross-norm/minimum output data. No faithful representation, tensor
model, norm/equivalence certificate or nonzero-H assumption is provided.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder RightActions TensorProduct
open CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uH uA

variable (H : Type uH)
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The original full-H compact operator matrix entry as an actual complex linear functional. -/
def compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient (ξ η : H) :
    (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ where
  toFun := fun T => inner ℂ η ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)
  map_add' := fun T U => by
    change inner ℂ η ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ + (U : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) =
      inner ℂ η ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) + inner ℂ η ((U : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)
    exact _root_.inner_add_right _ _ _
  map_smul' := fun c T => by
    change inner ℂ η (c • ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)) = c * inner ℂ η ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)
    exact _root_.inner_smul_right _ _ _

/-- The linear functional has the literal original matrix entry on every compact operator. -/
theorem compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient_apply (ξ η : H)
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient H ξ η T = inner ℂ η ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) := rfl

variable (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The neutral algebraic tensor lift of the original coefficient-valued matrix entries. -/
def tensorMatrixCoefficient (ξ η : H) : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier →ₗ[ℂ] A :=
  TensorProduct.lift
    { toFun := fun a => (compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient H ξ η).smulRight a
      map_add' := fun a b => by
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro T
        change compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient H ξ η T • (a + b) =
          compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient H ξ η T • a + compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient H ξ η T • b
        exact smul_add _ _ _
      map_smul' := fun c a => by
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro T
        change compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient H ξ η T • (c • a) =
          c • (compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient H ξ η T • a)
        exact smul_comm _ _ _ }

/-- Each original tensor matrix entry has its actual elementary scalar-times-coefficient value. -/
theorem tensorMatrixCoefficient_tmul (ξ η : H) (a : A)
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    tensorMatrixCoefficient H A ξ η (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) = compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient H ξ η T • a := rfl

/-- The original module inner action recovers every actual coefficient-valued tensor matrix entry. -/
theorem rightInner_algebraicTensorOperator_pure (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier)
    (ξ η : H) (c b : A) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    rightInner (B := A) (pure H A η c) (algebraicTensorOperator H A z (pure H A ξ b)) =
      star c * (tensorMatrixCoefficient H A ξ η z * b) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a T =>
    have hact : algebraicTensorOperator H A (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) (pure H A ξ b) =
        pure H A ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) (a * b) :=
      algebraicCompactTensorHom_pure H A a T ξ b
    rw [hact, rightInner_pure, tensorMatrixCoefficient_tmul, compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient_apply]
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
  | add z w hz hw =>
    rw [map_add]
    change rightInner (B := A) (pure H A η c)
      (algebraicTensorOperator H A z (pure H A ξ b) +
        algebraicTensorOperator H A w (pure H A ξ b)) =
          star c * (tensorMatrixCoefficient H A ξ η (z + w) * b)
    rw [CStarModule.rightInner_add_right, hz, hw, map_add, add_mul, mul_add]

/-- A zero original algebraic operator action forces every actual tensor matrix entry to vanish. -/
theorem tensorMatrixCoefficient_eq_zero_of_algebraicTensorOperator_eq_zero
    (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) (ξ η : H) :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    algebraicTensorOperator H A z = 0 → tensorMatrixCoefficient H A ξ η z = 0 := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  intro hz
  let a : A := tensorMatrixCoefficient H A ξ η z
  have hab (b : A) : a * b = 0 := by
    have h := rightInner_algebraicTensorOperator_pure H A z ξ η (a * b) b
    rw [hz] at h
    change rightInner (B := A) (pure H A η (a * b)) (0 : Space H A) =
      star (a * b) * (a * b) at h
    rw [CStarModule.rightInner_zero_right] at h
    exact star_mul_self_eq_zero.mp h.symm
  exact mul_star_self_eq_zero.mp (hab (star a))

end

end CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.InducedCompletion

import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Unitization
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Mul

/-!
# The original pure cross norm of the actual compact tensor action

Original pure-vector norms and the actual action formula give a joint bound
on the Hilbert operator and coefficient left multiplication. Two weighted
operator-norm bounds recover the product of the two original norms without
division or a nonzero-space assumption. The C-star regular norm of the genuine
coefficient left multiplier supplies its original coefficient norm.

The exact induced source gauge and canonical completed source image therefore
have the original pure cross norm. This is one needed field of the genuine
cross-norm data; raw injectivity and equality with the least cross norm remain
separate minimum bridges, and terminal Takai/equivariance proofs stay open.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder RightActions TensorProduct Topology
open CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uH uA

variable (H : Type uH) (A : Type uA)
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The actual elementary tensor compact-action norm is the product of the two original norms. -/
theorem norm_algebraicCompactTensorHom_tmul (a : A)
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A;
    ‖algebraicCompactTensorHom H A (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T)‖ = ‖a‖ * ‖T‖ := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  let P : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A) :=
    (algebraicCompactTensorHom H A (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A))
  have hP : P = coefficientHom H A a * compactHilbertHom H A T := by
    change (algebraicCompactTensorHom H A (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) :
      AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A)) = coefficientHom H A a * compactHilbertHom H A T
    rw [algebraicCompactTensorHom_tmul]
    rfl
  have ha : ‖coefficientHom H A a‖ ≤ ‖a‖ := coefficientOperator_norm_le H A a
  have hT : ‖compactHilbertHom H A T‖ ≤ ‖T‖ := compactHilbertHom_norm_le H A T
  have hupper : ‖P‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖T‖ := by
    rw [hP]
    exact (norm_mul_le _ _).trans
      (mul_le_mul ha hT (_root_.norm_nonneg _) (_root_.norm_nonneg _))
  have hpoint (ξ : H) (b : A) :
      ‖(T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ * ‖a * b‖ ≤ ‖P‖ * (‖ξ‖ * ‖b‖) := by
    have haction : P (pure H A ξ b) = pure H A ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) (a * b) :=
      algebraicCompactTensorHom_pure H A a T ξ b
    calc
      ‖(T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ * ‖a * b‖ = ‖P (pure H A ξ b)‖ := by
        rw [haction, norm_pure]
      _ ≤ ‖P‖ * ‖pure H A ξ b‖ := by
        rw [AdjointableOperator.norm_eq]
        exact P.toContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (pure H A ξ b)
      _ = ‖P‖ * (‖ξ‖ * ‖b‖) := by rw [norm_pure]
  have hleft (ξ : H) : ‖(T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ * ‖a‖ ≤ ‖P‖ * ‖ξ‖ := by
    let L : A →L[ℂ] A :=
      (‖(T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ : ℂ) • ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A a
    have hL : ‖L‖ ≤ ‖P‖ * ‖ξ‖ := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound L
        (mul_nonneg (_root_.norm_nonneg P) (_root_.norm_nonneg ξ))
      intro b
      calc
        ‖L b‖ = ‖(T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ * ‖a * b‖ := by
          change ‖(‖(T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ : ℂ) • (a * b)‖ =
            ‖(T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ * ‖a * b‖
          rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg (_root_.norm_nonneg _)]
        _ ≤ (‖P‖ * ‖ξ‖) * ‖b‖ := by simpa only [mul_assoc] using hpoint ξ b
    have hnormL : ‖L‖ = ‖(T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ * ‖a‖ := by
      change ‖(‖(T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ : ℂ) • ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℂ A a‖ =
        ‖(T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ * ‖a‖
      rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg (_root_.norm_nonneg _),
        ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_mul_apply]
    exact hnormL.symm.trans_le hL
  let U : H →L[ℂ] H := (‖a‖ : ℂ) • (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
  have hU : ‖U‖ ≤ ‖P‖ := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound U (_root_.norm_nonneg P)
    intro ξ
    calc
      ‖U ξ‖ = ‖a‖ * ‖(T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖ := by
        change ‖(‖a‖ : ℂ) • ((T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)‖ = ‖a‖ * ‖(T : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ‖
        rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg (_root_.norm_nonneg _)]
      _ ≤ ‖P‖ * ‖ξ‖ := by simpa only [mul_comm] using hleft ξ
  have hnormU : ‖U‖ = ‖a‖ * ‖T‖ := by
    change ‖(‖a‖ : ℂ) • (T : H →L[ℂ] H)‖ = ‖a‖ * ‖T‖
    have hnormT : ‖(T : H →L[ℂ] H)‖ = ‖T‖ :=
      Submodule.norm_coe (s := (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier.toSubmodule) T
    rw [norm_smul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg (_root_.norm_nonneg _), hnormT]
  have hlower : ‖a‖ * ‖T‖ ≤ ‖P‖ := hnormU.symm.trans_le hU
  change ‖P‖ = ‖a‖ * ‖T‖
  exact le_antisymm hupper hlower

/-- The actual induced C-star seminorm retains the original elementary cross-norm equation. -/
theorem compactTensorSeminorm_tmul (a : A)
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    compactTensorSeminorm H A (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T) = ‖a‖ * ‖T‖ := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  exact (compactTensorSeminorm_apply H A (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T)).trans
    (norm_algebraicCompactTensorHom_tmul H A a T)

/-- The actual canonical completion image has the original product norm on every pure tensor. -/
theorem norm_toCompactTensorCompletion_tmul (a : A)
    (T : (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A;
    ‖toCompactTensorCompletion H A (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T)‖ = ‖a‖ * ‖T‖ := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactTensorCompletion H A) := compactTensorCompletionCStarAlgebra H A
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  exact (norm_toCompactTensorCompletion H A (a ⊗ₜ[ℂ] T)).trans
    (norm_algebraicCompactTensorHom_tmul H A a T)

end

end CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.MatrixCoefficients
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.InducedCompletion

import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Basis
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Basis.VectorSpace

/-!
# Raw injectivity of the actual compact tensor action

Actual tensor matrix entries separate the compact-operator coefficients of
an internally chosen algebraic source basis. The stock tensor/Finsupp basis
equivalence is an original raw vector-space normal form; no faithful Hilbert
representation or tensor model is provided. Zero actual action forces every
matrix entry zero, every compact coefficient zero and thus the raw tensor zero.

This supplies actual raw definiteness needed by genuine cross-norm DATA for
the original minimum target. The least-cross-norm comparison and terminal
Takai/equivariance theorem proofs remain separate source obligations.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder RightActions TensorProduct
open CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uH uA uI

variable (H : Type uH) (A : Type uA)
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- Original coefficient basis coordinates commute with the actual Hilbert tensor matrix entries. -/
theorem tensorMatrixCoefficient_basisCoordinate {I : Type uI} (B : Module.Basis I ℂ A) (i : I)
    (ξ η : H) (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    letI : DecidableEq I := Classical.decEq I;
    B.coord i (tensorMatrixCoefficient H A ξ η z) =
      compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient H ξ η (TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft B z i) := by
  classical
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a T =>
    rw [tensorMatrixCoefficient_tmul,
      TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft_apply_tmul_apply, map_smul, map_smul]
    change compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient H ξ η T * B.repr a i =
      B.repr a i * compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient H ξ η T
    exact mul_comm _ _
  | add z w hz hw =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, map_add, hz, hw]

/-- Vanishing of every original tensor matrix entry forces the same raw algebraic tensor to be zero. -/
theorem eq_zero_of_tensorMatrixCoefficient_eq_zero (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier)
    (hz : ∀ ξ η : H, tensorMatrixCoefficient H A ξ η z = 0) : z = 0 := by
  classical
  let B : Module.Basis (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℂ A) ℂ A := Module.Free.chooseBasis ℂ A
  let e : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier ≃ₗ[ℂ]
      Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℂ A →₀ (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier :=
    TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft B
  have hcoeff (i : Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℂ A) : e z i = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro ξ
    apply (_root_.inner_self_eq_zero (𝕜 := ℂ)).mp
    have h := tensorMatrixCoefficient_basisCoordinate H A B i ξ ((e z i : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) z
    rw [hz, map_zero] at h
    have hzero : compactOperatorMatrixCoefficient H ξ ((e z i : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) (e z i) = 0 :=
      h.symm
    exact hzero
  have he : e z = 0 := Finsupp.ext fun i => hcoeff i
  have he0 : e (0 : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) = 0 :=
    map_zero e
  exact e.injective (he.trans he0.symm)

/-- The original algebraic compact-action operator is injective on its actual raw tensor carrier. -/
theorem injective_algebraicTensorOperator :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A;
    letI : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A;
    Function.Injective (algebraicTensorOperator H A) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  intro z w hzw
  have hzero : algebraicTensorOperator H A (z - w) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hzw, sub_self]
  have hm : ∀ ξ η : H, tensorMatrixCoefficient H A ξ η (z - w) = 0 := fun ξ η =>
    tensorMatrixCoefficient_eq_zero_of_algebraicTensorOperator_eq_zero H A (z - w) ξ η hzero
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eq_zero_of_tensorMatrixCoefficient_eq_zero H A (z - w) hm)

/-- The actual algebraic A tensor K(full H) compact-module star hom is genuinely raw-injective. -/
theorem injective_algebraicCompactTensorHom : Function.Injective (algebraicCompactTensorHom H A) := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instComplexModule H
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instNormedSpace H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.instOppositeSMul H
  let : @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H)
      (ScalarRight.instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace := by
    rw [ScalarRight.normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace]
    exact (ScalarRight.completeSpace_iff H).mpr inferInstance
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := ScalarRight.cStarModule H
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)) :=
    radicalRightAction (E₁ := ScalarRight H) (scalarSelfHom A)
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (Space H A) := spaceNormedAddCommGroup H A
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (Space H A) := spaceNormedSpace H A
  let : SMul Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceOppositeSMul H A
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ (Space H A) := spaceCStarModule H A
  intro z w hzw
  apply injective_algebraicTensorOperator H A
  exact congrArg (fun T : CompactAlgebra H A =>
    (T : AdjointableOperator.End A (Space H A))) hzw

/-- The actually induced C-star seminorm is definite on the original raw compact tensor. -/
theorem compactTensorSeminorm_eq_zero_iff (z : A ⊗[ℂ] (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier) :
    compactTensorSeminorm H A z = 0 ↔ z = 0 := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactAlgebra H A) := compactCStarAlgebra H A
  rw [compactTensorSeminorm_apply, norm_eq_zero]
  exact map_eq_zero_iff (algebraicCompactTensorHom H A) (injective_algebraicCompactTensorHom H A)

end

end CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Compact
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Basic

/-!
# The scalar representation on a nonunital coefficient self module

Scalar multiplication by c is c times the genuine identity adjointable
endomorphism of A. The coefficient algebra need not have an identity.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

noncomputable section

universe uA

/-- The original complex scalar action on the coefficient self module,
with its canonical opposite spectral order and Hilbert-module data. -/
def scalarSelfHom (A : Type uA) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    letI : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ℂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End A A := by
  let : PartialOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Aᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Aᵐᵒᵖ A := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  exact
    { toFun := fun c => c • (1 : AdjointableOperator.End A A)
      map_zero' := zero_smul ℂ (1 : AdjointableOperator.End A A)
      map_add' := fun c d => add_smul c d (1 : AdjointableOperator.End A A)
      map_mul' := fun c d => by
        rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, one_mul, smul_smul]
      map_smul' := fun c d => by
        change (c * d) • (1 : AdjointableOperator.End A A) =
          c • (d • (1 : AdjointableOperator.End A A))
        exact (smul_smul c d (1 : AdjointableOperator.End A A)).symm
      map_star' := fun c => by
        rw [star_smul, star_one] }

end

end CStarModule.HilbertAmplification

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.CanonicalBaseChange

/-!
# Actual nonunital coefficient base change of Hilbert modules

The carrier is the existing balanced quotient, radical quotient and stock
completion for E tensor the target coefficient self-module. The existing
full model, canonical vector map, unital End map and real module-compact
transport are used directly, with the original coefficient orders retained.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra CStarModule.Right RightActions

namespace CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.BaseChange

universe uB uC uE

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
  [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {C : Type uC} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C]
  [PartialOrder Cᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing Cᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
  [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E] [CompleteSpace E]

/-- The actual left regular target self-module action along the original coefficient hom. -/
def coefficientAction (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End C C :=
  (AdjointableOperator.leftRegular (B := C)).comp f

omit [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ] in
/-- The same original left coefficient value, without a unit in either algebra. -/
@[simp]
theorem coefficientAction_apply (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (b : B) (c : C) :
    coefficientAction f b c = f b * c := rfl

/-- The genuine existing completed tensor; its carrier universe is max uE uC. -/
abbrev Carrier (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E) (coefficientAction f)

/-- The original quotient/completion normed-group dictionary. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def normedAddCommGroup (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) : NormedAddCommGroup (Carrier (E := E) f) := by
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E) (coefficientAction f)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (coefficientAction f)
  exact inferInstance

attribute [local instance] normedAddCommGroup

/-- The original completed complex-space dictionary. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def normedSpace (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) : NormedSpace ℂ (Carrier (E := E) f) := by
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E) (coefficientAction f)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (coefficientAction f)
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E) (coefficientAction f)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (coefficientAction f)
  exact inferInstance

attribute [local instance] normedSpace

/-- The original completed right target-coefficient action. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def rightAction (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) : SMul Cᵐᵒᵖ (Carrier (E := E) f) := by
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E) (coefficientAction f)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (coefficientAction f)
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E) (coefficientAction f)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (coefficientAction f)
  letI : SMul Cᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E) (coefficientAction f)) :=
    radicalRightAction (coefficientAction f)
  exact inferInstance

attribute [local instance] rightAction

/-- The genuine completed Hilbert-module dictionary, on the same original norm and action. -/
@[instance_reducible]
def cstarModule (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) : CStarModule Cᵐᵒᵖ (Carrier (E := E) f) := by
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E) (coefficientAction f)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (coefficientAction f)
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E) (coefficientAction f)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (coefficientAction f)
  letI : SMul Cᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E) (coefficientAction f)) :=
    radicalRightAction (coefficientAction f)
  exact completedCStarModule (coefficientAction f)

attribute [local instance] cstarModule

/-- The actual two-quotient/completion pure tensor map. -/
def pure (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (x : E) (c : C) : Carrier (E := E) f :=
  completedPure (coefficientAction f) x c

/-- Every full model clause is proved for the same actual completed tensor. -/
theorem isModel (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) : IsModel (coefficientAction f) (pure (E := E) f) := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E) (coefficientAction f)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup (coefficientAction f)
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E) (coefficientAction f)) :=
    radicalTensorNormedSpace (coefficientAction f)
  let : SMul Cᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E) (coefficientAction f)) :=
    radicalRightAction (coefficientAction f)
  exact completed_isModel (coefficientAction f)

/-- Pure coefficient inners are the actual original Gram formula along the given hom. -/
theorem pure_inner (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (x y : E) (c d : C) :
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := C) (pure f x c) (pure f y d) =
      star c * f (CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x y) * d := by
  simpa only [coefficientAction_apply, CStarModule.Right.rightInner_self, mul_assoc] using
    (isModel (E := E) f).2.2.2.2.2.2.1 x y c d

/-- The genuine canonical vector map, defined through strict nonunital factorization. -/
def canonicalMap (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) : E →L[ℂ] Carrier (E := E) f :=
  IsModel.canonicalBaseChangeMap (isModel (E := E) f)

/-- The exact original coefficient-inner formula of the canonical vector map. -/
@[simp]
theorem canonicalMap_inner (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (x y : E) :
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := C) (canonicalMap f x) (canonicalMap f y) =
      f (CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x y) :=
  IsModel.canonicalBaseChangeMap_inner (isModel (E := E) f) x y

/-- The actual canonical vector map is contractive; no coefficient injectivity is assumed. -/
theorem norm_canonicalMap_le (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (x : E) : ‖canonicalMap f x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ :=
  IsModel.norm_canonicalBaseChangeMap_le (isModel (E := E) f) x

/-- Canonical vectors preserve the original right action along the given hom. -/
@[simp]
theorem canonicalMap_right_smul (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (x : E) (b : B) :
    canonicalMap f (x <• b) = canonicalMap f x <• f b :=
  IsModel.canonicalBaseChangeMap_right_smul (isModel (E := E) f) x b

/-- Pure tensors are exactly the original canonical images acted on by target coefficients. -/
@[simp]
theorem canonicalMap_pure (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (x : E) (c : C) :
    canonicalMap f x <• c = pure f x c :=
  IsModel.canonicalBaseChangeMap_pure (isModel (E := E) f) x c

/-- The same full model constructs the genuine unital End transport. -/
def endomorphismMap (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) : AdjointableOperator.End B E →⋆ₐ[ℂ]
    AdjointableOperator.End C (Carrier (E := E) f) :=
  IsModel.mapLeftStarAlgHom (isModel (E := E) f)

/-- Every original operator has its actual pure-tensor value. -/
@[simp]
theorem endomorphismMap_pure (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (T : AdjointableOperator.End B E)
    (x : E) (c : C) : endomorphismMap f T (pure f x c) = pure f (T x) c :=
  IsModel.mapLeftStarAlgHom_pure (isModel (E := E) f) T x c

/-- Every original operator intertwines the actual canonical vector map. -/
@[simp]
theorem endomorphismMap_canonicalMap (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (T : AdjointableOperator.End B E)
    (x : E) : endomorphismMap f T (canonicalMap f x) = canonicalMap f (T x) :=
  IsModel.mapLeftStarAlgHom_canonicalBaseChangeMap (isModel (E := E) f) T x

/-- The real original rank-one maps to the rank-one of actual canonical vector images. -/
theorem endomorphismMap_rankOne (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) (x y : E) :
    endomorphismMap f (AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := B) x y) =
      AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := C) (canonicalMap f x) (canonicalMap f y) :=
  IsModel.mapLeftStarAlgHom_rankOne_baseChange (isModel (E := E) f) x y

/-- Actual module compacts are preserved for any original coefficient hom, including zero. -/
theorem endomorphismMap_mem_compact (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C) {T : AdjointableOperator.End B E}
    (hT : T ∈ AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule (B := B) (E := E) (F := E)) :
    endomorphismMap f T ∈ AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule
      (B := C) (E := Carrier (E := E) f) (F := Carrier (E := E) f) :=
  IsModel.mapLeftStarAlgHom_mem_compact_baseChange (isModel (E := E) f) hT

/-- Countable generation is genuinely derived without a target-coefficient CG premise. -/
theorem countablyGenerated (f : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C)
    (hE : CStarModule.IsCountablyGenerated (B := B) (E := E)) :
    CStarModule.IsCountablyGenerated (B := C) (E := Carrier (E := E) f) :=
  IsModel.countablyGenerated_baseChange (isModel (E := E) f) hE

end CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.BaseChange

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Generation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.Bounds
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.Creation
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Pairing

/-!
# Countable generation of an actual internal tensor

Both factors are arbitrary complete right Hilbert modules. The proof uses
their original right coefficient spans and the model's actual creation maps,
balancing, coefficient action and dense pure span. No countable generation
of either coefficient algebra or nondegeneracy of the representation is used.

This is a general counterpart to the existing coefficient-base-change theorem;
the latter only treats a second factor equal to the coefficient algebra.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped RightActions

namespace CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.IsModel

universe uD uB uE1 uE2 uX

variable {D : Type uD} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra D]
  [PartialOrder Dᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
  [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {E1 : Type uE1} [NormedAddCommGroup E1] [NormedSpace ℂ E1]
  [SMul Dᵐᵒᵖ E1] [CStarModule Dᵐᵒᵖ E1] [CompleteSpace E1]
variable {E2 : Type uE2} [NormedAddCommGroup E2] [NormedSpace ℂ E2]
  [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E2] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E2] [CompleteSpace E2]
variable {X : Type uX} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℂ X]
  [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ X] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ X] [CompleteSpace X]
variable {φ : D →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End B E2}
variable {pure : E1 → E2 → X}

/-- The original countable right spans of both factors give one countable
right span in any actual internal-tensor model, including a zero model. -/
theorem countablyGenerated
    (hX : CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.IsModel φ pure)
    (h1 : CStarModule.IsCountablyGenerated (B := D) (E := E1))
    (h2 : CStarModule.IsCountablyGenerated (B := B) (E := E2)) :
    CStarModule.IsCountablyGenerated (B := B) (E := X) := by
  classical
  rcases h1 with ⟨s1, hs1⟩
  rcases h2 with ⟨s2, hs2⟩
  let z : ℕ → X := fun n => pure (s1 (Nat.unpair n).1) (s2 (Nat.unpair n).2)
  let T : Submodule ℂ X := Submodule.span ℂ
    (Set.range fun p : ℕ × B => z p.1 <• p.2)
  let S : Submodule ℂ X := T.topologicalClosure
  have hSclosed : IsClosed (S : Set X) := T.isClosed_topologicalClosure
  let D1 : Submodule ℂ E1 := Submodule.span ℂ
    (Set.range fun p : ℕ × D => s1 p.1 <• p.2)
  let D2 : Submodule ℂ E2 := Submodule.span ℂ
    (Set.range fun p : ℕ × B => s2 p.1 <• p.2)
  have hD1top : D1.topologicalClosure = ⊤ :=
    Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mp hs1
  have hD2top : D2.topologicalClosure = ⊤ :=
    Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mp hs2
  have hgenerator (n m : ℕ) (b : B) :
      pure (s1 n) (s2 m <• b) ∈ S := by
    rw [hX.2.2.2.2.2.1]
    have hpair : pure (s1 n) (s2 m) = z (Nat.pair n m) := by
      simp only [z, Nat.unpair_pair]
    rw [hpair]
    exact T.le_topologicalClosure (Submodule.subset_span ⟨(Nat.pair n m, b), rfl⟩)
  have hfixed (n : ℕ) (y : E2) : pure (s1 n) y ∈ S := by
    let L : E2 →L[ℂ] X :=
      (CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.creationOnModel φ pure hX (s1 n)).toContinuousLinearMap
    let U : Submodule ℂ E2 := S.comap L.toLinearMap
    have hUclosed : IsClosed (U : Set E2) := by
      change IsClosed (L ⁻¹' (S : Set X))
      exact hSclosed.preimage L.continuous
    have hD2U : D2 ≤ U := by
      apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
      rintro _ ⟨⟨m, b⟩, rfl⟩
      apply Submodule.mem_comap.mpr
      change CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.creationOnModel φ pure hX (s1 n)
        (s2 m <• b) ∈ S
      rw [CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.creationOnModel_apply]
      exact hgenerator n m b
    have hUtop : (⊤ : Submodule ℂ E2) ≤ U := by
      rw [← hD2top]
      exact D2.topologicalClosure_minimal hD2U hUclosed
    have hy : L y ∈ S := Submodule.mem_comap.mp (hUtop (by trivial))
    change CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.creationOnModel φ pure hX (s1 n) y ∈ S at hy
    simpa only [CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.creationOnModel_apply] using hy
  have hpure (x : E1) (y : E2) : pure x y ∈ S := by
    let L : E1 →L[ℂ] X := hX.pureLeftCLM y
    let U : Submodule ℂ E1 := S.comap L.toLinearMap
    have hUclosed : IsClosed (U : Set E1) := by
      change IsClosed (L ⁻¹' (S : Set X))
      exact hSclosed.preimage L.continuous
    have hD1U : D1 ≤ U := by
      apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
      rintro _ ⟨⟨n, d⟩, rfl⟩
      apply Submodule.mem_comap.mpr
      change hX.pureLeftCLM y (s1 n <• d) ∈ S
      rw [pureLeftCLM_apply, hX.2.2.2.2.1]
      exact hfixed n (φ d y)
    have hUtop : (⊤ : Submodule ℂ E1) ≤ U := by
      rw [← hD1top]
      exact D1.topologicalClosure_minimal hD1U hUclosed
    have hx : L x ∈ S := Submodule.mem_comap.mp (hUtop (by trivial))
    simpa only [L, pureLeftCLM_apply] using hx
  let P : Submodule ℂ X := Submodule.span ℂ
    (Set.range fun p : E1 × E2 => pure p.1 p.2)
  have hPS : P ≤ S := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hpure x y
  have hPtop : P.topologicalClosure = ⊤ :=
    Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mp hX.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have hStop : S = ⊤ := by
    apply le_antisymm le_top
    rw [← hPtop]
    exact P.topologicalClosure_minimal hPS hSclosed
  exact ⟨z, Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mpr hStop⟩

end CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.IsModel

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.Iterated
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.Grading
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.GradedLeft

/-!
# The actual graded induced coefficient action on an inner completed tensor

The underlying hom is the existing literal inducedCompletedLeftAction.
The grading is the computed original completed tensor grading. The shared
graded left constructor supplies covariance; a pure-action comparison retains
the original ordinary operator DATA. No graded output map or action is supplied.

This is the strict constructor needed to state Blackadar18.3.4(f) and
18.3.5 on the actual two reassociated completed tensor carriers. It has no
countability, source connection or associator hypothesis.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped RightActions

namespace CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

universe uD1 uD2 uB uE2 uE3

variable {D1 : Type uD1} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra D1]
  [PartialOrder D1ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing D1ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {D2 : Type uD2} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra D2]
  [PartialOrder D2ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing D2ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
  [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {E2 : Type uE2} [NormedAddCommGroup E2] [NormedSpace ℂ E2]
  [SMul D2ᵐᵒᵖ E2] [CStarModule D2ᵐᵒᵖ E2] [CompleteSpace E2]
variable {E3 : Type uE3} [NormedAddCommGroup E3] [NormedSpace ℂ E3]
  [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E3] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E3] [CompleteSpace E3]
variable {gammaD1 : CStarGrading D1} {gammaD2 : CStarGrading D2} {gammaB : CStarGrading B}

/-- Reuse the shared graded left map for the same computed induced coefficient action. -/
def inducedCompletedGradedLeftAction
    (delta2 : CStarModuleGrading gammaD2 E2) (delta3 : CStarModuleGrading gammaB E3)
    (phi : CStarGrading.Hom gammaD1 delta2.operatorGrading)
    (chi : CStarGrading.Hom gammaD2 delta3.operatorGrading) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      radicalTensorNormedSpace chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    letI : SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      radicalRightAction chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      completedCStarModule chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    CStarGrading.Hom gammaD1 (Grading.completedGrading delta2 delta3 chi).operatorGrading := by
  let psi := chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) psi) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup psi
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) psi) := radicalTensorNormedSpace psi
  letI : SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) psi) := radicalRightAction psi
  letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E2) psi) := completedCStarModule psi
  let delta23 := Grading.completedGrading delta2 delta3 chi
  let gradedAction := CStarGrading.Hom.comp
    (IsModel.gradedLeftHom (completed_isModel (E₁ := E2) psi)
      delta2 delta3 delta23
      (Grading.completedGrading_generator_pure delta2 delta3 chi)) phi
  have hAction : gradedAction.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom =
      inducedCompletedLeftAction phi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom psi := by
    change (IsModel.mapLeftStarAlgHom (completed_isModel (E₁ := E2) psi)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp
        phi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom =
      (completedLeftStarAlgHom (E₁ := E2) psi).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp phi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    rw [CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.mapLeftStarAlgHom_completed]
  refine
    { toNonUnitalStarAlgHom := inducedCompletedLeftAction phi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom psi
      equivariant' := ?_ }
  intro n b
  change inducedCompletedLeftAction phi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom psi
      (PointNormCStarAddAction.aut gammaD1 n.toAdd b) =
    PointNormCStarAddAction.aut delta23.operatorGrading n.toAdd
      (inducedCompletedLeftAction phi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom psi b)
  have h := gradedAction.equivariant' n b
  change gradedAction.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
      (PointNormCStarAddAction.aut gammaD1 n.toAdd b) =
    PointNormCStarAddAction.aut delta23.operatorGrading n.toAdd
      (gradedAction.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom b) at h
  simpa only [hAction] using h

omit [PartialOrder D1ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing D1ᵐᵒᵖ] in
/-- Forgetting the grading returns exactly the existing computed coefficient action. -/
@[simp]
theorem inducedCompletedGradedLeftAction_toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    (delta2 : CStarModuleGrading gammaD2 E2) (delta3 : CStarModuleGrading gammaB E3)
    (phi : CStarGrading.Hom gammaD1 delta2.operatorGrading)
    (chi : CStarGrading.Hom gammaD2 delta3.operatorGrading) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      radicalTensorNormedSpace chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    letI : SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      radicalRightAction chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      completedCStarModule chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    (inducedCompletedGradedLeftAction delta2 delta3 phi chi).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom =
      inducedCompletedLeftAction phi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom := rfl

omit [PartialOrder D1ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing D1ᵐᵒᵖ] in
/-- The graded induced action has the original first-factor value on every actual pure tensor. -/
@[simp]
theorem inducedCompletedGradedLeftAction_pure
    (delta2 : CStarModuleGrading gammaD2 E2) (delta3 : CStarModuleGrading gammaB E3)
    (phi : CStarGrading.Hom gammaD1 delta2.operatorGrading)
    (chi : CStarGrading.Hom gammaD2 delta3.operatorGrading) (b : D1) (y : E2) (z : E3) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      radicalTensorNormedSpace chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    letI : SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      radicalRightAction chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      completedCStarModule chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    inducedCompletedGradedLeftAction delta2 delta3 phi chi b (completedPure chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom y z) =
      completedPure chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom (phi b y) z :=
  by
    let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      radicalTensorNormedSpace chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    let : SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      radicalRightAction chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E2) chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
      completedCStarModule chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    have hview (a : D1) : phi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom a = phi a := rfl
    have hwrapped (a : D1) : inducedCompletedGradedLeftAction delta2 delta3 phi chi a =
        (inducedCompletedGradedLeftAction delta2 delta3 phi chi).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom a := rfl
    rw [hwrapped, inducedCompletedGradedLeftAction_toNonUnitalStarAlgHom]
    simpa only [hview] using
      inducedCompletedLeftAction_completedPure phi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom chi.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom b y z

end CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct
