module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.MapLeft.Functoriality

/-!
# Actual induced actions and right-associated completed internal tensors

Two original nonunital left actions define the right-associated interior
tensor using the existing literal balanced/radical/completion model. The
inner tensor's left action is computed by the already constructed completed
first-factor star homomorphism composed with the original coefficient map.

No norm, module, output IsModel, reassociation unitary or desired tensor
certificate is supplied. Coefficient algebras and the three original complete
fibres retain independent universes, their given opposite orders and actions.
Zero algebras/modules/actions are allowed; neither left action is assumed
faithful or nondegenerate. Full source associativity and the original Lance
Proposition4.5 balanced-null identity remain separate open proof boundaries.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped RightActions

namespace CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

universe uB₁ uB₂ uB₃ uE₁ uE₂ uE₃

variable {B₁ : Type uB₁} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₁]
  [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₁ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {B₂ : Type uB₂} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₂]
  [PartialOrder B₂ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₂ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {B₃ : Type uB₃} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₃]
  [PartialOrder B₃ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₃ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {E₂ : Type uE₂} [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℂ E₂]
  [SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ E₂] [CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ E₂] [CompleteSpace E₂]
variable {E₃ : Type uE₃} [NormedAddCommGroup E₃] [NormedSpace ℂ E₃]
  [SMul B₃ᵐᵒᵖ E₃] [CStarModule B₃ᵐᵒᵖ E₃] [CompleteSpace E₃]

/-- The original first coefficient acts on the actual inner completed tensor by the computed left functor. -/
def inducedCompletedLeftAction
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (χ : B₂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₃ E₃) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ;
    letI : SMul B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalRightAction χ;
    letI : CStarModule B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := completedCStarModule χ;
    B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₃ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := by
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ
  letI : SMul B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalRightAction χ
  letI : CStarModule B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := completedCStarModule χ
  exact (completedLeftStarAlgHom (E₁ := E₂) χ).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp φ

omit [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] in
/-- The induced coefficient value is the completed first-factor image. -/
theorem inducedCompletedLeftAction_apply
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (χ : B₂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₃ E₃) (b : B₁) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ;
    letI : SMul B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalRightAction χ;
    letI : CStarModule B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := completedCStarModule χ;
    inducedCompletedLeftAction φ χ b = completedLeftStarAlgHom χ (φ b) := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ
  let : SMul B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalRightAction χ
  let : CStarModule B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := completedCStarModule χ
  rfl

omit [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] in
/-- The induced action has its original first-factor value on a completed pure tensor. -/
@[simp]
theorem inducedCompletedLeftAction_completedPure
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (χ : B₂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₃ E₃) (b : B₁) (y : E₂) (z : E₃) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ;
    letI : SMul B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalRightAction χ;
    letI : CStarModule B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := completedCStarModule χ;
    inducedCompletedLeftAction φ χ b (completedPure χ y z) = completedPure χ (φ b y) z := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ
  let : SMul B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalRightAction χ
  let : CStarModule B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := completedCStarModule χ
  change completedLeftStarAlgHom χ (φ b) (completedPure χ y z) = completedPure χ (φ b y) z
  exact completedLeftStarAlgHom_pure χ (φ b) y z

omit [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] in
/-- The zero first coefficient homomorphism has the actual zero induced homomorphism. -/
@[simp]
theorem inducedCompletedLeftAction_zero
    (χ : B₂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₃ E₃) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ;
    letI : SMul B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalRightAction χ;
    letI : CStarModule B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := completedCStarModule χ;
    inducedCompletedLeftAction (0 : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂) χ = 0 := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ
  let : SMul B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalRightAction χ
  let : CStarModule B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := completedCStarModule χ
  apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
  intro b
  change completedLeftStarAlgHom χ (0 : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂) = 0
  exact map_zero (completedLeftStarAlgHom χ)

variable {E₁ : Type uE₁} [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℂ E₁]
  [SMul B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] [CStarModule B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] [CompleteSpace E₁]

/-- The literal completed tensor with the original inner tensor's computed first-coefficient action. -/
abbrev RightAssociatedCompletedTensor
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (χ : B₂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₃ E₃) : Type (max uE₁ uE₂ uE₃) :=
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ
  letI : SMul B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := radicalRightAction χ
  letI : CStarModule B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₂) χ) := completedCStarModule χ
  CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) (inducedCompletedLeftAction φ χ)

/-- The actual right-associated pure triple passes through both original tensor quotient/completion maps. -/
def rightAssociatedCompletedPure
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (χ : B₂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₃ E₃)

  change completedPure η x (completedPure χ (y <• b) z) =

/-- The final original coefficient acts through the completed tensor right action. -/

/-!
# The actual left-associated completed internal tensor

The first literal completed tensor retains its existing norm, right action
and C-star module dictionaries. Applying the second original left action to
that original complete module gives the left-associated carrier and pure
triple. Both stages are the existing actual quotient/completion construction.

No output model, norm, completeness or associator certificate is an input.
All three coefficient and fibre universes, nonunital algebras, original
complete modules, given opposite orders and zero/degenerate actions remain.
Full source reassociation and the original Lance balanced-null identity are
separate whole-open theorem proof boundaries.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped RightActions

namespace CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

universe uB₁ uB₂ uB₃ uE₁ uE₂ uE₃

variable {B₁ : Type uB₁} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₁]
  [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₁ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {B₂ : Type uB₂} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₂]
  [PartialOrder B₂ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₂ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {B₃ : Type uB₃} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₃]
  [PartialOrder B₃ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₃ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {E₁ : Type uE₁} [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℂ E₁]
  [SMul B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] [CStarModule B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] [CompleteSpace E₁]
variable {E₂ : Type uE₂} [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℂ E₂]
  [SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ E₂] [CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ E₂] [CompleteSpace E₂]
variable {E₃ : Type uE₃} [NormedAddCommGroup E₃] [NormedSpace ℂ E₃]

/-- The literal left-associated completed tensor with both original coefficient actions. -/
abbrev LeftAssociatedCompletedTensor
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (χ : B₂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₃ E₃) : Type (max uE₁ uE₂ uE₃) :=
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  letI : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ
  letI : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ
  CompletedTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ

/-- The original left-associated triple uses the first completed pure tensor as the second tensor's first vector. -/
def leftAssociatedCompletedPure
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (χ : B₂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₃ E₃)
    (x : E₁) (y : E₂) (z : E₃) : LeftAssociatedCompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ χ := by
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  letI : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ
  letI : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ
  exact completedPure χ (completedPure φ x y) z

/-- The actual left-associated triple is the nested original completed pure map. -/
theorem leftAssociatedCompletedPure_apply
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)

    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ;

  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ

  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ

    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)

    leftAssociatedCompletedPure φ χ (x + x') y z =
      leftAssociatedCompletedPure φ χ x y z + leftAssociatedCompletedPure φ χ x' y z := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ

  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ

  exact completedPure_add_left χ (completedPure φ x y) (completedPure φ x' y) z

  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  let : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ
  let : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ
  simpa only [zero_smul] using
    leftAssociatedCompletedPure_smul_left φ χ (0 : ℂ) (0 : E₁) y z

/-- A zero middle fibre vector has the actual zero completed pure value. -/
@[simp]
theorem leftAssociatedCompletedPure_zero_middle
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (χ : B₂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₃ E₃) (x : E₁) (z : E₃) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    letI : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ;
    letI : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ;
    leftAssociatedCompletedPure φ χ x (0 : E₂) z = 0 := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  let : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ
  let : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ
  simpa only [zero_smul] using
    leftAssociatedCompletedPure_smul_middle φ χ (0 : ℂ) x (0 : E₂) z

/-- A zero right fibre vector has the actual zero completed pure value. -/
@[simp]
theorem leftAssociatedCompletedPure_zero_right
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (χ : B₂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₃ E₃) (x : E₁) (y : E₂) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    letI : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ;
    letI : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ;
    leftAssociatedCompletedPure φ χ x y (0 : E₃) = 0 := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  let : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ
  let : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ
  simpa only [zero_smul] using
    leftAssociatedCompletedPure_smul_right φ χ (0 : ℂ) x y (0 : E₃)

/-- The first original coefficient balances through the given first left action. -/
@[simp]
theorem leftAssociatedCompletedPure_balance_left
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (χ : B₂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₃ E₃) (x : E₁) (b : B₁) (y : E₂) (z : E₃) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    letI : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ;
    letI : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ;
    leftAssociatedCompletedPure φ χ (x <• b) y z = leftAssociatedCompletedPure φ χ x (φ b y) z := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  let : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ
  let : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ
  change completedPure χ (completedPure φ (x <• b) y) z =
    completedPure χ (completedPure φ x (φ b y)) z
  rw [completedPure_balance]

/-- The second original coefficient balances through the given second left action. -/
@[simp]
theorem leftAssociatedCompletedPure_balance_middle
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (χ : B₂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₃ E₃) (x : E₁) (y : E₂) (b : B₂) (z : E₃) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    letI : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ;
    letI : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ;
    leftAssociatedCompletedPure φ χ x (y <• b) z = leftAssociatedCompletedPure φ χ x y (χ b z) := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  let : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ
  let : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ
  change completedPure χ (completedPure φ x (y <• b)) z =
    completedPure χ (completedPure φ x y) (χ b z)
  rw [completedPure_right_smul, completedPure_balance]

/-- The final original coefficient acts through the completed tensor right action. -/
@[simp]
theorem leftAssociatedCompletedPure_right_smul
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (χ : B₂ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₃ E₃) (x : E₁) (y : E₂) (z : E₃) (b : B₃) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    letI : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ;
    letI : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ;
    letI : SMul B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) :=
      radicalRightAction χ;
    leftAssociatedCompletedPure φ χ x y (z <• b) = leftAssociatedCompletedPure φ χ x y z <• b := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  let : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ
  let : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ
  let : SMul B₃ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) χ) :=
    radicalRightAction χ
  change completedPure χ (completedPure φ x y) (z <• b) =
    completedPure χ (completedPure φ x y) z <• b
  exact completedPure_right_smul χ (completedPure φ x y) z b

end CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

Author: @toskua, Avocado

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.Radical

/-!
# Commuting second-factor maps on actual internal tensors

An adjointable map on the second factor that commutes with the given coefficient
representation induces maps on the original complex, balanced and radical
tensor carriers. Its genuine adjoint supplies the paired radical map.

This is the algebraic prerequisite for the coefficient action on the original
Hilbert amplification in Blackadar, K-Theory for Operator Algebras, 10.1.2.
The second-factor norm bound and completed operator are separate constructions.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped TensorProduct RightActions

namespace CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

universe uB₁ uB₂ uE₁ uE₂

variable {B₁ : Type uB₁} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₁] [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {B₂ : Type uB₂} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₂] [PartialOrder B₂ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {E₁ : Type uE₁} [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℂ E₁]
  [SMul B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] [CStarModule B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁]
variable {E₂ : Type uE₂} [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℂ E₂]
  [SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ E₂] [CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ E₂]

/-- The original complex tensor map induced by the actual second-factor map. -/
def rawRightFactorMap (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂) :
    AlgebraicTensor E₁ E₂ →ₗ[ℂ] AlgebraicTensor E₁ E₂ :=
  TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id S.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap

/-- The actual raw map changes only the original second factor. -/
@[simp]
theorem rawRightFactorMap_tmul (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (x : E₁) (y : E₂) :
    rawRightFactorMap S (x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] y) = x ⊗ₜ[ℂ] (S y) := by
  simp only [rawRightFactorMap, TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.id_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, AdjointableOperator.coe_toContinuousLinearMap]

omit [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] in
/-- Commutation with a star representation also holds for the genuine adjoint. -/
theorem rightFactorCommutant_adjoint
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) :
    ∀ b : B₁, Commute S.adjointOperator (φ b) := by
  intro b
  change Commute (star S) (φ b)
  simpa only [map_star, star_star] using (hComm (star b)).star_star

omit [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] in
private theorem rightFactorCommutant_apply
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) (b : B₁) (y : E₂) :
    S (φ b y) = φ b (S y) := by
  simpa only [AdjointableOperator.mul_apply] using
    congrArg (fun T : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂ => T y) (hComm b).eq

omit [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [CStarModule B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] in
/-- Coefficient commutation preserves the literal balancing span. -/
theorem balancingSpan_rawRightFactorMap
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) :
    balancingSpan (E₁ := E₁) φ ≤
      (balancingSpan (E₁ := E₁) φ).comap (rawRightFactorMap S) := by
  apply Submodule.span_le.2
  rintro _ ⟨⟨x, b, y⟩, rfl⟩
  change rawRightFactorMap S (balanceRelation φ x b y) ∈ balancingSpan (E₁ := E₁) φ
  simpa only [balanceRelation, map_sub, rawRightFactorMap_tmul,
    rightFactorCommutant_apply φ S hComm] using balanceRelation_mem φ x b (S y)

/-- The actual second-factor adjoint gives the original raw-inner identity. -/
theorem rawRightFactorMap_inner_adjoint
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b))
    (z w : AlgebraicTensor E₁ E₂) :
    rawInner φ (rawRightFactorMap S z) w =
      rawInner φ z (rawRightFactorMap S.adjointOperator w) := by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x u =>
    induction w using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul y v =>
      simp only [rawRightFactorMap_tmul, rawInner_tmul_tmul,
        AdjointableOperator.adjoint_inner]
      rw [← AdjointableOperator.adjointOperator_apply,
        rightFactorCommutant_apply φ S.adjointOperator
          (rightFactorCommutant_adjoint φ S hComm)]
    | add w w' hw hw' => simp only [map_add, hw, hw']
  | add z z' hz hz' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hz, hz']

/-- The second-factor map retains the original right coefficient action. -/
theorem rawRightFactorMap_rawRightSMul
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂) (b : B₂)
    (z : AlgebraicTensor E₁ E₂) :
    rawRightFactorMap S (rawRightSMul b z) =
      rawRightSMul b (rawRightFactorMap S z) := by
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y =>
    simp only [rawRightSMul_tmul, rawRightFactorMap_tmul,
      AdjointableOperator.map_right_smul]
  | add z w hz hw => simp only [map_add, hz, hw]

/-- The computed second-factor map on the genuine balanced quotient. -/
def balancedRightFactorMap
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) :
    BalancedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ →ₗ[ℂ] BalancedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ :=
  (balancingSpan (E₁ := E₁) φ).mapQ (balancingSpan (E₁ := E₁) φ)
    (rawRightFactorMap S) (balancingSpan_rawRightFactorMap φ S hComm)

omit [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [CStarModule B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] in
/-- Every original raw representative has its literal descended image. -/
theorem balancedRightFactorMap_mkQ
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) (z : AlgebraicTensor E₁ E₂) :
    balancedRightFactorMap φ S hComm ((balancingSpan (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ z) =
      (balancingSpan (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ (rawRightFactorMap S z) := by
  simp only [balancedRightFactorMap, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.mapQ_apply]

omit [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [CStarModule B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] in
/-- Balanced pure tensors retain the original second-factor formula. -/
@[simp]
theorem balancedRightFactorMap_pure
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) (x : E₁) (y : E₂) :
    balancedRightFactorMap φ S hComm (balancedPure φ x y) =
      balancedPure φ x (S y) := by
  simp only [balancedPure, balancedRightFactorMap_mkQ, rawRightFactorMap_tmul]

/-- Both balanced descents retain the actual paired-adjoint equation. -/
theorem balancedRightFactorMap_inner_adjoint
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b))
    (z w : BalancedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :
    balancedInner φ (balancedRightFactorMap φ S hComm z) w =
      balancedInner φ z (balancedRightFactorMap φ S.adjointOperator
        (rightFactorCommutant_adjoint φ S hComm) w) := by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (balancingSpan (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ_surjective z
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := (balancingSpan (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ_surjective w
  simpa only [balancedRightFactorMap_mkQ, balancedInner_mkQ_mkQ] using
    rawRightFactorMap_inner_adjoint φ S hComm z w

omit [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [CStarModule B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] in
/-- The original right coefficient action commutes with the balanced map. -/
theorem balancedRightFactorMap_balancedRightSMul
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) (b : B₂)
    (z : BalancedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :
    balancedRightFactorMap φ S hComm (balancedRightSMul φ b z) =
      balancedRightSMul φ b (balancedRightFactorMap φ S hComm z) := by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (balancingSpan (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ_surjective z
  simpa only [balancedRightFactorMap_mkQ, balancedRightSMul_mkQ] using
    congrArg (balancingSpan (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ
      (rawRightFactorMap_rawRightSMul S b z)

/-- The proved actual adjoint identity preserves the original radical. -/
theorem radicalSpace_balancedRightFactorMap
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) :
    radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ ≤
      (radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).comap (balancedRightFactorMap φ S hComm) := by
  intro z hz
  change balancedRightFactorMap φ S hComm z ∈ radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ
  apply (mem_radicalSpace_iff φ _).mpr
  intro w
  rw [balancedRightFactorMap_inner_adjoint]
  exact (mem_radicalSpace_iff φ z).mp hz _

/-- The genuine second-factor map on the original radical quotient. -/
def radicalRightFactorMap
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) :
    RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ →ₗ[ℂ] RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ :=
  (radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mapQ (radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ)
    (balancedRightFactorMap φ S hComm) (radicalSpace_balancedRightFactorMap φ S hComm)

/-- Each original balanced representative has the computed radical image. -/
theorem radicalRightFactorMap_mkQ
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) (z : BalancedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :
    radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm ((radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ z) =
      (radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ (balancedRightFactorMap φ S hComm z) := by
  simp only [radicalRightFactorMap, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.mapQ_apply]

/-- The original radical pure tensors have the printed second-factor value. -/
theorem radicalRightFactorMap_pure
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) (x : E₁) (y : E₂) :
    radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm ((radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ (balancedPure φ x y)) =
      (radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ (balancedPure φ x (S y)) := by
  simp only [radicalRightFactorMap_mkQ, balancedRightFactorMap_pure]

/-- Both radical descents retain the original paired-adjoint identity. -/
theorem radicalRightFactorMap_inner_adjoint
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b))
    (z w : RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :
    radicalInner φ (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm z) w =
      radicalInner φ z (radicalRightFactorMap φ S.adjointOperator
        (rightFactorCommutant_adjoint φ S hComm) w) := by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ_surjective z
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := (radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ_surjective w
  simpa only [radicalRightFactorMap_mkQ, radicalInner_mkQ_mkQ] using
    balancedRightFactorMap_inner_adjoint φ S hComm z w

/-- The original coefficient action commutes with the radical map. -/
theorem radicalRightFactorMap_radicalRightSMul
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) (b : B₂)
    (z : RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :
    radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm (radicalRightSMul φ b z) =
      radicalRightSMul φ b (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm z) := by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ_surjective z
  simpa only [radicalRightFactorMap_mkQ, radicalRightSMul_mkQ] using
    congrArg (radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ
      (balancedRightFactorMap_balancedRightSMul φ S hComm b z)

end CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.MapRight
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.PreHilbert
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Adjointable.CommutingSquareComplement

import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Order

/-!
# Bounded commuting second-factor maps on the original radical tensor

The positive CFC square complement stays in the represented commutant. Its
actual second-factor tensor map gives a positive remainder in the original
coefficient-valued inner form. The resulting bound uses the actual quotient
norm; no tensor norm, null witness or completed model is supplied.

This bound is the prerequisite for the original coefficient action on the
Hilbert amplification in Blackadar, K-Theory for Operator Algebras, 10.1.2.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped TensorProduct RightActions

namespace CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

universe uB₁ uB₂ uE₁ uE₂

variable {B₁ : Type uB₁} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₁]
  [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₁ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {B₂ : Type uB₂} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₂]
  [PartialOrder B₂ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₂ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {E₁ : Type uE₁} [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℂ E₁]
  [SMul B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] [CStarModule B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] [CompleteSpace E₁]
variable {E₂ : Type uE₂} [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℂ E₂]
  [SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ E₂] [CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ E₂] [CompleteSpace E₂]

omit [StarOrderedRing B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₂ᵐᵒᵖ]
  [CompleteSpace E₁] [CompleteSpace E₂] in
private theorem rawRightFactorMap_squareSplit
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S Q : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hS : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) (hQ : ∀ b : B₁, Commute Q (φ b))
    (hSquare : ∀ y : E₂, S.adjoint (S y) + Q.adjoint (Q y) = (‖S‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • y)
    (z w : AlgebraicTensor E₁ E₂) :
    rawInner φ (rawRightFactorMap S z) (rawRightFactorMap S w) +
        rawInner φ (rawRightFactorMap Q z) (rawRightFactorMap Q w) =
      (‖S‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • rawInner φ z w := by
  have hMoveS (b : B₁) (v : E₂) :
      S.adjoint (φ b (S v)) = φ b (S.adjoint (S v)) := by
    simpa only [AdjointableOperator.mul_apply, AdjointableOperator.adjointOperator_apply] using
      congrArg (fun T : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂ => T (S v))
        (rightFactorCommutant_adjoint φ S hS b).eq
  have hMoveQ (b : B₁) (v : E₂) :
      Q.adjoint (φ b (Q v)) = φ b (Q.adjoint (Q v)) := by
    simpa only [AdjointableOperator.mul_apply, AdjointableOperator.adjointOperator_apply] using
      congrArg (fun T : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂ => T (Q v))
        (rightFactorCommutant_adjoint φ Q hQ b).eq
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x u =>
    induction w using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul y v =>
      simp only [rawRightFactorMap_tmul, rawInner_tmul_tmul]
      rw [S.adjoint_inner, Q.adjoint_inner, hMoveS, hMoveQ,
        ← rightInner_add_right, ← map_add, hSquare]
      rw [RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := ℂ) (‖S‖ ^ 2) v,
        map_smul, rightInner_smul_right]
      exact (RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := ℂ) (‖S‖ ^ 2)
        (rightInner (B := B₂) u (φ (rightInner (B := B₁) x y) v))).symm
    | add w w' hw hw' =>
      simp only [map_add, smul_add]
      rw [add_add_add_comm, hw, hw']
  | add z z' hz hz' =>
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, smul_add]
    rw [add_add_add_comm, hz, hz']

/-- The actual second-factor map is bounded in the original quotient norm. -/
theorem radicalRightFactorMap_norm_le
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) (q : RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    ‖radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q‖ ≤ ‖S‖ * ‖q‖ := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  obtain ⟨Q, hQComm, hSquare⟩ :=
    AdjointableOperator.exists_commuting_norm_square_complement φ S hComm
  have hSplit :
      radicalInner φ (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q) (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q) +
        radicalInner φ (radicalRightFactorMap φ Q hQComm q) (radicalRightFactorMap φ Q hQComm q) =
      (‖S‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • radicalInner φ q q := by
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := (radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ_surjective q
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (balancingSpan (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ_surjective w
    simpa only [radicalRightFactorMap_mkQ, balancedRightFactorMap_mkQ,
      radicalInner_mkQ_mkQ, balancedInner_mkQ_mkQ] using
        rawRightFactorMap_squareSplit φ S Q hComm hQComm hSquare z z
  have hPosS : 0 ≤ MulOpposite.op
      (radicalInner φ (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q) (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q)) := by
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ_surjective
      (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q)
    rw [← hw, radicalInner_mkQ_mkQ]
    exact balancedInner_self_nonneg φ w
  have hPosQ : 0 ≤ MulOpposite.op
      (radicalInner φ (radicalRightFactorMap φ Q hQComm q) (radicalRightFactorMap φ Q hQComm q)) := by
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ_surjective
      (radicalRightFactorMap φ Q hQComm q)
    rw [← hw, radicalInner_mkQ_mkQ]
    exact balancedInner_self_nonneg φ w
  have hOp :
      MulOpposite.op
          (radicalInner φ (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q) (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q)) +
        MulOpposite.op
          (radicalInner φ (radicalRightFactorMap φ Q hQComm q) (radicalRightFactorMap φ Q hQComm q)) =
      (‖S‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • MulOpposite.op (radicalInner φ q q) := by
    simpa only [MulOpposite.op_add, MulOpposite.op_smul] using congrArg MulOpposite.op hSplit
  have hle :
      MulOpposite.op
          (radicalInner φ (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q) (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q)) ≤
        (‖S‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • MulOpposite.op (radicalInner φ q q) :=
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right hPosQ).trans_eq hOp
  have hn := CStarAlgebra.norm_le_norm_of_le_of_nonneg hle hPosS
  have hsq : ‖radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖S‖ * ‖q‖) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q‖ ^ 2 =
          ‖MulOpposite.op
            (radicalInner φ (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q)
              (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q))‖ := by
        rw [radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup_norm,
          Real.sq_sqrt (_root_.norm_nonneg _), MulOpposite.norm_op]
      _ ≤ ‖(‖S‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • MulOpposite.op (radicalInner φ q q)‖ := hn
      _ = (‖S‖ * ‖q‖) ^ 2 := by
        rw [_root_.norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg ‖S‖), MulOpposite.norm_op]
        rw [radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup_norm, mul_pow,
          Real.sq_sqrt (_root_.norm_nonneg _)]
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (_root_.norm_nonneg (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q))
    (mul_nonneg (_root_.norm_nonneg S) (_root_.norm_nonneg q))).mp hsq

/-- The actual radical map with continuity from its proved source bound. -/
def radicalRightFactorCLM
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ →L[ℂ] RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ := by
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
    radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  exact (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm).mkContinuous ‖S‖
    (fun q => radicalRightFactorMap_norm_le φ S hComm q)

/-- Continuity retains every original algebraic quotient value. -/
@[simp]
theorem radicalRightFactorCLM_apply
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) (q : RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    radicalRightFactorCLM φ S hComm q = radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  rfl

/-- The actual radical CLM retains its source operator-norm estimate. -/
theorem radicalRightFactorCLM_norm_le
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    ‖radicalRightFactorCLM (E₁ := E₁) φ S hComm‖ ≤ ‖S‖ := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  let F : RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ →L[ℂ] RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ :=
    radicalRightFactorCLM φ S hComm
  change ‖F‖ ≤ ‖S‖
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound F (_root_.norm_nonneg S) ?_
  intro q
  change ‖radicalRightFactorCLM φ S hComm q‖ ≤ ‖S‖ * ‖q‖
  rw [radicalRightFactorCLM_apply]
  exact radicalRightFactorMap_norm_le φ S hComm q

end CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.MapRight.Bounded
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.Completion
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Adjointable.OfPair

/-!
# Actual completed commuting second-factor operators

The proved bounded map on the original radical quotient is extended through
the stock completion. The genuine source adjoint supplies its paired extension;
the actual completed inner equation follows from dense quotient images.

This supplies the bounded second-factor action needed to form the original
Hilbert/coefficient tensor action in Blackadar, K-Theory for Operator Algebras,
Theorem 10.1.2. No completed operator, chosen norm or adjoint witness is an input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

universe uB₁ uB₂ uE₁ uE₂

variable {B₁ : Type uB₁} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₁]
  [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₁ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {B₂ : Type uB₂} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₂]
  [PartialOrder B₂ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₂ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {E₁ : Type uE₁} [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℂ E₁]
  [SMul B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] [CStarModule B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] [CompleteSpace E₁]
variable {E₂ : Type uE₂} [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℂ E₂]
  [SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ E₂] [CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ E₂] [CompleteSpace E₂]

/-- Extend the actual bounded radical map by stock completion. -/
def completedRightFactorCLM
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂) (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ →L[ℂ] CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ := by
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  exact ((UniformSpace.Completion.toComplL :
    RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ →L[ℂ] CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ).comp
      (radicalRightFactorCLM φ S hComm)).fromCompletion

/-- Each original quotient image has the exact extended source value. -/
@[simp]
theorem completedRightFactorCLM_coe
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂) (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b))
    (q : RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    completedRightFactorCLM φ S hComm (q : CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) =
      (radicalRightFactorMap φ S hComm q : CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  simp only [completedRightFactorCLM, ContinuousLinearMap.fromCompletion_apply_coe,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, UniformSpace.Completion.coe_toComplL,
    radicalRightFactorCLM_apply]

/-- Original balanced representatives retain the original second-factor map. -/
@[simp]
theorem completedRightFactorCLM_fromBalanced
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂) (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b))
    (z : BalancedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    completedRightFactorCLM φ S hComm (completedFromBalanced φ z) =
      completedFromBalanced φ (balancedRightFactorMap φ S hComm z) := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  rw [completedFromBalanced_apply, completedFromBalanced_apply,
    completedRightFactorCLM_coe, radicalRightFactorMap_mkQ]

/-- The original source bound passes through the stock completion. -/
theorem completedRightFactorCLM_norm_apply_le
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂) (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b))
    (z : CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    ‖completedRightFactorCLM φ S hComm z‖ ≤ ‖S‖ * ‖z‖ := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on z
    (isClosed_le (completedRightFactorCLM φ S hComm).continuous.norm
      (continuous_const.mul continuous_norm)) ?_
  intro q
  simpa only [completedRightFactorCLM_coe, UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe] using
    radicalRightFactorMap_norm_le φ S hComm q

/-- The actual completed maps retain their original paired-adjoint equation. -/
theorem completedRightFactorCLM_inner_adjoint
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂) (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b))
    (z w : CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    letI : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ;
    letI : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ;
    rightInner (B := B₂) (completedRightFactorCLM φ S hComm z) w =
      rightInner (B := B₂) z (completedRightFactorCLM φ S.adjointOperator
        (rightFactorCommutant_adjoint φ S hComm) w) := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  let : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ
  let : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ
  have hl : Continuous fun p : CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ × CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ =>
      rightInner (B := B₂) (completedRightFactorCLM φ S hComm p.1) p.2 :=
    (CStarModule.continuous_rightInner (B := B₂) (E := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ)).comp
      (((completedRightFactorCLM φ S hComm).continuous.comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd)
  have hr : Continuous fun p : CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ × CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ =>
      rightInner (B := B₂) p.1 (completedRightFactorCLM φ S.adjointOperator
        (rightFactorCommutant_adjoint φ S hComm) p.2) :=
    (CStarModule.continuous_rightInner (B := B₂) (E := CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ)).comp
      (continuous_fst.prodMk ((completedRightFactorCLM φ S.adjointOperator
        (rightFactorCommutant_adjoint φ S hComm)).continuous.comp continuous_snd))
  refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on₂ z w (isClosed_eq hl hr) ?_
  intro q v
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := (radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ_surjective q
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := (radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ_surjective v
  have hq : ((radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ q : CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) =
      completedFromBalanced φ q := (completedFromBalanced_apply φ q).symm
  have hv : ((radicalSpace (E₁ := E₁) φ).mkQ v : CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) =
      completedFromBalanced φ v := (completedFromBalanced_apply φ v).symm
  rw [hq, hv, completedRightFactorCLM_fromBalanced, completedRightFactorCLM_fromBalanced,
    completedFromBalanced_inner, completedFromBalanced_inner]
  exact balancedRightFactorMap_inner_adjoint φ S hComm q v

/-- Package the computed extension and its computed genuine adjoint. -/
def completedRightOperator
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂) (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    letI : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ;
    letI : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ;
    AdjointableOperator.End B₂ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := by
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  letI : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ
  letI : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ
  exact AdjointableOperator.ofAdjointPair (completedRightFactorCLM φ S hComm)
    (completedRightFactorCLM φ S.adjointOperator (rightFactorCommutant_adjoint φ S hComm))
    (completedRightFactorCLM_inner_adjoint φ S hComm)

/-- The original completed pure tensors have the literal second-factor value. -/
@[simp]
theorem completedRightOperator_pure
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂) (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b))
    (x : E₁) (y : E₂) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    letI : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ;
    letI : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ;
    completedRightOperator φ S hComm (completedPure φ x y) = completedPure φ x (S y) := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  let : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ
  let : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ
  change completedRightFactorCLM φ S hComm (completedPure φ x y) = completedPure φ x (S y)
  rw [completedPure_apply, completedPure_apply, completedRightFactorCLM_coe,
    radicalRightFactorMap_pure]

/-- The actual stored adjoint has the genuine second-factor adjoint value. -/
@[simp]
theorem completedRightOperator_adjoint_pure
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂) (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b))
    (x : E₁) (y : E₂) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    letI : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ;
    letI : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ;
    (completedRightOperator φ S hComm).adjoint (completedPure φ x y) =
      completedPure φ x (S.adjoint y) := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  let : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ
  let : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ
  change completedRightFactorCLM φ S.adjointOperator (rightFactorCommutant_adjoint φ S hComm)
    (completedPure φ x y) = completedPure φ x (S.adjoint y)
  rw [completedPure_apply, completedPure_apply, completedRightFactorCLM_coe,
    radicalRightFactorMap_pure, AdjointableOperator.adjointOperator_apply]

/-- The actual completed operator retains the original source norm bound. -/
theorem completedRightOperator_norm_le
    (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (S : AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂) (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    letI : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ;
    letI : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ;
    ‖completedRightOperator (E₁ := E₁) φ S hComm‖ ≤ ‖S‖ := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  let : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalRightAction φ
  let : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := completedCStarModule φ
  rw [AdjointableOperator.norm_eq]
  change ‖completedRightFactorCLM (E₁ := E₁) φ S hComm‖ ≤ ‖S‖
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (_root_.norm_nonneg S)
    (fun z => completedRightFactorCLM_norm_apply_le φ S hComm z)

end CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.ModelComparison.Completion
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.MapRight.Completion

/-!
# Commuting right-factor operators on supplied internal-tensor models

Conjugate the computed canonical right-factor operator by the actual
canonical-to-model unitary. The model retains its original pure vectors,
coefficient actions, inner form and dense span. The descended operator uses
the caller's original opposite orders and independent carrier universes.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped RightActions
namespace CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.IsModel

universe uB₁ uB₂ uE₁ uE₂ uX

variable {B₁ : Type uB₁} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₁]
  [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₁ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {B₂ : Type uB₂} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₂]
  [PartialOrder B₂ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₂ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {E₁ : Type uE₁} [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℂ E₁]
  [SMul B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] [CStarModule B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] [CompleteSpace E₁]
variable {E₂ : Type uE₂} [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℂ E₂]
  [SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ E₂] [CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ E₂] [CompleteSpace E₂]
variable {X : Type uX} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℂ X]
  [SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ X] [CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ X] [CompleteSpace X]

/-- Descend a commuting right-factor operator to the same supplied complete tensor model. -/
@[no_expose]
def mapRightOperator
    {φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂}
    {pure : E₁ → E₂ → X}
    (hX : CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.IsModel φ pure)
    (S : CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) :
    CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End B₂ X := by
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup (CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
    CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  letI : NormedSpace ℂ (CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
    CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  letI : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
    CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.radicalRightAction φ
  letI : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
    CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.completedCStarModule φ
  let U := CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.completedTensorModelUnitary φ pure hX
  exact U.conjStarAlgHom
    (CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.completedRightOperator (E₁ := E₁) φ S hComm)

/-- The descended right-factor operator has the original pure-model value. -/
@[simp]
theorem mapRightOperator_pure
    {φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂}
    {pure : E₁ → E₂ → X}
    (hX : CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.IsModel φ pure)
    (S : CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
    (hComm : ∀ b : B₁, Commute S (φ b)) (x : E₁) (y : E₂) :
    mapRightOperator hX S hComm (pure x y) = pure x (S y) := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
    CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ
  let : NormedSpace ℂ (CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
    CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.radicalTensorNormedSpace φ
  let : SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
    CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.radicalRightAction φ
  let : CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ (CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
    CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.completedCStarModule φ
  change (CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.completedTensorModelUnitary φ pure hX).conjStarAlgHom
      (CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.completedRightOperator (E₁ := E₁) φ S hComm)
      (pure x y) = pure x (S y)
  rw [CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv.conjStarAlgHom_apply,
    CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.completedTensorModelUnitary_symm_pure,
    CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.completedRightOperator_pure,
    CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.completedTensorModelUnitary_pure]

end CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct.IsModel

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.InternalTensorProduct.Semilinear

/-!
# Functoriality of coefficient-changing completed tensor equivalences

Identity and composition are established on the dense span of actual pure
tensors. No extra action, inverse, or composite-compatibility premise is stored.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra RightActions

namespace CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

open Set
open CStarModule
open CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

universe uB₁ uC₁ uD₁ uB₂ uC₂ uD₂ uE₁ uF₁ uH₁ uE₂ uF₂ uH₂

variable {B₁ : Type uB₁} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₁]
  [PartialOrder B₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₁ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {C₁ : Type uC₁} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C₁]
  [PartialOrder C₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing C₁ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {D₁ : Type uD₁} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra D₁]
  [PartialOrder D₁ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing D₁ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {B₂ : Type uB₂} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B₂]
  [PartialOrder B₂ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing B₂ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {C₂ : Type uC₂} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra C₂]
  [PartialOrder C₂ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing C₂ᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {D₂ : Type uD₂} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra D₂]
  [PartialOrder D₂ᵐᵒᵖ] [StarOrderedRing D₂ᵐᵒᵖ]

variable {E₁ : Type uE₁} [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℂ E₁]
  [SMul B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] [CStarModule B₁ᵐᵒᵖ E₁] [CompleteSpace E₁]
variable {F₁ : Type uF₁} [NormedAddCommGroup F₁] [NormedSpace ℂ F₁]
  [SMul C₁ᵐᵒᵖ F₁] [CStarModule C₁ᵐᵒᵖ F₁] [CompleteSpace F₁]
variable {H₁ : Type uH₁} [NormedAddCommGroup H₁] [NormedSpace ℂ H₁]
  [SMul D₁ᵐᵒᵖ H₁] [CStarModule D₁ᵐᵒᵖ H₁] [CompleteSpace H₁]
variable {E₂ : Type uE₂} [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℂ E₂]
  [SMul B₂ᵐᵒᵖ E₂] [CStarModule B₂ᵐᵒᵖ E₂] [CompleteSpace E₂]
variable {F₂ : Type uF₂} [NormedAddCommGroup F₂] [NormedSpace ℂ F₂]
  [SMul C₂ᵐᵒᵖ F₂] [CStarModule C₂ᵐᵒᵖ F₂] [CompleteSpace F₂]
variable {H₂ : Type uH₂} [NormedAddCommGroup H₂] [NormedSpace ℂ H₂]
  [SMul D₂ᵐᵒᵖ H₂] [CStarModule D₂ᵐᵒᵖ H₂] [CompleteSpace H₂]

variable (φ : B₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End B₂ E₂)
variable (ψ : C₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End C₂ F₂)
variable (χ : D₁ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End D₂ H₂)

private abbrev coherenceSourceRadicalNormedAddCommGroup :
    NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
  radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ

attribute [local instance] coherenceSourceRadicalNormedAddCommGroup

private abbrev coherenceSourceRadicalNormedSpace :
    NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
  radicalTensorNormedSpace φ

attribute [local instance] coherenceSourceRadicalNormedSpace

private abbrev coherenceMiddleRadicalNormedAddCommGroup :
    NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := F₁) ψ) :=
  radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup ψ

attribute [local instance] coherenceMiddleRadicalNormedAddCommGroup

private abbrev coherenceMiddleRadicalNormedSpace :
    NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := F₁) ψ) :=
  radicalTensorNormedSpace ψ

attribute [local instance] coherenceMiddleRadicalNormedSpace

private abbrev coherenceTargetRadicalNormedAddCommGroup :
    NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := H₁) χ) :=
  radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ

attribute [local instance] coherenceTargetRadicalNormedAddCommGroup

private abbrev coherenceTargetRadicalNormedSpace :
    NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := H₁) χ) :=
  radicalTensorNormedSpace χ

attribute [local instance] coherenceTargetRadicalNormedSpace

/-! ## Identity coherence -/

/-- Identity coefficient and vector equivalences induce the identity on the
literal completed internal tensor. -/
theorem completedSemilinearEquiv_refl :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    completedSemilinearEquiv (φ := φ) (ψ := φ)
      (σ₁ := StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ B₁) (σ₂ := StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ B₂)
      (U₁ := LinearEquiv.refl ℂ E₁) (U₂ := LinearEquiv.refl ℂ E₂)
      (hinner₁ := fun _ _ ↦ rfl) (hinner₂ := fun _ _ ↦ rfl)
      (hφ := fun _ _ ↦ rfl) =
        LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := by
  apply LinearIsometryEquiv.ext
  have hmaps :
      (completedSemilinearEquiv (φ := φ) (ψ := φ)
        (σ₁ := StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ B₁) (σ₂ := StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ B₂)
        (U₁ := LinearEquiv.refl ℂ E₁) (U₂ := LinearEquiv.refl ℂ E₂)
        (hinner₁ := fun _ _ ↦ rfl) (hinner₂ := fun _ _ ↦ rfl)
        (hφ := fun _ _ ↦ rfl)).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap =
      (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ
        (CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ)).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext_on (completedPure_dense_span φ)
    rintro _ ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩
    change completedSemilinearEquiv (φ := φ) (ψ := φ)
      (σ₁ := StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ B₁) (σ₂ := StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ B₂)
      (U₁ := LinearEquiv.refl ℂ E₁) (U₂ := LinearEquiv.refl ℂ E₂)
      (hinner₁ := fun _ _ ↦ rfl) (hinner₂ := fun _ _ ↦ rfl)
      (hφ := fun _ _ ↦ rfl) (completedPure φ x y) = completedPure φ x y
    exact completedSemilinearEquiv_pure
      (φ := φ) (ψ := φ)
      (σ₁ := StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ B₁) (σ₂ := StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ B₂)
      (U₁ := LinearEquiv.refl ℂ E₁) (U₂ := LinearEquiv.refl ℂ E₂)
      (hinner₁ := fun _ _ ↦ rfl) (hinner₂ := fun _ _ ↦ rfl)
      (hφ := fun _ _ ↦ rfl) x y
  intro z
  exact congrArg
    (fun L : CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ →L[ℂ]
      CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ ↦ L z) hmaps

/-! ## Two composable source-to-target diagrams -/

variable (σ₁ : B₁ ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] C₁) (σ₂ : B₂ ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] C₂)
variable (U₁ : E₁ ≃ₗ[ℂ] F₁) (U₂ : E₂ ≃ₗ[ℂ] F₂)
variable (hinner₁ : ∀ x y : E₁,
  CStarModule.rightInner (B := C₁) (U₁ x) (U₁ y) =
    σ₁ (CStarModule.rightInner (B := B₁) x y))
variable (hinner₂ : ∀ x y : E₂,
  CStarModule.rightInner (B := C₂) (U₂ x) (U₂ y) =
    σ₂ (CStarModule.rightInner (B := B₂) x y))
variable (hφ : ∀ (b : B₁) (y : E₂),
  U₂ (φ b y) = ψ (σ₁ b) (U₂ y))

variable (τ₁ : C₁ ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] D₁) (τ₂ : C₂ ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] D₂)
variable (V₁ : F₁ ≃ₗ[ℂ] H₁) (V₂ : F₂ ≃ₗ[ℂ] H₂)
variable (kinner₁ : ∀ x y : F₁,
  CStarModule.rightInner (B := D₁) (V₁ x) (V₁ y) =
    τ₁ (CStarModule.rightInner (B := C₁) x y))
variable (kinner₂ : ∀ x y : F₂,
  CStarModule.rightInner (B := D₂) (V₂ x) (V₂ y) =
    τ₂ (CStarModule.rightInner (B := C₂) x y))
variable (kφ : ∀ (c : C₁) (y : F₂),
  V₂ (ψ c y) = χ (τ₁ c) (V₂ y))

/-- The constructed coefficient-changing tensor equivalence respects
composition of compatible diagrams. Composite inner laws and the
representation square are derived, not supplied as additional premises. -/
theorem completedSemilinearEquiv_trans :
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup φ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace φ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := F₁) ψ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup ψ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := F₁) ψ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace ψ;
    letI : NormedAddCommGroup (RadicalTensor (E₁ := H₁) χ) :=
      radicalTensorNormedAddCommGroup χ;
    letI : NormedSpace ℂ (RadicalTensor (E₁ := H₁) χ) := radicalTensorNormedSpace χ;
    let hcomp₁ : ∀ x y : E₁,
        rightInner (B := D₁) ((U₁.trans V₁) x) ((U₁.trans V₁) y) =
          (σ₁.trans τ₁) (rightInner (B := B₁) x y) := fun x y ↦ by
            change rightInner (B := D₁) (V₁ (U₁ x)) (V₁ (U₁ y)) =
              τ₁ (σ₁ (rightInner (B := B₁) x y))
            rw [kinner₁, hinner₁]
    let hcomp₂ : ∀ x y : E₂,
        rightInner (B := D₂) ((U₂.trans V₂) x) ((U₂.trans V₂) y) =
          (σ₂.trans τ₂) (rightInner (B := B₂) x y) := fun x y ↦ by
            change rightInner (B := D₂) (V₂ (U₂ x)) (V₂ (U₂ y)) =
              τ₂ (σ₂ (rightInner (B := B₂) x y))
            rw [kinner₂, hinner₂]
    let hcompφ : ∀ (b : B₁) (y : E₂),
        (U₂.trans V₂) (φ b y) =
          χ ((σ₁.trans τ₁) b) ((U₂.trans V₂) y) := fun b y ↦ by
            change V₂ (U₂ (φ b y)) = χ (τ₁ (σ₁ b)) (V₂ (U₂ y))
            rw [hφ, kφ]
    completedSemilinearEquiv φ χ (σ₁.trans τ₁) (σ₂.trans τ₂)
        (U₁.trans V₁) (U₂.trans V₂) hcomp₁ hcomp₂ hcompφ =
      (completedSemilinearEquiv φ ψ σ₁ σ₂ U₁ U₂
        hinner₁ hinner₂ hφ).trans
        (completedSemilinearEquiv ψ χ τ₁ τ₂ V₁ V₂
          kinner₁ kinner₂ kφ) := by
  dsimp only
  let hcomp₁ : ∀ x y : E₁,
      rightInner (B := D₁) ((U₁.trans V₁) x) ((U₁.trans V₁) y) =
        (σ₁.trans τ₁) (rightInner (B := B₁) x y) := fun x y ↦ by
    change rightInner (B := D₁) (V₁ (U₁ x)) (V₁ (U₁ y)) =
      τ₁ (σ₁ (rightInner (B := B₁) x y))
    rw [kinner₁, hinner₁]
  let hcomp₂ : ∀ x y : E₂,
      rightInner (B := D₂) ((U₂.trans V₂) x) ((U₂.trans V₂) y) =
        (σ₂.trans τ₂) (rightInner (B := B₂) x y) := fun x y ↦ by
    change rightInner (B := D₂) (V₂ (U₂ x)) (V₂ (U₂ y)) =
      τ₂ (σ₂ (rightInner (B := B₂) x y))
    rw [kinner₂, hinner₂]
  let hcompφ : ∀ (b : B₁) (y : E₂),
      (U₂.trans V₂) (φ b y) = χ ((σ₁.trans τ₁) b) ((U₂.trans V₂) y) :=
    fun b y ↦ by
      change V₂ (U₂ (φ b y)) = χ (τ₁ (σ₁ b)) (V₂ (U₂ y))
      rw [hφ, kφ]
  apply LinearIsometryEquiv.ext
  have hmaps :
      (completedSemilinearEquiv φ χ (σ₁.trans τ₁) (σ₂.trans τ₂)
        (U₁.trans V₁) (U₂.trans V₂)
        hcomp₁ hcomp₂ hcompφ).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap =
      ((completedSemilinearEquiv φ ψ σ₁ σ₂ U₁ U₂ hinner₁ hinner₂ hφ).trans
        (completedSemilinearEquiv ψ χ τ₁ τ₂ V₁ V₂
          kinner₁ kinner₂ kφ)).toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext_on (completedPure_dense_span φ)
    rintro _ ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩
    change completedSemilinearEquiv φ χ (σ₁.trans τ₁) (σ₂.trans τ₂)
        (U₁.trans V₁) (U₂.trans V₂) hcomp₁ hcomp₂ hcompφ (completedPure φ x y) =
      completedSemilinearEquiv ψ χ τ₁ τ₂ V₁ V₂ kinner₁ kinner₂ kφ
        (completedSemilinearEquiv φ ψ σ₁ σ₂ U₁ U₂
          hinner₁ hinner₂ hφ (completedPure φ x y))
    rw [completedSemilinearEquiv_pure, completedSemilinearEquiv_pure,
      completedSemilinearEquiv_pure]
    rfl
  intro z
  exact congrArg
    (fun L : CompletedTensor (E₁ := E₁) φ →L[ℂ]
      CompletedTensor (E₁ := H₁) χ ↦ L z) hmaps

end CStarModule.InternalTensorProduct

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Matrix
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Compact
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Standard.FiniteCoordinateAdjoints

/-!
# Finite matrix column actions as actual module-compacts

The existing matrix star hom is restricted to the existing compact
endomorphism subalgebra of the finite right standard module. Coefficient
insertion and evaluation use their shared finite-coordinate adjoint operator;
compactness comes from the coefficient left multiplication between them.

The original coefficient-inner norm, operator norm, matrix action and
noncommutative product order are retained. No coefficient unit, nonzero
algebra, compactness of coordinate maps or supplied output model is assumed.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

namespace CStarModule.AdjointableOperator

open CStarModule.Right
open scoped BigOperators

universe uB uι

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι]

/-- The actual finite matrix column hom with codomain restricted to the
existing module-compact endomorphisms, including empty finite indices. -/
noncomputable def rightMatrixCompactHom :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    CStarMatrix ι ι B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      compactStarSubalgebra (B := B) (E := FiniteStandard B ι) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let E := FiniteStandard B ι
  change CStarMatrix ι ι B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] compactStarSubalgebra (B := B) (E := E)
  refine NonUnitalStarAlgHom.codRestrict
    (rightMatrixHom (B := B) (ι := ι))
    (compactStarSubalgebra (B := B) (E := E)) ?_
  intro M
  change (rightMatrixHom (B := B) (ι := ι) M : End B E) ∈
    compactSubmodule (B := B) (E := E) (F := E)
  classical
  let S (i : ι) : AdjointableOperator B B E :=
    finiteSingleAdjointable (B := B) (I := ι) i
  let P (i : ι) : AdjointableOperator B E B := (S i).adjointOperator
  have hS (i : ι) (b : B) : S i b = finiteSingle i b :=
    congrArg (fun L : B →L[ℂ] E => L b)
      (finiteSingleAdjointable_toContinuousLinearMap (B := B) (I := ι) i)
  have hP (i : ι) (y : E) : P i y = finiteCoord i y :=
    congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℂ] B => L y)
      (finiteSingleAdjointable_adjoint (B := B) (I := ι) i)
  let R : End B E := rightMatrixHom (B := B) (ι := ι) M
  have hR (y : E) : R y = rightMatrix (B := B) M y :=
    rightMatrixHom_apply M y
  have hBlock (i j : ι) :
      (P i).comp (R.comp (S j)) = leftMul (B := B) (M i j) := by
    apply AdjointableOperator.ext
    intro b
    calc
      ((P i).comp (R.comp (S j))) b =
          finiteCoord i (rightMatrix (B := B) M (finiteSingle j b)) := by
        rw [comp_apply, comp_apply, hP, hS, hR]
      _ = M i j * b :=
        (finiteCoord_apply i _).trans (rightMatrix_finiteSingle M j b i)
      _ = leftMul (B := B) (M i j) b := (leftMul_apply _ _).symm
  have hReconstruct (y : E) : ∑ i, S i (P i y) = y := by
    calc
      ∑ i, S i (P i y) = ∑ i, finiteSingle i (y i) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [hS, hP, finiteCoord_apply]
      _ = y := finite_sum_single y
  let block (i j : ι) : End B E :=
    (S i).comp ((leftMul (B := B) (M i j)).comp (P j))
  have hEval (f : ι → End B E) (y : E) :
      (∑ i, f i) y = ∑ i, f i y := by
    let ev : End B E →+ E :=
      { toFun := fun T => T y
        map_zero' := zero_apply y
        map_add' := fun T U => add_apply T U y }
    exact _root_.map_sum ev f Finset.univ
  have hMatrix : R = ∑ i, ∑ j, block i j := by
    apply AdjointableOperator.ext
    intro y
    calc
      R y = ∑ i, S i (P i (R y)) := (hReconstruct (R y)).symm
      _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, S i (P i (R (S j (P j y)))) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        let U : End B E := (S i).comp ((P i).comp R)
        have hInput : U y = U (∑ j, S j (P j y)) :=
          congrArg U (hReconstruct y).symm
        calc
          S i (P i (R y)) = U (∑ j, S j (P j y)) := hInput
          _ = ∑ j, U (S j (P j y)) :=
            _root_.map_sum U.toContinuousLinearMap
              (fun j => S j (P j y)) Finset.univ
          _ = ∑ j, S i (P i (R (S j (P j y)))) := rfl
      _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, S i (leftMul (B := B) (M i j) (P j y)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        have h := congrArg (fun T : End B B => T (P j y)) (hBlock i j)
        change P i (R (S j (P j y))) =
          leftMul (B := B) (M i j) (P j y) at h
        exact congrArg (S i) h
      _ = (∑ i, ∑ j, block i j) y := by
        symm
        calc
          (∑ i, ∑ j, block i j) y = ∑ i, (∑ j, block i j) y :=
            hEval (fun i => ∑ j, block i j) y
          _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, block i j y := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i _
            exact hEval (fun j => block i j) y
          _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, S i (leftMul (B := B) (M i j) (P j y)) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i _
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j _
            rfl
  have hCompact (i j : ι) :
      block i j ∈ compactSubmodule (B := B) (E := E) (F := E) := by
    have hLP : (leftMul (B := B) (M i j)).comp (P j) ∈
        compactSubmodule (B := B) (E := E) (F := B) :=
      comp_mem_compact_left (B := B) (E := E) (F := B) (G := B)
        (leftMul_mem_compact (B := B) (M i j)) (P j)
    exact comp_mem_compact_right (B := B) (E := E) (F := B) (G := E) (S i) hLP
  have hSum : (∑ i, ∑ j, block i j) ∈
      compactSubmodule (B := B) (E := E) (F := E) :=
    (compactSubmodule (B := B) (E := E) (F := E)).sum_mem fun i _ =>
      (compactSubmodule (B := B) (E := E) (F := E)).sum_mem fun j _ => hCompact i j
  change R ∈ compactSubmodule (B := B) (E := E) (F := E)
  rw [hMatrix]
  exact hSum

/-- Including the compact-valued hom gives literally the original square
matrix operator, with no alternative action or norm. -/
@[simp]
theorem rightMatrixCompactHom_coe (M : CStarMatrix ι ι B) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    (rightMatrixCompactHom (B := B) (ι := ι) M : End B (FiniteStandard B ι)) =
      rightMatrixHom M := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  rfl

/-- The included compact operator retains the source-order column formula. -/
theorem rightMatrixCompactHom_apply (M : CStarMatrix ι ι B)
    (x : FiniteStandard B ι) (i : ι) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    (rightMatrixCompactHom (B := B) (ι := ι) M : End B (FiniteStandard B ι)) x i =
      ∑ j, M i j * x j := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  rw [rightMatrixCompactHom_coe, rightMatrixHom_apply]
  exact rightMatrix_apply M x i

end CStarModule.AdjointableOperator

end

end
