module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Standard.FiniteInclusion
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Matrix.Compact
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Matrix.Positivity
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Hom
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CStarMatrix.Padding
public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin

/-!
# Actual finite matrix corners in standard-module compacts

A finite coefficient matrix acts on the standard right module through the
actual finite-coordinate inclusion and its adjoint. Compactness comes from
the middle finite matrix operator, not from compactness of the inclusion.
The finite-source identity proves multiplication and faithful extraction.

The original coefficient-inner norms and the C-star matrix operator norm
are retained. Empty finite indices and zero, possibly nonunital coefficient
algebras are included; no unit-valued coordinate vectors are used.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

namespace CStarModule.AdjointableOperator

open CStarModule.Right
open scoped BigOperators

universe uB uI uK

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable {I : Type uI} [Fintype I] {κ : Type uK}

/-- The original finite compact matrix hom, conjugated by the actual
finite-coordinate inclusion into the standard module. -/
noncomputable def rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    CStarMatrix I I B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      compactStarSubalgebra (B := B) (E := Standard B κ) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let E := FiniteStandard B I
  let F := Standard B κ
  let J : AdjointableOperator B E F := Standard.finiteInclusion (B := B) η
  let Φ : CStarMatrix I I B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ]
      compactStarSubalgebra (B := B) (E := E) :=
    rightMatrixCompactHom (B := B) (ι := I)
  let ρ : CStarMatrix I I B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] End B E :=
    (NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype
      (compactStarSubalgebra (B := B) (E := E))).comp Φ
  have hRound (x : E) : J.adjointOperator (J x) = x := by
    have h := congrArg (fun T : End B E => T x)
      (Standard.finiteInclusion_adjoint_comp_self (B := B) η)
    simpa only [comp_apply, one_apply] using h
  let cJ : End B E →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] End B F :=
    { toFun := fun T => J.comp (T.comp J.adjointOperator)
      map_zero' := by
        apply AdjointableOperator.ext
        intro y
        change J ((0 : End B E) (J.adjointOperator y)) = 0
        rw [zero_apply, map_zero]
      map_add' := by
        intro T U
        apply AdjointableOperator.ext
        intro y
        change J ((T + U) (J.adjointOperator y)) =
          J (T (J.adjointOperator y)) + J (U (J.adjointOperator y))
        rw [add_apply, map_add]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c T
        apply AdjointableOperator.ext
        intro y
        change J ((c • T) (J.adjointOperator y)) =
          c • J (T (J.adjointOperator y))
        rw [smul_apply, map_smul]
      map_mul' := by
        intro T U
        apply AdjointableOperator.ext
        intro y
        change J ((T * U) (J.adjointOperator y)) =
          J (T (J.adjointOperator (J (U (J.adjointOperator y)))))
        simp only [mul_apply, hRound]
      map_star' := by
        intro T
        change J.comp ((star T).comp J.adjointOperator) =
          (J.comp (T.comp J.adjointOperator)).adjointOperator
        apply AdjointableOperator.ext
        intro y
        simp only [comp_adjointOperator, adjointOperator_adjointOperator,
          comp_apply, star_apply, adjointOperator_apply] }
  let θ : CStarMatrix I I B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] End B F := cJ.comp ρ
  have hMem (X : CStarMatrix I I B) :
      θ X ∈ compactStarSubalgebra (B := B) (E := F) := by
    have hX : ρ X ∈ compactSubmodule (B := B) (E := E) (F := E) := by
      change (Φ X : End B E) ∈ compactSubmodule (B := B) (E := E) (F := E)
      exact (mem_compactStarSubalgebra (B := B) (E := E) (Φ X)).mp
        (Φ X).property
    have hRight : (ρ X).comp J.adjointOperator ∈
        compactSubmodule (B := B) (E := F) (F := E) :=
      comp_mem_compact_left (B := B) (E := F) (F := E) (G := E)
        hX J.adjointOperator
    change J.comp ((ρ X).comp J.adjointOperator) ∈
      compactSubmodule (B := B) (E := F) (F := F)
    exact comp_mem_compact_right (B := B) (E := F) (F := E) (G := F)
      J hRight
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.codRestrict θ
    (compactStarSubalgebra (B := B) (E := F)) hMem

/-- Including the corner gives the literal inclusion–matrix–adjoint
composite, with the same original finite compact matrix operator. -/
theorem rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_coe (η : I ↪ κ) (X : CStarMatrix I I B) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    (rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) η X : End B (Standard B κ)) =
      (Standard.finiteInclusion (B := B) η).comp
        ((rightMatrixCompactHom (B := B) (ι := I) X :
          End B (FiniteStandard B I)).comp
            (Standard.finiteInclusion (B := B) η).adjointOperator) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  rfl

/-- The whole corner action is the literal finite sum of coefficient singles
with the original row-before-column, unconjugated matrix entries. -/
theorem rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_apply (η : I ↪ κ) (X : CStarMatrix I I B) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ∀ y : Standard B κ,
      (rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) η X : End B (Standard B κ)) y =
        ∑ i : I, Standard.single (η i)
          (∑ j : I, X i j * Standard.coord (η j) y) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  intro y
  let J := Standard.finiteInclusion (B := B) η
  have hCoord (j : I) : (J.adjointOperator y) j = Standard.coord (η j) y := by
    rw [adjointOperator_apply]
    exact Standard.finiteInclusion_adjoint_apply (B := B) η y j
  rw [rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_coe, comp_apply, comp_apply,
    Standard.finiteInclusion_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply congrArg (Standard.single (η i))
  calc
    (rightMatrixCompactHom (B := B) (ι := I) X : End B (FiniteStandard B I))
        (J.adjointOperator y) i = ∑ j : I, X i j * (J.adjointOperator y) j :=
      rightMatrixCompactHom_apply X (J.adjointOperator y) i
    _ = ∑ j : I, X i j * Standard.coord (η j) y := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact congrArg (fun b : B => X i j * b) (hCoord j)

/-- Every selected coordinate of the corner is the original matrix column
action on the selected input coordinates. -/
@[simp]
theorem coord_rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_apply (η : I ↪ κ)
    (X : CStarMatrix I I B) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ∀ (y : Standard B κ) (i : I),
      Standard.coord (η i)
          ((rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) η X : End B (Standard B κ)) y) =
        ∑ j : I, X i j * Standard.coord (η j) y := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  intro y i
  let J := Standard.finiteInclusion (B := B) η
  have hCoord (j : I) : (J.adjointOperator y) j = Standard.coord (η j) y := by
    rw [adjointOperator_apply]
    exact Standard.finiteInclusion_adjoint_apply (B := B) η y j
  rw [rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_coe, comp_apply, comp_apply,
    Standard.coord_finiteInclusion, rightMatrixCompactHom_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  exact congrArg (fun b : B => X i j * b) (hCoord j)

/-- The original selected coordinate block is left multiplication by Xij,
as a whole operator on supplied coefficients, without a coefficient unit. -/
theorem rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_block (η : I ↪ κ) (X : CStarMatrix I I B) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ∀ i j : I,
      (Standard.singleAdjointable (B := B) (η i)).adjointOperator.comp
          ((rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) η X : End B (Standard B κ)).comp
            (Standard.singleAdjointable (B := B) (η j))) =
        leftMul (B := B) (X i j) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  classical
  intro i j
  apply AdjointableOperator.ext
  intro b
  rw [comp_apply, comp_apply, Standard.singleAdjointable_adjoint_apply,
    Standard.singleAdjointable_apply, coord_rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_apply]
  calc
    (∑ k : I, X i k * Standard.coord (η k) (Standard.single (η j) b)) =
        X i j * Standard.coord (η j) (Standard.single (η j) b) :=
      Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem j (Finset.mem_univ j) fun k _ hkj => by
        have hη : η k ≠ η j := fun h => hkj (η.injective h)
        rw [Standard.coord_single_ne hη, mul_zero]
    _ = X i j * b := by rw [Standard.coord_single_self]
    _ = leftMul (B := B) (X i j) b := (leftMul_apply _ _).symm

/-- The actual standard compact corner is faithful, by compression back
to the original faithful finite matrix hom. -/
theorem rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_injective (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    Function.Injective (rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) η) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let E := FiniteStandard B I
  let F := Standard B κ
  let J : AdjointableOperator B E F := Standard.finiteInclusion (B := B) η
  let KF := compactStarSubalgebra (B := B) (E := F)
  let f : CStarMatrix I I B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] KF := rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) η
  let ψ : CStarMatrix I I B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] End B F :=
    (NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype KF).comp f
  have hRound (x : E) : J.adjointOperator (J x) = x := by
    have h := congrArg (fun T : End B E => T x)
      (Standard.finiteInclusion_adjoint_comp_self (B := B) η)
    simpa only [comp_apply, one_apply] using h
  have hPull (X : CStarMatrix I I B) :
      J.adjointOperator.comp ((ψ X).comp J) =
        (rightMatrixCompactHom (B := B) (ι := I) X : End B E) := by
    have hValue : ψ X = J.comp
        ((rightMatrixCompactHom (B := B) (ι := I) X : End B E).comp
          J.adjointOperator) :=
      rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_coe (B := B) η X
    rw [hValue]
    apply AdjointableOperator.ext
    intro x
    change J.adjointOperator
        (J ((rightMatrixCompactHom (B := B) (ι := I) X : End B E)
          (J.adjointOperator (J x)))) = _
    rw [hRound, hRound]
  have hψ : Function.Injective ψ := by
    intro X Y h
    have hPullXY := congrArg
      (fun T : End B F => J.adjointOperator.comp (T.comp J)) h
    rw [hPull, hPull, rightMatrixCompactHom_coe, rightMatrixCompactHom_coe] at hPullXY
    exact rightMatrixHom_injective (B := B) (I := I) hPullXY
  have hMem (X : CStarMatrix I I B) : ψ X ∈ KF := (f X).property
  have hPin : NonUnitalStarAlgHom.codRestrict ψ KF hMem = f := by
    apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
    intro X
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  change Function.Injective f
  rw [← hPin]
  exact (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.injective_codRestrict ψ KF hMem).mpr hψ

/-- The corner preserves the original C-star matrix norm and inherited
compact-operator norm, including the zero algebra and empty indices. -/
theorem norm_rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_apply (η : I ↪ κ)
    (X : CStarMatrix I I B) :
    letI : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B;
    letI : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B;
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ‖rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) η X‖ = ‖X‖ := by
  let : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  let : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let F := Standard B κ
  let KF := compactStarSubalgebra (B := B) (E := F)
  let f : CStarMatrix I I B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] KF := rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) η
  let ψ : CStarMatrix I I B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] End B F :=
    (NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype KF).comp f
  have hψ : Function.Injective ψ := by
    intro M N h
    apply rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_injective (B := B) η
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact h
  calc
    ‖rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) η X‖ = ‖ψ X‖ := rfl
    _ = ‖X‖ := NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_map ψ hψ X

/-- The same computed corner is an isometry for the original metrics. -/
theorem rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_isometry (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B;
    letI : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B;
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    Isometry (rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) η) := by
  let : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  let : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let F := Standard B κ
  let KF := compactStarSubalgebra (B := B) (E := F)
  let f : CStarMatrix I I B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] KF := rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) η
  let ψ : CStarMatrix I I B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] End B F :=
    (NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype KF).comp f
  have hψ : Function.Injective ψ := by
    intro M N h
    apply rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_injective (B := B) η
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact h
  refine isometry_iff_dist_eq.mpr ?_
  intro X Y
  calc
    dist (rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) η X)
        (rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) η Y) = dist (ψ X) (ψ Y) := rfl
    _ = dist X Y := (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.isometry ψ hψ).dist_eq X Y

/-- Literal top-left zero padding leaves the actual initial-segment compact
corner unchanged. Ordinary size zero is the empty finite stage. -/
theorem rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_zeroExtend {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (X : CStarMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n) B) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B)
        (⟨Fin.val, Fin.val_injective⟩ : Fin m ↪ ℕ)
        (CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom h X) =
      rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B)
        (⟨Fin.val, Fin.val_injective⟩ : Fin n ↪ ℕ) X := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  classical
  rcases Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h with ⟨d, rfl⟩
  let ηn : Fin n ↪ ℕ := ⟨Fin.val, Fin.val_injective⟩
  let ηm : Fin (n + d) ↪ ℕ := ⟨Fin.val, Fin.val_injective⟩
  let Y : CStarMatrix (Fin (n + d)) (Fin (n + d)) B :=
    CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom h X
  have hηn (i : Fin n) : ηn i = i.val :=
    congrFun (Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk
      (Fin.val : Fin n → ℕ) Fin.val_injective) i
  have hηm (i : Fin (n + d)) : ηm i = i.val :=
    congrFun (Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk
      (Fin.val : Fin (n + d) → ℕ) Fin.val_injective) i
  have hRetained (i j : Fin n) : Y (i.castAdd d) (j.castAdd d) = X i j := by
    have hentry := CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom_apply_entry (A := B) h X
      (i.castAdd d) (j.castAdd d)
    calc
      Y (i.castAdd d) (j.castAdd d) =
          CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom h X (i.castAdd d) (j.castAdd d) := rfl
      _ = X i j := by
        simpa only [Fin.val_castAdd, i.isLt, j.isLt, ↓reduceDIte] using hentry
  have hNewRow (i : Fin d) (j : Fin (n + d)) : Y (Fin.natAdd n i) j = 0 := by
    have hge : n ≤ (Fin.natAdd n i).val := by
      rw [Fin.val_natAdd]
      exact Nat.le_add_right n i.val
    have hentry := CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom_apply_entry (A := B) h X
      (Fin.natAdd n i) j
    calc
      Y (Fin.natAdd n i) j =
          CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom h X (Fin.natAdd n i) j := rfl
      _ = 0 := hentry.trans (dite_eq_right (not_lt_of_ge hge))
  have hNewColumn (i : Fin n) (j : Fin d) :
      Y (i.castAdd d) (Fin.natAdd n j) = 0 := by
    have hge : n ≤ (Fin.natAdd n j).val := by
      rw [Fin.val_natAdd]
      exact Nat.le_add_right n j.val
    have hnot : ¬ (Fin.natAdd n j).val < n := not_lt_of_ge hge
    have hentry := CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom_apply_entry (A := B) h X
      (i.castAdd d) (Fin.natAdd n j)
    calc
      Y (i.castAdd d) (Fin.natAdd n j) =
          CStarMatrix.zeroExtendStarAlgHom h X (i.castAdd d) (Fin.natAdd n j) := rfl
      _ = 0 := by
        simpa only [Fin.val_castAdd, i.isLt, hnot, ↓reduceDIte] using hentry
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply AdjointableOperator.ext
  intro y
  change (rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) ηm Y :
      End B (Standard B ℕ)) y =
    (rightMatrixStandardCompactHom (B := B) ηn X : End B (Standard B ℕ)) y
  rw [rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_apply, rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_apply]
  have hColumns (i : Fin n) :
      (∑ j : Fin (n + d), Y (i.castAdd d) j * Standard.coord (ηm j) y) =
        ∑ j : Fin n, X i j * Standard.coord (ηn j) y := by
    calc
      (∑ j : Fin (n + d), Y (i.castAdd d) j * Standard.coord (ηm j) y) =
          ∑ j : Fin n, Y (i.castAdd d) (j.castAdd d) *
            Standard.coord (ηm (j.castAdd d)) y :=
        Fin.sum_trunc
          (fun j : Fin (n + d) => Y (i.castAdd d) j * Standard.coord (ηm j) y)
          (fun j : Fin d => by rw [hNewColumn, zero_mul])
      _ = ∑ j : Fin n, X i j * Standard.coord (ηn j) y := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        simp only [hRetained, hηm, hηn, Fin.val_castAdd]
  calc
    (∑ i : Fin (n + d), Standard.single (ηm i)
        (∑ j : Fin (n + d), Y i j * Standard.coord (ηm j) y)) =
        ∑ i : Fin n, Standard.single (ηm (i.castAdd d))
          (∑ j : Fin (n + d), Y (i.castAdd d) j * Standard.coord (ηm j) y) :=
      Fin.sum_trunc
        (fun i : Fin (n + d) => Standard.single (ηm i)
          (∑ j : Fin (n + d), Y i j * Standard.coord (ηm j) y))
        (fun i : Fin d => by
          have hZero :
              (∑ j : Fin (n + d), Y (Fin.natAdd n i) j *
                Standard.coord (ηm j) y) = 0 :=
            Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => by rw [hNewRow, zero_mul]
          rw [hZero, map_zero])
    _ = ∑ i : Fin n, Standard.single (ηn i)
        (∑ j : Fin n, X i j * Standard.coord (ηn j) y) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      have hIndex : ηm (i.castAdd d) = ηn i := by
        calc
          ηm (i.castAdd d) = (i.castAdd d).val := hηm (i.castAdd d)
          _ = i.val := by rw [Fin.val_castAdd]
          _ = ηn i := (hηn i).symm
      calc
        Standard.single (ηm (i.castAdd d))
            (∑ j : Fin (n + d), Y (i.castAdd d) j * Standard.coord (ηm j) y) =
            Standard.single (ηm (i.castAdd d))
              (∑ j : Fin n, X i j * Standard.coord (ηn j) y) :=
          congrArg (Standard.single (ηm (i.castAdd d))) (hColumns i)
        _ = Standard.single (ηn i)
            (∑ j : Fin n, X i j * Standard.coord (ηn j) y) :=
          congrArg (fun k : ℕ => Standard.single k
            (∑ j : Fin n, X i j * Standard.coord (ηn j) y)) hIndex

end CStarModule.AdjointableOperator

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Ideal.Hereditary
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Compact
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Support

/-!
# Analytic strong Morita equivalence

Two complex C-star algebras are strongly Morita equivalent when a full right
Hilbert module over the second algebra carries a bijective nonunital star
homomorphism from the first algebra onto its actual compact endomorphism
algebra.  This is an analytic relation and is distinct from ring-theoretic
Morita equivalence.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Set

namespace CStarModule

universe uA uB

/-- Analytic strong Morita equivalence through a full Hilbert module and the
literal compact-operator C-star algebra. -/
def StronglyMoritaEquivalent
    (A : Type uA) (B : Type uB)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] : Prop :=
  let _ : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let _ : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  ∃ (E : Type (max uA uB)) (hE : NormedAddCommGroup E),
    let _ := hE
    ∃ hES : NormedSpace ℂ E,
    let _ := hES
    ∃ hsmul : SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E,
    let _ := hsmul
    ∃ hmodule : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E,
    let _ := hmodule
    ∃ hcomplete : CompleteSpace E,
    let _ := hcomplete
    ∃ α : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] AdjointableOperator.End B E,
      IsFull B E ∧
      ∃ hcompact : ∀ a, α a ∈ AdjointableOperator.compactStarSubalgebra,
        Function.Bijective
          (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.codRestrict α
            AdjointableOperator.compactStarSubalgebra hcompact)

/-- A star subalgebra is full hereditary when it is closed, hereditary in the
shared canonical-order sense, and contained in no proper closed two-sided
ideal. -/
def IsFullHereditarySubalgebra
    {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (S : NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ B) : Prop :=
  IsClosed (S : Set B) ∧ S.IsHereditary ∧
    ∀ I : ClosedStarIdeal B, (∀ x ∈ S, x ∈ I) → I = ⊤

end CStarModule

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Unitary.Dense

import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Matrix.Positivity
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Order

/-!
# Dense-range polar decomposition for adjointable module maps

For an adjointable map `T : E → F`, suppose the adjoint square `T* T` and `T`
have dense range.  The existing rectangular-operator positivity theorem makes
`T* T` nonnegative in the canonical spectral order.  Its
continuous-functional-calculus square root has dense range, and the rule
`sqrt (T* T) x ↦ T x` extends to a unique unitary equivalence.

This is the source-neutral analytic step used in Blackadar, *K-Theory for
Operator Algebras*, second edition, in the proof of Theorem 13.6.2.  The
compactness of the particular operator constructed there is not used here.

No compactness, fullness, countability, or closed-range hypothesis is used.
The cross-module positivity input is the actual
`AdjointableOperator.adjoint_comp_self_nonneg` theorem, not a supplied model or
an inferred global order instance.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set

namespace CStarModule.AdjointableOperator

noncomputable section

universe uB uE uF

variable {B : Type uB} {E : Type uE} {F : Type uF}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
  [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E]
  [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E] [CompleteSpace E]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ F]
  [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ F] [CompleteSpace F]

/-- The endomorphism `T* T` belonging to a cross-module adjointable map. -/
abbrev adjointSquare (T : AdjointableOperator B E F) : End B E :=
  T.adjointOperator.comp T

/-- The positive square root of `T* T` in the adjointable endomorphism
C-star algebra. -/
noncomputable def absoluteValue
    (T : AdjointableOperator B E F) : End B E := by
  letI : PartialOrder (End B E) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  letI : StarOrderedRing (End B E) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  exact CFC.sqrt T.adjointSquare

omit [CompleteSpace F] in
/-- The absolute value is nonnegative in the canonical spectral order. -/
theorem absoluteValue_nonnegative (T : AdjointableOperator B E F) :
    @LE.le (End B E) (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder (End B E)).toLE
      0 T.absoluteValue := by
  let _ : PartialOrder (End B E) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let _ : StarOrderedRing (End B E) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  exact CFC.sqrt_nonneg T.adjointSquare

/-- The square of the absolute value is the adjoint square. -/
theorem absoluteValue_sq (T : AdjointableOperator B E F) :
    T.absoluteValue * T.absoluteValue = T.adjointSquare := by
  let _ : PartialOrder (End B E) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let _ : StarOrderedRing (End B E) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  have hnonneg : (0 : End B E) ≤ T.adjointSquare :=
    adjoint_comp_self_nonneg T
  simpa only [absoluteValue] using
    CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self T.adjointSquare hnonneg

omit [CompleteSpace F] in
private theorem absoluteValue_adjointOperator
    (T : AdjointableOperator B E F) :
    T.absoluteValue.adjointOperator = T.absoluteValue := by
  change star T.absoluteValue = T.absoluteValue
  let _ : PartialOrder (End B E) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let _ : StarOrderedRing (End B E) := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  exact (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (absoluteValue_nonnegative T)).star_eq

/-- Dense range of `T* T` implies dense range of its positive square root. -/
theorem denseRange_absoluteValue_of_denseRange_adjointSquare
    (T : AdjointableOperator B E F)
    (hDense : DenseRange T.adjointSquare) :
    DenseRange T.absoluteValue := by
  refine Dense.mono ?_ hDense
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨T.absoluteValue x, ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun S : End B E => S x) (absoluteValue_sq T)
  simpa only [mul_apply] using h

private theorem absoluteValue_gram
    (T : AdjointableOperator B E F)
    (x y : E) :
    rightInner (B := B) (T x) (T y) =
      rightInner (B := B) (T.absoluteValue x) (T.absoluteValue y) := by
  have hSquareApply :
      T.absoluteValue (T.absoluteValue y) = T.adjointSquare y := by
    have h := congrArg (fun S : End B E => S y) (absoluteValue_sq T)
    simpa only [mul_apply] using h
  have hAdjointApply :
      T.absoluteValue.adjoint (T.absoluteValue y) =
        T.absoluteValue (T.absoluteValue y) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun S : End B E => S (T.absoluteValue y))
      (absoluteValue_adjointOperator T)
    exact h
  calc
    rightInner (B := B) (T x) (T y) =
        rightInner (B := B) x (T.adjoint (T y)) :=
      T.adjoint_inner x (T y)
    _ = rightInner (B := B) x (T.adjointSquare y) := by
      rfl
    _ = rightInner (B := B) x
        (T.absoluteValue (T.absoluteValue y)) := by
      rw [hSquareApply]
    _ = rightInner (B := B) x
        (T.absoluteValue.adjoint (T.absoluteValue y)) := by
      rw [hAdjointApply]
    _ = rightInner (B := B) (T.absoluteValue x)
        (T.absoluteValue y) := by
      exact (T.absoluteValue.adjoint_inner x (T.absoluteValue y)).symm

/-- The canonical unitary factor in the dense-range polar decomposition. -/
@[no_expose]
noncomputable def polarUnitary
    (T : AdjointableOperator B E F)
    (hAbsoluteDense : DenseRange T.absoluteValue)
    (hDense : DenseRange T) :
    CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv B E F :=
  CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv.ofDenseLinearMaps
    T.absoluteValue.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap
    T.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap
    (by
      change DenseRange T.absoluteValue
      exact hAbsoluteDense)
    (by
      change DenseRange T
      exact hDense)
    T.absoluteValue_gram

/-- The polar unitary is characterized on the dense range of the absolute
value by `U (|T| x) = T x`. -/
@[simp]
theorem polarUnitary_absoluteValue_apply
    (T : AdjointableOperator B E F)
    (hAbsoluteDense : DenseRange T.absoluteValue)
    (hDense : DenseRange T) (x : E) :
    T.polarUnitary hAbsoluteDense hDense (T.absoluteValue x) = T x := by
  exact CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv.ofDenseLinearMaps_apply
    T.absoluteValue.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap
    T.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap _ _ T.absoluteValue_gram x

/-- The adjoint of the polar unitary sends `T x` back to `|T| x`. -/
@[simp]
theorem polarUnitary_adjoint_apply
    (T : AdjointableOperator B E F)
    (hAbsoluteDense : DenseRange T.absoluteValue)
    (hDense : DenseRange T) (x : E) :
    (T.polarUnitary hAbsoluteDense hDense).toAdjointable.adjoint (T x) =
      T.absoluteValue x := by
  exact CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv.ofDenseLinearMaps_adjoint_apply
    T.absoluteValue.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap
    T.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap _ _ T.absoluteValue_gram x

/-- Dense-range polar decomposition in source orientation `T = U |T|`. -/
theorem polarDecomposition
    (T : AdjointableOperator B E F)
    (hAbsoluteDense : DenseRange T.absoluteValue)
    (hDense : DenseRange T) :
    T = (T.polarUnitary hAbsoluteDense hDense).toAdjointable.comp
      T.absoluteValue := by
  apply AdjointableOperator.ext
  intro x
  exact (T.polarUnitary_absoluteValue_apply hAbsoluteDense hDense x).symm

/-- Dense ranges of `T* T` and `T` give one unitary polar decomposition,
with the unitary characterized on every square-root image. -/
theorem exists_polarDecomposition
    (T : AdjointableOperator B E F)
    (hSquareDense : DenseRange T.adjointSquare)
    (hDense : DenseRange T) :
    ∃ U : CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv B E F,
      T = U.toAdjointable.comp T.absoluteValue ∧
        ∀ x, U (T.absoluteValue x) = T x := by
  let hAbsoluteDense : DenseRange T.absoluteValue :=
    T.denseRange_absoluteValue_of_denseRange_adjointSquare hSquareDense
  exact ⟨T.polarUnitary hAbsoluteDense hDense,
    T.polarDecomposition hAbsoluteDense hDense,
    T.polarUnitary_absoluteValue_apply hAbsoluteDense hDense⟩

/-- The unitary in the dense-range polar decomposition is unique. -/
theorem polarUnitary_unique
    (T : AdjointableOperator B E F)
    (hAbsoluteDense : DenseRange T.absoluteValue)
    (hDense : DenseRange T)
    (U : CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv B E F)
    (hU : T = U.toAdjointable.comp T.absoluteValue) :
    U = T.polarUnitary hAbsoluteDense hDense := by
  apply CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv.ofDenseLinearMaps_unique
    T.absoluteValue.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap
    T.toContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap
    (by
      change DenseRange T.absoluteValue
      exact hAbsoluteDense)
    (by
      change DenseRange T
      exact hDense)
    T.absoluteValue_gram
  intro x
  change U (T.absoluteValue x) = T x
  calc
    U (T.absoluteValue x) =
        (U.toAdjointable.comp T.absoluteValue) x := by rfl
    _ = T x := (congrArg (fun S : AdjointableOperator B E F => S x) hU).symm

end

end CStarModule.AdjointableOperator

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.RectangularPartial
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Right
public import Mathlib.Topology.Separation.Hausdorff

/-!
# The actual adjoint of a dense rectangular right-module operator

The adjoint domain is the full set of vectors admitting a coefficient-valued
pairing witness. Density makes that witness unique, and the chosen value
defines the actual complex-linear partial adjoint and right-module action.
The graph is precisely the intersection of its closed pairing equations.
No density of the adjoint domain, closedness of the original operator,
regularity or orthogonal complement is assumed.

The compatible `StarOrderedRing` dictionary is the one used by the existing
right-inner-product continuity API. The canonical spectral order supplies
it for the original C-star coefficient algebra; no unit is required.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open Set
open scoped RightActions

namespace CStarModule.DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator

universe uB uE uF

variable {B : Type uB} {E : Type uE} {F : Type uF}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ F] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ F]

/-- The literal coefficient pairing equation defining an adjoint witness. -/
def IsAdjointWitness (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F) (y : F) (z : E) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ x : T.toPartial.domain,
    rightInner (B := B) (T.toPartial x) y = rightInner (B := B) (x : E) z

/-- Every vector admitting an actual adjoint witness belongs to the full adjoint domain. -/
def adjointDomain (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F) : Submodule ℂ F where
  carrier := {y | ∃ z : E, IsAdjointWitness T y z}
  zero_mem' := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    intro x
    rw [rightInner_zero_right, rightInner_zero_right]
  add_mem' := by
    rintro y y' ⟨z, hz⟩ ⟨z', hz'⟩
    refine ⟨z + z', ?_⟩
    intro x
    rw [rightInner_add_right, rightInner_add_right, hz x, hz' x]
  smul_mem' := by
    rintro c y ⟨z, hz⟩
    refine ⟨c • z, ?_⟩
    intro x
    rw [rightInner_smul_right, rightInner_smul_right, hz x]

/-- The domain is exactly the original full witness set. -/
@[simp]
theorem mem_adjointDomain_iff (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F) (y : F) :
    y ∈ adjointDomain T ↔ ∃ z : E, IsAdjointWitness T y z := Iff.rfl

/-- The full adjoint domain is stable under right multiplication by the coefficient algebra. -/
theorem adjointDomain_right_smul (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F)
    {y : F} (hy : y ∈ adjointDomain T) (b : B) : y <• b ∈ adjointDomain T := by
  rcases hy with ⟨z, hz⟩
  refine ⟨z <• b, ?_⟩
  intro x
  rw [rightInner_right_smul, rightInner_right_smul, hz x]

variable [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]

/-- Density of the original domain makes each adjoint witness unique. -/
theorem adjointWitness_unique (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F)
    {y : F} {z z' : E} (hz : IsAdjointWitness T y z) (hz' : IsAdjointWitness T y z') :
    z = z' := by
  apply ext_rightInner (B := B)
  intro x
  have h := Continuous.ext_on T.dense_domain
    (continuous_rightInner_left (B := B) z)
    (continuous_rightInner_left (B := B) z')
    (by
      intro u hu
      exact (hz ⟨u, hu⟩).symm.trans (hz' ⟨u, hu⟩))
  exact congrFun h x

/-- The full domain supplies a proved unique witness for every one of its vectors. -/
theorem existsUnique_adjointWitness (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F)
    (y : adjointDomain T) : ∃! z : E, IsAdjointWitness T (y : F) z := by
  rcases y.property with ⟨z, hz⟩
  refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
  intro z' hz'
  exact adjointWitness_unique T hz' hz

/-- The actual adjoint value is the unique witness already proved to exist in its domain. -/
def adjointValue (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F) (y : adjointDomain T) : E :=
  Classical.choose (existsUnique_adjointWitness T y)

/-- The constructed value satisfies the full original pairing equation. -/
theorem adjointValue_spec (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F)
    (y : adjointDomain T) : IsAdjointWitness T (y : F) (adjointValue T y) :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (existsUnique_adjointWitness T y)).1

@[simp]
theorem adjointValue_zero (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F) :
    adjointValue T 0 = 0 := by
  apply adjointWitness_unique T (adjointValue_spec T 0)
  intro x
  change rightInner (B := B) (T.toPartial x) (0 : F) =
    rightInner (B := B) (x : E) (0 : E)
  rw [rightInner_zero_right, rightInner_zero_right]

@[simp]
theorem adjointValue_add (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F)
    (y y' : adjointDomain T) :
    adjointValue T (y + y') = adjointValue T y + adjointValue T y' := by
  apply adjointWitness_unique T (adjointValue_spec T (y + y'))
  intro x
  change rightInner (B := B) (T.toPartial x) ((y : F) + (y' : F)) =
    rightInner (B := B) (x : E) (adjointValue T y + adjointValue T y')
  rw [rightInner_add_right, rightInner_add_right,
    adjointValue_spec T y x, adjointValue_spec T y' x]

@[simp]
theorem adjointValue_smul (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F)
    (c : ℂ) (y : adjointDomain T) :
    adjointValue T (c • y) = c • adjointValue T y := by
  apply adjointWitness_unique T (adjointValue_spec T (c • y))
  intro x
  change rightInner (B := B) (T.toPartial x) (c • (y : F)) =
    rightInner (B := B) (x : E) (c • adjointValue T y)
  rw [rightInner_smul_right, rightInner_smul_right, adjointValue_spec T y x]

/-- The selected adjoint witness preserves the original right coefficient multiplication. -/
theorem adjointValue_right_smul (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F)
    (y : adjointDomain T) (b : B) :
    adjointValue T ⟨(y : F) <• b, adjointDomain_right_smul T y.property b⟩ =
      adjointValue T y <• b := by
  apply adjointWitness_unique T (adjointValue_spec T
    ⟨(y : F) <• b, adjointDomain_right_smul T y.property b⟩)
  intro x
  rw [rightInner_right_smul, rightInner_right_smul, adjointValue_spec T y x]

/-- The genuine rectangular complex-linear partial adjoint on its full witness domain. -/
def adjoint (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F) : F →ₗ.[ℂ] E where
  domain := adjointDomain T
  toFun :=
    { toFun := adjointValue T
      map_add' := adjointValue_add T
      map_smul' := fun c y => by
        simpa only [RingHom.id_apply] using adjointValue_smul T c y }

@[simp]
theorem adjoint_domain (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F) :
    (adjoint T).domain = adjointDomain T := rfl

@[simp]
theorem adjoint_apply (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F)
    (y : adjointDomain T) : (adjoint T) y = adjointValue T y := rfl

/-- The partial adjoint satisfies the original coefficient-valued pairing on both domains. -/
theorem adjoint_pairing (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F)
    (x : T.toPartial.domain) (y : adjointDomain T) :
    rightInner (B := B) (T.toPartial x) (y : F) =
      rightInner (B := B) (x : E) ((adjoint T) y) :=
  adjointValue_spec T y x

/-- The partial adjoint is right-linear on its actual source domain. -/
theorem adjoint_right_smul (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F)
    (y : adjointDomain T) (b : B) :
    (adjoint T) ⟨(y : F) <• b, adjointDomain_right_smul T y.property b⟩ =
      (adjoint T) y <• b :=
  adjointValue_right_smul T y b

/-- The actual graph consists of all pairs satisfying the original full pairing equations. -/
theorem adjoint_graph_eq (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F) :
    ((adjoint T).graph : Set (F × E)) =
      {p | IsAdjointWitness T p.1 p.2} := by
  ext p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    rcases (LinearPMap.mem_graph_iff (adjoint T)).1 hp with ⟨y, hy, hz⟩
    have h := adjointValue_spec T y
    change IsAdjointWitness T (y : F) ((adjoint T) y) at h
    rw [hy, hz] at h
    exact h
  · intro hp
    have hy : p.1 ∈ adjointDomain T := ⟨p.2, hp⟩
    apply (LinearPMap.mem_graph_iff (adjoint T)).2
    refine ⟨⟨p.1, hy⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
    exact adjointWitness_unique T (adjointValue_spec T ⟨p.1, hy⟩) hp

/-- The full witness graph is closed in the original product norm topology. -/
theorem isClosed_adjoint_graph (T : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F) :
    IsClosed ((adjoint T).graph : Set (F × E)) := by
  have hs : {p : F × E | IsAdjointWitness T p.1 p.2} =
      ⋂ x : T.toPartial.domain,
        {p | rightInner (B := B) (T.toPartial x) p.1 = rightInner (B := B) (x : E) p.2} := by
    ext p
    simp only [IsAdjointWitness, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter]
  rw [adjoint_graph_eq, hs]
  apply isClosed_iInter
  intro x
  exact isClosed_eq
    ((continuous_rightInner_right (B := B) (T.toPartial x)).comp continuous_fst)
    ((continuous_rightInner_right (B := B) (x : E)).comp continuous_snd)

end CStarModule.DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator

module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Action.Opposite
public import Mathlib.Basic.Complex.Basic
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Defs
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.LinearPMap

/-!
# Dense rectangular partial operators with right coefficient actions

The operator has its original dense complex submodule as domain and an
actual complex-linear map from that domain to the independent codomain.
Right coefficient stability and linearity express the original nonunital
module action; no `Module B` structure or coefficient unit is imposed.
This carrier uses only normed additive groups, complex modules and right actions.
The adjoint construction supplies the original normed C-star-module context.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set
open scoped RightActions

namespace CStarModule

universe uB uE uF

/-- A densely defined right-linear operator between the original right modules. -/
structure DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator
    (B : Type uB) (E : Type uE) (F : Type uF)
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [Module ℂ F] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ F] where
  /-- The original rectangular complex-linear partial map. -/
  toPartial : E →ₗ.[ℂ] F
  /-- Its actual domain is dense in the original source norm topology. -/
  dense_domain : Dense (toPartial.domain : Set E)
  /-- The domain is stable under the original right coefficient action. -/
  domain_right_smul : ∀ (x : E), x ∈ toPartial.domain → ∀ b : B,
    x <• b ∈ toPartial.domain
  /-- The actual partial map preserves that right coefficient action. -/
  map_right_smul : ∀ (x : toPartial.domain) (b : B),
    toPartial ⟨(x : E) <• b, domain_right_smul (x : E) x.property b⟩ =
      toPartial x <• b

namespace DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator

variable {B : Type uB} {E : Type uE} {F : Type uF}
variable [NormedAddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup F] [Module ℂ F] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ F]

/-- Dense right-linear operators are determined by their genuine partial maps. -/
@[ext]
theorem ext {T S : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E F}
    (h : T.toPartial = S.toPartial) : T = S := by
  cases T
  cases S
  cases h
  rfl

end DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator

end CStarModule

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Adjointable
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.LinearPMap

/-!
# Regular operators on right C-star modules

This file defines a domain-aware carrier for regular operators.  A partial
operator and its adjoint are mutually maximal adjoints, both domains are
dense, and the literal partial range of `1 + T* T` is dense.  Mutual
maximality records `T = T**` and therefore closedness; right-module linearity
is deliberately not stored as a field.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Set
open scoped RightActions

namespace CStarModule

universe uB uE

variable {B : Type uB} {E : Type uE}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E]
  [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E]

/-- A densely-defined complex-linear operator before regularity hypotheses
are imposed. -/
abbrev PartialOperator := E →ₗ.[ℂ] E

/-- `S` is the maximal adjoint of `T`: its domain is exactly the vectors
admitting an adjoint witness, and its action is that unique witness. -/
def IsMaximalAdjoint (T S : PartialOperator (E := E)) : Prop :=
  (∀ y : E, y ∈ S.domain ↔
    ∃! z : E, ∀ x : T.domain,
      rightInner (B := B) (T x) y = rightInner (B := B) (x : E) z) ∧
  ∀ (y : S.domain) (x : T.domain),
    rightInner (B := B) (T x) (y : E) =
      rightInner (B := B) (x : E) (S y)

/-- A closed regular operator with its maximal adjoint.  Mutual maximality is
the domain-aware equality `T = T**`. -/
structure RegularOperator [CompleteSpace E] where
  /-- The original partial operator. -/
  toPartial : PartialOperator (E := E)
  /-- Its maximal adjoint. -/
  adjoint : PartialOperator (E := E)
  /-- The selected partial map is maximal as the adjoint of `toPartial`. -/
  adjoint_maximal : IsMaximalAdjoint (B := B) toPartial adjoint
  /-- The original map is the maximal adjoint of `adjoint`. -/
  doubleAdjoint_maximal : IsMaximalAdjoint (B := B) adjoint toPartial
  /-- The domain of `T` is dense. -/
  dense_domain : Dense (toPartial.domain : Set E)
  /-- The domain of `T*` is dense. -/
  dense_adjointDomain : Dense (adjoint.domain : Set E)
  /-- The partial range of `1 + T* T` is dense. -/
  dense_one_add_adjoint_comp_range : Dense
    {z : E | ∃ (x : E) (hx : x ∈ toPartial.domain)
      (hTx : toPartial ⟨x, hx⟩ ∈ adjoint.domain),
      z = x + adjoint ⟨toPartial ⟨x, hx⟩, hTx⟩}

namespace RegularOperator

variable [CompleteSpace E] [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]

/-- The domain of a regular operator is stable under the source-order right
coefficient action. -/
theorem mem_domain_right_smul (T : RegularOperator (B := B) (E := E))
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ T.toPartial.domain) (b : B) :
    x <• b ∈ T.toPartial.domain := by
  apply (T.doubleAdjoint_maximal.1 (x <• b)).2
  have hWitness : ∀ u : T.adjoint.domain,
      rightInner (B := B) (T.adjoint u) (x <• b) =
        rightInner (B := B) (u : E)
          (T.toPartial ⟨x, hx⟩ <• b) := by
    intro u
    have hAdj :
        rightInner (B := B) (T.adjoint u) x =
          rightInner (B := B) (u : E) (T.toPartial ⟨x, hx⟩) := by
      have h := congrArg star (T.adjoint_maximal.2 u ⟨x, hx⟩)
      simpa only [star_rightInner] using h.symm
    calc
      rightInner (B := B) (T.adjoint u) (x <• b) =
          rightInner (B := B) (T.adjoint u) x * b := by simp
      _ = rightInner (B := B) (u : E) (T.toPartial ⟨x, hx⟩) * b :=
        congrArg (· * b) hAdj
      _ = rightInner (B := B) (u : E)
          (T.toPartial ⟨x, hx⟩ <• b) := by simp
  refine ⟨T.toPartial ⟨x, hx⟩ <• b, hWitness, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  apply CStarModule.ext_rightInner (B := B)
  intro v
  have hContinuous := Continuous.ext_on T.dense_adjointDomain
    (continuous_rightInner_left (B := B) z)
    (continuous_rightInner_left (B := B)
      (T.toPartial ⟨x, hx⟩ <• b))
    (by
      intro u hu
      exact (hz ⟨u, hu⟩).symm.trans (hWitness ⟨u, hu⟩))
  exact congrFun hContinuous v

/-- A regular operator intertwines the source-order right coefficient
action on its domain. -/
theorem map_right_smul (T : RegularOperator (B := B) (E := E))
    (x : T.toPartial.domain) (b : B) :
    T.toPartial
        ⟨(x : E) <• b, T.mem_domain_right_smul x.2 b⟩ =
      T.toPartial x <• b := by
  apply CStarModule.ext_rightInner (B := B)
  intro v
  have hContinuous := Continuous.ext_on T.dense_adjointDomain
    (continuous_rightInner_left (B := B)
      (T.toPartial
        ⟨(x : E) <• b, T.mem_domain_right_smul x.2 b⟩))
    (continuous_rightInner_left (B := B) (T.toPartial x <• b))
    (by
      intro u hu
      let u' : T.adjoint.domain := ⟨u, hu⟩
      have hAdj :
          rightInner (B := B) (T.adjoint u') (x : E) =
            rightInner (B := B) (u' : E) (T.toPartial x) := by
        have h := congrArg star (T.adjoint_maximal.2 u' x)
        simpa only [star_rightInner] using h.symm
      calc
        rightInner (B := B) u
            (T.toPartial
              ⟨(x : E) <• b, T.mem_domain_right_smul x.2 b⟩) =
            rightInner (B := B) (T.adjoint u') ((x : E) <• b) :=
          (T.doubleAdjoint_maximal.2
            ⟨(x : E) <• b, T.mem_domain_right_smul x.2 b⟩ u').symm
        _ = rightInner (B := B) (T.adjoint u') (x : E) * b := by
          simp
        _ = rightInner (B := B) (u' : E) (T.toPartial x) * b :=
          congrArg (· * b) hAdj
        _ = rightInner (B := B) u (T.toPartial x <• b) := by
          simp [u'])
  exact congrFun hContinuous v

/-- Positivity in the canonical spectral order on the adjointable
endomorphism C-star algebra. -/
def IsSpectrallyNonnegative
    (T : AdjointableOperator.End B E) : Prop :=
  @LE.le (AdjointableOperator.End B E)
    (CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder (AdjointableOperator.End B E)).toLE 0 T

/-- Domain-aware bounded-transform data for a regular operator.  The range
clauses make `h⁻¹` and `l⁻¹` partial inverses on their natural domains. -/
structure BoundedTransformData (T : RegularOperator (B := B) (E := E)) where
  /-- The bounded extension of `(1 + T* T)⁻¹/²`. -/
  h : AdjointableOperator.End B E
  /-- The bounded extension of `(1 + T T*)⁻¹/²`. -/
  l : AdjointableOperator.End B E
  /-- The bounded transform extending `T h`. -/
  F : AdjointableOperator.End B E
  h_nonnegative : IsSpectrallyNonnegative h
  l_nonnegative : IsSpectrallyNonnegative l
  h_mem_domain : ∀ x, h x ∈ T.toPartial.domain
  l_mem_adjointDomain : ∀ x, l x ∈ T.adjoint.domain
  h_parametrizes_domain : ∀ (y : E), y ∈ T.toPartial.domain →
    ∃! x : E, h x = y
  l_parametrizes_adjointDomain : ∀ (y : E), y ∈ T.adjoint.domain →
    ∃! x : E, l x = y
  F_extends_Th : ∀ x, T.toPartial ⟨h x, h_mem_domain x⟩ = F x
  Fstar_extends_Tstar_l : ∀ x,
    T.adjoint ⟨l x, l_mem_adjointDomain x⟩ = F.adjointOperator x
  h_squared_inverse : ∀ x,
    ∃ hy : h (h x) ∈ T.toPartial.domain,
      ∃ hTy : T.toPartial ⟨h (h x), hy⟩ ∈ T.adjoint.domain,
        h (h x) + T.adjoint ⟨T.toPartial ⟨h (h x), hy⟩, hTy⟩ = x
  l_squared_inverse : ∀ x,
    ∃ hy : l (l x) ∈ T.adjoint.domain,
      ∃ hTy : T.adjoint ⟨l (l x), hy⟩ ∈ T.toPartial.domain,
        l (l x) + T.toPartial ⟨T.adjoint ⟨l (l x), hy⟩, hTy⟩ = x

end RegularOperator

end CStarModule

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Regular
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.RectangularAdjoint

/-!
# Canonical regular operators and their actual dense partial maps

The canonical maximality fields identify the full computed adjoint and
computed double adjoint. The existing closed-adjoint graph theorem then
proves original closedness. These adapters are prerequisites for preserving
canonical regular operators in the source unbounded-multiplier API.
No converse from a weaker regularity predicate or output certificate is used.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Set
open scoped RightActions

namespace CStarModule
universe uB uE
variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
  [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E] [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]

namespace DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator

/-- The actual full computed adjoint satisfies literal canonical maximality. -/
theorem adjoint_isMaximal (t : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E E) :
    IsMaximalAdjoint (B := B) t.toPartial (adjoint t) := by
  constructor
  · intro y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      exact existsUnique_adjointWitness t ⟨y, hy⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, _⟩
      exact ⟨z, hz⟩
  · intro y x
    exact adjoint_pairing t x y

/-- A maximal adjoint is the actual unique full witness construction. -/
theorem maximalAdjoint_eq_adjoint (t : DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E E)
    (S : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E) (hS : IsMaximalAdjoint (B := B) t.toPartial S) :
    S = adjoint t := by
  apply LinearPMap.dExt
  · apply Submodule.ext
    intro y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      obtain ⟨z, hz, _⟩ := (hS.1 y).1 hy
      exact ⟨z, hz⟩
    · intro hy
      exact (hS.1 y).2 (existsUnique_adjointWitness t ⟨y, hy⟩)
  · intro y z hyz
    change S y = adjointValue t z
    have hleft : IsAdjointWitness t (y : E) (S y) := hS.2 y
    have hright : IsAdjointWitness t (y : E) (adjointValue t z) := by
      intro x
      calc
        rightInner (B := B) (t.toPartial x) (y : E) =
            rightInner (B := B) (t.toPartial x) (z : E) :=
          congrArg (rightInner (B := B) (t.toPartial x)) hyz
        _ = rightInner (B := B) (x : E) (adjointValue t z) := adjointValue_spec t z x
    exact adjointWitness_unique t hleft hright

end DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator

namespace RegularOperator
variable [CompleteSpace E]

/-- The canonical carrier supplies its actual dense right-linear partial map. -/
def toDenselyDefined (T : RegularOperator (B := B) (E := E)) :
    DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E E where
  toPartial := T.toPartial
  dense_domain := T.dense_domain
  domain_right_smul _x hx b := T.mem_domain_right_smul hx b
  map_right_smul x b := T.map_right_smul x b

/-- This adapter retains the original partial map and its exact domain. -/
theorem toDenselyDefined_toPartial (T : RegularOperator (B := B) (E := E)) :
    T.toDenselyDefined.toPartial = T.toPartial := rfl

/-- Canonical maximality identifies the entire computed adjoint partial map. -/
theorem computedAdjoint_eq (T : RegularOperator (B := B) (E := E)) :
    DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator.adjoint T.toDenselyDefined = T.adjoint :=
  (DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator.maximalAdjoint_eq_adjoint
    T.toDenselyDefined T.adjoint T.adjoint_maximal).symm

/-- The same actual computed adjoint, bundled only with its existing density. -/
def toDenselyDefinedAdjoint (T : RegularOperator (B := B) (E := E)) :
    DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator B E E where
  toPartial := DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator.adjoint T.toDenselyDefined
  dense_domain := by
    have hd := congrArg (fun p : E →ₗ.[ℂ] E => p.domain) T.computedAdjoint_eq
    rw [hd]
    exact T.dense_adjointDomain
  domain_right_smul y hy b :=
    DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator.adjointDomain_right_smul T.toDenselyDefined hy b
  map_right_smul y b :=
    DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator.adjoint_right_smul T.toDenselyDefined y b

/-- The dense adjoint adapter retains the canonical full adjoint. -/
theorem toDenselyDefinedAdjoint_toPartial (T : RegularOperator (B := B) (E := E)) :
    T.toDenselyDefinedAdjoint.toPartial = T.adjoint := T.computedAdjoint_eq

/-- Canonical mutual maximality identifies the actual computed double adjoint. -/
theorem computedDoubleAdjoint_eq (T : RegularOperator (B := B) (E := E)) :
    DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator.adjoint T.toDenselyDefinedAdjoint = T.toPartial := by
  have hmax : IsMaximalAdjoint (B := B) T.toDenselyDefinedAdjoint.toPartial T.toPartial :=
    T.toDenselyDefinedAdjoint_toPartial.symm ▸ T.doubleAdjoint_maximal
  exact (DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator.maximalAdjoint_eq_adjoint
    T.toDenselyDefinedAdjoint T.toPartial hmax).symm

/-- The original canonical graph is closed because it is the full double-adjoint graph. -/
theorem isClosed_graph (T : RegularOperator (B := B) (E := E)) :
    IsClosed (T.toPartial.graph : Set (E × E)) := by
  have h := DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator.isClosed_adjoint_graph T.toDenselyDefinedAdjoint
  rwa [T.computedDoubleAdjoint_eq] at h

/-- Keeping the original partial map loses no canonical regular-operator DATA. -/
theorem toDenselyDefined_injective :
    Function.Injective (toDenselyDefined (B := B) (E := E)) := by
  intro T U h
  have hp : T.toPartial = U.toPartial :=
    congrArg DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator.toPartial h
  have ha : T.adjoint = U.adjoint :=
    T.computedAdjoint_eq.symm.trans
      ((congrArg DenselyDefinedRightPartialOperator.adjoint h).trans U.computedAdjoint_eq)
  cases T
  cases U
  cases hp
  cases ha
  rfl

end RegularOperator
end CStarModule

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Right
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.LinearIsometry
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.Basic

/-!
# Right submodules of right C-star modules

This file packages a complex submodule of a right C-star module which is
stable under the right coefficient action.  Its subtype inherits the exact
coefficient-valued inner product and norm.  A closed right submodule of a
complete module is complete.

The construction is deliberately independent of orthogonal complementability:
closed Hilbert-module submodules need not be ranges of adjointable projections.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped RightActions

namespace CStarModule

universe uB uE

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
variable [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E]

/-- A complex submodule stable under the right coefficient action of `B`.

No closedness or complementability is stored.  Thus its subtype is always a
right pre-Hilbert module, and it becomes a Hilbert module when its carrier is
closed in a complete ambient module. -/
structure RightSubmodule (B : Type uB) (E : Type uE)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E] [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E]
    extends Submodule ℂ E where
  /-- The carrier is stable under Blackadar's right coefficient action. -/
  right_smul_mem' : ∀ {x : E}, x ∈ carrier → ∀ b : B, x <• b ∈ carrier

namespace RightSubmodule

variable (S : RightSubmodule B E)

instance : SetLike (RightSubmodule B E) E where
  coe S := S.carrier
  coe_injective S T h := by
    cases S
    cases T
    congr
    exact SetLike.coe_injective h

@[simp, nolint simpNF]
theorem mem_carrier {x : E} : x ∈ S.carrier ↔ x ∈ S :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- The underlying complex submodule. -/
def toComplexSubmodule : Submodule ℂ E :=
  S.toSubmodule

instance : AddCommGroup S :=
  inferInstanceAs (AddCommGroup S.toSubmodule)

instance : Module ℂ S :=
  inferInstanceAs (Module ℂ S.toSubmodule)

instance : NormedAddCommGroup S :=
  inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup S.toSubmodule)

instance : NormedSpace ℂ S :=
  inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℂ S.toSubmodule)

/-- Right coefficients act on a right submodule by restriction. -/
instance : SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ S where
  smul b x := ⟨(b : Bᵐᵒᵖ) • (x : E), S.right_smul_mem' x.property b.unop⟩

@[simp]
theorem coe_right_smul (x : S) (b : B) :
    ((x <• b : S) : E) = (x : E) <• b :=
  rfl

/-- The restricted coefficient-valued inner product makes every right
submodule a right pre-Hilbert C-star module. -/
instance : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ S where
  inner x y := inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (x : E) (y : E)
  inner_add_right := by
    intro x y z
    exact CStarModule.inner_add_right
  inner_self_nonneg := by
    intro x
    exact CStarModule.inner_self_nonneg
  inner_self := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (CStarModule.inner_self (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (x := (x : E))).mp hx
    · rintro rfl
      exact (CStarModule.inner_self (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (x := (0 : E))).mpr rfl
  inner_op_smul_right := by
    intro b x y
    exact CStarModule.inner_op_smul_right
  inner_smul_right_complex := by
    intro c x y
    exact CStarModule.inner_smul_right_complex
  star_inner := by
    intro x y
    exact CStarModule.star_inner (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (x : E) (y : E)
  norm_eq_sqrt_norm_inner_self := by
    intro x
    exact CStarModule.norm_eq_sqrt_norm_inner_self (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (x : E)

@[simp]
theorem inner_coe (x y : S) :
    inner Bᵐᵒᵖ x y = inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (x : E) (y : E) :=
  by
    change inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (x : E) (y : E) = _
    rfl

@[simp]
theorem rightInner_coe (x y : S) :
    rightInner (B := B) x y = rightInner (B := B) (x : E) (y : E) :=
  by
    change MulOpposite.unop (inner Bᵐᵒᵖ (x : E) (y : E)) = _
    rfl

/-- Closedness of a right submodule, stated on its literal ambient carrier. -/
def IsClosed : Prop :=
  _root_.IsClosed (S : Set E)

/-- A closed right submodule of a complete module is complete.  The result is
plain locally activatable data, so different closed carriers do not introduce
competing global instances on the ambient type. -/
theorem completeSpace [CompleteSpace E] (hS : S.IsClosed) : CompleteSpace S :=
  IsComplete.completeSpace_coe hS.isComplete

/-- The subtype inclusion of a right submodule as a complex-linear isometry. -/
def subtypeLIE : S →ₗᵢ[ℂ] E :=
  S.toSubmodule.subtypeₗᵢ

@[simp]
theorem subtypeLIE_apply (x : S) : S.subtypeLIE x = x :=
  rfl

/-- The full ambient module, viewed as a right submodule. -/
def top : RightSubmodule B E where
  toSubmodule := ⊤
  right_smul_mem' := by
    intro x _ b
    exact Submodule.mem_top

@[simp]
theorem mem_top (x : E) : x ∈ (top : RightSubmodule B E) :=
  trivial

/-- The zero right submodule. -/
def bot : RightSubmodule B E where
  toSubmodule := ⊥
  right_smul_mem' := by
    intro x hx b
    change x ∈ (⊥ : Submodule ℂ E) at hx
    change x <• b ∈ (⊥ : Submodule ℂ E)
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hx ⊢
    simp [hx]

@[simp]
theorem mem_bot {x : E} :
    x ∈ (RightSubmodule.bot (B := B) (E := E)) ↔ x = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    change x ∈ (⊥ : Submodule ℂ E) at hx
    exact (Submodule.mem_bot ℂ).mp hx
  · rintro rfl
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _

end RightSubmodule

end CStarModule

Author: @toskua
