module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Synonym
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Right

import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Isometry
import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.RingHom

/-!
# An explicit canonical right scalar model

The carrier is exactly `WithCStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ H`. The functions in this module supply its
canonical scalar, norm and inner-product dictionaries; no target-specific global instance is
registered. This prevents the generic synonym's inherited opposite action or its product/Pi
C-star-module constructions from silently selecting a different dictionary.

The original norm, uniformity and bornology are transported through the existing equivalence.
Every public characteristic uses the chosen factory data explicitly or pins them by local
instance bindings in its result type. No opposite action is installed on `H`.

The core requires only a complex inner-product space, not completeness. Lance Chapter 1,
Blackadar §13.1 and Connes II.Appendix A use conjugate-linear first/linear second conventions.
The standard `ComplexOrder` scope supplies the coefficient order; it is not installed globally.
-/

public section

open scoped ComplexOrder InnerProductSpace RightActions

universe u

/-- The existing coefficient-indexed carrier; this introduces no new synonym mechanism. -/
abbrev ScalarRight (H : Type u) : Type u :=
  WithCStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ H

namespace ScalarRight

/-- The ordinary complex module is copied exactly as in the synonym's inherited instance. -/
@[expose, instance_reducible]
def instComplexModule (H : Type u) [AddCommGroup H] [Module ℂ H] :
    Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Module ℂ H)

/-- The chosen opposite scalar action, independent of any opposite action already on `H`. -/
@[expose, instance_reducible]
def instOppositeSMul (H : Type u) [AddCommGroup H] [Module ℂ H] :
    SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) where
  smul a x :=
    (WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H).symm
      (MulOpposite.unop a • WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x)

/-- The chosen opposite module, pulled back from the fixed ordinary complex module. -/
@[expose, instance_reducible]
def instOppositeModule (H : Type u) [AddCommGroup H] [Module ℂ H] :
    Module ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := by
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  exact Module.compHom (ScalarRight H)
    { toFun := MulOpposite.unop
      map_one' := rfl
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_mul' := fun a b => mul_comm (MulOpposite.unop b) (MulOpposite.unop a) }

/-- These two factories choose exactly the same opposite scalar data. -/
theorem oppositeModule_toSMul
    (H : Type u) [AddCommGroup H] [Module ℂ H] :
    (instOppositeModule H).toSMul = instOppositeSMul H :=
  rfl

/-- The fixed original norm and metric, with the inherited comap uniformity and bornology. -/
@[expose, instance_reducible]
def instNormedAddCommGroup (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] :
    NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) :=
  NormedAddCommGroup.induced (ScalarRight H) H
    (WithCStarModule.addEquiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H)
    (WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H).injective

/-- The factory's uniformity is exactly the synonym's inherited uniformity. -/
theorem normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] :
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace =
      (inferInstance : UniformSpace H).comap (WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H) :=
  rfl

/-- The factory's bornology is exactly the synonym's inherited bornology. -/
theorem normedAddCommGroup_bornology
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] :
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toBornology =
      Bornology.induced (WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H) :=
  rfl

/-- The normed space uses the chosen norm and the chosen ordinary complex module. -/
@[expose, instance_reducible]
def instNormedSpace
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H] :
    let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  exact
    { toModule := instComplexModule H
      norm_smul_le := fun c x => by
        change ‖c • WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x‖ ≤
          ‖c‖ * ‖WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x‖
        exact norm_smul_le _ _ }

/-- The complex module in the normed-space factory is the chosen complex module. -/
theorem normedSpace_toModule
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H] :
    let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    (instNormedSpace H).toModule = instComplexModule H := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  rfl

/-- Reuse the existing continuous linear equivalence with its dictionaries fixed by `H`. -/
@[expose]
def equivL (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H] :
    let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    ScalarRight H ≃L[ℂ] H := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  exact WithCStarModule.equivL (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H) ℂ

theorem equivL_apply
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H] (x : ScalarRight H) :
    equivL H x = WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x :=
  rfl

theorem equivL_symm_apply
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H] (x : H) :
    (equivL H).symm x = (WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H).symm x :=
  rfl

/-- The chosen norm is exactly the original norm; no ambient synonym norm is consulted. -/
@[simp]
theorem norm_apply
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] (x : ScalarRight H) :
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toNorm.norm x =
      ‖WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x‖ :=
  rfl

/-- The fixed metric makes the canonical equivalence an isometry. -/
theorem isometry_equivL
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H] :
    let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    Isometry (equivL H) := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  exact Isometry.of_dist_eq fun _ _ => rfl

/-- The chosen opposite action has the original complex scalar formula. -/
@[simp]
theorem op_smul_apply
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H]
    (c : ℂ) (x : ScalarRight H) :
    equivL H ((instOppositeSMul H).smul (MulOpposite.op c) x) =
      c • equivL H x :=
  rfl

/-- Existing right-action notation agrees once the exact opposite action is installed locally. -/
@[simp]
theorem right_smul_apply
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H]
    (x : ScalarRight H) (c : ℂ) :
    let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    equivL H (x <• c) = c • equivL H x := by
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  rfl

/-- The chosen opposite-valued inner product, not an ambient C-star-module inner product. -/
@[expose, instance_reducible]
def instInner (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] :
    Inner ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) where
  inner x y := MulOpposite.op
    ⟪WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x, WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H y⟫_ℂ

@[simp]
theorem op_inner_apply
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (x y : ScalarRight H) :
    (instInner H).inner x y = MulOpposite.op ⟪equivL H x, equivL H y⟫_ℂ :=
  rfl

/-- The full canonical pre-Hilbert dictionary, with every target dictionary pinned. -/
@[expose, instance_reducible]
def cStarModule
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] :
    let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  exact {
    toInner := instInner H
    inner_add_right := by
      intro x y z
      apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
      change
        ⟪WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x,
          WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H y + WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H z⟫_ℂ =
        ⟪WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x, WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H y⟫_ℂ +
          ⟪WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x, WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H z⟫_ℂ
      exact inner_add_right _ _ _
    inner_self_nonneg := by
      intro x
      change (0 : ℂ) ≤
        ⟪WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x, WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x⟫_ℂ
      rw [← inner_self_ofReal_re, RCLike.ofReal_nonneg]
      exact inner_self_nonneg
    inner_self := by
      intro x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        apply (WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H).injective
        rw [WithCStarModule.equiv_zero]
        apply (inner_self_eq_zero (𝕜 := ℂ)).mp
        have h := congrArg MulOpposite.unop hx
        change MulOpposite.unop
            (MulOpposite.op
              ⟪WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x,
                WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x⟫_ℂ) = 0 at h
        simpa only [MulOpposite.unop_op] using h
      · rintro rfl
        simp
    inner_op_smul_right := by
      intro a x y
      apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
      change
        ⟪WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x,
          MulOpposite.unop a • WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H y⟫_ℂ =
        ⟪WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x, WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H y⟫_ℂ *
          MulOpposite.unop a
      rw [inner_smul_right, mul_comm]
    inner_smul_right_complex := by
      intro c x y
      apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
      change
        ⟪WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x,
          c • WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H y⟫_ℂ =
        c •
          ⟪WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x, WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H y⟫_ℂ
      exact inner_smul_right_eq_smul _ _ _
    star_inner := by
      intro x y
      apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
      change
        star
          ⟪WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x, WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H y⟫_ℂ =
        ⟪WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H y, WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x⟫_ℂ
      simp
    norm_eq_sqrt_norm_inner_self := by
      intro x
      change ‖WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x‖ =
        √‖MulOpposite.op
          ⟪WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x,
            WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x⟫_ℂ‖
      rw [MulOpposite.norm_op]
      simpa only [← inner_self_re_eq_norm] using
        norm_eq_sqrt_re_inner (WithCStarModule.equiv ℂᵐᵒᵖ H x)
  }

/-- The C-star factory uses the exact inner factory, not a second inner dictionary. -/
theorem cStarModule_toInner
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] :
    let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    (cStarModule H).toInner = instInner H := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  rfl

/-- The existing right-inner product agrees under the fully pinned local factory dictionary. -/
@[simp]
theorem rightInner_apply
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    (x y : ScalarRight H) :
    let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := ℂ) x y = ⟪equivL H x, equivL H y⟫_ℂ := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  rfl

/-- Completeness is inherited through the original uniformity, with the factory metric fixed. -/
theorem completeSpace_iff
    (H : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup H] :
    let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) ↔ CompleteSpace H := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  exact (WithCStarModule.uniformEquiv (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H)).completeSpace_iff

end ScalarRight

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.ScalarRight
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Adjointable.OfPair

/-!
# Ordinary Hilbert-space adjoint pairs on the scalar-right model

An ordinary bounded complex-linear map and a supplied ordinary adjoint are
transported through the exact `ScalarRight.equivL` factories and bundled as the
existing C-star-module `AdjointableOperator`. No canonical adjoint choice,
completeness, global instance or parallel operator carrier is introduced.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped ComplexOrder InnerProductSpace RightActions

namespace ScalarRight.Adjointable

noncomputable section

universe u v

/-- Transport an ordinary bounded complex-linear map to the two explicitly
factory-equipped scalar-right models. -/
noncomputable def continuousLinearMap
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℂ K]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] K) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    ScalarRight H →L[ℂ] ScalarRight K := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  exact (equivL K).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (T.comp (equivL H).toContinuousLinearMap)

@[simp]
theorem continuousLinearMap_apply
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℂ K]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] K) (x : ScalarRight H) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    equivL K (continuousLinearMap H K T x) = T (equivL H x) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  change equivL K ((equivL K).symm (T (equivL H x))) = T (equivL H x)
  exact (equivL K).apply_symm_apply _

/-- Bundle an ordinary bounded adjoint pair on `H,K` as an adjointable
operator between their exact scalar-right models. The source convention is
conjugate-linear first and linear second. -/
noncomputable def ofOrdinaryAdjointPair
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] K) (S : K →L[ℂ] H)
    (h : ∀ x y, ⟪T x, y⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, S y⟫_ℂ) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    CStarModule.AdjointableOperator ℂ (ScalarRight H) (ScalarRight K) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  let T' : ScalarRight H →L[ℂ] ScalarRight K :=
    (equivL K).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
      (T.comp (equivL H).toContinuousLinearMap)
  let S' : ScalarRight K →L[ℂ] ScalarRight H :=
    (equivL H).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
      (S.comp (equivL K).toContinuousLinearMap)
  exact CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ofAdjointPair T' S' (by
    intro x y
    rw [ScalarRight.rightInner_apply, ScalarRight.rightInner_apply]
    change ⟪T (equivL H x), equivL K y⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪equivL H x, S (equivL K y)⟫_ℂ
    exact h _ _)

@[simp]
theorem ofOrdinaryAdjointPair_toContinuousLinearMap
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] K) (S : K →L[ℂ] H)
    (h : ∀ x y, ⟪T x, y⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, S y⟫_ℂ) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    (ofOrdinaryAdjointPair H K T S h).toContinuousLinearMap =
      continuousLinearMap H K T := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  let T' : ScalarRight H →L[ℂ] ScalarRight K :=
    (equivL K).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
      (T.comp (equivL H).toContinuousLinearMap)
  let S' : ScalarRight K →L[ℂ] ScalarRight H :=
    (equivL H).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
      (S.comp (equivL K).toContinuousLinearMap)
  have h' : ∀ x y,
      CStarModule.rightInner (B := ℂ) (T' x) y =
        CStarModule.rightInner (B := ℂ) x (S' y) := by
    intro x y
    rw [ScalarRight.rightInner_apply, ScalarRight.rightInner_apply]
    change ⟪T (equivL H x), equivL K y⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪equivL H x, S (equivL K y)⟫_ℂ
    exact h _ _
  change (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ofAdjointPair T' S' h').toContinuousLinearMap =
    T'
  exact CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ofAdjointPair_toContinuousLinearMap
    T' S' h'

@[simp]
theorem ofOrdinaryAdjointPair_adjoint
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] K) (S : K →L[ℂ] H)
    (h : ∀ x y, ⟪T x, y⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, S y⟫_ℂ) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H

    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    (ofOrdinaryAdjointPair H K T S h).adjoint =
      continuousLinearMap K H S := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  let T' : ScalarRight H →L[ℂ] ScalarRight K :=
    (equivL K).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
      (T.comp (equivL H).toContinuousLinearMap)
  let S' : ScalarRight K →L[ℂ] ScalarRight H :=
    (equivL H).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
      (S.comp (equivL K).toContinuousLinearMap)
  have h' : ∀ x y,
      CStarModule.rightInner (B := ℂ) (T' x) y =
        CStarModule.rightInner (B := ℂ) x (S' y) := by
    intro x y
    rw [ScalarRight.rightInner_apply, ScalarRight.rightInner_apply]
    change ⟪T (equivL H x), equivL K y⟫_ℂ =
      ⟪equivL H x, S (equivL K y)⟫_ℂ
    exact h _ _
  change (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ofAdjointPair T' S' h').adjoint =
    S'
  exact CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ofAdjointPair_adjoint T' S' h'

@[simp]
theorem ofOrdinaryAdjointPair_apply
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] K) (S : K →L[ℂ] H)
    (h : ∀ x y, ⟪T x, y⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, S y⟫_ℂ)
    (x : ScalarRight H) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    equivL K (ofOrdinaryAdjointPair H K T S h x) = T (equivL H x) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  have hforward :
      (ofOrdinaryAdjointPair H K T S h).toContinuousLinearMap =
        continuousLinearMap H K T :=
    ofOrdinaryAdjointPair_toContinuousLinearMap H K T S h
  calc
    equivL K (ofOrdinaryAdjointPair H K T S h x) =
        equivL K (continuousLinearMap H K T x) :=
      congrArg (fun f : ScalarRight H →L[ℂ] ScalarRight K =>
        equivL K (f x)) hforward
    _ = T (equivL H x) := continuousLinearMap_apply H K T x

end
end ScalarRight.Adjointable

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.ScalarRight.Adjointable
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint

/-!
# Ordinary Hilbert-space operators as scalar-right adjointable operators

On complete complex inner-product spaces, Mathlib supplies the canonical
adjoint of every bounded complex-linear map. This module specializes the
pair-based ScalarRight bridge and packages the resulting carrier
correspondence. The noncomplete pair-based API remains the lower layer.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped ComplexOrder InnerProductSpace InnerProduct RightActions

namespace ScalarRight.Adjointable

noncomputable section

universe u v

/-- The canonical ScalarRight adjointable operator attached to an ordinary
bounded operator between complex Hilbert spaces. -/
noncomputable def ofContinuousLinearMap
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] K) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    CStarModule.AdjointableOperator ℂ (ScalarRight H) (ScalarRight K) :=
  ofOrdinaryAdjointPair H K T (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) fun x y =>
    (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right T x y).symm

/-- Forget the ScalarRight model by conjugating the forward action through the
factory continuous-linear equivalences. -/
noncomputable def toContinuousLinearMap
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K]
    (T :
      let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
      let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
      let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
      let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
      let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
      let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
      let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
      let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
      let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
      let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator ℂ (ScalarRight H) (ScalarRight K)) :
    H →L[ℂ] K := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  exact (equivL K).toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (T.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (equivL H).symm.toContinuousLinearMap)

@[simp]
theorem ofContinuousLinearMap_apply
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] K) (x : ScalarRight H) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    equivL K (ofContinuousLinearMap H K T x) = T (equivL H x) :=
  ofOrdinaryAdjointPair_apply H K T (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T)
    (fun a b => (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right T a b).symm) x

@[simp]
theorem ofContinuousLinearMap_adjoint
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] K) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    (ofContinuousLinearMap H K T).adjoint =
      continuousLinearMap K H (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) :=
  ofOrdinaryAdjointPair_adjoint H K T (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T)
    fun a b => (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right T a b).symm

@[simp]
theorem toContinuousLinearMap_apply
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K]
    (T :
      let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
      let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
      let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
      let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
      let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
      let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
      let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
      let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
      let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
      let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator ℂ (ScalarRight H) (ScalarRight K))
    (x : H) :
    toContinuousLinearMap H K T x =
      equivL K (T ((equivL H).symm x)) :=
  rfl

/-- On complete complex Hilbert spaces, ordinary bounded operators correspond
exactly to adjointable operators on the factory-equipped ScalarRight models. -/
noncomputable def continuousLinearMapEquiv
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K] :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    (H →L[ℂ] K) ≃
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator ℂ (ScalarRight H) (ScalarRight K) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  exact {
    toFun := ofContinuousLinearMap H K
    invFun := toContinuousLinearMap H K
    left_inv := by
      intro T
      ext x
      change equivL K
          (ofContinuousLinearMap H K T ((equivL H).symm x)) = T x
      rw [ofContinuousLinearMap_apply, (equivL H).apply_symm_apply]
    right_inv := by
      intro T
      apply CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ext
      intro x
      apply (equivL K).injective
      rw [ofContinuousLinearMap_apply, toContinuousLinearMap_apply,
        (equivL H).symm_apply_apply] }

end
end ScalarRight.Adjointable

module

/-!
# Forgetting scalar-right adjointable operators is a linear isometry

This is the source-facing orientation of the scalar adjointable
correspondence: module adjointable operators map to ordinary bounded
complex-linear maps. It is the inverse of the canonical-adjoint construction,
not a second carrier or comparison.

@[expose] public section

open scoped ComplexOrder InnerProductSpace InnerProduct RightActions

namespace ScalarRight.Adjointable

noncomputable section

universe u v

/-- Forget scalar-right adjointable structure by conjugating the forward map
through the fixed ScalarRight equivalences. -/
noncomputable def adjointableOperatorLinearIsometryEquiv
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K] :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    CStarModule.AdjointableOperator ℂ (ScalarRight H) (ScalarRight K) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]
      (H →L[ℂ] K) :=
  (continuousLinearMapLinearIsometryEquiv H K).symm

@[simp]
theorem adjointableOperatorLinearIsometryEquiv_apply
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (T :
      let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
      let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
      let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
      let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
      let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
      let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
      let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
      let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
      let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
      let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator ℂ (ScalarRight H) (ScalarRight K)) :
    adjointableOperatorLinearIsometryEquiv H K T =
      toContinuousLinearMap H K T :=
  rfl

end
end ScalarRight.Adjointable

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.ScalarRight.AdjointableEquiv

/-!
# The scalar-right adjointable correspondence is a linear isometry

The complete-Hilbert carrier equivalence is upgraded to a complex-linear
isometric equivalence. The proof uses the exact ScalarRight factories and
operator norms; no compactness or Calkin assertion is made here.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped ComplexOrder InnerProductSpace InnerProduct RightActions

namespace ScalarRight.Adjointable

noncomputable section

universe u v

theorem ofContinuousLinearMap_toContinuousLinearMap
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] K) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    (ofContinuousLinearMap H K T).toContinuousLinearMap =
      continuousLinearMap H K T :=
  ofOrdinaryAdjointPair_toContinuousLinearMap H K T
    (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T)
    (fun x y => (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right T x y).symm)

/-- Conjugation through the fixed ScalarRight equivalences preserves the
operator norm. Completeness is not needed. -/
theorem norm_continuousLinearMap
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [NormedSpace ℂ K]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] K) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : AddCommMonoid (ScalarRight H) :=
      (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toAddCommMonoid
    let _ : AddCommMonoid (ScalarRight K) :=
      (instNormedAddCommGroup K).toAddCommMonoid
    let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
      (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
    let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight K) :=
      (instNormedAddCommGroup K).toUniformSpace
    let _ : TopologicalSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
      (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
    let _ : TopologicalSpace (ScalarRight K) :=
      (instNormedAddCommGroup K).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := (instNormedSpace H).toModule
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := (instNormedSpace K).toModule
    let T' : ScalarRight H →L[ℂ] ScalarRight K := by
      exact continuousLinearMap H K T
    ‖T'‖ = ‖T‖ := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : AddCommMonoid (ScalarRight H) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toAddCommMonoid
  let _ : AddCommMonoid (ScalarRight K) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup K).toAddCommMonoid
  let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
  let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight K) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup K).toUniformSpace
  let _ : TopologicalSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
  let _ : TopologicalSpace (ScalarRight K) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup K).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := (instNormedSpace H).toModule
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := (instNormedSpace K).toModule
  let T' : ScalarRight H →L[ℂ] ScalarRight K := by
    exact continuousLinearMap H K T
  let eH : ScalarRight H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H :=
    { toLinearEquiv := by exact (equivL H).toLinearEquiv
      norm_map' := fun x =>
        (isometry_equivL H).norm_map_of_map_zero
          (map_zero (equivL H)) x }
  let eK : ScalarRight K ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K :=
    { toLinearEquiv := by exact (equivL K).toLinearEquiv
      norm_map' := fun x =>
        (isometry_equivL K).norm_map_of_map_zero
          (map_zero (equivL K)) x }
  change ‖(eK.symm : K →L[ℂ] ScalarRight K).comp
      (T.comp (eH : ScalarRight H →L[ℂ] H))‖ = ‖T‖
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_linearIsometryEquiv_comp,
    ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_linearIsometryEquiv]

theorem norm_ofContinuousLinearMap
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] K) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    ‖ofContinuousLinearMap H K T‖ = ‖T‖ := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  let _ : AddCommMonoid (ScalarRight H) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toAddCommMonoid
  let _ : AddCommMonoid (ScalarRight K) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup K).toAddCommMonoid
  let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
  let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight K) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup K).toUniformSpace
  let _ : TopologicalSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
  let _ : TopologicalSpace (ScalarRight K) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup K).toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := (instNormedSpace H).toModule
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := (instNormedSpace K).toModule
  let T' : ScalarRight H →L[ℂ] ScalarRight K := by
    exact continuousLinearMap H K T
  have hT' (x : ScalarRight H) :
      equivL K (T' x) = T (equivL H x) := by
    change equivL K (continuousLinearMap H K T x) = T (equivL H x)
    exact continuousLinearMap_apply H K T x
  have hforward :
      (ofContinuousLinearMap H K T).toContinuousLinearMap = T' := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    apply (equivL K).injective
    change equivL K (ofContinuousLinearMap H K T x) = equivL K (T' x)
    exact (ofContinuousLinearMap_apply H K T x).trans (hT' x).symm
  rw [CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.norm_eq, hforward]
  exact norm_continuousLinearMap H K T

/-- The complete-Hilbert scalar-right correspondence as a complex-linear
equivalence. -/
noncomputable def continuousLinearMapLinearEquiv
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K] :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    (H →L[ℂ] K) ≃ₗ[ℂ]
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator ℂ (ScalarRight H) (ScalarRight K) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  exact {
    toEquiv := continuousLinearMapEquiv H K
    map_add' := by
      intro T S
      change ofContinuousLinearMap H K (T + S) =
        ofContinuousLinearMap H K T + ofContinuousLinearMap H K S
      apply CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ext
      intro x
      apply (equivL K).injective
      simp only [ofContinuousLinearMap_apply,
        CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.add_apply, map_add]
      rfl
    map_smul' := by
      intro c T
      change ofContinuousLinearMap H K (c • T) =
        c • ofContinuousLinearMap H K T
      apply CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ext
      intro x
      apply (equivL K).injective
      simp only [ofContinuousLinearMap_apply,
        CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.smul_apply, map_smul]
      rfl }

/-- On complete complex Hilbert spaces, bounded operators and scalar-right
adjointable operators are complex-linearly isometrically equivalent. -/
noncomputable def continuousLinearMapLinearIsometryEquiv
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K] :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    (H →L[ℂ] K) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator ℂ (ScalarRight H) (ScalarRight K) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  exact {
    toLinearEquiv := continuousLinearMapLinearEquiv H K
    norm_map' := norm_ofContinuousLinearMap H K }

end
end ScalarRight.Adjointable

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.ScalarRight.AdjointableIsometry

/-!
# Identity, composition, and adjoint laws for the scalar-right correspondence

The canonical complete-Hilbert correspondence preserves the three basic
operator operations needed by Hilbert-module and Fredholm consumers.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped ComplexOrder InnerProductSpace InnerProduct RightActions

namespace ScalarRight.Adjointable

noncomputable section

universe u v w

@[simp]
theorem ofContinuousLinearMap_id
    (H : Type u)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    ofContinuousLinearMap H H (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H) =
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.id (B := ℂ) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  apply CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ext
  intro x
  apply (equivL H).injective
  rw [ofContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.id_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]

@[simp]
theorem ofContinuousLinearMap_comp
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v) (L : Type w)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    [NormedAddCommGroup L] [InnerProductSpace ℂ L] [CompleteSpace L]
    (S : K →L[ℂ] L) (T : H →L[ℂ] K) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight L) := instNormedAddCommGroup L
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight L) := instComplexModule L
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight L) := instNormedSpace L
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight L) := instOppositeSMul L
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight L) := cStarModule L
    ofContinuousLinearMap H L (S.comp T) =
      (ofContinuousLinearMap K L S).comp
        (ofContinuousLinearMap H K T) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight L) := instNormedAddCommGroup L
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight L) := instComplexModule L
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight L) := instNormedSpace L
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight L) := instOppositeSMul L
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight L) := cStarModule L
  apply CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ext
  intro x
  apply (equivL L).injective
  rw [ofContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.comp_apply,
    ofContinuousLinearMap_apply, ofContinuousLinearMap_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]

@[simp]
theorem ofContinuousLinearMap_adjointOperator
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] K) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    (ofContinuousLinearMap H K T).adjointOperator =
      ofContinuousLinearMap K H (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  apply CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ext
  intro y
  apply (equivL H).injective
  have hAdj :
      (ofContinuousLinearMap H K T).adjoint =
        continuousLinearMap K H (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) :=
    ofContinuousLinearMap_adjoint H K T
  have hAdjPoint :
      equivL H ((ofContinuousLinearMap H K T).adjoint y) =
        equivL H
          (continuousLinearMap K H (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) y) :=
    congrArg
      (fun f : ScalarRight K →L[ℂ] ScalarRight H => equivL H (f y)) hAdj
  calc
    equivL H ((ofContinuousLinearMap H K T).adjointOperator y) =
        equivL H ((ofContinuousLinearMap H K T).adjoint y) := rfl
    _ = equivL H
        (continuousLinearMap K H (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) y) :=
      hAdjPoint
    _ = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T (equivL K y) :=
      continuousLinearMap_apply K H (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) y
    _ = equivL H
        (ofContinuousLinearMap K H (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) y) :=
      (ofContinuousLinearMap_apply K H
        (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) y).symm

end
end ScalarRight.Adjointable
