module

public import
  MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.ScalarRight.AdjointableLaws
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.ScalarRight.Compact
public import
  MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.CompactOperator.FiniteRankClosure
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Compact.Calkin

/-!
# Scalar-right compact operators and the Calkin algebra

On complete complex Hilbert spaces, the canonical ScalarRight correspondence
identifies ordinary compact operators with Hilbert-module compact operators.
For endomorphisms it preserves identity, composition and adjoint, maps the
ordinary compact ideal onto the module compact ideal, and descends to an
algebra equivalence of the two quotient carriers.

This comparison is specific to scalar coefficients. No Banach-compactness
claim is made for Hilbert modules over a general C-star algebra.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open Set
open scoped CStarAlgebra ComplexOrder InnerProductSpace InnerProduct RightActions

namespace ScalarRight.Adjointable

universe u v

variable {H : Type u} {K : Type v}
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]

/-- The scalar-right correspondence sends the ordinary rank-one span into the
module rank-one span. -/
theorem ofContinuousLinearMap_mem_finiteRank
    {T : H →L[ℂ] K}
    (hT : T ∈ InnerProductSpace.finiteRankSubmodule
      (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := K)) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    ofContinuousLinearMap H K T ∈
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.finiteRankSubmodule
        (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H) (F := ScalarRight K) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  let e := continuousLinearMapLinearEquiv H K
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun T _ => e T ∈
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.finiteRankSubmodule
        (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H) (F := ScalarRight K))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hT
  · rintro _ ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩
    change ofContinuousLinearMap H K (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ x y) ∈ _
    rw [ofContinuousLinearMap_rankOne]
    exact CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.rankOne_mem_finiteRank
      ((equivL K).symm x) ((equivL H).symm y)
  · simpa only [map_zero] using
      (Submodule.zero_mem
        (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.finiteRankSubmodule
          (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H) (F := ScalarRight K)))
  · intro S T _ _ hS hT
    simpa only [map_add] using
      (Submodule.add_mem _ hS hT)
  · intro c T _ hT
    simpa only [map_smul] using
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ c hT)

/-- Forgetting the scalar-right model sends the module rank-one span into the
ordinary Hilbert-space rank-one span. -/
theorem toContinuousLinearMap_mem_finiteRank
    {T :
      let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
      let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
      let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
      let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
      let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
      let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
      let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
      let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
      let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
      let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator ℂ (ScalarRight H) (ScalarRight K)}
    (hT :
      let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
      let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
      let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
      let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
      let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
      let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
      let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
      let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
      let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
      let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
      T ∈ CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.finiteRankSubmodule
        (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H) (F := ScalarRight K)) :
    toContinuousLinearMap H K T ∈
      InnerProductSpace.finiteRankSubmodule
        (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := K) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  let e := continuousLinearMapLinearEquiv H K
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun T _ => e.symm T ∈
      InnerProductSpace.finiteRankSubmodule
        (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := K))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hT
  · rintro _ ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩
    change toContinuousLinearMap H K
        (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := ℂ) x y) ∈ _
    rw [toContinuousLinearMap_rankOne]
    exact InnerProductSpace.rankOne_mem_finiteRankSubmodule
      (equivL K x) (equivL H y)
  · simpa only [map_zero] using
      (Submodule.zero_mem
        (InnerProductSpace.finiteRankSubmodule
          (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := K)))
  · intro S T _ _ hS hT
    simpa only [map_add] using
      (Submodule.add_mem _ hS hT)
  · intro c T _ hT
    simpa only [map_smul] using
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ c hT)

/-- Under the scalar-right correspondence, module compactness is exactly
ordinary Hilbert-space compactness. -/
theorem ofContinuousLinearMap_mem_compact_iff
    (T : H →L[ℂ] K) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    ofContinuousLinearMap H K T ∈
        CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule
          (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H) (F := ScalarRight K) ↔
      IsCompactOperator T := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  let e := continuousLinearMapLinearIsometryEquiv H K
  constructor
  · intro hT
    change e T ∈ closure
      (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.finiteRankSubmodule
        (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H) (F := ScalarRight K) : Set _) at hT
    have hBack : e.symm (e T) ∈ closure
        (InnerProductSpace.finiteRankSubmodule
          (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H) (F := K) : Set _) :=
      map_mem_closure (f := e.symm) e.symm.continuous hT
        (fun _ h => toContinuousLinearMap_mem_finiteRank h)
    rw [e.symm_apply_apply] at hBack
    exact
      (InnerProductSpace.isCompactOperator_iff_mem_topologicalClosure_finiteRankSubmodule T).2
        hBack
  · intro hT
    have hClosure :=
      (InnerProductSpace.isCompactOperator_iff_mem_topologicalClosure_finiteRankSubmodule T).1
        hT
    change e T ∈ closure
      (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.finiteRankSubmodule
        (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H) (F := ScalarRight K) : Set _)
    exact map_mem_closure (f := e) e.continuous hClosure
      (fun _ h => ofContinuousLinearMap_mem_finiteRank h)

/-- The ambient linear equivalence maps the ordinary compact-operator submodule
onto the scalar-right module compact submodule. -/
theorem continuousLinearMapLinearEquiv_map_compactOperator :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    Submodule.map (continuousLinearMapLinearEquiv H K).toLinearMap
        (compactOperator (RingHom.id ℂ) H K) =
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule
        (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H) (F := ScalarRight K) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  let e := continuousLinearMapLinearEquiv H K
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro S ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩
    exact (ofContinuousLinearMap_mem_compact_iff T).2 hT
  · intro S hS
    refine ⟨e.symm S, ?_, e.apply_symm_apply S⟩
    have hModule : e (e.symm S) ∈
        CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule
          (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H) (F := ScalarRight K) := by
      simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using hS
    exact (ofContinuousLinearMap_mem_compact_iff (e.symm S)).1 hModule

section Endomorphism

variable (H)

/-- The canonical star-algebra homomorphism from ordinary endomorphisms to
scalar-right adjointable endomorphisms. -/
noncomputable def endStarAlgHom :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
      (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
    let _ : CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) := by
      change @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
      rw [normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace H]
      exact (WithCStarModule.uniformEquiv (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H)).completeSpace_iff.mpr
        inferInstance
    (H →L[ℂ] H) →⋆ₐ[ℂ]
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End ℂ (ScalarRight H) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
  let _ : CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) := by
    change @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
    rw [normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace H]
    exact (WithCStarModule.uniformEquiv (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H)).completeSpace_iff.mpr
      inferInstance
  let e := continuousLinearMapLinearEquiv H H
  let f : (H →L[ℂ] H) →ₐ[ℂ]
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End ℂ (ScalarRight H) :=
    AlgHom.ofLinearMap e.toLinearMap
      (by
        change ofContinuousLinearMap H H (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H) =
          CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.id (B := ℂ)
        exact ofContinuousLinearMap_id H)
      (by
        intro T S
        change ofContinuousLinearMap H H (T.comp S) =
          (ofContinuousLinearMap H H T).comp
            (ofContinuousLinearMap H H S)
        exact ofContinuousLinearMap_comp H H H T S)
  exact
    { f with
      map_star' := by
        intro T
        change ofContinuousLinearMap H H (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) =
          (ofContinuousLinearMap H H T).adjointOperator
        exact (ofContinuousLinearMap_adjointOperator H H T).symm }

/-- The canonical star-algebra equivalence between the two endomorphism
algebras. -/
noncomputable def endStarAlgEquiv :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
      (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
    let _ : CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) := by
      change @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
      rw [normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace H]
      exact (WithCStarModule.uniformEquiv (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H)).completeSpace_iff.mpr
        inferInstance
    (H →L[ℂ] H) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ]
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End ℂ (ScalarRight H) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
  let _ : CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) := by
    change @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
    rw [normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace H]
    exact (WithCStarModule.uniformEquiv (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H)).completeSpace_iff.mpr
      inferInstance
  exact StarAlgEquiv.ofBijective (endStarAlgHom H)
    (continuousLinearMapLinearEquiv H H).bijective

/-- The canonical ambient equivalence acts by the existing scalar-right lift. -/
@[simp]
theorem endStarAlgEquiv_apply (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
      (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
    let _ : CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) := by
      change @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
      rw [normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace H]
      exact (WithCStarModule.uniformEquiv (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H)).completeSpace_iff.mpr
        inferInstance
    endStarAlgEquiv H T = ofContinuousLinearMap H H T := by
  rfl

end Endomorphism

/-- The scalar-right module Calkin carrier, using the existing compact closed
star ideal and its canonical quotient. -/
abbrev CalkinAlgebra (H : Type u)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] :=
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
  let _ : CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) := by
    change @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
    rw [normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace H]
    exact (WithCStarModule.uniformEquiv (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H)).completeSpace_iff.mpr
      inferInstance
  (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.compactClosedStarIdeal
    (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H)).Quotient

/-- The ambient linear equivalence descends to the ordinary and module Calkin
quotient carriers. -/
noncomputable def calkinLinearEquiv (H : Type u)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
      (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
    let _ : CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) := by
      change @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
      rw [normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace H]
      exact (WithCStarModule.uniformEquiv (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H)).completeSpace_iff.mpr
        inferInstance
    _root_.CalkinAlgebra ℂ H ≃ₗ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra H := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
  let _ : CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) := by
    change @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
    rw [normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace H]
    exact (WithCStarModule.uniformEquiv (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H)).completeSpace_iff.mpr
      inferInstance
  let e := continuousLinearMapLinearEquiv H H
  change ((H →L[ℂ] H) ⧸ compactOperator (RingHom.id ℂ) H H) ≃ₗ[ℂ]
    (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End ℂ (ScalarRight H) ⧸
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule
        (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H) (F := ScalarRight H))
  exact Submodule.Quotient.equiv
    (compactOperator (RingHom.id ℂ) H H)
    (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.compactSubmodule
      (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H) (F := ScalarRight H))
    e continuousLinearMapLinearEquiv_map_compactOperator

/-- The descended linear equivalence sends the class of an ordinary operator
to the class of its scalar-right adjointable image. -/
theorem calkinLinearEquiv_classMap
    (H : Type u)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
      (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
    let _ : CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) := by
      change @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
      rw [normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace H]
      exact (WithCStarModule.uniformEquiv (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H)).completeSpace_iff.mpr
        inferInstance
    let I := CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.compactClosedStarIdeal
      (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H)
    let _ : CStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.unitalQuotientCStarAlgebra
    calkinLinearEquiv H (_root_.CalkinAlgebra.classMap T) =
      I.unitalQuotientMap (endStarAlgEquiv H T) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
  let _ : CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) := by
    change @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
    rw [normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace H]
    exact (WithCStarModule.uniformEquiv (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H)).completeSpace_iff.mpr
      inferInstance
  let I := CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.compactClosedStarIdeal
    (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H)
  let _ : CStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.unitalQuotientCStarAlgebra
  change calkinLinearEquiv H (Submodule.Quotient.mk T) =
    Submodule.Quotient.mk (ofContinuousLinearMap H H T)
  rfl

/-- The ordinary Banach-space Calkin algebra and the scalar-right module
Calkin quotient are canonically algebra equivalent. -/
noncomputable def calkinAlgEquiv
    (H : Type u)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
      (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
    let _ : CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) := by
      change @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
      rw [normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace H]
      exact (WithCStarModule.uniformEquiv (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H)).completeSpace_iff.mpr
        inferInstance
    let I := CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.compactClosedStarIdeal
      (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H)
    let _ : CStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.unitalQuotientCStarAlgebra
    _root_.CalkinAlgebra ℂ H ≃ₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra H := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
    (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
  let _ : CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) := by
    change @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
    rw [normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace H]
    exact (WithCStarModule.uniformEquiv (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H)).completeSpace_iff.mpr
      inferInstance
  let I := CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.compactClosedStarIdeal
    (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H)
  let _ : CStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.unitalQuotientCStarAlgebra
  refine AlgEquiv.ofLinearEquiv (calkinLinearEquiv H) ?_ ?_
  · calc
      calkinLinearEquiv H (1 : _root_.CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) =
          calkinLinearEquiv H
            (_root_.CalkinAlgebra.classMap
              (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)) :=
        congrArg (calkinLinearEquiv H)
          (_root_.CalkinAlgebra.one_eq_class_id (𝕜 := ℂ) (E := H))
      _ = I.unitalQuotientMap
            (endStarAlgEquiv H (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)) :=
        calkinLinearEquiv_classMap H (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H)
      _ = 1 := by
        change I.unitalQuotientMap
          (endStarAlgEquiv H (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)) = 1
        rw [map_one, map_one]
  · intro q r
    obtain ⟨T, rfl⟩ := _root_.CalkinAlgebra.classMap_surjective q
    obtain ⟨S, rfl⟩ := _root_.CalkinAlgebra.classMap_surjective r
    rw [← _root_.CalkinAlgebra.classMap_mul,
      calkinLinearEquiv_classMap, calkinLinearEquiv_classMap,
      calkinLinearEquiv_classMap, map_mul, map_mul]

/-- The quotient algebra equivalence commutes with the two actual quotient
maps on every endomorphism. -/
theorem calkinAlgEquiv_classMap
    (H : Type u)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : UniformSpace (ScalarRight H) :=
      (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
    let _ : CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) := by
      change @CompleteSpace (ScalarRight H) (instNormedAddCommGroup H).toUniformSpace
      rw [normedAddCommGroup_uniformSpace H]
      exact (WithCStarModule.uniformEquiv (A := ℂᵐᵒᵖ) (E := H)).completeSpace_iff.mpr
        inferInstance
    let I := CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.compactClosedStarIdeal
      (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H)
    let _ : CStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.unitalQuotientCStarAlgebra
    calkinAlgEquiv H (_root_.CalkinAlgebra.classMap T) =
      I.unitalQuotientMap (endStarAlgEquiv H T) :=
  calkinLinearEquiv_classMap H T

end ScalarRight.Adjointable

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.ScalarRight.AdjointableEquiv
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Compact

/-!
# Scalar-right rank-one operators

The scalar-right module rank-one operator is exactly the ordinary Hilbert-space
rank-one operator after conjugating through the fixed `ScalarRight.equivL`
factories.  This is the algebraic leaf needed before comparing finite-rank
spans and compact-operator closures; no closure or compactness equivalence is
claimed here.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped ComplexOrder InnerProductSpace InnerProduct RightActions

namespace ScalarRight.Adjointable

noncomputable section

universe u v

/-- Forgetting a scalar-right module rank-one operator gives the ordinary
Hilbert-space rank-one operator.  Completeness is not needed in this
direction. -/
theorem toContinuousLinearMap_rankOne
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K]
    (x : ScalarRight K) (y : ScalarRight H) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    toContinuousLinearMap H K
        (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := ℂ) x y) =
      InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (equivL K x) (equivL H y) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  ext z
  change equivL K
      (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := ℂ) x y
        ((equivL H).symm z)) =
    InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ (equivL K x) (equivL H y) z
  rw [CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.rankOne_apply,
    ScalarRight.right_smul_apply, ScalarRight.rightInner_apply,
    (equivL H).apply_symm_apply, InnerProductSpace.rankOne_apply]

/-- The complete-Hilbert correspondence sends the ordinary rank-one operator
to the literal scalar-right module rank-one operator. -/
theorem ofContinuousLinearMap_rankOne
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (x : K) (y : H) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    ofContinuousLinearMap H K (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ x y) =
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.rankOne (B := ℂ)
        ((equivL K).symm x) ((equivL H).symm y) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  apply CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ext
  intro z
  apply (equivL K).injective
  rw [ofContinuousLinearMap_apply, InnerProductSpace.rankOne_apply,
    CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.rankOne_apply,
    ScalarRight.right_smul_apply, ScalarRight.rightInner_apply,
    (equivL K).apply_symm_apply, (equivL H).apply_symm_apply]

/-- Ordinary Hilbert-space rank-one maps land in the module finite-rank span
under the complete-Hilbert scalar-right correspondence. -/
theorem ofContinuousLinearMap_rankOne_mem_finiteRank
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]
    (x : K) (y : H) :
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
    let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
    let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
    let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
    let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
    let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
    ofContinuousLinearMap H K (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ x y) ∈
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.finiteRankSubmodule
        (B := ℂ) (E := ScalarRight H) (F := ScalarRight K) := by
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight H) := instNormedAddCommGroup H
  let _ : NormedAddCommGroup (ScalarRight K) := instNormedAddCommGroup K
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instComplexModule H
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight H) := instNormedSpace H
  let _ : Module ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instComplexModule K
  let _ : NormedSpace ℂ (ScalarRight K) := instNormedSpace K
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := instOppositeSMul H
  let _ : SMul ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := instOppositeSMul K
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight H) := cStarModule H
  let _ : CStarModule ℂᵐᵒᵖ (ScalarRight K) := cStarModule K
  rw [ofContinuousLinearMap_rankOne]
  exact CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.rankOne_mem_finiteRank
    ((equivL K).symm x) ((equivL H).symm y)

end
end ScalarRight.Adjointable

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Standard
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Adjointable.OfPair

/-!
# Coordinate adjoints on the actual standard right C-star module

For complete possibly nonunital coefficients, the existing coefficient single
and coordinate evaluation form an actual bounded adjoint pair. Their maps,
norms and module carriers are unchanged. The pairing uses the coefficient-valued
inner product and the source-order product `star a * coord i y`.

Canonical opposite-coefficient order and the actual self-module dictionary are
activated locally before the operator types. No unit-valued basis, adjoint of an
arbitrary bounded map, nonzero coefficient algebra or new norm is required.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

namespace CStarModule.Right.Standard

universe uB uι

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] {ι : Type uι}

/-- The existing coefficient single as an adjointable map, with the existing
coordinate evaluation as its stored adjoint. -/
noncomputable def singleAdjointable (i : ι) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    CStarModule.AdjointableOperator B B (Standard B ι) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  change CStarModule.AdjointableOperator B B (Standard B ι)
  refine CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ofAdjointPair
    (single (B := B) i) (coord (B := B) i) ?_
  intro a y
  calc
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) (single i a) y =
        ∑' j, star (coord j (single i a)) * coord j y :=
      rightInner_eq_tsum_coord _ _
    _ = star (coord i (single i a)) * coord i y :=
      tsum_eq_single i fun j hji => by
        rw [coord_single_ne hji, star_zero, zero_mul]
    _ = CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) a (coord i y) := by
      rw [coord_single_self, CStarModule.Right.rightInner_self]

/-- The forward bounded map is literally the original single. -/
theorem singleAdjointable_toContinuousLinearMap (i : ι) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    (singleAdjointable (B := B) i).toContinuousLinearMap = single i := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  rfl

/-- The reverse bounded map is literally the original coordinate evaluation. -/
theorem singleAdjointable_adjoint_toContinuousLinearMap (i : ι) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    (singleAdjointable (B := B) i).adjointOperator.toContinuousLinearMap =
      coord i := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  rfl

/-- The adjointable insertion has the original pointwise value. -/
@[simp]
theorem singleAdjointable_apply (i : ι) (a : B) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    singleAdjointable i a = single i a := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  rfl

/-- The stored adjoint is literally the original coordinate evaluation. -/
@[simp]
theorem singleAdjointable_adjoint (i : ι) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    (singleAdjointable (B := B) i).adjoint = coord i := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  rfl

/-- The constructed adjoint operator has the original coordinate value. -/
theorem singleAdjointable_adjoint_apply (i : ι) (y : Standard B ι) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    (singleAdjointable i).adjointOperator y = coord i y := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  rfl

/-- A coefficient single pairs with any vector by the literal coordinate
product, with the coefficient starred on the left. -/
theorem rightInner_single_coord (i : ι) (a : B) (y : Standard B ι) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) (single i a) y =
      star a * coord i y := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  have h := (singleAdjointable (B := B) i).adjoint_inner a y
  change CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) (single i a) y =
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) a (coord i y) at h
  simpa only [CStarModule.Right.rightInner_self] using h

/-- Evaluation after insertion at the same index is the identity operator on
the actual coefficient self-module, without assuming a coefficient unit. -/
@[simp]
theorem singleAdjointable_adjoint_comp_self :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ∀ i : ι, (singleAdjointable i).adjointOperator.comp (singleAdjointable i) =
      (1 : CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End B B) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  intro i
  apply CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ext
  intro a
  change coord i (single i a) = a
  exact coord_single_self i a

/-- Evaluation at one index after insertion at a different index vanishes. -/
@[simp]
theorem singleAdjointable_adjoint_comp_of_ne :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ∀ {i j : ι}, i ≠ j →
      (singleAdjointable i).adjointOperator.comp (singleAdjointable j) =
      (0 : CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.End B B) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  intro i j hij
  apply CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ext
  intro a
  change coord i (single j a) = 0
  exact coord_single_ne hij a

/-- Coefficient insertion is an isometry for the unchanged coefficient and
standard-module norms, including the zero coefficient algebra. -/
theorem singleAdjointable_isometry (i : ι) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    Isometry (singleAdjointable (B := B) i) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  change Isometry (single (B := B) i)
  refine isometry_iff_dist_eq.mpr ?_
  intro a b
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← map_sub (single (B := B) i) a b]
  exact norm_single i (a - b)

/-- The actual insertion operator has norm at most one. Equality with one is
not asserted for the zero coefficient algebra. -/
theorem norm_singleAdjointable_le (i : ι) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ‖singleAdjointable (B := B) i‖ ≤ 1 := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  rw [CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.norm_eq,
    singleAdjointable_toContinuousLinearMap]
  refine (single (B := B) i).opNorm_le_bound zero_le_one ?_
  intro a
  simp only [norm_single, one_mul, le_refl]

end CStarModule.Right.Standard

end

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Standard
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Adjointable.OfPair

/-!
# Adjointable finite coefficient coordinates

The existing finite coefficient insertion and evaluation are an actual
adjoint pair on the original finite right standard module. The pairing is
the stock finite Pi inner-product identity, specialized to the opposite
coefficient algebra and the constant coefficient family.

The original maps, coefficient-inner norm and module carrier are retained.
No coefficient unit, nonzero algebra, supplied adjoint or new norm is needed.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace CStarModule.Right

universe uB uI

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] {I : Type uI} [Fintype I]

/-- The existing finite coefficient insertion, with the existing coordinate
evaluation as its actual stored adjoint. -/
noncomputable def finiteSingleAdjointable (i : I) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    CStarModule.AdjointableOperator B B (FiniteStandard B I) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  classical
  change CStarModule.AdjointableOperator B B (FiniteStandard B I)
  refine CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.ofAdjointPair
    (finiteSingle (B := B) (ι := I) i)
    (finiteCoord (B := B) (ι := I) i) ?_
  intro a y
  have hSingle : finiteSingle (B := B) (ι := I) i a =
      (WithCStarModule.equiv Bᵐᵒᵖ (I → B)).symm (Pi.single i a) := rfl
  have hPi :
      inner Bᵐᵒᵖ
        ((WithCStarModule.equiv Bᵐᵒᵖ (I → B)).symm (Pi.single i a)) y =
      inner Bᵐᵒᵖ a (y i) :=
    WithCStarModule.inner_single_left
      (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ) (E := fun _ : I => B) (i := i) y a
  have hUnop :
      CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
        ((WithCStarModule.equiv Bᵐᵒᵖ (I → B)).symm (Pi.single i a)) y =
      CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) a (y i) :=
    congrArg (MulOpposite.unop : Bᵐᵒᵖ → B) hPi
  calc
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) (finiteSingle (B := B) (ι := I) i a) y =
        CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
          ((WithCStarModule.equiv Bᵐᵒᵖ (I → B)).symm (Pi.single i a)) y :=
      congrArg (fun z : FiniteStandard B I =>
        CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) z y) hSingle
    _ = CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) a (y i) := hUnop
    _ = CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) a
        (finiteCoord (B := B) (ι := I) i y) :=
      congrArg (fun b : B => CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) a b)
        (finiteCoord_apply (B := B) (ι := I) i y).symm

/-- The forward bounded map is literally the original finite insertion. -/
theorem finiteSingleAdjointable_toContinuousLinearMap (i : I) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    (finiteSingleAdjointable (B := B) (I := I) i).toContinuousLinearMap =
      finiteSingle (B := B) (ι := I) i := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  rfl

/-- The stored adjoint is literally the original finite evaluation. -/
theorem finiteSingleAdjointable_adjoint (i : I) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    (finiteSingleAdjointable (B := B) (I := I) i).adjoint =
      finiteCoord (B := B) (ι := I) i := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  rfl

end CStarModule.Right

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Standard.CoordinateAdjoints
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Standard.FiniteCoordinateAdjoints

/-!
# Finite coordinate inclusions in standard right C-star modules

A genuine injection of a finite index type into an arbitrary index type gives
an adjointable inclusion of the actual finite standard module. The inclusion
is a finite sum of the existing adjointable coordinate maps, and its stored
adjoint is the corresponding coordinate restriction.

The finite-source composite is the operator identity; the reverse composite
is the existing standard truncation on the finite image. The coefficient inner
product and original norms are preserved. Operator bounds are at most one,
including empty indices and zero coefficients. No coefficient unit, new norm,
module model or compactness of the inclusion is assumed.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace CStarModule.Right.Standard

open CStarModule.AdjointableOperator
open scoped BigOperators

universe uB uI uK

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable {I : Type uI} [Fintype I] {κ : Type uK}

/-- The finite-coordinate inclusion, formed from the actual standard and
finite coordinate adjoints. -/
noncomputable def finiteInclusion (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    AdjointableOperator B (FiniteStandard B I) (Standard B κ) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  classical
  exact ∑ i : I, (singleAdjointable (B := B) (η i)).comp
    (finiteSingleAdjointable (B := B) (I := I) i).adjointOperator

/-- The forward bounded map is the finite sum of the original single and
finite evaluation composites. -/
theorem finiteInclusion_toContinuousLinearMap (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    (finiteInclusion (B := B) η).toContinuousLinearMap =
      ∑ i : I, (single (B := B) (η i)).comp
        (finiteCoord (B := B) (ι := I) i) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  classical
  let E := FiniteStandard B I
  let F := Standard B κ
  let f : I → AdjointableOperator B E F := fun i =>
    (singleAdjointable (B := B) (η i)).comp
      (finiteSingleAdjointable (B := B) (I := I) i).adjointOperator
  change (∑ i : I, f i).toContinuousLinearMap = _
  calc
    (∑ i : I, f i).toContinuousLinearMap =
        ∑ i : I, (f i).toContinuousLinearMap :=
      map_sum (forwardAddHom (B := B) (E := E) (F := F)) f Finset.univ
    _ = ∑ i : I, (single (B := B) (η i)).comp
        (finiteCoord (B := B) (ι := I) i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      have hSingle := singleAdjointable_toContinuousLinearMap (B := B) (η i)
      have hCoord :
          (finiteSingleAdjointable (B := B) (I := I) i).adjoint =
            finiteCoord (B := B) (ι := I) i :=
        finiteSingleAdjointable_adjoint (B := B) (I := I) i
      change (singleAdjointable (B := B) (η i)).toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        (finiteSingleAdjointable (B := B) (I := I) i).adjoint = _
      rw [hSingle, hCoord]

/-- The stored adjoint is the finite sum of the original finite insertion
and standard evaluation composites, in reverse composition order. -/
theorem finiteInclusion_adjoint (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    (finiteInclusion (B := B) η).adjoint =
      ∑ i : I, (finiteSingle (B := B) (ι := I) i).comp
        (coord (B := B) (η i)) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  classical
  let E := FiniteStandard B I
  let F := Standard B κ
  let f : I → AdjointableOperator B E F := fun i =>
    (singleAdjointable (B := B) (η i)).comp
      (finiteSingleAdjointable (B := B) (I := I) i).adjointOperator
  let adjProj : AdjointableOperator B E F →+ (F →L[ℂ] E) :=
    { toFun := fun T => T.adjoint
      map_zero' := zero_adjoint (B := B) (E := E) (F := F)
      map_add' := fun T U => add_adjoint T U }
  change (∑ i : I, f i).adjoint = _
  calc
    (∑ i : I, f i).adjoint = ∑ i : I, (f i).adjoint :=
      map_sum adjProj f Finset.univ
    _ = ∑ i : I, (finiteSingle (B := B) (ι := I) i).comp
        (coord (B := B) (η i)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      change ((singleAdjointable (B := B) (η i)).comp
        (finiteSingleAdjointable (B := B) (I := I) i).adjointOperator).adjoint = _
      rw [comp_adjoint, adjointOperator_adjoint,
        finiteSingleAdjointable_toContinuousLinearMap, singleAdjointable_adjoint]

/-- The inclusion has the literal finite sum of standard coefficient singles
as its value. -/
theorem finiteInclusion_apply (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ∀ x : FiniteStandard B I,
      finiteInclusion (B := B) η x = ∑ i : I, single (η i) (x i) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  intro x
  have h := congrArg (fun L : FiniteStandard B I →L[ℂ] Standard B κ => L x)
    (finiteInclusion_toContinuousLinearMap (B := B) η)
  have hApply : (finiteInclusion (B := B) η).toContinuousLinearMap x =
      finiteInclusion (B := B) η x :=
    congrFun (AdjointableOperator.coe_toContinuousLinearMap
      (finiteInclusion (B := B) η)) x
  calc
    finiteInclusion (B := B) η x =
        (finiteInclusion (B := B) η).toContinuousLinearMap x := hApply.symm
    _ = ∑ i : I, single (η i) (x i) := by
      simpa only [_root_.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        finiteCoord_apply] using h

/-- The actual stored adjoint reads exactly the coordinates selected by the
injection. -/
@[simp]
theorem finiteInclusion_adjoint_apply (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ∀ (y : Standard B κ) (i : I),
      (finiteInclusion (B := B) η).adjoint y i = coord (η i) y := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  classical
  intro y i
  have hValue : (finiteInclusion (B := B) η).adjoint y =
      ∑ j : I, finiteSingle (B := B) (ι := I) j (coord (η j) y) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun L : Standard B κ →L[ℂ] FiniteStandard B I => L y)
      (finiteInclusion_adjoint (B := B) η)
    simpa only [_root_.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] using h
  have hCoord : finiteCoord (B := B) (ι := I) i
      ((finiteInclusion (B := B) η).adjoint y) = coord (η i) y := by
    rw [hValue, map_sum]
    calc
      (∑ j : I, finiteCoord (B := B) (ι := I) i
          (finiteSingle (B := B) (ι := I) j (coord (η j) y))) =
          finiteCoord (B := B) (ι := I) i
            (finiteSingle (B := B) (ι := I) i (coord (η i) y)) :=
        Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i (Finset.mem_univ i) fun j _ hji =>
          finiteCoord_single_ne (B := B) (ι := I) (Ne.symm hji) (coord (η j) y)
      _ = coord (η i) y := finiteCoord_single_self (B := B) i (coord (η i) y)
  simpa only [finiteCoord_apply] using hCoord

/-- The image coordinate of an included vector is its original coefficient. -/
@[simp]
theorem coord_finiteInclusion (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ∀ (x : FiniteStandard B I) (i : I),
      coord (η i) (finiteInclusion (B := B) η x) = x i := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  classical
  intro x i
  rw [finiteInclusion_apply, map_sum]
  calc
    (∑ j : I, coord (η i) (single (η j) (x j))) =
        coord (η i) (single (η i) (x i)) :=
      Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i (Finset.mem_univ i) fun j _ hji => by
        have hη : η i ≠ η j := fun h => hji (η.injective h).symm
        exact coord_single_ne hη (x j)
    _ = x i := coord_single_self (η i) (x i)

/-- Restriction after inclusion is the whole identity operator on the finite
source, without a coefficient-unit hypothesis. -/
@[simp]
theorem finiteInclusion_adjoint_comp_self (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    (finiteInclusion (B := B) η).adjointOperator.comp (finiteInclusion (B := B) η) =
      (1 : AdjointableOperator.End B (FiniteStandard B I)) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  apply AdjointableOperator.ext
  intro x
  change (finiteInclusion (B := B) η).adjoint (finiteInclusion (B := B) η x) = x
  apply (WithCStarModule.equiv Bᵐᵒᵖ (I → B)).injective
  funext i
  change (finiteInclusion (B := B) η).adjoint (finiteInclusion (B := B) η x) i = x i
  rw [finiteInclusion_adjoint_apply, coord_finiteInclusion]

/-- The reverse whole composite has the original standard truncation as its
forward CLM, on the literal finite image of the injection. -/
theorem finiteInclusion_comp_adjoint_toContinuousLinearMap (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ((finiteInclusion (B := B) η).comp
      (finiteInclusion (B := B) η).adjointOperator).toContinuousLinearMap =
      truncate (B := B) (Finset.univ.map η) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  classical
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro y
  change finiteInclusion (B := B) η ((finiteInclusion (B := B) η).adjoint y) =
    truncate (B := B) (Finset.univ.map η) y
  rw [finiteInclusion_apply, truncate_eq_sum_single, Finset.sum_map]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact congrArg (single (B := B) (η i))
    (finiteInclusion_adjoint_apply (B := B) η y i)

/-- The inclusion preserves the coefficient-valued right inner product. -/
theorem rightInner_finiteInclusion (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ∀ x y : FiniteStandard B I,
      CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
          (finiteInclusion (B := B) η x) (finiteInclusion (B := B) η y) =
        CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x y := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  intro x y
  have h := congrArg
    (fun T : AdjointableOperator.End B (FiniteStandard B I) => T y)
    (finiteInclusion_adjoint_comp_self (B := B) η)
  have hRound : (finiteInclusion (B := B) η).adjoint
      (finiteInclusion (B := B) η y) = y := by
    simpa only [AdjointableOperator.comp_apply,
      AdjointableOperator.adjointOperator_apply, AdjointableOperator.one_apply] using h
  calc
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
        (finiteInclusion (B := B) η x) (finiteInclusion (B := B) η y) =
        CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x
          ((finiteInclusion (B := B) η).adjoint (finiteInclusion (B := B) η y)) :=
      (finiteInclusion (B := B) η).adjoint_inner x (finiteInclusion (B := B) η y)
    _ = CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x y :=
      congrArg (CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x) hRound

/-- The original finite and standard module norms agree on the inclusion. -/
@[simp]
theorem norm_finiteInclusion_apply (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ∀ x : FiniteStandard B I, ‖finiteInclusion (B := B) η x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  intro x
  exact CStarModule.norm_map_of_map_rightInner
    (B := B) (C := B) (E := FiniteStandard B I) (F := Standard B κ)
    (fun b : B => b) (fun z : FiniteStandard B I => finiteInclusion (B := B) η z)
    (fun _ => rfl) (rightInner_finiteInclusion (B := B) η) x

/-- The finite inclusion is an isometry for the original metrics. -/
theorem finiteInclusion_isometry (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    Isometry (finiteInclusion (B := B) η) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  refine isometry_iff_dist_eq.mpr ?_
  intro x y
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm,
    ← map_sub (finiteInclusion (B := B) η) x y]
  exact norm_finiteInclusion_apply (B := B) η (x - y)

/-- The inclusion has norm at most one, also for an empty source or zero
coefficient algebra. -/
theorem norm_finiteInclusion_le (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ‖finiteInclusion (B := B) η‖ ≤ 1 := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  rw [AdjointableOperator.norm_eq]
  refine (finiteInclusion (B := B) η).toContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound
    zero_le_one ?_
  intro x
  have hApply : (finiteInclusion (B := B) η).toContinuousLinearMap x =
      finiteInclusion (B := B) η x :=
    congrFun (AdjointableOperator.coe_toContinuousLinearMap
      (finiteInclusion (B := B) η)) x
  calc
    ‖(finiteInclusion (B := B) η).toContinuousLinearMap x‖ =
        ‖finiteInclusion (B := B) η x‖ :=
      congrArg (fun z : Standard B κ => ‖z‖) hApply
    _ = ‖x‖ := norm_finiteInclusion_apply (B := B) η x
    _ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖ := by simp only [one_mul, le_refl]

/-- The actual adjoint operator has the same zero-safe bound. -/
theorem norm_finiteInclusion_adjointOperator_le (η : I ↪ κ) :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ‖(finiteInclusion (B := B) η).adjointOperator‖ ≤ 1 := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  rw [AdjointableOperator.norm_adjointOperator]
  exact norm_finiteInclusion_le (B := B) η

end CStarModule.Right.Standard

end
