module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Standard
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Unitary
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Finsupp.LSum
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Finsupp.SumProd
public import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Nat

/-!
# Unitary equivalences of standard right C-star modules

This file constructs the canonical unitary equivalences induced by a
reindexing of coordinates and by splitting a sum of coordinate types.  In
particular, the countable standard module is unitarily equivalent to the
direct sum of two copies of itself.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open Set
open scoped RightActions

namespace CStarModule.Right.Standard

universe uB uι uκ

variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable {ι : Type uι} {κ : Type uκ}

local instance coefficientSpectralOrder : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ :=
  CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ

local instance coefficientSpectralOrderedRing : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ :=
  CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ

/-! ## Reindexing -/

/-- Reindex finite-support standard vectors along an equivalence of
coordinate types. -/
def preReindexLinearEquiv (e : ι ≃ κ) :
    StandardPre B ι ≃ₗ[ℂ] StandardPre B κ :=
  (StandardPre.toFinsuppLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι)).trans
    ((Finsupp.domLCongr (R := ℂ) (M := B) e).trans
      (StandardPre.toFinsuppLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := κ)).symm)

/-- Reindexing has the expected coordinate formula. -/
@[simp]
theorem preReindexLinearEquiv_apply
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (x : StandardPre B ι) (j : κ) :
    preReindexLinearEquiv (B := B) e x j = x (e.symm j) := by
  change (Finsupp.domLCongr (R := ℂ) (M := B) e
    (StandardPre.toFinsupp x)) j = x (e.symm j)
  simp

/-- The inverse reindexing formula. -/
@[simp]
theorem preReindexLinearEquiv_symm_apply
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (x : StandardPre B κ) (i : ι) :
    (preReindexLinearEquiv (B := B) e).symm x i = x (e i) := by
  have h := preReindexLinearEquiv_apply
    (B := B) e ((preReindexLinearEquiv (B := B) e).symm x) (e i)
  simpa using h.symm

/-- Reindexing preserves the coefficient-valued inner product. -/
theorem preReindexLinearEquiv_rightInner
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (x y : StandardPre B ι) :
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
        (preReindexLinearEquiv (B := B) e x)
        (preReindexLinearEquiv (B := B) e y) =
      CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x y := by
  classical
  rw [StandardPre.rightInner_apply, StandardPre.rightInner_apply]
  rw [Finsupp.sum]
  change (∑ j ∈ (Finsupp.equivMapDomain e
      (StandardPre.toFinsupp x)).support,
        star (x (e.symm j)) * y (e.symm j)) = _
  rw [Finsupp.equivMapDomain_eq_mapDomain,
    Finsupp.mapDomain_support_of_injective e.injective,
    Finset.sum_image]
  · simp only [e.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [Finsupp.sum]
  · exact fun _ _ _ _ h ↦ e.injective h

/-- Reindexing preserves the standard-module norm. -/
@[simp]
theorem norm_preReindexLinearEquiv
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (x : StandardPre B ι) :
    ‖preReindexLinearEquiv (B := B) e x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  calc
    ‖preReindexLinearEquiv (B := B) e x‖ =
        √‖CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
          (preReindexLinearEquiv (B := B) e x)
          (preReindexLinearEquiv (B := B) e x)‖ :=
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.norm_eq_sqrt_norm_rightInner _
    _ = √‖CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x x‖ := by
      rw [preReindexLinearEquiv_rightInner]
    _ = ‖x‖ :=
      (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.norm_eq_sqrt_norm_rightInner x).symm

theorem reindexComparison_norm
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (x : StandardPre B ι) :
    ‖(ofPre (B := B) (ι := κ)).toLinearMap
        (preReindexLinearEquiv (B := B) e x)‖ =
      ‖(ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι)).toLinearMap x‖ := by
  change ‖ofPre (preReindexLinearEquiv (B := B) e x)‖ = ‖ofPre x‖
  rw [(ofPre (B := B) (ι := κ)).norm_map,
    (ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι)).norm_map,
    norm_preReindexLinearEquiv]

/-- The linear isometric equivalence of completed standard modules induced
by a coordinate equivalence. -/
noncomputable def reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (e : ι ≃ κ) :
    Standard B ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] Standard B κ :=
  (preReindexLinearEquiv (B := B) e).extendOfIsometry
    (ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι)).toLinearMap
    (ofPre (B := B) (ι := κ)).toLinearMap
    (denseRange_ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι))
    (denseRange_ofPre (B := B) (ι := κ))
    (reindexComparison_norm (B := B) e)

/-- Completed reindexing extends finite-support reindexing. -/
@[simp]
theorem reindexLinearIsometryEquiv_ofPre
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (x : StandardPre B ι) :
    reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) e (ofPre x) =
      ofPre (preReindexLinearEquiv (B := B) e x) := by
  unfold reindexLinearIsometryEquiv
  exact LinearEquiv.extendOfIsometry_eq _ _ _ _ _
    (reindexComparison_norm (B := B) e) x

/-- Completed reindexing has the expected coordinate formula. -/
@[simp]
theorem coord_reindexLinearIsometryEquiv
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (x : Standard B ι) (j : κ) :
    coord j (reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) e x) =
      coord (e.symm j) x := by
  have hleft : Continuous fun x : Standard B ι ↦
      coord j (reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) e x) :=
    (coord j).continuous.comp
      (reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) e).continuous
  refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on x
    (isClosed_eq hleft (coord (e.symm j)).continuous) ?_
  intro x
  change coord j
      (reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) e
        (ofPre x : Standard B ι)) =
    coord (e.symm j) (ofPre x : Standard B ι)
  rw [reindexLinearIsometryEquiv_ofPre, coord_ofPre, coord_ofPre,
    preReindexLinearEquiv_apply]

/-- Completed reindexing preserves the coefficient-valued inner product. -/
theorem reindexLinearIsometryEquiv_rightInner
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (x y : Standard B ι) :
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
        (reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) e x)
        (reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) e y) =
      CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x y := by
  have hdense : DenseRange
      (fun p : StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B ι ↦
        (ofPre p.1, ofPre p.2)) :=
    (denseRange_ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι)).prodMap
      (denseRange_ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι))
  have hfun :
      (fun p : Standard B ι × Standard B ι ↦
        CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
          (reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) e p.1)
          (reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) e p.2)) =
      (fun p : Standard B ι × Standard B ι ↦
        CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) p.1 p.2) := by
    apply Continuous.ext_on hdense
    · exact CStarModule.continuous_rightInner.comp
        (((reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) e).continuous.comp
            continuous_fst).prodMk
          ((reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) e).continuous.comp
            continuous_snd))
    · exact CStarModule.continuous_rightInner
    · rintro _ ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩
      change CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
          (reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) e
            (ofPre x : Standard B ι))
          (reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) e
            (ofPre y : Standard B ι)) =
        CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
          (ofPre x : Standard B ι) (ofPre y : Standard B ι)
      rw [reindexLinearIsometryEquiv_ofPre,
        reindexLinearIsometryEquiv_ofPre,
        rightInner_ofPre_ofPre, rightInner_ofPre_ofPre,
        preReindexLinearEquiv_rightInner]
  exact congrFun hfun (x, y)

/-- The unitary equivalence of standard modules induced by a coordinate
equivalence. -/
noncomputable def reindexUnitary (e : ι ≃ κ) :
    CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv B (Standard B ι) (Standard B κ) :=
  CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv.ofLinearIsometryEquiv
    (reindexLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) e)
    (reindexLinearIsometryEquiv_rightInner (B := B) e)

@[simp]
theorem coord_reindexUnitary
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (x : Standard B ι) (j : κ) :
    coord j (reindexUnitary (B := B) e x) = coord (e.symm j) x :=
  coord_reindexLinearIsometryEquiv e x j

/-! ## Splitting a sum of coordinate types -/

/-- Split a finite-support standard vector on a sum of coordinate types into
its two components. -/
def preSumLinearEquiv :
    StandardPre B (ι ⊕ κ) ≃ₗ[ℂ]
      WithCStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ
        (StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B κ) :=
  (StandardPre.toFinsuppLinearEquiv
      (B := B) (ι := ι ⊕ κ)).trans
    ((Finsupp.sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp ℂ).trans
      (((StandardPre.toFinsuppLinearEquiv
          (B := B) (ι := ι)).symm.prodCongr
        (StandardPre.toFinsuppLinearEquiv
          (B := B) (ι := κ)).symm).trans
        (WithCStarModule.linearEquiv ℂ Bᵐᵒᵖ
          (StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B κ)).symm))

@[simp]
theorem preSumLinearEquiv_fst
    (x : StandardPre B (ι ⊕ κ)) (i : ι) :
    (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x).1 i =
      x (Sum.inl i) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem preSumLinearEquiv_snd
    (x : StandardPre B (ι ⊕ κ)) (j : κ) :
    (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x).2 j =
      x (Sum.inr j) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem preSumLinearEquiv_symm_inl
    (x : WithCStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ
      (StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B κ)) (i : ι) :
    (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).symm x
        (Sum.inl i) = x.1 i :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem preSumLinearEquiv_symm_inr
    (x : WithCStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ
      (StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B κ)) (j : κ) :
    (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).symm x
        (Sum.inr j) = x.2 j :=
  rfl

/-- Splitting finite-support vectors preserves the coefficient-valued inner
product. -/
theorem preSumLinearEquiv_rightInner
    (x y : StandardPre B (ι ⊕ κ)) :
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
        (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x)
        (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) y) =
      CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x y := by
  classical
  change CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
        (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x).1
        (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) y).1 +
      CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
        (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x).2
        (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) y).2 =
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x y
  rw [StandardPre.rightInner_apply, StandardPre.rightInner_apply,
    StandardPre.rightInner_apply]
  have hx :
      (StandardPre.toFinsupp
          (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x).1).sumElim
        (StandardPre.toFinsupp
          (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x).2) =
      StandardPre.toFinsupp x := by
    ext s
    cases s with
    | inl i => exact preSumLinearEquiv_fst x i
    | inr j => exact preSumLinearEquiv_snd x j
  rw [← hx, Finsupp.sum_sumElim]
  rfl

/-- Splitting finite-support vectors preserves the standard-module norm. -/
@[simp]
theorem norm_preSumLinearEquiv
    (x : StandardPre B (ι ⊕ κ)) :
    ‖preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  calc
    ‖preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x‖ =
        √‖CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
          (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x)
          (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x)‖ :=
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.norm_eq_sqrt_norm_rightInner _
    _ = √‖CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x x‖ := by
      rw [preSumLinearEquiv_rightInner]
    _ = ‖x‖ :=
      (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.norm_eq_sqrt_norm_rightInner x).symm

/-- Include a pair of finite-support vectors into the completed direct sum. -/
def productOfPre :
    WithCStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ
        (StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B κ) →ₗ[ℂ]
      WithCStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ
        (Standard B ι × Standard B κ) :=
  (WithCStarModule.linearEquiv ℂ Bᵐᵒᵖ
      (Standard B ι × Standard B κ)).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    (((ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι)).toLinearMap.prodMap
      (ofPre (B := B) (ι := κ)).toLinearMap).comp
      (WithCStarModule.linearEquiv ℂ Bᵐᵒᵖ
        (StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B κ)).toLinearMap)

/-- The product inclusion acts componentwise. -/
@[simp]
theorem productOfPre_apply
    (x : WithCStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ
      (StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B κ)) :
    WithCStarModule.equiv Bᵐᵒᵖ
        (Standard B ι × Standard B κ)
        (productOfPre (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x) =
      (ofPre x.1, ofPre x.2) :=
  rfl

/-- The componentwise finite-support inclusion has dense range in the
completed direct sum. -/
theorem denseRange_productOfPre :
    DenseRange (productOfPre (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)) := by
  let raw : StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B κ →L[ℂ]
      Standard B ι × Standard B κ :=
    (ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι)).toContinuousLinearMap.prodMap
      (ofPre (B := B) (ι := κ)).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hraw : DenseRange raw :=
    (denseRange_ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι)).prodMap
      (denseRange_ofPre (B := B) (ι := κ))
  have hin : DenseRange
      (WithCStarModule.equivL (R := ℂ) (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ)
        (E := StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B κ)) :=
    (WithCStarModule.equivL (R := ℂ) (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ)
      (E := StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B κ)).surjective.denseRange
  have hout : DenseRange
      (WithCStarModule.equivL (R := ℂ) (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ)
        (E := Standard B ι × Standard B κ)).symm :=
    (WithCStarModule.equivL (R := ℂ) (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ)
      (E := Standard B ι × Standard B κ)).symm.surjective.denseRange
  have hcomp : DenseRange
      ((WithCStarModule.equivL (R := ℂ) (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ)
          (E := Standard B ι × Standard B κ)).symm ∘
        raw ∘
        (WithCStarModule.equivL (R := ℂ) (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ)
          (E := StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B κ))) :=
    hout.comp (hraw.comp hin raw.continuous)
      (WithCStarModule.equivL (R := ℂ) (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ)
        (E := Standard B ι × Standard B κ)).symm.continuous
  have hmap :
      (fun x ↦ productOfPre (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x) =
      ((WithCStarModule.equivL (R := ℂ) (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ)
          (E := Standard B ι × Standard B κ)).symm ∘
        raw ∘
        (WithCStarModule.equivL (R := ℂ) (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ)
          (E := StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B κ))) := by
    funext x
    rfl
  change DenseRange
    (fun x ↦ productOfPre (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x)
  rw [hmap]
  exact hcomp

/-- The componentwise finite-support inclusion preserves the
coefficient-valued inner product. -/
theorem productOfPre_rightInner
    (x y : WithCStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ
      (StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B κ)) :
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
        (productOfPre (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x)
        (productOfPre (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) y) =
      CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x y := by
  change CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) (ofPre x.1) (ofPre y.1) +
      CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) (ofPre x.2) (ofPre y.2) =
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x.1 y.1 +
      CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x.2 y.2
  rw [rightInner_ofPre_ofPre, rightInner_ofPre_ofPre]

/-- The componentwise finite-support inclusion is isometric for the genuine
C-star-module direct-sum norm. -/
@[simp]
theorem norm_productOfPre
    (x : WithCStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ
      (StandardPre B ι × StandardPre B κ)) :
    ‖productOfPre (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  calc
    ‖productOfPre (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x‖ =
        √‖CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
          (productOfPre (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x)
          (productOfPre (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x)‖ :=
      CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.norm_eq_sqrt_norm_rightInner _
    _ = √‖CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x x‖ := by
      rw [productOfPre_rightInner]
    _ = ‖x‖ :=
      (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.norm_eq_sqrt_norm_rightInner x).symm

theorem sumComparison_norm
    (x : StandardPre B (ι ⊕ κ)) :
    ‖productOfPre (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)
        (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x)‖ =
      ‖(ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι ⊕ κ)).toLinearMap x‖ := by
  rw [norm_productOfPre, norm_preSumLinearEquiv]
  exact ((ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι ⊕ κ)).norm_map x).symm

/-- Splitting the coordinate type gives a linear isometric equivalence from
the completed standard module to the genuine direct sum. -/
noncomputable def sumLinearIsometryEquiv :
    Standard B (ι ⊕ κ) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ]
      WithCStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ
        (Standard B ι × Standard B κ) :=
  (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).extendOfIsometry
    (ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι ⊕ κ)).toLinearMap
    (productOfPre (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ))
    (denseRange_ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι ⊕ κ))
    (denseRange_productOfPre (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ))
    (sumComparison_norm (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ))

/-- The completed sum equivalence extends finite-support splitting. -/
@[simp]
theorem sumLinearIsometryEquiv_ofPre
    (x : StandardPre B (ι ⊕ κ)) :
    sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) (ofPre x) =
      productOfPre (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)
        (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x) := by
  unfold sumLinearIsometryEquiv
  exact LinearEquiv.extendOfIsometry_eq _ _ _ _ _
    (sumComparison_norm (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)) x

/-- The first coordinates of the completed sum equivalence are the left
summand coordinates. -/
@[simp]
theorem coord_sumLinearIsometryEquiv_inl
    (x : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ)) (i : ι) :
    coord i
        (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x).1 =
      coord (Sum.inl i) x := by
  have hprod : Continuous fun x : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ) ↦
      WithCStarModule.equiv Bᵐᵒᵖ
        (Standard B ι × Standard B κ)
        (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x) :=
    (WithCStarModule.equivL (R := ℂ) (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ)
      (E := Standard B ι × Standard B κ)).continuous.comp
        (sumLinearIsometryEquiv
          (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).continuous
  have hleft : Continuous fun x : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ) ↦
      coord i
        (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x).1 :=
    (coord i).continuous.comp (continuous_fst.comp hprod)
  refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on x
    (isClosed_eq hleft (coord (Sum.inl i)).continuous) ?_
  intro x
  change coord i
      (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)
        (ofPre x : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ))).1 =
    coord (Sum.inl i) (ofPre x : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ))
  rw [sumLinearIsometryEquiv_ofPre]
  change coord i
      (ofPre
        (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x).1) =
    coord (Sum.inl i) (ofPre x : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ))
  rw [coord_ofPre, coord_ofPre, preSumLinearEquiv_fst]

/-- The second coordinates of the completed sum equivalence are the right
summand coordinates. -/
@[simp]
theorem coord_sumLinearIsometryEquiv_inr
    (x : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ)) (j : κ) :
    coord j
        (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x).2 =
      coord (Sum.inr j) x := by
  have hprod : Continuous fun x : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ) ↦
      WithCStarModule.equiv Bᵐᵒᵖ
        (Standard B ι × Standard B κ)
        (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x) :=
    (WithCStarModule.equivL (R := ℂ) (A := Bᵐᵒᵖ)
      (E := Standard B ι × Standard B κ)).continuous.comp
        (sumLinearIsometryEquiv
          (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).continuous
  have hright : Continuous fun x : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ) ↦
      coord j
        (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x).2 :=
    (coord j).continuous.comp (continuous_snd.comp hprod)
  refine UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on x
    (isClosed_eq hright (coord (Sum.inr j)).continuous) ?_
  intro x
  change coord j
      (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)
        (ofPre x : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ))).2 =
    coord (Sum.inr j) (ofPre x : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ))
  rw [sumLinearIsometryEquiv_ofPre]
  change coord j
      (ofPre
        (preSumLinearEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x).2) =
    coord (Sum.inr j) (ofPre x : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ))
  rw [coord_ofPre, coord_ofPre, preSumLinearEquiv_snd]

/-- The inverse sum equivalence reconstructs the left coordinates. -/
@[simp]
theorem coord_sumLinearIsometryEquiv_symm_inl
    (x : WithCStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ
      (Standard B ι × Standard B κ)) (i : ι) :
    coord (Sum.inl i)
        ((sumLinearIsometryEquiv
          (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).symm x) =
      coord i x.1 := by
  have h := coord_sumLinearIsometryEquiv_inl
    (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)
    ((sumLinearIsometryEquiv
      (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).symm x) i
  calc
    coord (Sum.inl i)
        ((sumLinearIsometryEquiv
          (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).symm x) =
      coord i
        (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)
          ((sumLinearIsometryEquiv
            (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).symm x)).1 := h.symm
    _ = coord i x.1 := by
      rw [(sumLinearIsometryEquiv
        (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).apply_symm_apply]

/-- The inverse sum equivalence reconstructs the right coordinates. -/
@[simp]
theorem coord_sumLinearIsometryEquiv_symm_inr
    (x : WithCStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ
      (Standard B ι × Standard B κ)) (j : κ) :
    coord (Sum.inr j)
        ((sumLinearIsometryEquiv
          (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).symm x) =
      coord j x.2 := by
  have h := coord_sumLinearIsometryEquiv_inr
    (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)
    ((sumLinearIsometryEquiv
      (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).symm x) j
  calc
    coord (Sum.inr j)
        ((sumLinearIsometryEquiv
          (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).symm x) =
      coord j
        (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)
          ((sumLinearIsometryEquiv
            (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).symm x)).2 := h.symm
    _ = coord j x.2 := by
      rw [(sumLinearIsometryEquiv
        (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).apply_symm_apply]

/-- The completed sum equivalence preserves the coefficient-valued inner
product. -/
theorem sumLinearIsometryEquiv_rightInner
    (x y : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ)) :
    CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
        (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) x)
        (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) y) =
      CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) x y := by
  have hdense : DenseRange
      (fun p : StandardPre B (ι ⊕ κ) × StandardPre B (ι ⊕ κ) ↦
        (ofPre p.1, ofPre p.2)) :=
    (denseRange_ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι ⊕ κ)).prodMap
      (denseRange_ofPre (B := B) (ι := ι ⊕ κ))
  have hfun :
      (fun p : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ) × Standard B (ι ⊕ κ) ↦
        CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
          (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) p.1)
          (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ) p.2)) =
      (fun p : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ) × Standard B (ι ⊕ κ) ↦
        CStarModule.rightInner (B := B) p.1 p.2) := by
    apply Continuous.ext_on hdense
    · exact CStarModule.continuous_rightInner.comp
        (((sumLinearIsometryEquiv
            (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).continuous.comp
              continuous_fst).prodMk
          ((sumLinearIsometryEquiv
            (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)).continuous.comp
              continuous_snd))
    · exact CStarModule.continuous_rightInner
    · rintro _ ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩
      change CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
          (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)
            (ofPre x : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ)))
          (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ)
            (ofPre y : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ))) =
        CStarModule.rightInner (B := B)
          (ofPre x : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ))
          (ofPre y : Standard B (ι ⊕ κ))
      rw [sumLinearIsometryEquiv_ofPre,
        sumLinearIsometryEquiv_ofPre,
        productOfPre_rightInner,
        preSumLinearEquiv_rightInner,
        rightInner_ofPre_ofPre]
  exact congrFun hfun (x, y)

/-- The standard module on a sum of coordinate types is unitarily equivalent
to the genuine direct sum of the two standard modules. -/
noncomputable def sumUnitary :
    CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv B
      (Standard B (ι ⊕ κ))
      (WithCStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ
        (Standard B ι × Standard B κ)) :=
  CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv.ofLinearIsometryEquiv
    (sumLinearIsometryEquiv (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ))
    (sumLinearIsometryEquiv_rightInner
      (B := B) (ι := ι) (κ := κ))

/-- The direct sum of two countable standard modules is unitarily equivalent
to the countable standard module. -/
noncomputable def doubleHUnitary :
    CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv B
      (WithCStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ (H B × H B)) (H B) :=
  (sumUnitary (B := B) (ι := ℕ) (κ := ℕ)).symm.trans
    (reindexUnitary (B := B) Equiv.natSumNatEquivNat)

end CStarModule.Right.Standard

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Compact
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Standard

/-!
# Compact endomorphisms of the standard Hilbert C-star module

This is the genuine standard-module model of stabilization: compact
endomorphisms of the completed countable standard right module. The carrier is
the existing closed compact-operator ideal. Its C-star dictionary is explicit
and is not globally registered.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace CStarModule.Right

universe uB

/-- The compact-endomorphism model of the stabilization of `B`. The canonical
opposite spectral-order dictionaries are fixed locally in the carrier. -/
def StandardStabilization
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] : Type uB :=
  let _ : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let _ : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.CompactEnd B (H B)

/-- Explicit canonical C-star structure on the standard stabilization. It is
obtained from the existing closed ideal of compact endomorphisms and is not a
global instance. -/
@[instance_reducible]
noncomputable def standardStabilizationCStarAlgebra
    (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (StandardStabilization B) := by
  let _ : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let _ : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  exact (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.compactClosedStarIdeal
    (B := B) (E := H B)).carrierCStarAlgebra

#print axioms standardStabilizationCStarAlgebra

end CStarModule.Right

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.StandardStabilization
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Matrix.StandardCompact
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.CStarMatrix
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.StarAlgHom
public import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin

/-!
# The actual coefficient corner into compacts of the genuine standard module

H_B is the existing coefficient-inner completion of finite-support vectors,
with its verified norm-convergent coefficient square-sum realization. The
coefficient goes through the literal 1×1 matrix and the actual finite-coordinate
compact corner. No scalar norm-l2(B), coefficient unit, target model,
stabilization/equivalence output or V/K0 theorem is used to form this DATA.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace CStarModule.Right

noncomputable section
universe uB
attribute [local instance] standardStabilizationCStarAlgebra

/-- The actual initial coefficient coordinate in the genuine standard module. -/
public def standardCoefficientIndex : Fin 1 ↪ ℕ where
  toFun i := i.val
  inj' := Fin.val_injective

/-- The actual source coefficient as its literal 1×1 C-star matrix, with no coefficient unit. -/
public def standardCoefficientMatrix (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CStarMatrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) B := by
  exact (CStarMatrix.toOneByOne (Fin 1) ℂ B).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom

/-- Every original 1×1 entry is exactly the supplied coefficient. -/
public theorem standardCoefficientMatrix_apply (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (b : B) (i j : Fin 1) : standardCoefficientMatrix B b i j = b := rfl

/-- The actual nonunital coefficient corner into K(H_B), using its original compact/inner norm. -/
public def standardCoefficientCompactHom (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] StandardStabilization B := by
  letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  exact (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.rightMatrixStandardCompactHom
    (B := B) standardCoefficientIndex).comp (standardCoefficientMatrix B)

/-- The literal initial standard coordinate is zero. -/
public theorem standardCoefficientIndex_zero : standardCoefficientIndex (0 : Fin 1) = 0 := rfl

/-- Every whole standard-vector action is the original single(0,b*coord(0,x)). -/
public theorem standardCoefficientCompactHom_apply (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    letI : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ;
    letI : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule;
    ∀ (b : B) (x : H B),
      (Subtype.val (show CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.CompactEnd B (H B) from standardCoefficientCompactHom B b)) x =
        Standard.single 0 (b * Standard.coord 0 x) := by
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  exact fun b x => by
    change (Subtype.val (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.rightMatrixStandardCompactHom
      (B := B) standardCoefficientIndex (standardCoefficientMatrix B b))) x =
        Standard.single 0 (b * Standard.coord 0 x)
    simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_one, standardCoefficientMatrix_apply, standardCoefficientIndex_zero] using
      (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_apply
        (B := B) standardCoefficientIndex (standardCoefficientMatrix B b) x)

/-- The original complete matrix and compact norms give the exact coefficient norm. -/
public theorem norm_standardCoefficientCompactHom (B : Type uB) [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] :
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (StandardStabilization B) := standardStabilizationCStarAlgebra B;
    ∀ b : B, ‖standardCoefficientCompactHom B b‖ = ‖b‖ := by
  let : PartialOrder B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder B
  let : StarOrderedRing B := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing B
  let : PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ
  let : CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ B := CStarModule.Right.selfModule
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (StandardStabilization B) := standardStabilizationCStarAlgebra B
  exact fun b =>
    (CStarModule.AdjointableOperator.norm_rightMatrixStandardCompactHom_apply
      (B := B) standardCoefficientIndex (standardCoefficientMatrix B b)).trans
        (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_map
          (CStarMatrix.toOneByOne (Fin 1) ℂ B).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
          (CStarMatrix.toOneByOne (Fin 1) ℂ B).toEquiv.injective b)

end

end CStarModule.Right

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.Unitary

import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Extend

/-!
# Unitary equivalences from a common dense model

Two dense complex-linear maps out of one algebraic model determine a unitary
equivalence when they have the same coefficient-valued Gram form.  Mathlib's
dense isometric extension supplies the underlying linear isometry equivalence;
continuity of the Hilbert-module inner product upgrades the equality from the
dense model to the completed carriers.

No fullness, countability, unitality, or complementability hypothesis is used.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open Set

namespace CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv

noncomputable section

universe uB uX uE uF

variable {B : Type uB} {X : Type uX} {E : Type uE} {F : Type uF}
variable [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B] [PartialOrder Bᵐᵒᵖ]
  [StarOrderedRing Bᵐᵒᵖ]
variable [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℂ X]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ E]
  [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ E] [CompleteSpace E]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℂ F] [SMul Bᵐᵒᵖ F]
  [CStarModule Bᵐᵒᵖ F] [CompleteSpace F]

/-- Two dense linear realizations of one algebraic model with the same
coefficient-valued Gram form extend canonically to a unitary equivalence. -/
@[no_expose]
noncomputable def ofDenseLinearMaps
    (e : X →ₗ[ℂ] E) (f : X →ₗ[ℂ] F)
    (he : DenseRange e) (hf : DenseRange f)
    (hinner : ∀ x y,
      rightInner (B := B) (f x) (f y) =
        rightInner (B := B) (e x) (e y)) :
    CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv B E F := by
  let hnorm : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ = ‖e x‖ := fun x => by
    calc
      ‖f x‖ = √‖rightInner (B := B) (f x) (f x)‖ :=
        AdjointableOperator.norm_eq_sqrt_norm_rightInner (B := B) (f x)
      _ = √‖rightInner (B := B) (e x) (e x)‖ := by rw [hinner x x]
      _ = ‖e x‖ :=
        (AdjointableOperator.norm_eq_sqrt_norm_rightInner (B := B) (e x)).symm
  let U : E ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] F :=
    LinearEquiv.extendOfIsometry (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ X) e f he hf hnorm
  apply ofLinearIsometryEquiv U
  intro x y
  have hEq :
      (fun p : E × E =>
        rightInner (B := B) (U p.1) (U p.2)) =
        fun p : E × E => rightInner (B := B) p.1 p.2 := by
    apply Continuous.ext_on (he.prodMap he)
    · exact (CStarModule.continuous_rightInner (B := B) (E := F)).comp
        (U.continuous.prodMap U.continuous)
    · exact CStarModule.continuous_rightInner (B := B) (E := E)
    · rintro _ ⟨⟨a, b⟩, rfl⟩
      have ha : U (e a) = f a := by
        simpa only [U, LinearEquiv.refl_apply] using
          LinearEquiv.extendOfIsometry_eq (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ X)
            e f he hf hnorm a
      have hb : U (e b) = f b := by
        simpa only [U, LinearEquiv.refl_apply] using
          LinearEquiv.extendOfIsometry_eq (LinearEquiv.refl ℂ X)
            e f he hf hnorm b
      simpa only [Prod.map_apply, ha, hb] using hinner a b
  exact congrFun hEq (x, y)

/-- The unitary extension agrees with the second realization on the common
dense model. -/
@[simp]
theorem ofDenseLinearMaps_apply
    (e : X →ₗ[ℂ] E) (f : X →ₗ[ℂ] F)
    (he : DenseRange e) (hf : DenseRange f)
    (hinner : ∀ x y,
      rightInner (B := B) (f x) (f y) =
        rightInner (B := B) (e x) (e y))
    (x : X) :
    ofDenseLinearMaps e f he hf hinner (e x) = f x := by
  unfold ofDenseLinearMaps
  simp only [ofLinearIsometryEquiv_apply]
  apply LinearEquiv.extendOfIsometry_eq

/-- The adjoint unitary extension sends the second realization back to the
first one. -/
@[simp]
theorem ofDenseLinearMaps_adjoint_apply
    (e : X →ₗ[ℂ] E) (f : X →ₗ[ℂ] F)
    (he : DenseRange e) (hf : DenseRange f)
    (hinner : ∀ x y,
      rightInner (B := B) (f x) (f y) =
        rightInner (B := B) (e x) (e y))
    (x : X) :
    (ofDenseLinearMaps e f he hf hinner).toAdjointable.adjoint (f x) =
      e x := by
  rw [← ofDenseLinearMaps_apply e f he hf hinner x,
    adjoint_apply_apply]

/-- A unitary equivalence with the prescribed action on the common dense
model is the canonical dense extension. -/
theorem ofDenseLinearMaps_unique
    (e : X →ₗ[ℂ] E) (f : X →ₗ[ℂ] F)
    (he : DenseRange e) (hf : DenseRange f)
    (hinner : ∀ x y,
      rightInner (B := B) (f x) (f y) =
        rightInner (B := B) (e x) (e y))
    (U : CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv B E F)
    (hU : ∀ x, U (e x) = f x) :
    U = ofDenseLinearMaps e f he hf hinner := by
  apply CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv.ext
  intro y
  have hEq :
      (fun z : E => U z) =
        fun z : E => ofDenseLinearMaps e f he hf hinner z := by
    apply Continuous.ext_on he
    · exact U.toAdjointable.toContinuousLinearMap.continuous
    · exact (ofDenseLinearMaps e f he hf hinner).toAdjointable.toContinuousLinearMap.continuous
    · rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
      change U (e x) = ofDenseLinearMaps e f he hf hinner (e x)
      rw [hU x, ofDenseLinearMaps_apply]
  exact congrFun hEq y

end

end CStarModule.UnitaryEquiv

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.IdealQuotient
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Multiplier
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ApproximateUnit

/-!
# Actual multiplier actions preserve every closed two-sided coefficient ideal

This is the defining prerequisite for descending the original left/right
multiplier operators to the actual quotient by a closed star ideal.
Centrality supplies the centralizer product laws. The actual C-star
approximate unit of the ideal, in its inherited original norm, then gives
membership of each multiplier value by closedness. No multiplier extension,
invariance certificate, nonzero quotient or source theorem output is supplied.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter Set
open scoped MultiplierAlgebra Topology
namespace DoubleCentralizer
universe uB
variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- The actual first operator is a left centralizer, needed for quotient well-definedness. -/
theorem fst_apply_mul (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) (a b : B) : m.fst (a * b) = m.fst a * b := by
  have h (x : B) : x * m.fst (a * b) = x * (m.fst a * b) := by
    calc
      x * m.fst (a * b) = m.snd x * (a * b) := (m.central x (a * b)).symm
      _ = (m.snd x * a) * b := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (x * m.fst a) * b := congrArg (fun z : B => z * b) (m.central x a)
      _ = x * (m.fst a * b) := mul_assoc _ _ _
  let z := m.fst (a * b) - m.fst a * b
  have hz : star z * z = 0 := by
    dsimp only [z]
    rw [mul_sub, h, sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (star_mul_self_eq_zero.mp hz)

/-- The actual second operator is a right centralizer in the original multiplication. -/
theorem snd_apply_mul (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) (a b : B) : m.snd (a * b) = a * m.snd b := by
  have h := fst_apply_mul (star m) (star b) (star a)
  have hs := congrArg (star : B → B) h
  simpa only [star_fst, star_mul, star_star] using hs

/-- Every original first-component multiplier value of a closed-ideal element remains in that ideal. -/
theorem fst_mem_closedStarIdeal (I : ClosedStarIdeal B) (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    m.fst x ∈ I := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra I.carrier := I.carrierCStarAlgebra
  let : PartialOrder I.carrier := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing I.carrier := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  let l := CStarAlgebra.approximateUnit I.carrier
  have hl : l.IsApproximateUnit := (CStarAlgebra.increasingApproximateUnit I.carrier).toIsApproximateUnit
  let : NeBot l := hl.neBot
  let xi : I.carrier := ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hi : Tendsto (fun e : I.carrier => xi * e) l (𝓝 xi) := hl.tendsto_mul_left xi
  have hb := ((continuous_subtype_val : Continuous (fun y : I.carrier => (y : B))).tendsto xi).comp hi
  change Tendsto (fun e : I.carrier => x * (e : B)) l (𝓝 x) at hb
  refine I.isClosed.mem_of_tendsto ((m.fst.continuous.tendsto x).comp hb) (Eventually.of_forall ?_)
  intro e
  change m.fst (x * (e : B)) ∈ I.carrier
  rw [fst_apply_mul]
  exact I.isTwoSided.mul_mem_left (m.fst x) e.property

/-- Every original second-component multiplier value of a closed-ideal element remains in that ideal. -/
theorem snd_mem_closedStarIdeal (I : ClosedStarIdeal B) (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) {x : B} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    m.snd x ∈ I := by
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra I.carrier := I.carrierCStarAlgebra
  let : PartialOrder I.carrier := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder _
  let : StarOrderedRing I.carrier := CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing _
  let l := CStarAlgebra.approximateUnit I.carrier
  have hl : l.IsApproximateUnit := (CStarAlgebra.increasingApproximateUnit I.carrier).toIsApproximateUnit
  let : NeBot l := hl.neBot
  let xi : I.carrier := ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hi : Tendsto (fun e : I.carrier => e * xi) l (𝓝 xi) := hl.tendsto_mul_right xi
  have hb := ((continuous_subtype_val : Continuous (fun y : I.carrier => (y : B))).tendsto xi).comp hi
  change Tendsto (fun e : I.carrier => (e : B) * x) l (𝓝 x) at hb
  refine I.isClosed.mem_of_tendsto ((m.snd.continuous.tendsto x).comp hb) (Eventually.of_forall ?_)
  intro e
  change m.snd ((e : B) * x) ∈ I.carrier
  rw [snd_apply_mul]
  exact I.isTwoSided.mul_mem_right e.property (m.snd x)

end DoubleCentralizer

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Multiplier.IdealInvariant
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Quotient

/-!
# Actual multiplier descent to the original closed-ideal quotient

Both original continuous linear multiplier operators descend by the stock
submodule quotient lift. Their kernel condition is the proved ideal
invariance. The original centrality identity descends through the actual
quotient projection and supplies a genuine DoubleCentralizer. Every
zero/add/mul/star/unit/scalar law of the resulting map is computed on actual
quotient representatives. No quotient model, extended multiplier map or
nontriviality condition is an input; the zero quotient remains included.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter Set
open scoped MultiplierAlgebra Topology
namespace DoubleCentralizer
universe uB
variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]

/-- The descended first operator uses the actual quotient norm/topology and proved kernel condition. -/
def quotientFst (I : ClosedStarIdeal B) (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) : I.Quotient →L[ℂ] I.Quotient :=
  (NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.quotientSubmodule I.carrier).liftQL
    ((NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.quotientSubmodule I.carrier).mkQL.comp m.fst) (by
      intro x hx
      change (Submodule.Quotient.mk (m.fst x) : I.Quotient) = 0
      exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero
        (NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.quotientSubmodule I.carrier)).2 (fst_mem_closedStarIdeal I m hx))

/-- The descended second operator uses the same actual quotient structure and kernel condition. -/
def quotientSnd (I : ClosedStarIdeal B) (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) : I.Quotient →L[ℂ] I.Quotient :=
  (NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.quotientSubmodule I.carrier).liftQL
    ((NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.quotientSubmodule I.carrier).mkQL.comp m.snd) (by
      intro x hx
      change (Submodule.Quotient.mk (m.snd x) : I.Quotient) = 0
      exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero
        (NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.quotientSubmodule I.carrier)).2 (snd_mem_closedStarIdeal I m hx))

/-- The original first-component value is exactly preserved on every original quotient representative. -/
theorem quotientFst_mk (I : ClosedStarIdeal B) (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) (b : B) :
    quotientFst I m (Submodule.Quotient.mk b) = (Submodule.Quotient.mk (m.fst b) : I.Quotient) := rfl

/-- The original second-component value is exactly preserved on every original quotient representative. -/
theorem quotientSnd_mk (I : ClosedStarIdeal B) (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) (b : B) :
    quotientSnd I m (Submodule.Quotient.mk b) = (Submodule.Quotient.mk (m.snd b) : I.Quotient) := rfl

/-- The actual descended pair satisfies the original centrality identity on the quotient. -/
def quotientMultiplier (I : ClosedStarIdeal B) (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) :
    letI : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.quotientCStarAlgebra;
    𝓜(ℂ, I.Quotient) := by
  letI : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact
    { fst := quotientFst I m
      snd := quotientSnd I m
      central := by
        intro x y
        obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := I.quotientMap_surjective x
        obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := I.quotientMap_surjective y
        let q : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] I.Quotient := I.quotientMap
        change q (m.snd a) * q b = q a * q (m.fst b)
        exact (map_mul q _ _).symm.trans ((congrArg q (m.central a b)).trans (map_mul q _ _)) }

/-- The descended multiplier retains the original first operator on the canonical quotient map. -/
theorem quotientMultiplier_fst_quotientMap (I : ClosedStarIdeal B) (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) (b : B) :
    letI : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.quotientCStarAlgebra;
    (quotientMultiplier I m).fst (I.quotientMap b) = I.quotientMap (m.fst b) := rfl

/-- The descended multiplier retains the original second operator on the same quotient map. -/
theorem quotientMultiplier_snd_quotientMap (I : ClosedStarIdeal B) (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) (b : B) :
    letI : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.quotientCStarAlgebra;
    (quotientMultiplier I m).snd (I.quotientMap b) = I.quotientMap (m.snd b) := rfl

/-- The actual closed-ideal multiplier quotient map is a unital star-algebra homomorphism. -/
def quotientMultiplierHom (I : ClosedStarIdeal B) :
    letI : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided;
    letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.quotientCStarAlgebra;
    𝓜(ℂ, B) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] 𝓜(ℂ, I.Quotient) := by
  letI : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.quotientCStarAlgebra
  exact
    { toFun := quotientMultiplier I
      map_one' := by
        apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ I.Quotient
        apply Prod.ext <;> apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext <;> intro z
        · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := I.quotientMap_surjective z
          simp only [quotientMultiplier_fst_quotientMap, one_fst, one_apply_eq_self]
        · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := I.quotientMap_surjective z
          simp only [quotientMultiplier_snd_quotientMap, one_snd, one_apply_eq_self]
      map_zero' := by
        apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ I.Quotient
        apply Prod.ext <;> apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext <;> intro z
        · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := I.quotientMap_surjective z
          simp only [quotientMultiplier_fst_quotientMap, zero_fst, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
        · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := I.quotientMap_surjective z
          simp only [quotientMultiplier_snd_quotientMap, zero_snd, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
      map_add' := by
        intro m n
        apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ I.Quotient
        apply Prod.ext <;> apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext <;> intro z
        · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := I.quotientMap_surjective z
          simp only [quotientMultiplier_fst_quotientMap, add_fst, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, map_add]
        · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := I.quotientMap_surjective z
          simp only [quotientMultiplier_snd_quotientMap, add_snd, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, map_add]
      map_mul' := by
        intro m n
        apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ I.Quotient
        apply Prod.ext <;> apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext <;> intro z
        · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := I.quotientMap_surjective z
          simp only [quotientMultiplier_fst_quotientMap, mul_fst, mul_apply_eq_comp]
        · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := I.quotientMap_surjective z
          simp only [quotientMultiplier_snd_quotientMap, mul_snd, mul_apply_eq_comp]
      commutes' := by
        intro c
        apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ I.Quotient
        apply Prod.ext <;> apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext <;> intro z
        · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := I.quotientMap_surjective z
          simp only [quotientMultiplier_fst_quotientMap, algebraMap_fst,
            ContinuousLinearMap.algebraMap_apply, map_smul]
        · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := I.quotientMap_surjective z
          simp only [quotientMultiplier_snd_quotientMap, algebraMap_snd,
            ContinuousLinearMap.algebraMap_apply, map_smul]
      map_star' := by
        intro m
        apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ I.Quotient
        apply Prod.ext <;> apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext <;> intro z
        · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := I.quotientMap_surjective z
          change I.quotientMap (star (m.snd (star b))) =
            star ((quotientMultiplier I m).snd (star (I.quotientMap b)))
          rw [← map_star I.quotientMap b, quotientMultiplier_snd_quotientMap]
          exact map_star I.quotientMap _
        · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := I.quotientMap_surjective z
          change I.quotientMap (star (m.fst (star b))) =
            star ((quotientMultiplier I m).fst (star (I.quotientMap b)))
          rw [← map_star I.quotientMap b, quotientMultiplier_fst_quotientMap]
          exact map_star I.quotientMap _ }

end DoubleCentralizer

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Multiplier.Quotient
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Multiplier.Outer

/-!
# Actual multiplier and outer-multiplier maps from a coefficient quotient

The source quotient homomorphism B to D is given, with genuine surjectivity.
Its actual closed kernel and the strict first-isomorphism equivalence identify
D with the constructed quotient; multiplier transport uses that equivalence.
The resulting map preserves the original coefficient embeddings, so the
actual outer quotient map is defined as well. No multiplier-extension map,
quotient model, surjectivity of the multiplier map or nonzero quotient premise
is supplied. Stabilized minimum-tensor coefficient base change is a separate
prerequisite of Blackadar15.12 residual essentiality.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped MultiplierAlgebra
namespace DoubleCentralizer
universe uB uD
variable {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
variable {D : Type uD} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra D]

/-- The original coefficient quotient induces the actual unital multiplier homomorphism. -/
def mapOfSurjective (rho : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D) (hrho : Function.Surjective rho) :
    𝓜(ℂ, B) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] 𝓜(ℂ, D) := by
  let I := ClosedStarIdeal.ker rho
  letI : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  letI : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.quotientCStarAlgebra
  let e : I.Quotient ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] D := NonUnitalStarAlgHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective rho hrho
  exact (DoubleCentralizer.congr e).toStarAlgHom.comp (quotientMultiplierHom I)

/-- Every original first multiplier action has its actual quotient value. -/
theorem mapOfSurjective_fst (rho : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D) (hrho : Function.Surjective rho)
    (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) (b : B) :
    (mapOfSurjective rho hrho m).fst (rho b) = rho (m.fst b) := by
  let I := ClosedStarIdeal.ker rho
  let : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.quotientCStarAlgebra
  let e : I.Quotient ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] D := NonUnitalStarAlgHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective rho hrho
  have he (x : B) : e (I.quotientMap x) = rho x :=
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_quotientMap rho hrho x
  have hb : e.symm (rho b) = I.quotientMap b := by
    calc
      e.symm (rho b) = e.symm (e (I.quotientMap b)) := congrArg e.symm (he b).symm
      _ = I.quotientMap b := e.symm_apply_apply _
  change (DoubleCentralizer.congr e (quotientMultiplier I m)).fst (rho b) = _
  rw [congr_apply_fst, hb, quotientMultiplier_fst_quotientMap, he]

/-- Every original second multiplier action has its actual quotient value. -/
theorem mapOfSurjective_snd (rho : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D) (hrho : Function.Surjective rho)
    (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) (b : B) :
    (mapOfSurjective rho hrho m).snd (rho b) = rho (m.snd b) := by
  let I := ClosedStarIdeal.ker rho
  let : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  let : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra I.Quotient := I.quotientCStarAlgebra
  let e : I.Quotient ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] D := NonUnitalStarAlgHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective rho hrho
  have he (x : B) : e (I.quotientMap x) = rho x :=
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_quotientMap rho hrho x
  have hb : e.symm (rho b) = I.quotientMap b := by
    calc
      e.symm (rho b) = e.symm (e (I.quotientMap b)) := congrArg e.symm (he b).symm
      _ = I.quotientMap b := e.symm_apply_apply _
  change (DoubleCentralizer.congr e (quotientMultiplier I m)).snd (rho b) = _
  rw [congr_apply_snd, hb, quotientMultiplier_snd_quotientMap, he]

/-- The multiplier map sends every actual embedded coefficient to its given coefficient quotient. -/
theorem mapOfSurjective_coeHom (rho : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D) (hrho : Function.Surjective rho) (b : B) :
    mapOfSurjective rho hrho (DoubleCentralizer.coeHom (𝕜 := ℂ) b) =
      DoubleCentralizer.coeHom (𝕜 := ℂ) (rho b) := by
  apply DoubleCentralizer.ext ℂ D
  apply Prod.ext <;> apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext <;> intro d
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hrho d
    rw [mapOfSurjective_fst]
    change rho (b * a) = rho b * rho a
    exact map_mul rho b a
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hrho d
    rw [mapOfSurjective_snd]
    change rho (a * b) = rho a * rho b
    exact map_mul rho a b

/-- The actual multiplier quotient preserves the original coefficient ideal. -/
theorem mapOfSurjective_mem_coefficientIdeal (rho : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D)
    (hrho : Function.Surjective rho) {m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)} (hm : m ∈ coefficientIdeal B) :
    mapOfSurjective rho hrho m ∈ coefficientIdeal D := by
  rcases (mem_coefficientIdeal_iff m).1 hm with ⟨b, rfl⟩
  rw [mapOfSurjective_coeHom]
  exact coeHom_mem_coefficientIdeal _

/-- The actual coefficient-quotient multiplier map descends to the actual unital outer quotient. -/
def outerMapOfSurjective (rho : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D) (hrho : Function.Surjective rho) :
    letI : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B;
    letI : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier D) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra D;
    OuterMultiplier B →⋆ₐ[ℂ] OuterMultiplier D := by
  letI : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B
  letI : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier D) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra D
  letI : (coefficientIdeal B).carrier.IsTwoSided := (coefficientIdeal B).isTwoSided
  letI : (coefficientIdeal D).carrier.IsTwoSided := (coefficientIdeal D).isTwoSided
  let f : OuterMultiplier B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] OuterMultiplier D :=
    NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.map (coefficientIdeal B).carrier (coefficientIdeal D).carrier
      (mapOfSurjective rho hrho).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
      (fun m hm => mapOfSurjective_mem_coefficientIdeal rho hrho hm)
  have hf (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) : f (outerQuotientMap m) =
      outerQuotientMap (mapOfSurjective rho hrho m) := rfl
  have hOne : f 1 = 1 := by
    calc
      f 1 = f (outerQuotientMap (1 : 𝓜(ℂ, B))) :=
        congrArg f (map_one (outerQuotientMap (A := B))).symm
      _ = outerQuotientMap (mapOfSurjective rho hrho 1) := hf _
      _ = 1 := by rw [map_one, map_one]
  exact
    { toFun := f
      map_one' := hOne
      map_zero' := map_zero f
      map_add' := map_add f
      map_mul' := map_mul f
      commutes' := by
        intro c
        simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, map_smul, hOne]
      map_star' := map_star f }

/-- The actual outer-quotient square commutes on every original multiplier. -/
theorem outerMapOfSurjective_outerQuotientMap (rho : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] D)
    (hrho : Function.Surjective rho) (m : 𝓜(ℂ, B)) :
    letI : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier B) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra B;
    letI : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier D) := outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra D;
    outerMapOfSurjective rho hrho (outerQuotientMap m) =
      outerQuotientMap (mapOfSurjective rho hrho m) := rfl

end DoubleCentralizer

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Operator.Calkin
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Hom

/-!
# Actual unitary transport of Calkin classes

The original Hilbert unitary acts by the stock `conjStarAlgEquiv` on bounded
operators. Compactness is preserved by the stock two composition laws, so
the existing star-ideal quotient lift gives the actual unital Calkin map.
The quotient carrier and Hilbert dictionaries are unchanged.

This constructor is needed to descend continuous functional calculus to
the original compact-unitary Ext(X) quotient. No classification or
unitary-equivalence theorem is supplied as an input or used as a witness.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section

open scoped Topology

namespace CalkinAlgebra

universe uH uK

variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type uK} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]

/-- Hilbert-unitary conjugation preserves compactness on the original operator spaces. -/
theorem conjugate_compact (U : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hT : IsCompactOperator T) : IsCompactOperator (U.conjStarAlgEquiv T) := by
  rcases hT with ⟨C, hC, hTC⟩
  refine ⟨U '' C, hC.image U.continuous, ?_⟩
  have hcont : Filter.Tendsto (U.symm : K → H) (𝓝 (0 : K)) (𝓝 (0 : H)) := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using U.symm.continuous.tendsto (0 : K)
  exact Filter.mem_of_superset (hcont.eventually hTC) fun x hx =>
    ⟨T (U.symm x), hx, rfl⟩

/-- Actual unitary transport of the original Calkin classes, using the existing quotient lift. -/
def conjugateStarAlgHom (U : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) :
    CalkinAlgebra ℂ H →⋆ₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ K := by
  let I := compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)
  letI : I.carrier.IsTwoSided := I.isTwoSided
  let f : (H →L[ℂ] H) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ K :=
    (classStarMap (H := K)).comp U.conjStarAlgEquiv.toStarAlgHom
  let g : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ K :=
    NonUnitalStarSubalgebra.Quotient.lift I.carrier f.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
    (fun T hT => by
      apply (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff (H := K) (U.conjStarAlgEquiv T)).mpr
      exact conjugate_compact U T (show IsCompactOperator T from hT))
  exact
    { __ := g
      map_one' := by
        rw [← map_one (classStarMap (H := H))]
        change f (1 : H →L[ℂ] H) = (1 : CalkinAlgebra ℂ K)
        exact map_one f
      commutes' := by
        intro z
        rw [← AlgHomClass.commutes (classStarMap (H := H)) z]
        change f (algebraMap ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) z) = algebraMap ℂ (CalkinAlgebra ℂ K) z
        exact f.toAlgHom.commutes z }

/-- The descended map keeps the literal original unitary action on every operator representative. -/
@[simp]
theorem conjugateStarAlgHom_classStarMap (U : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    conjugateStarAlgHom U (classStarMap (H := H) T) =
      classStarMap (H := K) (U.conjStarAlgEquiv T) := rfl

/-- The actual Calkin transport is continuous by the canonical C-star contractivity bound. -/
theorem conjugateStarAlgHom_continuous (U : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] K) :
    Continuous (conjugateStarAlgHom U) := by
  exact AddMonoidHomClass.continuous_of_bound (conjugateStarAlgHom U) 1 (by
    intro a
    simpa only [one_mul] using NonUnitalStarAlgHom.norm_apply_le (conjugateStarAlgHom U) a)

end CalkinAlgebra

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Operator.CalkinOrthogonalSum
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Operator.FredholmCalkin
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Compact.EssentialSpectrum
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Compact.Basic

/-!
# Literal orthogonal Calkin units and essential-spectrum union

The existing block-diagonal Calkin map has unit detection by its two original
coordinates. Actual bounded lifts of an inverse have compact left/right
remainder; their two diagonal blocks are the actual inverses modulo compacts.
No inverse, spectrum model or result certificate is a supplied constructor
input. The resulting essential-spectrum union is needed to keep the original
Ext(X) sum within its exact source spectrum. The arguments retain independent
Hilbert universes and include zero/finite/infinite spaces.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace CalkinAlgebra

universe uH uK
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {K : Type uK} [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]

omit [CompleteSpace H] [CompleteSpace K] in
/-- Compactness of the proof-local first coordinate follows from the existing composition API. -/
private theorem compact_block11 (R : OrthogonalSum H K →L[ℂ] OrthogonalSum H K)
    (hR : IsCompactOperator R) : IsCompactOperator (OrthogonalSum.block11 R) := by
  simpa only [OrthogonalSum.block11_eq, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] using
    (hR.comp_clm (OrthogonalSum.inl (𝕜 := ℂ) H K).toContinuousLinearMap).clm_comp
      (WithLp.fstL 2 ℂ H K)

omit [CompleteSpace H] [CompleteSpace K] in
/-- Compactness of the proof-local second coordinate follows from the existing composition API. -/
private theorem compact_block22 (R : OrthogonalSum H K →L[ℂ] OrthogonalSum H K)
    (hR : IsCompactOperator R) : IsCompactOperator (OrthogonalSum.block22 R) := by
  simpa only [OrthogonalSum.block22_eq, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] using
    (hR.comp_clm (OrthogonalSum.inr (𝕜 := ℂ) H K).toContinuousLinearMap).clm_comp
      (WithLp.sndL 2 ℂ H K)

/-- The actual product Calkin block map is injective on all original complete Hilbert carriers. -/
theorem blockDiagonalStarAlgHom_injective :
    Function.Injective (CalkinAlgebra.blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (H := H) (K := K)) := by
  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap_surjective (H := H) (x.1 - y.1)
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap_surjective (H := K) (x.2 - y.2)
  have hz : CalkinAlgebra.blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (x - y) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
  have hDiag : IsCompactOperator (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal T S) := by
    apply (CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap_eq_zero_iff _).mp
    rw [← CalkinAlgebra.blockDiagonalStarAlgHom_apply, hT, hS]
    exact hz
  have hTc := compact_block11 _ hDiag
  have hSc := compact_block22 _ hDiag
  rw [OrthogonalSum.block11_blockDiagonal] at hTc
  rw [OrthogonalSum.block22_blockDiagonal] at hSc
  have hTz := (CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap_eq_zero_iff _).mpr hTc
  have hSz := (CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap_eq_zero_iff _).mpr hSc
  rw [hT, sub_eq_zero] at hTz
  rw [hS, sub_eq_zero] at hSz
  exact Prod.ext hTz hSz

/-- The original block-diagonal Calkin class is a unit exactly when its two actual coordinates are
  units. -/
theorem isUnit_blockDiagonal_iff (x : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) (y : CalkinAlgebra ℂ K) :
    IsUnit (blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (x, y)) ↔ IsUnit x ∧ IsUnit y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨T, rfl⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := H) x
    obtain ⟨S, rfl⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := K) y
    rw [blockDiagonalStarAlgHom_apply] at h
    obtain ⟨b, hDb, hbD⟩ := isUnit_iff_exists.mp h
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := OrthogonalSum H K) b
    have hRD : IsCompactOperator (R * OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal T S -
        (1 : OrthogonalSum H K →L[ℂ] OrthogonalSum H K)) := by
      apply (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff _).mp
      rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_one, hR, hbD, sub_self]
    have hDR : IsCompactOperator (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal T S * R -
        (1 : OrthogonalSum H K →L[ℂ] OrthogonalSum H K)) := by
      apply (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff _).mp
      rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_one, hR, hDb, sub_self]
    have hRT := compact_block11 _ hRD
    have hTR := compact_block11 _ hDR
    have hRS := compact_block22 _ hRD
    have hSR := compact_block22 _ hDR
    rw [map_sub, OrthogonalSum.block11_one] at hRT hTR
    rw [map_sub, OrthogonalSum.block22_one] at hRS hSR
    change IsCompactOperator
      (((OrthogonalSum.block11 (R.comp (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal T S)) : H →L[ℂ] H) -
        (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)) : H → H) at hRT
    change IsCompactOperator
      (((OrthogonalSum.block11 ((OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal T S).comp R) : H →L[ℂ] H) -
        (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)) : H → H) at hTR
    change IsCompactOperator
      (((OrthogonalSum.block22 (R.comp (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal T S)) : K →L[ℂ] K) -
        (1 : K →L[ℂ] K)) : K → K) at hRS
    change IsCompactOperator
      (((OrthogonalSum.block22 ((OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal T S).comp R) : K →L[ℂ] K) -
        (1 : K →L[ℂ] K)) : K → K) at hSR
    simp only [OrthogonalSum.block11_comp, OrthogonalSum.block11_blockDiagonal,
      OrthogonalSum.block21_blockDiagonal, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_zero, add_zero] at hRT
    simp only [OrthogonalSum.block11_comp, OrthogonalSum.block11_blockDiagonal,
      OrthogonalSum.block12_blockDiagonal, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp, add_zero] at hTR
    simp only [OrthogonalSum.block22_comp, OrthogonalSum.block22_blockDiagonal,
      OrthogonalSum.block12_blockDiagonal, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_zero, zero_add] at hRS
    simp only [OrthogonalSum.block22_comp, OrthogonalSum.block22_blockDiagonal,
      OrthogonalSum.block21_blockDiagonal, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp, zero_add] at hSR
    change IsCompactOperator (OrthogonalSum.block11 R * T - (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)) at hRT
    change IsCompactOperator (T * OrthogonalSum.block11 R - (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)) at hTR
    change IsCompactOperator (OrthogonalSum.block22 R * S - (1 : K →L[ℂ] K)) at hRS
    change IsCompactOperator (S * OrthogonalSum.block22 R - (1 : K →L[ℂ] K)) at hSR
    have hRT' := (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff (H := H)
      (OrthogonalSum.block11 R * T - 1)).mpr hRT
    have hTR' := (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff (H := H)
      (T * OrthogonalSum.block11 R - 1)).mpr hTR
    have hRS' := (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff (H := K)
      (OrthogonalSum.block22 R * S - 1)).mpr hRS
    have hSR' := (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff (H := K)
      (S * OrthogonalSum.block22 R - 1)).mpr hSR
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_one, sub_eq_zero] at hRT' hTR' hRS' hSR'
    exact ⟨isUnit_iff_exists.mpr ⟨classStarMap (OrthogonalSum.block11 R), hTR', hRT'⟩,
      isUnit_iff_exists.mpr ⟨classStarMap (OrthogonalSum.block22 R), hSR', hRS'⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨a, hxa, hax⟩ := isUnit_iff_exists.mp hx
    obtain ⟨b, hyb, hby⟩ := isUnit_iff_exists.mp hy
    refine isUnit_iff_exists.mpr ⟨blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (a, b), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← map_mul]
      change blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (x * a, y * b) = 1
      rw [hxa, hyb]
      exact map_one _
    · rw [← map_mul]
      change blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (a * x, b * y) = 1
      rw [hax, hby]
      exact map_one _

/-- The original scalar shift of a literal block diagonal is the literal diagonal of the two
  scalar shifts. -/
private theorem blockDiagonal_scalar_shift (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (S : K →L[ℂ] K) (z : ℂ) :
    OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal T S - z • (1 : OrthogonalSum H K →L[ℂ] OrthogonalSum H K) =
      OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal (T - z • (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)) (S - z • (1 : K →L[ℂ] K)) := by
  let d := OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) (K := K)
  have h : d ((T, S) - z • (1 : (H →L[ℂ] H) × (K →L[ℂ] K))) = d (T, S) - z • 1 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_smul, map_one]
  exact h.symm

/-- The actual essential spectrum of the original orthogonal sum is the union of its two original
  spectra. -/
theorem essentialSpectrum_blockDiagonal (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (S : K →L[ℂ] K) :
    (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal T S).essentialSpectrum = T.essentialSpectrum ∪
      S.essentialSpectrum := by
  ext z
  apply not_iff_not.mp
  have hClass : classStarMap
      (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal T S - z • (1 : OrthogonalSum H K →L[ℂ] OrthogonalSum H K)) =
      blockDiagonalStarAlgHom
        (classStarMap (T - z • (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)), classStarMap (S - z • (1 : K →L[ℂ] K))) := by
    rw [blockDiagonal_scalar_shift]
    exact (blockDiagonalStarAlgHom_apply _ _).symm
  calc
    z ∉ (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal T S).essentialSpectrum ↔
        IsUnit (classStarMap
          (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal T S - z • (1 : OrthogonalSum H K →L[ℂ] OrthogonalSum H K)))
            :=
      (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal T S).notMem_essentialSpectrum_iff_isUnit z
    _ ↔ IsUnit (blockDiagonalStarAlgHom
        (classStarMap (T - z • (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)), classStarMap (S - z • (1 : K →L[ℂ] K)))) := by
      rw [hClass]
    _ ↔ IsUnit (classStarMap (T - z • (1 : H →L[ℂ] H))) ∧
        IsUnit (classStarMap (S - z • (1 : K →L[ℂ] K))) := isUnit_blockDiagonal_iff _ _
    _ ↔ z ∉ T.essentialSpectrum ∧ z ∉ S.essentialSpectrum :=
      (T.notMem_essentialSpectrum_iff_isUnit z).symm.and
        (S.notMem_essentialSpectrum_iff_isUnit z).symm
    _ ↔ z ∉ T.essentialSpectrum ∪ S.essentialSpectrum := by
      simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or]

end CalkinAlgebra

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Operator.Calkin
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.OrthogonalSum
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Compact.Basic

/-!
# Orthogonal block sums in the Calkin algebra

The literal block diagonal of two compact operators is compact. Consequently
the existing block-diagonal star-algebra homomorphism descends to a unital
star-algebra homomorphism from the product of the two Calkin algebras into the
Calkin algebra of their stock orthogonal product.

The quotient carriers, quotient norms and class maps are unchanged. The
construction uses the stock binary quotient eliminator with compact-ideal
compatibility, not a choice of representatives or a second quotient carrier.
The compactness lemma permits incomplete normed spaces and rectangular maps;
the star-algebra map uses complete complex Hilbert spaces, including zero ones.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace OrthogonalSum

universe u𝕜 uH₁ uK₁ uH₂ uK₂

variable {𝕜 : Type u𝕜} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
variable {H₁ : Type uH₁} {K₁ : Type uK₁} {H₂ : Type uH₂} {K₂ : Type uK₂}
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H₁] [NormedSpace 𝕜 H₁]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup K₁] [NormedSpace 𝕜 K₁]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H₂] [NormedSpace 𝕜 H₂]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup K₂] [NormedSpace 𝕜 K₂]

/-- The literal orthogonal block diagonal preserves compactness, without
completeness, inner-product or nontriviality requirements on the spaces. -/
theorem isCompactOperator_blockDiagonal (S : H₁ →L[𝕜] H₂) (T : K₁ →L[𝕜] K₂)
    (hS : IsCompactOperator S) (hT : IsCompactOperator T) :
    IsCompactOperator (blockDiagonal S T) := by
  let L := (inl (𝕜 := 𝕜) H₂ K₂).toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (S.comp (WithLp.fstL 2 𝕜 H₁ K₁))
  let R := (inr (𝕜 := 𝕜) H₂ K₂).toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (T.comp (WithLp.sndL 2 𝕜 H₁ K₁))
  have hL : IsCompactOperator L := by
    simpa only [L, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] using
      (hS.comp_clm (WithLp.fstL 2 𝕜 H₁ K₁)).clm_comp
        (inl (𝕜 := 𝕜) H₂ K₂).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hR : IsCompactOperator R := by
    simpa only [R, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] using
      (hT.comp_clm (WithLp.sndL 2 𝕜 H₁ K₁)).clm_comp
        (inr (𝕜 := 𝕜) H₂ K₂).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hsum : IsCompactOperator (L + R) := by
    have hcoe :
        ((L + R : OrthogonalSum H₁ K₁ →L[𝕜] OrthogonalSum H₂ K₂) :
          OrthogonalSum H₁ K₁ → OrthogonalSum H₂ K₂) =
        (L : OrthogonalSum H₁ K₁ → OrthogonalSum H₂ K₂) +
          (R : OrthogonalSum H₁ K₁ → OrthogonalSum H₂ K₂) := by
      funext x
      exact _root_.add_apply L R x
    exact hcoe.symm ▸ hL.add hR
  have hdiag : blockDiagonal S T = L + R := by
    ext x
    rw [blockDiagonal_apply, _root_.add_apply]
    change WithLp.toLp 2 (S x.fst, T x.snd) =
      inl (𝕜 := 𝕜) H₂ K₂ (S x.fst) + inr (𝕜 := 𝕜) H₂ K₂ (T x.snd)
    exact (inl_fst_add_inr_snd (𝕜 := 𝕜) H₂ K₂
      (WithLp.toLp 2 (S x.fst, T x.snd))).symm
  rw [hdiag]
  exact hsum

end OrthogonalSum

namespace CalkinAlgebra

universe uH uK

variable {H : Type uH} {K : Type uK}
variable [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable [NormedAddCommGroup K] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K] [CompleteSpace K]

/-- Equality of the actual upstairs classes for compact-equivalent representatives. -/
private theorem blockDiagonalClass_respects
    (S : H →L[ℂ] H) (T : K →L[ℂ] K) (S' : H →L[ℂ] H) (T' : K →L[ℂ] K)
    (hS : (compactOperator (RingHom.id ℂ) H H).quotientRel S S')
    (hT : (compactOperator (RingHom.id ℂ) K K).quotientRel T T') :
    ((classStarMap (H := OrthogonalSum H K)).comp
        (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) (K := K))) (S, T) =
      ((classStarMap (H := OrthogonalSum H K)).comp
        (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) (K := K))) (S', T') := by
  let d := (classStarMap (H := OrthogonalSum H K)).comp
    (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) (K := K))
  change d (S, T) = d (S', T')
  have hSc : IsCompactOperator (S - S') :=
    (Submodule.quotientRel_def (compactOperator (RingHom.id ℂ) H H)).1 hS
  have hTc : IsCompactOperator (T - T') :=
    (Submodule.quotientRel_def (compactOperator (RingHom.id ℂ) K K)).1 hT
  have hc := OrthogonalSum.isCompactOperator_blockDiagonal (S - S') (T - T') hSc hTc
  have hz := (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff
    (H := OrthogonalSum H K) (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal (S - S') (T - T'))).2 hc
  change d ((S, T) - (S', T')) = 0 at hz
  rw [map_sub] at hz
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

/-- The actual unital star-algebra map on the two existing Calkin algebras.
Its computational value uses only public quotient and upstairs class-map DATA. -/
def blockDiagonalStarAlgHom :
    (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H × CalkinAlgebra ℂ K) →⋆ₐ[ℂ]
      CalkinAlgebra ℂ (OrthogonalSum H K) := by
  let d := (classStarMap (H := OrthogonalSum H K)).comp
    (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) (K := K))
  let f : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H → CalkinAlgebra ℂ K →
      CalkinAlgebra ℂ (OrthogonalSum H K) :=
    fun x y => Quotient.liftOn₂ x y (fun S T => d (S, T))
      (by exact blockDiagonalClass_respects (H := H) (K := K))
  have hmk : ∀ (S : H →L[ℂ] H) (T : K →L[ℂ] K),
      f (classStarMap (H := H) S) (classStarMap (H := K) T) = d (S, T) := by
    intro S T
    rfl
  exact
    { toFun x := Quotient.liftOn₂ x.1 x.2
        (fun S T => ((classStarMap (H := OrthogonalSum H K)).comp
          (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) (K := K))) (S, T))
        (by exact blockDiagonalClass_respects (H := H) (K := K))
      map_zero' := by
        change f 0 0 = 0
        have hf : f 0 0 = d (0, 0) := by
          simpa only [map_zero] using
            hmk (0 : H →L[ℂ] H) (0 : K →L[ℂ] K)
        exact hf.trans (map_zero d)
      map_one' := by
        change f 1 1 = 1
        have hf : f 1 1 = d (1, 1) := by
          simpa only [map_one] using
            hmk (1 : H →L[ℂ] H) (1 : K →L[ℂ] K)
        exact hf.trans (map_one d)
      map_add' := by
        rintro ⟨x₁, x₂⟩ ⟨y₁, y₂⟩
        obtain ⟨S, rfl⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := H) x₁
        obtain ⟨T, rfl⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := K) x₂
        obtain ⟨U, rfl⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := H) y₁
        obtain ⟨V, rfl⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := K) y₂
        change f
            (classStarMap (H := H) S + classStarMap (H := H) U)
            (classStarMap (H := K) T + classStarMap (H := K) V) =
          f (classStarMap (H := H) S) (classStarMap (H := K) T) +
            f (classStarMap (H := H) U) (classStarMap (H := K) V)
        rw [← map_add (classStarMap (H := H)) S U,
          ← map_add (classStarMap (H := K)) T V,
          hmk, hmk, hmk]
        exact map_add d (S, T) (U, V)
      map_mul' := by
        rintro ⟨x₁, x₂⟩ ⟨y₁, y₂⟩
        obtain ⟨S, rfl⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := H) x₁
        obtain ⟨T, rfl⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := K) x₂
        obtain ⟨U, rfl⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := H) y₁
        obtain ⟨V, rfl⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := K) y₂
        change f
            (classStarMap (H := H) S * classStarMap (H := H) U)
            (classStarMap (H := K) T * classStarMap (H := K) V) =
          f (classStarMap (H := H) S) (classStarMap (H := K) T) *
            f (classStarMap (H := H) U) (classStarMap (H := K) V)
        rw [← map_mul (classStarMap (H := H)) S U,
          ← map_mul (classStarMap (H := K)) T V,
          hmk, hmk, hmk]
        exact map_mul d (S, T) (U, V)
      commutes' c := by
        change f (algebraMap ℂ (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) c)
            (algebraMap ℂ (CalkinAlgebra ℂ K) c) =
          algebraMap ℂ (CalkinAlgebra ℂ (OrthogonalSum H K)) c
        have hH : classStarMap (H := H) (algebraMap ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) c) =
            algebraMap ℂ (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) c :=
          (classStarMap (H := H)).toAlgHom.commutes c
        have hK : classStarMap (H := K) (algebraMap ℂ (K →L[ℂ] K) c) =
            algebraMap ℂ (CalkinAlgebra ℂ K) c :=
          (classStarMap (H := K)).toAlgHom.commutes c
        exact (congrArg₂ f hH.symm hK.symm).trans
          ((hmk (algebraMap ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) c)
            (algebraMap ℂ (K →L[ℂ] K) c)).trans (d.toAlgHom.commutes c))
      map_star' := by
        rintro ⟨x, y⟩
        obtain ⟨S, rfl⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := H) x
        obtain ⟨T, rfl⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := K) y
        change f (star (classStarMap (H := H) S))
            (star (classStarMap (H := K) T)) =
          star (f (classStarMap (H := H) S) (classStarMap (H := K) T))
        rw [← map_star (classStarMap (H := H)) S,
          ← map_star (classStarMap (H := K)) T, hmk, hmk]
        exact map_star d (S, T)
    }

/-- The descended map is represented by the literal operator block diagonal. -/
theorem blockDiagonalStarAlgHom_apply (S : H →L[ℂ] H) (T : K →L[ℂ] K) :
    blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (classStarMap (H := H) S, classStarMap (H := K) T) =
      classStarMap (H := OrthogonalSum H K) (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal S T) :=
  rfl

/-- The canonical simp form acts on the two literal quotient representatives. -/
@[simp]
theorem blockDiagonalStarAlgHom_mk (S : H →L[ℂ] H) (T : K →L[ℂ] K) :
    blockDiagonalStarAlgHom
        ((Submodule.Quotient.mk S : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H),
          (Submodule.Quotient.mk T : CalkinAlgebra ℂ K)) =
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonal S T) :
        CalkinAlgebra ℂ (OrthogonalSum H K)) :=
  rfl

/-- Bundled compatibility with the standard product of the two class maps. -/
theorem blockDiagonalStarAlgHom_comp_classMaps :
    (blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (H := H) (K := K)).comp
        (((classStarMap (H := H)).comp
            (StarAlgHom.fst ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) (K →L[ℂ] K))).prod
          ((classStarMap (H := K)).comp
            (StarAlgHom.snd ℂ (H →L[ℂ] H) (K →L[ℂ] K)))) =
      (classStarMap (H := OrthogonalSum H K)).comp
        (OrthogonalSum.blockDiagonalStarAlgHom (𝕜 := ℂ) (H := H) (K := K)) := by
  ext p
  exact blockDiagonalStarAlgHom_apply p.1 p.2

end CalkinAlgebra
