module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Operator.Calkin
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Pullback
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.Basic
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Extension.Busby
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Operator.CompactOuterMultiplier
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.NonUnitalSubalgebra
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.StarAlgHom

/-!
# Actual Calkin pullbacks with operator-first coordinates

The coefficient is the actual closed star ideal of compact operators on H.
A nonunital star map A -> Q(H) has its literal closed pullback inside
End(H) x A, with compatibility pi(T)=phi(a). The compact inclusion and
quotient coordinate are strict maps. The existing compact multiplier
equivalences identify these literal coordinates with the canonical Busby
pullback; injectivity, surjectivity and exactness are transported from that API.
All H, including finite and zero Hilbert spaces, are allowed; neither phi nor
A is assumed unital, injective or separable. This strict coordinate
constructor serves the original concrete extension statements.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace CalkinAlgebra

universe uA uH

variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The original compact-operator coefficient has the literal closed-ideal subtype carrier. -/
abbrev CompactCoefficients (H : Type uH)
    [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] :=
  (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier

/-- The actual compact coefficient reuses the strict existing closed-ideal C-star dictionary. -/
instance compactCoefficientsCStarAlgebra : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra (CompactCoefficients H) :=
  (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrierCStarAlgebra

variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The actual source pullback retains operator-first coordinates with its inherited product C-star norm. -/
abbrev operatorPullback (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :=
  NonUnitalCStarPullback.Pullback (classStarMap (H := H)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom φ

/-- Literal compact inclusion into the compatible original operator/coefficient pairs. -/
def operatorPullbackInclusion (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :
    CompactCoefficients H →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] operatorPullback φ := by
  let j : CompactCoefficients H →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
    NonUnitalStarSubalgebraClass.subtype (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H)).carrier
  exact NonUnitalStarAlgHom.codRestrict
    (j.prod (0 : CompactCoefficients H →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A)) (operatorPullback φ) (fun k => by
      change classStarMap (H := H) (k : H →L[ℂ] H) = φ 0
      rw [map_zero]
      apply (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff _).mpr
      exact k.property)

/-- The original coefficient quotient is the actual second coordinate of the compatible pair. -/
def operatorPullbackQuotient (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :
    operatorPullback φ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A :=
  NonUnitalCStarPullback.sndHom (classStarMap (H := H)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom φ

/-- The original operator representation is the actual first coordinate of the compatible pair. -/
def operatorPullbackRepresentation (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :
    operatorPullback φ →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (H →L[ℂ] H) :=
  NonUnitalCStarPullback.fstHom (classStarMap (H := H)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom φ

/-- The compact coefficient has its literal operator-first pair value. -/
theorem operatorPullbackInclusion_coe (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)
    (k : CompactCoefficients H) :
    (operatorPullbackInclusion φ k : (H →L[ℂ] H) × A) = ((k : H →L[ℂ] H), 0) := rfl

/-- Every compatible pair retains its literal coefficient quotient value. -/
theorem operatorPullbackQuotient_apply (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)
    (p : operatorPullback φ) : operatorPullbackQuotient φ p = p.1.2 := rfl

/-- Every compatible pair retains its literal original operator value. -/
theorem operatorPullbackRepresentation_apply (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)
    (p : operatorPullback φ) : operatorPullbackRepresentation φ p = p.1.1 := rfl

/-- Transport the original Calkin map through the existing compact outer-multiplier equivalence. -/
def operatorBusbyMap (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :
    CStarExtension.BusbyMap (A := A) (B := CompactCoefficients H) := by
  letI : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier (CompactCoefficients H)) :=
    outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra (CompactCoefficients H)
  exact (DoubleCentralizer.compactOuterMultiplierEquiv (H := H)).symm.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp φ

/-- The original operator-first pairs are the existing Busby pullback in compact-multiplier coordinates. -/
def operatorPullbackBusbyEquiv (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :
    operatorPullback φ ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] CStarExtension.BusbyPullback (operatorBusbyMap φ) := by
  letI : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier (CompactCoefficients H)) :=
    outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra (CompactCoefficients H)
  let m := DoubleCentralizer.compactMultiplierEquiv (H := H)
  let o := DoubleCentralizer.compactOuterMultiplierEquiv (H := H)
  let π := (outerQuotientMap (A := CompactCoefficients H)).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom
  have h : (operatorBusbyMap φ).comp (operatorPullbackQuotient φ) =
      π.comp (m.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp (operatorPullbackRepresentation φ)) := by
    apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
    intro p
    change o.symm (φ p.1.2) = outerQuotientMap (m p.1.1)
    calc
      o.symm (φ p.1.2) = o.symm (classStarMap (H := H) p.1.1) :=
        congrArg o.symm p.property.symm
      _ = outerQuotientMap (m p.1.1) :=
        DoubleCentralizer.compactOuterMultiplierEquiv_symm_classStarMap (H := H) p.1.1
  let f := NonUnitalCStarPullback.lift (operatorBusbyMap φ) π
    (operatorPullbackQuotient φ) (m.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp (operatorPullbackRepresentation φ)) h
  refine StarAlgEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p q hpq
    have ha : p.1.2 = q.1.2 :=
      congrArg (fun x : CStarExtension.BusbyPullback (operatorBusbyMap φ) => x.1.1) hpq
    have hm : m p.1.1 = m q.1.1 :=
      congrArg (fun x : CStarExtension.BusbyPullback (operatorBusbyMap φ) => x.1.2) hpq
    exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (m.injective hm) ha)
  · intro p
    have hClass : classStarMap (H := H) (m.symm p.1.2) = φ p.1.1 := by
      have hp := p.property
      change o.symm (φ p.1.1) = outerQuotientMap p.1.2 at hp
      calc
        classStarMap (H := H) (m.symm p.1.2) = o (outerQuotientMap p.1.2) :=
          (DoubleCentralizer.compactOuterMultiplierEquiv_outerQuotientMap (H := H) p.1.2).symm
        _ = o (o.symm (φ p.1.1)) := congrArg o hp.symm
        _ = φ p.1.1 := o.apply_symm_apply _
    refine ⟨⟨(m.symm p.1.2, p.1.1), hClass⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext rfl (m.apply_symm_apply p.1.2)

/-- The coordinate equivalence retains the actual quotient and bounded-operator multiplier values. -/
theorem operatorPullbackBusbyEquiv_coe (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) (p : operatorPullback φ) :
    (operatorPullbackBusbyEquiv φ p : A × DoubleCentralizer ℂ (CompactCoefficients H)) =
      (p.1.2, DoubleCentralizer.compactMultiplierEquiv (H := H) p.1.1) := rfl

/-- Transport identifies the literal compact endpoint with the canonical Busby inclusion. -/
theorem operatorPullbackBusbyEquiv_inclusion (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)
    (k : CompactCoefficients H) :
    operatorPullbackBusbyEquiv φ (operatorPullbackInclusion φ k) =
      CStarExtension.pullbackInclusion (operatorBusbyMap φ) k := by
  letI : CStarAlgebra (OuterMultiplier (CompactCoefficients H)) :=
    outerMultiplierCStarAlgebra (CompactCoefficients H)
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · change DoubleCentralizer.compactMultiplierEquiv (H := H) (k : H →L[ℂ] H) =
      DoubleCentralizer.coeHom (𝕜 := ℂ) k
    rw [DoubleCentralizer.compactMultiplierEquiv_apply]
    change DoubleCentralizer.multiplierExtension (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := H))
      (StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ (CompactCoefficients H)) (k : H →L[ℂ] H) =
        DoubleCentralizer.coeHom (𝕜 := ℂ) k
    exact DoubleCentralizer.multiplierExtension_idealEquiv _ _ k

/-- Transport fixes the original quotient algebra and its literal second-coordinate map. -/
theorem operatorPullbackBusbyEquiv_quotient (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) (p : operatorPullback φ) :
    CStarExtension.pullbackQuotient (operatorBusbyMap φ) (operatorPullbackBusbyEquiv φ p) =
      operatorPullbackQuotient φ p := rfl

/-- The original compact inclusion inherits injectivity from the canonical Busby inclusion. -/
theorem operatorPullbackInclusion_injective (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :
    Function.Injective (operatorPullbackInclusion φ) := by
  intro k l h
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg (fun p : operatorPullback φ => p.1.1) h

/-- The actual coefficient projection inherits surjectivity from the canonical Busby quotient. -/
theorem operatorPullbackQuotient_surjective (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :
    Function.Surjective (operatorPullbackQuotient φ) := by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := H) (φ a)
  exact ⟨⟨(T, a), hT⟩, rfl⟩

/-- The original exact pair is transported from the existing canonical Busby exact pair. -/
theorem operatorPullback_exact (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :
    Function.Exact (operatorPullbackInclusion φ) (operatorPullbackQuotient φ) := by
  intro p
  change p.1.2 = 0 ↔ ∃ k, operatorPullbackInclusion φ k = p
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have hClass : classStarMap (H := H) p.1.1 = 0 := by
      calc
        classStarMap (H := H) p.1.1 = φ p.1.2 := p.property
        _ = φ 0 := congrArg φ hp
        _ = 0 := map_zero φ
    let k : CompactCoefficients H :=
      ⟨p.1.1, (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff p.1.1).mp hClass⟩
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext rfl hp.symm
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rfl

/-- The original operator and coefficient projections have the same literal Calkin class. -/
theorem operatorPullback_compatibility (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)
    (p : operatorPullback φ) :
    classStarMap (H := H) (operatorPullbackRepresentation φ p) = φ (operatorPullbackQuotient φ p) :=
  p.property

/-- The original operator-first pullback constructs the existing normalized concrete extension. -/
def operatorExtension (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :
    CStarExtension A (CompactCoefficients H) :=
  CStarExtension.ofExact (operatorPullbackInclusion φ) (operatorPullbackQuotient φ)
    (operatorPullbackInclusion_injective φ) (operatorPullbackQuotient_surjective φ)
    (operatorPullback_exact φ)

/-- The normalized extension retains the same original compact inclusion. -/
theorem operatorExtension_inclusion_apply (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)
    (k : CompactCoefficients H) : (operatorExtension φ).inclusion k = operatorPullbackInclusion φ k :=
  CStarExtension.ofExact_inclusion_apply _ _ _ _ _ k

/-- The normalized extension retains the same original coefficient quotient. -/
theorem operatorExtension_quotient_apply (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)
    (p : operatorPullback φ) : (operatorExtension φ).quotient p = operatorPullbackQuotient φ p :=
  CStarExtension.ofExact_quotient_apply _ _ _ _ _ p

/-- The operator-coordinate normalization is the existing Busby extension with both endpoints fixed. -/
def operatorExtensionBusbyEquiv (φ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :
    CStarExtension.Equiv (operatorExtension φ) (CStarExtension.ofBusby (operatorBusbyMap φ)) where
  idealEquiv := StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ (CompactCoefficients H)
  middleEquiv := operatorPullbackBusbyEquiv φ
  quotientEquiv := StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ A
  inclusion_commutes := by
    apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
    intro k
    change operatorPullbackBusbyEquiv φ ((operatorExtension φ).inclusion k) =
      (CStarExtension.ofBusby (operatorBusbyMap φ)).inclusion k
    exact (congrArg (operatorPullbackBusbyEquiv φ)
      (operatorExtension_inclusion_apply φ k)).trans
        ((operatorPullbackBusbyEquiv_inclusion φ k).trans
          (CStarExtension.ofBusby_inclusion (operatorBusbyMap φ) k).symm)
  quotient_commutes := by
    apply NonUnitalStarAlgHom.ext
    intro p
    change (CStarExtension.ofBusby (operatorBusbyMap φ)).quotient (operatorPullbackBusbyEquiv φ p) =
      (operatorExtension φ).quotient p
    exact (CStarExtension.ofBusby_quotient (operatorBusbyMap φ)
      (operatorPullbackBusbyEquiv φ p)).trans
        ((operatorPullbackBusbyEquiv_quotient φ p).trans
          (operatorExtension_quotient_apply φ p).symm)

end CalkinAlgebra

end

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Compact.EssentialSpectrum
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Operator.FredholmCalkin

/-!
# Essentially normal Hilbert operators

Essential normality is normality of the actual Calkin class. Its compact
commutator characterization and invariance under compact perturbations use
the existing star class map. The Banach-space essential spectrum is reused
without changing its carrier or scalar action.

Atkinson's theorem identifies the complement of that spectrum with Fredholm
scalar resolvents. Hilbert spaces may be finite-dimensional or zero; neither
an infinite-dimensional assumption nor a global nontriviality instance is added.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousLinearMap

universe u

variable {H : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  [CompleteSpace H]

/-- An operator is essentially normal when its class modulo compact operators
is star-normal. -/
def IsEssentiallyNormal (T : H →L[ℂ] H) : Prop :=
  IsStarNormal (CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) T)

/-- Essential normality is equivalent to compactness of the adjoint commutator. -/
theorem isEssentiallyNormal_iff_isCompactOperator_commutator (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    T.IsEssentiallyNormal ↔ IsCompactOperator (star T * T - T * star T) := by
  rw [IsEssentiallyNormal, isStarNormal_iff, commute_iff_eq,
    ← CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, map_star, sub_eq_zero]

/-- The generic Banach-space definition uses the same class as the Hilbert
star-algebra projection. -/
theorem essentialSpectrum_eq_spectrum_classStarMap (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    T.essentialSpectrum = spectrum ℂ (CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) T) :=
  rfl

/-- Compact perturbations preserve and reflect essential normality. -/
theorem isEssentiallyNormal_add_compact_iff (T K : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) :
    (T + K).IsEssentiallyNormal ↔ T.IsEssentiallyNormal := by
  simp only [IsEssentiallyNormal, map_add,
    (CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap_eq_zero_iff K).mpr hK, add_zero]

/-- Subtracting a compact operator preserves and reflects essential normality. -/
theorem isEssentiallyNormal_sub_compact_iff (T K : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) :
    (T - K).IsEssentiallyNormal ↔ T.IsEssentiallyNormal := by
  simp only [IsEssentiallyNormal, map_sub,
    (CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap_eq_zero_iff K).mpr hK, sub_zero]

/-- Atkinson's theorem for the exact essential-spectrum resolvent. -/
theorem notMem_essentialSpectrum_iff_isFredholm (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (z : ℂ) :
    z ∉ T.essentialSpectrum ↔ (T - z • 1).IsFredholm := by
  rw [notMem_essentialSpectrum_iff_isUnit]
  exact CalkinAlgebra.isUnit_classStarMap_iff_isFredholm (T - z • 1)

/-- An off-essential-spectrum scalar resolvent is Fredholm. -/
theorem isFredholm_of_notMem_essentialSpectrum (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (z : ℂ)
    (hz : z ∉ T.essentialSpectrum) : (T - z • 1).IsFredholm :=
  (T.notMem_essentialSpectrum_iff_isFredholm z).mp hz

end ContinuousLinearMap

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Operator.Calkin
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Fredholm.Basic

import MathlibExt.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.CompactOperator
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Fredholm.Open
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Normed
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.IntermediateValue

/-!
# Fredholm operators and the Calkin algebra

This file develops the bridges relating Fredholm operators on a complex
Hilbert space to invertible classes in the Calkin algebra. Equality of Calkin
classes is identified with compactness of the corresponding operator
difference, and Atkinson's theorem identifies Fredholm operators exactly with
operators having invertible Calkin class. The resulting Fredholm index depends
only on the Calkin unit and defines a homomorphism to the additive integers.
-/

@[expose] public section

noncomputable section

open scoped LinearMap.FiniteRangeSetoid

namespace CalkinAlgebra

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Two operators have the same Calkin class exactly when their difference is
compact. The difference orientation is fixed as `T - U`. -/
@[simp]
theorem classStarMap_eq_iff (T U : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    classStarMap (H := H) T = classStarMap (H := H) U ↔
      IsCompactOperator (T - U) := by
  rw [← classStarMap_eq_zero_iff, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]

private theorem isUnit_classStarMap_of_isFredholm {T : H →L[ℂ] H}
    (hT : T.IsFredholm) : IsUnit (classStarMap (H := H) T) := by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hT.exists_isQuasiInverse
  have hSTfinite : (S * T - 1).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
    change (S.toLinearMap ∘ₗ T.toLinearMap - LinearMap.id).HasFiniteRange
    exact LinearMap.FiniteRangeSetoid.equiv_iff_hasFiniteRange.mp hS.1
  have hTSfinite : (T * S - 1).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
    change (T.toLinearMap ∘ₗ S.toLinearMap - LinearMap.id).HasFiniteRange
    exact LinearMap.FiniteRangeSetoid.equiv_iff_hasFiniteRange.mp hS.2
  have hSTcompact : IsCompactOperator ⇑(S * T - 1 : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
    hSTfinite.isCompactOperator
  have hTScompact : IsCompactOperator ⇑(T * S - 1 : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
    hTSfinite.isCompactOperator
  have hST :
      classStarMap (H := H) S * classStarMap (H := H) T = 1 := by
    have hz := (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff (H := H) (S * T - 1)).2 hSTcompact
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_one, sub_eq_zero] at hz
    exact hz
  have hTS :
      classStarMap (H := H) T * classStarMap (H := H) S = 1 := by
    have hz := (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff (H := H) (T * S - 1)).2 hTScompact
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_one, sub_eq_zero] at hz
    exact hz
  exact isUnit_iff_exists.mpr ⟨classStarMap (H := H) S, hTS, hST⟩

private theorem isFredholm_of_isUnit_classStarMap {T : H →L[ℂ] H}
    (hunit : IsUnit (classStarMap (H := H) T)) : T.IsFredholm := by
  obtain ⟨b, hTb, hbT⟩ := isUnit_iff_exists.mp hunit
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := classStarMap_surjective (H := H) b
  let K_L : H →L[ℂ] H := S * T - 1
  let K_R : H →L[ℂ] H := T * S - 1
  have hKL : IsCompactOperator K_L :=
    (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff (H := H) K_L).mp (by
      change classStarMap (H := H) (S * T - 1) = 0
      rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_one, hS, hbT, sub_self])
  have hKR : IsCompactOperator K_R :=
    (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff (H := H) K_R).mp (by
      change classStarMap (H := H) (T * S - 1) = 0
      rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_one, hS, hTb, sub_self])
  obtain ⟨U_L, hUL, hLapprox⟩ :=
    hKL.exists_projectionFactor_hasFiniteRange_adjoint_norm_sub_lt
      (ε := 1) zero_lt_one
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℂ U_L := hUL
  obtain ⟨F_L, _hFLfactor, hFLfinite, _hFLadj, hFLnorm⟩ := hLapprox
  let E_L : H →L[ℂ] H := K_L - F_L
  have hEL : ‖E_L‖ < 1 := by
    simpa [E_L] using hFLnorm
  let u_L : (H →L[ℂ] H)ˣ := Units.oneSub (-E_L) (by simpa using hEL)
  let L : H →L[ℂ] H := (↑(u_L⁻¹) : H →L[ℂ] H) * S
  have huLval : (u_L : H →L[ℂ] H) = 1 + E_L := by
    simp [u_L]
  have hST : S * T = (u_L : H →L[ℂ] H) + F_L := by
    rw [huLval]
    dsimp [E_L, K_L]
    noncomm_ring
  have hLdefect :
      L * T - 1 = (↑(u_L⁻¹) : H →L[ℂ] H) * F_L := by
    have huLinv :
        (↑(u_L⁻¹) : H →L[ℂ] H) * (u_L : H →L[ℂ] H) = 1 :=
      Units.inv_mul u_L
    dsimp [L]
    rw [mul_assoc, hST, mul_add, huLinv]
    noncomm_ring
  have hLfinite : (L * T - 1).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
    rw [hLdefect]
    change (((↑(u_L⁻¹) : H →L[ℂ] H).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      F_L.toLinearMap).HasFiniteRange)
    exact hFLfinite.comp_left _
  obtain ⟨U_R, hUR, hRapprox⟩ :=
    hKR.exists_projectionFactor_hasFiniteRange_adjoint_norm_sub_lt
      (ε := 1) zero_lt_one
  let _ : FiniteDimensional ℂ U_R := hUR
  obtain ⟨F_R, _hFRfactor, hFRfinite, _hFRadj, hFRnorm⟩ := hRapprox
  let E_R : H →L[ℂ] H := K_R - F_R
  have hER : ‖E_R‖ < 1 := by
    simpa [E_R] using hFRnorm
  let u_R : (H →L[ℂ] H)ˣ := Units.oneSub (-E_R) (by simpa using hER)
  let R : H →L[ℂ] H := S * (↑(u_R⁻¹) : H →L[ℂ] H)
  have huRval : (u_R : H →L[ℂ] H) = 1 + E_R := by
    simp [u_R]
  have hTS : T * S = (u_R : H →L[ℂ] H) + F_R := by
    rw [huRval]
    dsimp [E_R, K_R]
    noncomm_ring
  have hRdefect :
      T * R - 1 = F_R * (↑(u_R⁻¹) : H →L[ℂ] H) := by
    have huRinv :
        (u_R : H →L[ℂ] H) * (↑(u_R⁻¹) : H →L[ℂ] H) = 1 :=
      Units.mul_inv u_R
    dsimp [R]
    rw [← mul_assoc, hTS, add_mul, huRinv]
    noncomm_ring
  have hRfinite : (T * R - 1).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
    rw [hRdefect]
    change ((F_R.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      (↑(u_R⁻¹) : H →L[ℂ] H).toLinearMap).HasFiniteRange)
    exact hFRfinite.comp_right _
  have hLleft : L.toLinearMap.IsLeftQuasiInverse T.toLinearMap := by
    rw [LinearMap.IsLeftQuasiInverse,
      LinearMap.FiniteRangeSetoid.equiv_iff_hasFiniteRange]
    change (L * T - 1).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange
    exact hLfinite
  have hRright : R.toLinearMap.IsRightQuasiInverse T.toLinearMap := by
    rw [LinearMap.IsRightQuasiInverse,
      LinearMap.FiniteRangeSetoid.equiv_iff_hasFiniteRange]
    change (T * R - 1).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange
    exact hRfinite
  have hOneTRfinite : (1 - T * R).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
    have heq : 1 - T * R = -(T * R - 1) := by
      noncomm_ring
    rw [heq]
    simpa using hRfinite.neg
  have hTerm1 : (L * (1 - T * R)).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
    change (L.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (1 - T * R).toLinearMap).HasFiniteRange
    exact hOneTRfinite.comp_left L.toLinearMap
  have hTerm2 : ((L * T - 1) * R).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
    change ((L * T - 1).toLinearMap ∘ₗ R.toLinearMap).HasFiniteRange
    exact hLfinite.comp_right R.toLinearMap
  have hLRfinite : (L - R).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange := by
    have hid : L - R = L * (1 - T * R) + (L * T - 1) * R := by
      noncomm_ring
    rw [hid]
    simpa using hTerm1.add hTerm2
  have hLR : L.toLinearMap ≈ R.toLinearMap := by
    rw [LinearMap.FiniteRangeSetoid.equiv_iff_hasFiniteRange]
    change (L - R).toLinearMap.HasFiniteRange
    exact hLRfinite
  have hLright : L.toLinearMap.IsRightQuasiInverse T.toLinearMap :=
    hRright.congr hLR (Setoid.refl _)
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm.of_isQuasiInverse ⟨hLleft, hLright⟩

/-- Atkinson's theorem: an operator on a complex Hilbert space is Fredholm
exactly when its Calkin class is invertible. -/
theorem isUnit_classStarMap_iff_isFredholm (T : H →L[ℂ] H) :
    IsUnit (classStarMap (H := H) T) ↔ T.IsFredholm :=
  ⟨isFredholm_of_isUnit_classStarMap,
    isUnit_classStarMap_of_isFredholm⟩

end CalkinAlgebra

namespace ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  [CompleteSpace H]

/-- Fredholmness depends only on the Calkin class. -/
theorem of_classStarMap_eq {T U : H →L[ℂ] H} (hT : T.IsFredholm)
    (h : CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) T =
      CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) U) : U.IsFredholm := by
  apply (CalkinAlgebra.isUnit_classStarMap_iff_isFredholm U).mp
  rw [← h]
  exact (CalkinAlgebra.isUnit_classStarMap_iff_isFredholm T).mpr hT

/-- Equal Calkin classes of Fredholm operators have equal index. -/
theorem index_eq_of_classStarMap_eq {T U : H →L[ℂ] H} (hT : T.IsFredholm)
    (h : CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) T =
      CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) U) : T.index = U.index := by
  let P : ℝ → (H →L[ℂ] H) := fun t => T + (t : ℂ) • (U - T)
  have hUT : CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) (U - T) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, h, sub_self]
  have hPclass (t : ℝ) :
      CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) T =
        CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) (P t) := by
    change CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) T =
      CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap (H := H) (T + (t : ℂ) • (U - T))
    rw [map_add, map_smul, hUT, smul_zero, add_zero]
  have hP (t : ℝ) : (P t).IsFredholm :=
    hT.of_classStarMap_eq (hPclass t)
  have hPcontinuous : Continuous P := by
    dsimp [P]
    exact (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => T)).add
      (Complex.continuous_ofReal.smul
        (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => U - T)))
  have hindex : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => (P t).index) := by
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro t
    exact (hP t).index_continuousAt.comp hPcontinuous.continuousAt
  have h01 : (P (0 : ℝ)).index = (P (1 : ℝ)).index :=
    (inferInstance : PreconnectedSpace ℝ).constant hindex
  simpa [P] using h01

/-- Compact perturbations preserve Fredholmness. -/
theorem add_compact {T K : H →L[ℂ] H} (hT : T.IsFredholm)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) : (T + K).IsFredholm := by
  apply hT.of_classStarMap_eq
  rw [map_add,
    (CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap_eq_zero_iff (H := H) K).2 hK, add_zero]

/-- Compact perturbations preserve the Fredholm index. -/
theorem index_add_compact {T K : H →L[ℂ] H} (hT : T.IsFredholm)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) : (T + K).index = T.index := by
  symm
  apply hT.index_eq_of_classStarMap_eq
  rw [map_add,
    (CalkinAlgebra.classStarMap_eq_zero_iff (H := H) K).2 hK, add_zero]

/-- Subtracting a compact operator preserves Fredholmness. -/
theorem sub_compact {T K : H →L[ℂ] H} (hT : T.IsFredholm)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) : (T - K).IsFredholm := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact hT.add_compact (by simpa using hK.neg)

/-- Subtracting a compact operator preserves the Fredholm index. -/
theorem index_sub_compact {T K : H →L[ℂ] H} (hT : T.IsFredholm)
    (hK : IsCompactOperator K) : (T - K).index = T.index := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact hT.index_add_compact (by simpa using hK.neg)

end ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm

namespace CalkinAlgebra.Unit

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  [CompleteSpace H]

/-- The Fredholm index of a unit in the Calkin algebra. -/
noncomputable def index (x : (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)ˣ) : ℤ :=
  (Classical.choose
    (classStarMap_surjective (H := H) (x : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H))).index

/-- The Calkin-unit index is computed by every operator lift. -/
theorem index_eq_lift (x : (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)ˣ) (T : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hT : classStarMap (H := H) T = (x : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)) :
    index x = T.index := by
  let S : H →L[ℂ] H := Classical.choose
    (classStarMap_surjective (H := H) (x : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H))
  have hS : classStarMap (H := H) S = (x : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :=
    Classical.choose_spec
      (classStarMap_surjective (H := H) (x : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H))
  have hSFred : S.IsFredholm := by
    apply (isUnit_classStarMap_iff_isFredholm S).mp
    rw [hS]
    exact x.isUnit
  change S.index = T.index
  exact hSFred.index_eq_of_classStarMap_eq (hS.trans hT.symm)

/-- The identity Calkin unit has index zero. -/
@[simp]
theorem index_one : index (1 : (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)ˣ) = 0 := by
  calc
    index (1 : (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)ˣ) = (1 : H →L[ℂ] H).index :=
      index_eq_lift _ _ (classStarMap (H := H)).map_one
    _ = 0 := by
      change (LinearMap.id : H →ₗ[ℂ] H).index = 0
      exact LinearMap.index_id

/-- The index of a product of Calkin units is the sum of their indices. -/
@[simp]
theorem index_mul (x y : (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)ˣ) :
    index (x * y) = index x + index y := by
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ :=
    classStarMap_surjective (H := H) (x : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ :=
    classStarMap_surjective (H := H) (y : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)
  have hTFred : T.IsFredholm := by
    apply (isUnit_classStarMap_iff_isFredholm T).mp
    rw [hT]
    exact x.isUnit
  have hUFred : U.IsFredholm := by
    apply (isUnit_classStarMap_iff_isFredholm U).mp
    rw [hU]
    exact y.isUnit
  have hTU : classStarMap (H := H) (T * U) =
      ((x * y : (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)ˣ) : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := by
    calc
      classStarMap (H := H) (T * U) =
          classStarMap (H := H) T * classStarMap (H := H) U :=
        (classStarMap (H := H)).map_mul T U
      _ = (x : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) * (y : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) :=
        congrArg₂ (· * ·) hT hU
      _ = ((x * y : (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)ˣ) : CalkinAlgebra ℂ H) := rfl
  calc
    index (x * y) = (T * U).index := index_eq_lift _ _ hTU
    _ = T.index + U.index := by
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def] using
        hTFred.index_comp hUFred
    _ = index x + index y := congrArg₂ (· + ·)
      (index_eq_lift x T hT).symm (index_eq_lift y U hU).symm

/-- Inversion negates the Calkin-unit index. -/
@[simp]
theorem index_inv (x : (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)ˣ) :
    index x⁻¹ = -index x := by
  have h := index_mul x x⁻¹
  rw [mul_inv_cancel, index_one] at h
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h.symm

/-- The Calkin-unit index as a multiplicative-to-additive homomorphism. -/
noncomputable def indexHom :
    (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)ˣ →* Multiplicative ℤ where
  toFun x := Multiplicative.ofAdd (index x)
  map_one' := by
    change Multiplicative.ofAdd (index (1 : (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)ˣ)) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd 0
    rw [index_one]
  map_mul' x y := by
    change Multiplicative.ofAdd (index (x * y)) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd (index x + index y)
    rw [index_mul]

/-- Evaluation of the Calkin-unit index homomorphism. -/
@[simp]
theorem indexHom_apply (x : (CalkinAlgebra ℂ H)ˣ) :
    (indexHom (H := H) x).toAdd = index x :=
  rfl

end CalkinAlgebra.Unit

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.HilbertDirectSum
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Operator.Calkin
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Hom
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.Basic
public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Star
public import Mathlib.Topology.Sequences
public import Mathlib.Topology.MetricSpace.Cauchy
public import Mathlib.Topology.DenseEmbedding
public import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Pairing
public import Mathlib.Data.ULift

/-!
# Faithful split Calkin representation by repeated dense evaluations

The actual scalar Hilbert sum is indexed by `ULift ℕ`, retaining its stock
lp-two norm, inner product and completeness at any requested Hilbert universe.
The canonical Hilbert basis has a countable dense span and infinitely many
linearly independent vectors, giving the required separability and infinite
dimension internally.

Each point of the canonical dense sequence of the coefficient space is
repeated at all paired indices. A nonzero coefficient at such a point gives
uniformly separated images of infinitely many original unit vectors. The
stock compact-image subsequence theorem therefore proves faithfulness
modulo the actual compact ideal. The operator representation is the existing
`StarAlgHom.hilbertDirectSum`, with its original coordinate action.

This strict split representation supplies the full target summand needed by
the original Ext(X) pushforward for a continuous map whose image can be a
proper subset of its target. No faithful representation, output extension,
normal-operator existence theorem or naturality witness is assumed.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section

open Set Filter TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

namespace CalkinAlgebra.RepeatedEvaluation

universe uH uY

/-- The countable coordinate index is lifted only to preserve the requested carrier universe. -/
private abbrev Index := ULift.{uH, 0} ℕ

/-- The original scalar Hilbert sum keeps the standard lp-two norm and inner product. -/
abbrev ScalarHilbert : Type uH := lp (fun _ : ULift.{uH, 0} ℕ => ℂ) 2

private def scalarHilbertBasis : HilbertBasis Index.{uH} ℂ ScalarHilbert.{uH} :=
  HilbertBasis.ofRepr (LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℂ _)

/-- Countably many original basis vectors have dense span, so the actual scalar sum is separable. -/
instance scalarHilbertSeparable : SeparableSpace ScalarHilbert.{uH} := by
  apply isSeparable_univ_iff.mp
  have hs : IsSeparable
      (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range scalarHilbertBasis) : Set ScalarHilbert.{uH}) :=
    (Set.countable_range scalarHilbertBasis).isSeparable.span
  have hc := hs.closure
  change IsSeparable
    ((Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range scalarHilbertBasis)).topologicalClosure :
      Set ScalarHilbert.{uH}) at hc
  simpa only [HilbertBasis.dense_span, Submodule.top_coe] using hc

/-- The actual infinite coordinate family rules out finite dimension of the original scalar sum. -/
theorem scalarHilbert_infinite : ¬ FiniteDimensional ℂ ScalarHilbert.{uH} := by
  intro h
  let : FiniteDimensional ℂ ScalarHilbert.{uH} := h
  exact Module.Finite.not_linearIndependent_of_infinite (R := ℂ)
    (scalarHilbertBasis : Index.{uH} → ScalarHilbert.{uH})
    scalarHilbertBasis.orthonormal.linearIndependent

variable {Y : Type uY} [TopologicalSpace Y]

/-- Point evaluation followed by the actual canonical scalar operator action. -/
private def pointRepresentation (y : Y) : C(Y, ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) :=
  (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ (ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ)).comp
    (ContinuousMap.evalStarAlgHom ℂ ℂ y)

@[simp]
private theorem pointRepresentation_apply (y : Y) (a : C(Y, ℂ)) (z : ℂ) :
    pointRepresentation y a z = a y * z := by
  change algebraMap ℂ (ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) (a y) z = a y * z
  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  simp

variable [Nonempty Y] [SeparableSpace Y]

/-- Every canonical dense point appears at infinitely many genuine scalar coordinates. -/
private def repeatedPoint (n : Index.{uH}) : Y :=
  denseSeq Y (Nat.unpair n.down).1

variable [CompactSpace Y]

/-- The actual repeated-evaluation operator representation is the existing canonical Hilbert sum. -/
def representation : C(Y, ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (ScalarHilbert.{uH} →L[ℂ] ScalarHilbert.{uH}) :=
  StarAlgHom.hilbertDirectSum
    (fun n : ULift.{uH, 0} ℕ =>
      (StarAlgHom.ofId ℂ (ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ)).comp
        (ContinuousMap.evalStarAlgHom ℂ ℂ (denseSeq Y (Nat.unpair n.down).1)))

@[simp]
theorem representation_apply (a : C(Y, ℂ)) (x : ScalarHilbert.{uH}) (n : ULift.{uH, 0} ℕ) :
    representation a x n = a (denseSeq Y (Nat.unpair n.down).1) * x n := by
  change pointRepresentation (repeatedPoint (Y := Y) n) a (x n) = _
  exact pointRepresentation_apply _ _ _

private def unitVector (n : Index.{uH}) : ScalarHilbert.{uH} := lp.single 2 n (1 : ℂ)

private theorem norm_unitVector (n : Index.{uH}) : ‖unitVector n‖ = 1 := by
  simpa only [unitVector, norm_one] using
    lp.norm_single (E := fun _ : Index.{uH} => ℂ) (p := (2 : ENNReal))
      (by norm_num) n (1 : ℂ)

private theorem unitVector_mem_closedBall (n : Index.{uH}) :
    unitVector n ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ScalarHilbert.{uH}) 1 := by
  simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_unitVector] using
    (le_refl (1 : ℝ))

/-- Compactness forces each repeated coefficient to vanish in the original lp-two norm. -/
private theorem evaluation_eq_zero_of_isCompactOperator (a : C(Y, ℂ))
    (hCompact : IsCompactOperator
      (representation a : ScalarHilbert.{uH} →L[ℂ] ScalarHilbert.{uH})) (k : ℕ) :
    a (denseSeq Y k) = 0 := by
  by_contra ha
  let v : ℕ → ScalarHilbert.{uH} := fun n =>
    representation a (unitVector (ULift.up (Nat.pair k n)))
  have hsep {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≠ n) :
      ‖a (denseSeq Y k)‖ ≤ dist (v m) (v n) := by
    have hp : (ULift.up (Nat.pair k m) : Index.{uH}) ≠ ULift.up (Nat.pair k n) := by
      intro h
      have hs := congrArg (fun r : Index.{uH} => (Nat.unpair r.down).2) h
      exact hmn (by simpa only [Nat.unpair_pair] using hs)
    have hself : unitVector (ULift.up (Nat.pair k m)) (ULift.up (Nat.pair k m)) = (1 : ℂ) :=
      lp.single_apply_self 2 _ _
    have hother : unitVector (ULift.up (Nat.pair k n)) (ULift.up (Nat.pair k m)) = (0 : ℂ) :=
      lp.single_apply_ne 2 _ _ hp
    have hvm : v m (ULift.up (Nat.pair k m)) = a (denseSeq Y k) := by
      change representation a (unitVector (ULift.up (Nat.pair k m)))
        (ULift.up (Nat.pair k m)) = a (denseSeq Y k)
      rw [representation_apply, hself]
      simp only [Nat.unpair_pair, mul_one]
    have hvn : v n (ULift.up (Nat.pair k m)) = 0 := by
      change representation a (unitVector (ULift.up (Nat.pair k n)))
        (ULift.up (Nat.pair k m)) = 0
      rw [representation_apply, hother, mul_zero]
    have hcoord : (v m - v n) (ULift.up (Nat.pair k m)) = a (denseSeq Y k) := by
      change v m (ULift.up (Nat.pair k m)) - v n (ULift.up (Nat.pair k m)) = _
      rw [hvm, hvn, sub_zero]
    calc
      ‖a (denseSeq Y k)‖ = ‖(v m - v n) (ULift.up (Nat.pair k m))‖ := by rw [hcoord]
      _ ≤ ‖v m - v n‖ := lp.norm_apply_le_norm (by norm_num) _ _
      _ = dist (v m) (v n) := (dist_eq_norm _ _).symm
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hImage⟩ := IsCompactOperator.image_closedBall_subset_compact
    (f := (representation a : ScalarHilbert.{uH} →L[ℂ] ScalarHilbert.{uH}).toLinearMap) hCompact 1
  have hv : ∀ n, v n ∈ K := fun n =>
    hImage ⟨unitVector (ULift.up (Nat.pair k n)), unitVector_mem_closedBall _, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨z, _hz, φ, hφ, hLimit⟩ := hK.tendsto_subseq hv
  have hCauchy : CauchySeq (v ∘ φ) := hLimit.cauchy_map
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mp hCauchy
    ‖a (denseSeq Y k)‖ (norm_pos_iff.mpr ha)
  have hSmall := hN N (le_refl N) (N + 1) (Nat.le_succ N)
  have hLarge := hsep (hφ (Nat.lt_succ_self N)).ne
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hLarge) hSmall

/-- Only the zero continuous coefficient gives a compact repeated-evaluation operator. -/
theorem eq_zero_of_isCompactOperator (a : C(Y, ℂ))
    (hCompact : IsCompactOperator
      (representation a : ScalarHilbert.{uH} →L[ℂ] ScalarHilbert.{uH})) : a = 0 := by
  have hDense : (a : Y → ℂ) ∘ denseSeq Y = (fun _ : Y => (0 : ℂ)) ∘ denseSeq Y := by
    funext k
    exact evaluation_eq_zero_of_isCompactOperator a hCompact k
  have hEqual := (denseRange_denseSeq Y).equalizer a.continuous continuous_const hDense
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro y
  exact congrFun hEqual y

/-- The genuine split representation in the original compact-operator quotient. -/
def calkinRepresentation : C(Y, ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ ScalarHilbert.{uH} :=
  (classStarMap (H := ScalarHilbert.{uH})).comp representation

/-- Repeating every dense point makes the actual Calkin representation faithful. -/
theorem calkinRepresentation_injective :
    Function.Injective
      (calkinRepresentation (Y := Y) : C(Y, ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ ScalarHilbert.{uH}) := by
  intro a b hab
  have hc : IsCompactOperator
      (representation (a - b) : ScalarHilbert.{uH} →L[ℂ] ScalarHilbert.{uH}) := by
    apply (classStarMap_eq_zero_iff _).mp
    change (calkinRepresentation (a - b) : CalkinAlgebra ℂ ScalarHilbert.{uH}) = 0
    rw [map_sub, hab, sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (eq_zero_of_isCompactOperator (a - b) hc)

/-- The split Calkin representation retains the exact full range of each continuous coefficient. -/
theorem spectrum_calkinRepresentation (a : C(Y, ℂ)) :
    spectrum ℂ (calkinRepresentation a : CalkinAlgebra ℂ ScalarHilbert.{uH}) = Set.range a := by
  let φ : C(Y, ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] CalkinAlgebra ℂ ScalarHilbert.{uH} := calkinRepresentation
  let S := φ.range
  have : IsClosed (S : Set (CalkinAlgebra ℂ ScalarHilbert.{uH})) := by
    change IsClosed (Set.range φ)
    exact (NonUnitalStarAlgHom.isometry φ calkinRepresentation_injective).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
  let e := StarAlgEquiv.ofInjective φ calkinRepresentation_injective
  calc
    spectrum ℂ (φ a) = spectrum ℂ (e a : S) := (S.spectrum_eq (a := e a)).symm
    _ = spectrum ℂ a := AlgEquiv.spectrum_eq e.toAlgEquiv a
    _ = Set.range a := ContinuousMap.spectrum_eq_range a

end CalkinAlgebra.RepeatedEvaluation

end

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Module.HilbertAmplification.ElementaryCompacts
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.l2Space
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Dual
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.StarProjection

/-!
# Actual compact operators on countable scalar Hilbert space

The algebra is the actual compact-operator closed star ideal on lp(ℕ,ℂ,2).
A one-dimensional projection retains an actual compact operator, its star
projection laws, and the dimension of its literal operator range. Rank-one
operators and the standard coordinate projections are computed on this same
infinite Hilbert carrier.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace ScalarHilbertCompacts

/-- The genuine countable scalar Hilbert space used for the compact algebra. -/
abbrev Hilbert := lp (fun _ : ℕ => ℂ) 2

/-- The actual compact-operator closed star ideal on countable scalar Hilbert space. -/
abbrev Algebra := (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := Hilbert)).carrier

/-- The C-star dictionary is the existing closed-ideal dictionary on that carrier. -/
noncomputable instance instNonUnitalCStarAlgebra : NonUnitalCStarAlgebra Algebra :=
  (compactEndomorphismClosedStarIdeal (H := Hilbert)).carrierCStarAlgebra

/-- A literal one-dimensional compact star projection on the original Hilbert space. -/
structure OneDimensionalProjection where
  /-- The actual compact operator, without a supplied representation or comparison. -/
  value : Algebra
  /-- The original operator is self-adjoint and idempotent. -/
  projection : IsStarProjection value
  /-- Its literal operator range has complex dimension one. -/
  finrank_range : Module.finrank ℂ
    (LinearMap.range (value : Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert).toLinearMap) = 1

/-- The existing full-H compact rank-one constructor, specialized to scalar Hilbert space. -/
def rankOne (v w : Hilbert) : Algebra :=
  CStarModule.HilbertAmplification.hilbertCompactRankOne Hilbert v w

/-- The computed compact rank-one operator has its original Hilbert-space action. -/
@[simp]
theorem rankOne_apply (v w x : Hilbert) :
    (rankOne v w : Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert) x = inner ℂ w x • v :=
  CStarModule.HilbertAmplification.hilbertCompactRankOne_apply Hilbert v w x

/-- Adjoint exchanges the two actual rank-one vectors. -/
@[simp]
theorem star_rankOne (v w : Hilbert) : star (rankOne v w) = rankOne w v :=
  CStarModule.HilbertAmplification.hilbertCompactRankOne_star Hilbert v w

/-- A unit-vector rank-one operator is an actual idempotent in the compact ideal. -/
theorem rankOne_mul_self {v : Hilbert} (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) :
    rankOne v v * rankOne v v = rankOne v v := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact InnerProductSpace.isIdempotentElem_rankOne_self (𝕜 := ℂ) hv

/-- The compact subtype retains the original rank-one operator norm. -/
@[simp]
theorem norm_rankOne (v w : Hilbert) :
    ‖(rankOne v w : Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert)‖ = ‖v‖ * ‖w‖ :=
  InnerProductSpace.norm_rankOne v w

/-- A unit vector gives a computed actual projection with genuine one-dimensional range. -/
def rankOneProjection (v : Hilbert) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) : OneDimensionalProjection where
  value := rankOne v v
  projection := ⟨rankOne_mul_self hv, star_rankOne v v⟩
  finrank_range := by
    have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have h01 : (0 : ℝ) = 1 := by simpa only [h, norm_zero] using hv
      exact zero_ne_one h01
    change Module.finrank ℂ
      (LinearMap.range (InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℂ v v).toLinearMap) = 1
    apply Module.rank_eq_one_iff_finrank_eq_one.mp
    exact InnerProductSpace.rank_rankOne (𝕜 := ℂ) hv0 hv0

/-- The constructed projection is exactly the original rank-one compact operator. -/
@[simp]
theorem rankOneProjection_value (v : Hilbert) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1) :
    (rankOneProjection v hv).value = rankOne v v := rfl

/-- A standard Hilbert vector has its actual single-coordinate lp value. -/
def basisVector (i : ℕ) : Hilbert :=
  lp.single (E := fun _ : ℕ => ℂ) 2 i (1 : ℂ)

/-- Every standard coordinate vector has norm one in the genuine lp-two norm. -/
@[simp]
theorem norm_basisVector (i : ℕ) : ‖basisVector i‖ = 1 := by
  simpa only [basisVector, norm_one] using
    lp.norm_single (E := fun _ : ℕ => ℂ) (p := (2 : ENNReal)) (by norm_num) i (1 : ℂ)

/-- The original standard compact coordinate projection is a computed rank-one projection. -/
def coordinateProjection (i : ℕ) : OneDimensionalProjection :=
  rankOneProjection (basisVector i) (norm_basisVector i)

/-- The standard compact projection acts by the actual rank-one formula on every Hilbert vector. -/
theorem coordinateProjection_apply (i : ℕ) (x : Hilbert) :
    ((coordinateProjection i).value : Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert) x =
      inner ℂ (basisVector i) x • basisVector i := rfl

end ScalarHilbertCompacts

Author: @toskua

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Homotopy

import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Spectrum
import Mathlib.Topology.Path
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-!
# Point-norm homotopies through C-star automorphisms

This file packages paths whose intermediate maps are complex star-algebra
automorphisms.  Only forward point-norm continuity is stored: continuity of
the inverse orbits follows from isometry.  The resulting path has a canonical
forgetful map to the weaker homomorphism-valued point-norm homotopy.
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped CStarAlgebra

noncomputable section

universe uA uB

/-- A point-norm continuous path through complex star-algebra automorphisms. -/
structure AutomorphismHomotopy
    {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
    (α β : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) where
  /-- The automorphism at one point of the unit interval. -/
  aut : unitInterval → A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A
  /-- Every coefficient varies continuously along the path. -/
  continuous_apply : ∀ a : A, Continuous fun t ↦ aut t a
  /-- The path starts at `α`. -/
  zero : aut 0 = α
  /-- The path ends at `β`. -/
  one : aut 1 = β

namespace AutomorphismHomotopy

variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {α β γ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A}

/-- Automorphism homotopies are determined by their path of automorphisms. -/
@[ext]
theorem ext {h k : AutomorphismHomotopy α β} (haut : h.aut = k.aut) : h = k := by
  cases h
  cases k
  cases haut
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem aut_zero (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β) : h.aut 0 = α :=
  h.zero

@[simp]
theorem aut_one (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β) : h.aut 1 = β :=
  h.one

/-- Forward point-norm continuity forces continuity of every inverse orbit. -/
theorem continuous_symm_apply (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β) (a : A) :
    Continuous fun t ↦ (h.aut t).symm a := by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro t₀
  rw [ContinuousAt, Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  intro ε hε
  let b : A := (h.aut t₀).symm a
  filter_upwards [
      (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (h.continuous_apply b).continuousAt) ε hε] with t ht
  calc
    dist ((h.aut t).symm a) ((h.aut t₀).symm a) =
        dist (h.aut t ((h.aut t).symm a))
          (h.aut t ((h.aut t₀).symm a)) :=
      ((StarAlgEquiv.isometry (h.aut t)).dist_eq _ _).symm
    _ = dist a (h.aut t b) := by simp [b]
    _ < ε := by simpa [b, dist_comm] using ht

/-- The constant automorphism homotopy. -/
def refl (α : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) : AutomorphismHomotopy α α where
  aut := fun _ ↦ α
  continuous_apply := fun _ ↦ continuous_const
  zero := rfl
  one := rfl

/-- Reverse the interval parameter of an automorphism homotopy. -/
def symm (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β) : AutomorphismHomotopy β α where
  aut := fun t ↦ h.aut (unitInterval.symmHomeomorph t)
  continuous_apply := fun a ↦
    (h.continuous_apply a).comp unitInterval.symmHomeomorph.continuous
  zero := by simp [h.one]
  one := by simp [h.zero]

/-- Invert every automorphism along a homotopy without reversing time. -/
def inverse (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β) :
    AutomorphismHomotopy α.symm β.symm where
  aut := fun t ↦ (h.aut t).symm
  continuous_apply := h.continuous_symm_apply
  zero := by rw [h.zero]
  one := by rw [h.one]

/-- Postcompose every member of an automorphism homotopy by a fixed
automorphism. -/
def compLeft (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β) (δ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) :
    AutomorphismHomotopy (δ * α) (δ * β) where
  aut := fun t ↦ δ * h.aut t
  continuous_apply := fun a ↦ by
    change Continuous fun t ↦ δ (h.aut t a)
    exact (map_continuous δ.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom).comp (h.continuous_apply a)
  zero := by rw [h.zero]
  one := by rw [h.one]

/-- Precompose every member of an automorphism homotopy by a fixed
automorphism. -/
def compRight (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β) (δ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) :
    AutomorphismHomotopy (α * δ) (β * δ) where
  aut := fun t ↦ h.aut t * δ
  continuous_apply := fun a ↦ by
    change Continuous fun t ↦ h.aut t (δ a)
    exact h.continuous_apply (δ a)
  zero := by rw [h.zero]
  one := by rw [h.one]

/-- Concatenate two automorphism homotopies, following the first on
`[0, 1/2]` and the second on `[1/2, 1]`. -/
noncomputable def trans
    (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β) (k : AutomorphismHomotopy β γ) :
    AutomorphismHomotopy α γ := by
  let hPath (a : A) : Path (α a) (β a) :=
    { toContinuousMap := ⟨fun t ↦ h.aut t a, h.continuous_apply a⟩
      source' := by
        change h.aut 0 a = α a
        rw [h.zero]
      target' := by
        change h.aut 1 a = β a
        rw [h.one] }
  let kPath (a : A) : Path (β a) (γ a) :=
    { toContinuousMap := ⟨fun t ↦ k.aut t a, k.continuous_apply a⟩
      source' := by
        change k.aut 0 a = β a
        rw [k.zero]
      target' := by
        change k.aut 1 a = γ a
        rw [k.one] }
  let pathAut : unitInterval → A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A := fun t ↦
    if ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 then
      h.aut ⟨2 * (t : ℝ),
        (unitInterval.mul_pos_mem_iff zero_lt_two).2 ⟨t.2.1, ht⟩⟩
    else
      k.aut ⟨2 * (t : ℝ) - 1,
        unitInterval.two_mul_sub_one_mem_iff.2 ⟨(not_le.1 ht).le, t.2.2⟩⟩
  have pathAut_apply (t : unitInterval) (a : A) :
      pathAut t a =
        ((hPath a).trans (kPath a)) t := by
    rw [Path.trans_apply]
    dsimp only [pathAut]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  exact
    { aut := pathAut
      continuous_apply := fun a ↦ by
        rw [show (fun t ↦ pathAut t a) =
            fun t ↦ ((hPath a).trans (kPath a)) t by
          funext t
          exact pathAut_apply t a]
        exact ((hPath a).trans (kPath a)).continuous
      zero := by
        apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
        intro a
        rw [pathAut_apply]
        exact Path.source _
      one := by
        apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
        intro a
        rw [pathAut_apply]
        exact Path.target _ }

@[simp]
theorem refl_aut (α : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) (t : unitInterval) :
    (refl α).aut t = α :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem symm_aut_apply (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    (t : unitInterval) (a : A) :
    h.symm.aut t a = h.aut (unitInterval.symmHomeomorph t) a :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem inverse_aut_apply (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    (t : unitInterval) (a : A) :
    h.inverse.aut t a = (h.aut t).symm a :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem compLeft_aut_apply (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    (δ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) (t : unitInterval) (a : A) :
    (h.compLeft δ).aut t a = δ (h.aut t a) :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem compRight_aut_apply (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    (δ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) (t : unitInterval) (a : A) :
    (h.compRight δ).aut t a = h.aut t (δ a) :=
  rfl

/-- On the left half of the interval, concatenation is the first path with
the parameter doubled. -/
theorem trans_apply_of_le_half (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    (k : AutomorphismHomotopy β γ) (t : unitInterval)
    (ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (a : A) :
    (h.trans k).aut t a =
      h.aut ⟨2 * (t : ℝ),
        (unitInterval.mul_pos_mem_iff zero_lt_two).2 ⟨t.2.1, ht⟩⟩ a := by
  have ht' : (t : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [one_div] using ht
  simp [trans, ht']

/-- On the strict right half of the interval, concatenation is the second
path with parameter `2t - 1`. -/
theorem trans_apply_of_half_lt (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    (k : AutomorphismHomotopy β γ) (t : unitInterval)
    (ht : 1 / 2 < (t : ℝ)) (a : A) :
    (h.trans k).aut t a =
      k.aut ⟨2 * (t : ℝ) - 1,
        unitInterval.two_mul_sub_one_mem_iff.2 ⟨ht.le, t.2.2⟩⟩ a := by
  have ht' : ¬(t : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    apply not_le.mpr
    simpa only [one_div] using ht
  simp [trans, ht']

@[simp]
theorem trans_aut_zero (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    (k : AutomorphismHomotopy β γ) : (h.trans k).aut 0 = α :=
  (h.trans k).zero

@[simp]
theorem trans_aut_one (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    (k : AutomorphismHomotopy β γ) : (h.trans k).aut 1 = γ :=
  (h.trans k).one

/-- The concatenated homotopy has the common endpoint at time `1/2`. -/
theorem trans_aut_half (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    (k : AutomorphismHomotopy β γ) :
    (h.trans k).aut
        ⟨(1 : ℝ) / 2, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ = β := by
  apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
  intro a
  simp [trans, h.one]

/-- The proposition that two automorphisms are joined by a point-norm
automorphism homotopy. -/
def AutomorphismHomotopic (α β : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) : Prop :=
  Nonempty (AutomorphismHomotopy α β)

/-- Point-norm automorphism homotopy is an equivalence relation. -/
theorem automorphismHomotopic_equivalence (A : Type uA)
    [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A] :
    Equivalence (AutomorphismHomotopic :
      (A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) → (A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) → Prop) := by
  refine ⟨fun δ ↦ ⟨refl δ⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro δ ε ⟨h⟩
    exact ⟨h.symm⟩
  · rintro δ ε ζ ⟨h⟩ ⟨k⟩
    exact ⟨h.trans k⟩

/-! ## Forgetful map to homomorphism-valued homotopy -/

/-- An automorphism homotopy as one nonunital star-algebra homomorphism into
the algebra of continuous paths. -/
def toHomotopyMap (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β) :
    A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] C(unitInterval, A) where
  toFun a := ⟨fun t ↦ h.aut t a, h.continuous_apply a⟩
  map_zero' := by ext; simp
  map_add' a b := by ext t; exact map_add (h.aut t) a b
  map_mul' a b := by ext t; exact map_mul (h.aut t) a b
  map_smul' z a := by ext t; exact map_smul (h.aut t) z a
  map_star' a := by ext t; exact map_star (h.aut t) a

@[simp]
theorem toHomotopyMap_apply (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    (a : A) (t : unitInterval) : h.toHomotopyMap a t = h.aut t a :=
  rfl

/-- Forgetting invertibility gives a point-norm homotopy of nonunital
star-algebra homomorphisms with the same endpoint orientation. -/
theorem toHomotopic (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β) :
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.Homotopic
      α.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom β.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom := by
  refine ⟨h.toHomotopyMap, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a
    change h.aut 0 a = α a
    rw [h.zero]
  · intro a
    change h.aut 1 a = β a
    rw [h.one]

/-- Postcomposition preserves the homomorphism homotopy underlying an
automorphism homotopy. -/
theorem toHomotopic_postcomp (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (δ : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] B) :
    (δ.comp α.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom).Homotopic
      (δ.comp β.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom) :=
  h.toHomotopic.postcomp δ

/-- Precomposition preserves the homomorphism homotopy underlying an
automorphism homotopy. -/
theorem toHomotopic_precomp (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    {B : Type uB} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra B]
    (δ : B →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] A) :
    (α.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp δ).Homotopic
      (β.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom.comp δ) :=
  h.toHomotopic.precomp δ

/-- Left composition of an automorphism path has the correspondingly
postcomposed homomorphism-homotopy endpoints. -/
theorem compLeft_toHomotopic (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    (δ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) :
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.Homotopic
      (δ * α).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom (δ * β).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom :=
  (h.compLeft δ).toHomotopic

/-- Right composition of an automorphism path has the correspondingly
precomposed homomorphism-homotopy endpoints. -/
theorem compRight_toHomotopic (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    (δ : A ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] A) :
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.Homotopic
      (α * δ).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom (β * δ).toNonUnitalStarAlgHom :=
  (h.compRight δ).toHomotopic

/-- Reversing an automorphism homotopy reverses its underlying homomorphism
homotopy. -/
theorem toHomotopic_symm (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β) :
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.Homotopic
      β.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom α.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom :=
  h.toHomotopic.symm

/-- Concatenating automorphism homotopies concatenates their underlying
homomorphism homotopies. -/
theorem toHomotopic_trans (h : AutomorphismHomotopy α β)
    (k : AutomorphismHomotopy β γ) :
    NonUnitalStarAlgHom.Homotopic
      α.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom γ.toNonUnitalStarAlgHom :=
  h.toHomotopic.trans k.toHomotopic

end AutomorphismHomotopy

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap.ZeroAtInfty
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.PointNormAction
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousMap
public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.ZeroAtInfty
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.IsUniformGroup.Defs
import Mathlib.Tactic.Group

/-!
# The original C0(G) left-translation covariant system

Precomposition by the actual inverse-left-translation homeomorphism preserves
vanishing at infinity, algebra operations and star. Its inverse is the
opposite translation. Uniform continuity of every original C0 function in
the canonical right group uniformity proves point-norm orbit continuity.
The uniformity has the original topology; no alternate norm or group model
is introduced. This construction requires no discreteness, separability,
coefficient unit, nonzero space or supplied action.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
open scoped ZeroAtInfty Uniformity

noncomputable section

open Filter Topology
open scoped CStarAlgebra

namespace PointNormCStarAction

universe uG

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalGroup G]

/-- The actual C0 star-algebra automorphism f(s)↦f(g inverse*s). -/
def c0LeftTranslationEquiv (g : G) : C₀(G, ℂ) ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] C₀(G, ℂ) :=
  ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.starAlgEquivPrecomp (A := ℂ) (Homeomorph.mulLeft g⁻¹)

/-- Every coefficient value is the original inverse-left-translation formula. -/
@[simp]
theorem c0LeftTranslationEquiv_apply (g : G) (f : C₀(G, ℂ)) (s : G) :
    c0LeftTranslationEquiv g f s = f (g⁻¹ * s) := rfl

/-- The actual identity translation is the original identity automorphism. -/
@[simp]
theorem c0LeftTranslationEquiv_one : c0LeftTranslationEquiv (1 : G) = StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ _ := by
  apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
  intro f
  apply ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.ext
  intro s
  have hrefl : (StarAlgEquiv.refl ℂ C₀(G, ℂ)) f = f := rfl
  rw [hrefl, c0LeftTranslationEquiv_apply, inv_one, one_mul]

/-- Translation composition has exactly the original noncommutative group order. -/
theorem c0LeftTranslationEquiv_mul (g h : G) :
    c0LeftTranslationEquiv (g * h) = c0LeftTranslationEquiv g * c0LeftTranslationEquiv h := by
  apply StarAlgEquiv.ext
  intro f
  apply ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.ext
  intro s
  change f ((g * h)⁻¹ * s) = f (h⁻¹ * (g⁻¹ * s))
  rw [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]

/-- Every actual original C0 translation orbit is continuous in the original supremum norm. -/
theorem continuous_c0LeftTranslationEquiv_orbit (f : C₀(G, ℂ)) :
    Continuous (fun g : G => c0LeftTranslationEquiv g f) := by
  let : UniformSpace G := IsTopologicalGroup.rightUniformSpace G
  have hf : UniformContinuous (f : G → ℂ) := ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.uniformContinuous f
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro g0
  rw [ContinuousAt, Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  intro epsilon hepsilon
  have hhalf : 0 < epsilon / 2 := half_pos hepsilon
  have hu : {p : G × G | dist (f p.1) (f p.2) < epsilon / 2} ∈ 𝓤 G :=
    hf.eventually (Metric.dist_mem_uniformity hhalf)
  rw [_root_.uniformity_eq_comap_nhds_one' G] at hu
  rcases Filter.mem_comap.mp hu with ⟨V, hV, hsubset⟩
  have hnear : Tendsto (fun g : G => g⁻¹ * g0) (𝓝 g0) (𝓝 (1 : G)) := by
    have hcontinuous : Continuous (fun g : G => g⁻¹ * g0) :=
      continuous_inv.mul continuous_const
    have hlimit : Tendsto (fun g : G => g⁻¹ * g0) (𝓝 g0) (𝓝 (g0⁻¹ * g0)) :=
      hcontinuous.tendsto g0
    simpa only [inv_mul_cancel] using hlimit
  filter_upwards [hnear.eventually hV] with g hg
  have hbound : dist (c0LeftTranslationEquiv g f) (c0LeftTranslationEquiv g0 f) ≤ epsilon / 2 := by
    rw [← ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.isometry_toBCF.dist_eq]
    apply (BoundedContinuousFunction.dist_le hhalf.le).2
    intro s
    have hproduct : (g⁻¹ * s) * (g0⁻¹ * s)⁻¹ = g⁻¹ * g0 := by group
    have hpair : (g0⁻¹ * s, g⁻¹ * s) ∈
        (fun p : G × G => p.2 * p.1⁻¹) ⁻¹' V := by
      change (g⁻¹ * s) * (g0⁻¹ * s)⁻¹ ∈ V
      rw [hproduct]
      exact hg
    have hdist := hsubset hpair
    simpa only [c0LeftTranslationEquiv_apply, dist_comm] using hdist.le
  exact hbound.trans_lt (half_lt_self hepsilon)

/-- The actual original point-norm translation action on C0(G). -/
def c0LeftTranslationAction : PointNormCStarAction G C₀(G, ℂ) where
  toMonoidHom :=
    { toFun := c0LeftTranslationEquiv
      map_one' := c0LeftTranslationEquiv_one
      map_mul' := c0LeftTranslationEquiv_mul }
  continuous_orbit := continuous_c0LeftTranslationEquiv_orbit

/-- The point-norm action keeps every original coefficient value. -/
@[simp]
theorem c0LeftTranslationAction_apply (g : G) (f : C₀(G, ℂ)) (s : G) :
    c0LeftTranslationAction g f s = f (g⁻¹ * s) := rfl

end PointNormCStarAction

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.PointNormAction.CovariantRepresentation
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.EssentialNondegeneracy

/-!
# Actual essential restriction of a covariant representation

Covariance makes the actual closed span of coefficient-operator ranges
invariant under every group unitary. Restrict the group and coefficient
operators to that closed Hilbert subspace. The inherited vector values give
unitarity, strong continuity and covariance, while the existing essential
representation theorem gives actual nondegeneracy.

This computes a nondegenerate source covariant pair from the completed Gram
pair. No invariant subspace, continuity, norm model or nondegeneracy is an
additional constructor input.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped CStarAlgebra InnerProductSpace

namespace CovariantRepresentation

noncomputable section

universe uG uA uH

variable {G : Type uG} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]
variable {A : Type uA} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]
variable {H : Type uH} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
variable {α : PointNormCStarAction G A}

/-- Covariance transports every original coefficient vector value under the actual group unitary. -/
theorem group_algebra_apply (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H) (g : G) (a : A) (ξ : H) :
    (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) (ρ.algebra a ξ) =
      ρ.algebra (α g a) ((ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) := by
  have hStar : star (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) = (ρ.group g⁻¹ : H →L[ℂ] H) :=
    congrArg (fun u : unitary (H →L[ℂ] H) => (u : H →L[ℂ] H))
      (ρ.group.toMonoidHom.map_inv g).symm
  have h := congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => T ((ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ))
    (ρ.covariance g a)
  change (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H)
      (ρ.algebra a (star (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ((ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ))) = _ at h
  rw [hStar, ← ρ.group.apply_mul g⁻¹ g ξ, inv_mul_cancel, ρ.group.apply_one] at h
  exact h

/-- Covariance preserves the actual coefficient essential space under every group element. -/
theorem group_preserves_essentialSpace (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H) (g : G)
    (ξ : H) (hξ : ξ ∈ ρ.algebra.essentialSpace) :
    (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ ∈ ρ.algebra.essentialSpace := by
  let S : Submodule ℂ H := Submodule.span ℂ
    (Set.range fun p : A × H => ρ.algebra p.1 p.2)
  let P : Submodule ℂ H := ρ.algebra.essentialSpace.comap
    (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H).toLinearMap
  have hSpan : S ≤ P := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨⟨a, η⟩, rfl⟩
    change (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) (ρ.algebra a η) ∈ ρ.algebra.essentialSpace
    rw [ρ.group_algebra_apply]
    exact ρ.algebra.range_mem_essentialSpace (α g a) _
  have hClosed : IsClosed (P : Set H) :=
    S.isClosed_topologicalClosure.preimage (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H).continuous
  have hEssential : ρ.algebra.essentialSpace ≤ P :=
    S.topologicalClosure_minimal hSpan hClosed
  exact hEssential hξ

/-- The original group unitary restricted to the actual coefficient essential space. -/
def essentialGroupIsometry (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H) (g : G) :
    ρ.algebra.essentialSpace ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ρ.algebra.essentialSpace where
  toFun ξ := ⟨(ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ, ρ.group_preserves_essentialSpace g ξ ξ.property⟩
  invFun ξ := ⟨(ρ.group g⁻¹ : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ, ρ.group_preserves_essentialSpace g⁻¹ ξ ξ.property⟩
  left_inv ξ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (ρ.group g⁻¹ : H →L[ℂ] H) ((ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) = (ξ : H)
    rw [← ρ.group.apply_mul, inv_mul_cancel, ρ.group.apply_one]
  right_inv ξ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ((ρ.group g⁻¹ : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ) = (ξ : H)
    rw [← ρ.group.apply_mul, mul_inv_cancel, ρ.group.apply_one]
  map_add' ξ η := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ((ξ : H) + η) = _
    exact map_add (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ : H) (η : H)
  map_smul' c ξ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) (c • (ξ : H)) = _
    exact map_smul (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) c (ξ : H)
  norm_map' ξ := ρ.group.norm_apply g (ξ : H)

/-- The actual strongly continuous group representation on the coefficient essential space. -/
def essentialGroup (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H) :
    StronglyContinuousUnitaryRepresentation G ρ.algebra.essentialSpace where
  toMonoidHom :=
    { toFun g := Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv.symm (ρ.essentialGroupIsometry g)
      map_one' := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
        intro ξ
        apply Subtype.ext
        change (ρ.group (1 : G) : H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ : H) = (ξ : H)
        exact ρ.group.apply_one (ξ : H)
      map_mul' g h := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
        intro ξ
        apply Subtype.ext
        change (ρ.group (g * h) : H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ : H) =
          (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ((ρ.group h : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)
        exact ρ.group.apply_mul g h (ξ : H) }
  continuous_orbit ξ := by
    change Continuous (fun g : G =>
      (⟨(ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) (ξ : H),
        ρ.group_preserves_essentialSpace g ξ ξ.property⟩ : ρ.algebra.essentialSpace))
    exact (ρ.group.continuous_orbit (ξ : H)).subtype_mk _

/-- The restricted group action retains every original essential-vector value. -/
@[simp]
theorem essentialGroup_apply_coe (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H) (g : G)
    (ξ : ρ.algebra.essentialSpace) :
    ((ρ.essentialGroup g : ρ.algebra.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.algebra.essentialSpace) ξ : H) =
      (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ := rfl

/-- The original covariant pair restricted to its actual coefficient essential Hilbert space. -/
def essentialCovariantRepresentation (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H) :
    CovariantRepresentation α ρ.algebra.essentialSpace where
  algebra := ρ.algebra.essentialRepresentation
  group := ρ.essentialGroup
  covariance g a := by
    have hStar :
        star (ρ.essentialGroup g : ρ.algebra.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.algebra.essentialSpace) =
          (ρ.essentialGroup g⁻¹ : ρ.algebra.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.algebra.essentialSpace) :=
      congrArg (fun u : unitary (ρ.algebra.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.algebra.essentialSpace) =>
        (u : ρ.algebra.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.algebra.essentialSpace))
        (ρ.essentialGroup.toMonoidHom.map_inv g).symm
    rw [hStar]
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro ξ
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) (ρ.algebra a ((ρ.group g⁻¹ : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ)) =
      ρ.algebra (α g a) (ξ : H)
    rw [ρ.group_algebra_apply, ← ρ.group.apply_mul, mul_inv_cancel, ρ.group.apply_one]

/-- Essential restriction retains the literal existing coefficient representation. -/
@[simp]
theorem essentialCovariantRepresentation_algebra (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H) :
    ρ.essentialCovariantRepresentation.algebra = ρ.algebra.essentialRepresentation := rfl

/-- The actual essential covariant pair retains the original group vector values. -/
@[simp]
theorem essentialCovariantRepresentation_group_apply_coe
    (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H) (g : G) (ξ : ρ.algebra.essentialSpace) :
    ((ρ.essentialCovariantRepresentation.group g :
      ρ.algebra.essentialSpace →L[ℂ] ρ.algebra.essentialSpace) ξ : H) =
        (ρ.group g : H →L[ℂ] H) ξ := rfl

/-- The actual essential covariant coefficient map satisfies the neutral nondegeneracy condition. -/
theorem essentialCovariantRepresentation_essentialSpace_eq_top (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H) :
    ρ.essentialCovariantRepresentation.algebra.essentialSpace = ⊤ :=
  ρ.algebra.essentialRepresentation_essentialSpace_eq_top

/-- Compatibility with the original dense-span essential covariant statement. -/
theorem nondegenerate_essentialCovariantRepresentation (ρ : CovariantRepresentation α H) :
    Dense (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun p : A × ρ.algebra.essentialSpace =>
      ρ.essentialCovariantRepresentation.algebra p.1 p.2) : Set ρ.algebra.essentialSpace) :=
  ρ.essentialCovariantRepresentation.algebra.essentialSpace_eq_top_iff_dense.mp
    (ρ.essentialCovariantRepresentation_essentialSpace_eq_top)

end

end CovariantRepresentation

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.FiniteStarDomain
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Order
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.NonUnitalSubalgebra
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Abel

/-!
# The actual finite-square linear domain and original two-square star algebra

A global extended positive weight determines the literal set of x for which
its value on x*x is finite. Additivity, finite positive homogeneity and
C-star positivity make that same set a complex submodule and a left ideal.
The left multiplication maps below have their original algebra values.

The two-square-finite set likewise supplies an actual complex submodule
and a nonunital star subalgebra. These are algebraic prerequisites for the
weight GNS domain and its algebraic core. Only the original ambient norm is
inherited here; no weight inner product, weight norm, completion, normal
representation or modular operator is supplied.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped NNReal ENNReal

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

attribute [local instance] CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing

/-- Positive additivity makes the actual global weight monotone on the original positive cone. -/
theorem Weight.value_mono (φ : Weight A) (a b : PositiveElement A) (hab : (a : A) ≤ (b : A)) :
    φ.value a ≤ φ.value b := by
  let d : PositiveElement A := ⟨(b : A) - (a : A), sub_nonneg.mpr hab⟩
  have hsum : positiveAdd a d = b := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (a : A) + ((b : A) - (a : A)) = (b : A)
    abel
  calc
    φ.value a ≤ φ.value a + φ.value d := le_add_of_nonneg_right (show (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ φ.value d from zero_le)
    _ = φ.value b := by rw [← φ.add_value, hsum]

/-- A positive minorant of an actual finite-positive element has finite weight. -/
theorem Weight.finite_of_le (φ : Weight A) (a b : PositiveElement A)
    (hab : (a : A) ≤ (b : A)) (hb : φ.value b < ⊤) : φ.value a < ⊤ :=
  lt_of_le_of_lt (φ.value_mono a b hab) hb

/-- Finite nonnegative-real scaling preserves an actual finite-positive weight value. -/
theorem Weight.finite_positiveSmul (φ : Weight A) (r : ℝ≥0) (a : PositiveElement A)
    (ha : φ.value a < ⊤) : φ.value (positiveSmul r a) < ⊤ := by
  rw [φ.smul_value]
  exact ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.coe_lt_top ha

/-- Complex scaling of the original square is finite positive scaling by the scalar norm square. -/
theorem leftSquare_smul (c : ℂ) (x : A) :
    leftSquare (c • x) = positiveSmul ⟨‖c‖ ^ 2, sq_nonneg ‖c‖⟩ (leftSquare x) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change star (c • x) * (c • x) = (‖c‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • (star x * x)
  rw [star_smul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul, Complex.star_def, RCLike.conj_mul]
  change (RCLike.ofReal ‖c‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 • (star x * x) = (‖c‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • (star x * x)
  calc
    (RCLike.ofReal ‖c‖ : ℂ) ^ 2 • (star x * x) =
        (RCLike.ofReal (‖c‖ ^ 2) : ℂ) • (star x * x) :=
      congrArg (fun z : ℂ => z • (star x * x)) (RCLike.ofReal_pow (K := ℂ) ‖c‖ 2).symm
    _ = (‖c‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • (star x * x) :=
      (RCLike.real_smul_eq_coe_smul (K := ℂ) (‖c‖ ^ 2) (star x * x)).symm

/-- The original finite-square domain is closed under addition, by the positive square bound. -/
theorem Weight.add_mem_finiteSquareDomain (φ : Weight A) (x y : A)
    (hx : x ∈ φ.finiteSquareDomain) (hy : y ∈ φ.finiteSquareDomain) :
    x + y ∈ φ.finiteSquareDomain := by
  let s := positiveAdd (leftSquare x) (leftSquare y)
  have hidentity :
      ((star x * x + star y * y) + (star x * x + star y * y)) -
        star (x + y) * (x + y) = star (x - y) * (x - y) := by
    simp only [star_add, star_sub, add_mul, mul_add, sub_mul, mul_sub]
    abel
  have hbound : (leftSquare (x + y) : A) ≤ (positiveAdd s s : A) := by
    apply sub_nonneg.mp
    change 0 ≤ ((star x * x + star y * y) + (star x * x + star y * y)) -
      star (x + y) * (x + y)
    rw [hidentity]
    exact star_mul_self_nonneg (x - y)
  have hs : φ.value s < ⊤ := (φ.finite_add_iff (leftSquare x) (leftSquare y)).2 ⟨hx, hy⟩
  exact φ.finite_of_le (leftSquare (x + y)) (positiveAdd s s) hbound
    ((φ.finite_add_iff s s).2 ⟨hs, hs⟩)

/-- The original finite-square domain is closed under every complex scalar. -/
theorem Weight.smul_mem_finiteSquareDomain (φ : Weight A) (c : ℂ) (x : A)
    (hx : x ∈ φ.finiteSquareDomain) : c • x ∈ φ.finiteSquareDomain := by
  change φ.value (leftSquare (c • x)) < ⊤
  rw [leftSquare_smul]
  exact φ.finite_positiveSmul ⟨‖c‖ ^ 2, sq_nonneg ‖c‖⟩ (leftSquare x) hx

/-- Original left multiplication has the genuine C-star positive square estimate. -/
theorem leftSquare_mul_le (a x : A) :
    (leftSquare (a * x) : A) ≤
      (positiveSmul ⟨‖a‖ ^ 2, sq_nonneg ‖a‖⟩ (leftSquare x) : A) := by
  change star (a * x) * (a * x) ≤ (‖a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) • (star x * x)
  rw [star_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_assoc _ (star a), sq,
    ← CStarRing.norm_star_mul_self (x := a)]
  exact CStarAlgebra.star_left_conjugate_le_norm_smul x (star a * a)
    (IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (star_mul_self_nonneg a))

/-- The global weight retains the actual bound needed by the later weight-norm left action. -/
theorem Weight.value_leftSquare_mul_le (φ : Weight A) (a x : A) :
    φ.value (leftSquare (a * x)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofNNReal (NNReal.mk (‖a‖ ^ 2) (sq_nonneg ‖a‖)) * φ.value (leftSquare x) := by
  calc
    φ.value (leftSquare (a * x)) ≤
        φ.value (positiveSmul (NNReal.mk (‖a‖ ^ 2) (sq_nonneg ‖a‖)) (leftSquare x)) :=
      φ.value_mono _ _ (leftSquare_mul_le a x)
    _ = ENNReal.ofNNReal (NNReal.mk (‖a‖ ^ 2) (sq_nonneg ‖a‖)) * φ.value (leftSquare x) :=
      φ.smul_value (NNReal.mk (‖a‖ ^ 2) (sq_nonneg ‖a‖)) (leftSquare x)

/-- Every original left multiplier preserves the literal finite-square domain. -/
theorem Weight.mul_mem_finiteSquareDomain (φ : Weight A) (a x : A)
    (hx : x ∈ φ.finiteSquareDomain) : a * x ∈ φ.finiteSquareDomain := by
  change φ.value (leftSquare (a * x)) < ⊤
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (φ.value_leftSquare_mul_le a x)
    (ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.coe_lt_top hx)

/-- The original finite-square set with its proved complex submodule structure. -/
def Weight.finiteSquareSubmodule (φ : Weight A) : Submodule ℂ A where
  carrier := φ.finiteSquareDomain
  zero_mem' := φ.zero_mem_finiteSquareDomain
  add_mem' := by
    intro x y hx hy
    exact φ.add_mem_finiteSquareDomain x y hx hy
  smul_mem' := by
    intro c x hx
    exact φ.smul_mem_finiteSquareDomain c x hx

/-- The actual linear domain has exactly the original finite-square carrier. -/
@[simp]
theorem Weight.coe_finiteSquareSubmodule (φ : Weight A) :
    (φ.finiteSquareSubmodule : Set A) = φ.finiteSquareDomain :=
  rfl

/-- Left multiplication on the actual finite-square complex module. -/
def Weight.finiteSquareLeftMul (φ : Weight A) (a : A) :
    φ.finiteSquareSubmodule →ₗ[ℂ] φ.finiteSquareSubmodule where
  toFun x := ⟨a * (x : A), φ.mul_mem_finiteSquareDomain a (x : A) x.property⟩
  map_add' := by
    intro x y
    apply Subtype.ext
    change a * ((x : A) + (y : A)) = a * (x : A) + a * (y : A)
    exact mul_add a (x : A) (y : A)
  map_smul' := by
    intro c x
    apply Subtype.ext
    change a * (c • (x : A)) = c • (a * (x : A))
    exact mul_smul_comm c a (x : A)

/-- The actual linear left action retains every original multiplication value. -/
@[simp]
theorem Weight.finiteSquareLeftMul_apply (φ : Weight A) (a : A) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x : A) = a * (x : A) :=
  rfl

/-- The original two-square core is exactly the finite domain intersected with its star preimage. -/
theorem Weight.mem_finiteStarSquareDomain_iff (φ : Weight A) (x : A) :
    x ∈ φ.finiteStarSquareDomain ↔ x ∈ φ.finiteSquareDomain ∧ star x ∈ φ.finiteSquareDomain := by
  change φ.value (leftSquare x) < ⊤ ∧ φ.value (rightSquare x) < ⊤ ↔
    φ.value (leftSquare x) < ⊤ ∧ φ.value (leftSquare (star x)) < ⊤
  rw [leftSquare_star]

/-- The exact two-square-finite core as a complex submodule of the original algebra. -/
def Weight.finiteStarSquareSubmodule (φ : Weight A) : Submodule ℂ A where
  carrier := φ.finiteStarSquareDomain
  zero_mem' := by
    apply (φ.mem_finiteStarSquareDomain_iff 0).2
    rw [star_zero]
    exact ⟨φ.zero_mem_finiteSquareDomain, φ.zero_mem_finiteSquareDomain⟩
  add_mem' := by
    intro x y hx hy
    obtain ⟨hx, hxStar⟩ := (φ.mem_finiteStarSquareDomain_iff x).1 hx
    obtain ⟨hy, hyStar⟩ := (φ.mem_finiteStarSquareDomain_iff y).1 hy
    apply (φ.mem_finiteStarSquareDomain_iff (x + y)).2
    refine ⟨φ.add_mem_finiteSquareDomain x y hx hy, ?_⟩
    rw [star_add]
    exact φ.add_mem_finiteSquareDomain (star x) (star y) hxStar hyStar
  smul_mem' := by
    intro c x hx
    obtain ⟨hx, hxStar⟩ := (φ.mem_finiteStarSquareDomain_iff x).1 hx
    apply (φ.mem_finiteStarSquareDomain_iff (c • x)).2
    refine ⟨φ.smul_mem_finiteSquareDomain c x hx, ?_⟩
    rw [star_smul]
    exact φ.smul_mem_finiteSquareDomain (star c) (star x) hxStar

/-- The actual core module retains exactly the original two-square-finite set. -/
@[simp]
theorem Weight.coe_finiteStarSquareSubmodule (φ : Weight A) :
    (φ.finiteStarSquareSubmodule : Set A) = φ.finiteStarSquareDomain :=
  rfl

/-- Original multiplication preserves the actual two-square-finite core. -/
theorem Weight.mul_mem_finiteStarSquareDomain (φ : Weight A) (x y : A)
    (hx : x ∈ φ.finiteStarSquareDomain) (hy : y ∈ φ.finiteStarSquareDomain) :
    x * y ∈ φ.finiteStarSquareDomain := by
  have hxStar := ((φ.mem_finiteStarSquareDomain_iff x).1 hx).2
  have hyLeft := ((φ.mem_finiteStarSquareDomain_iff y).1 hy).1
  apply (φ.mem_finiteStarSquareDomain_iff (x * y)).2
  refine ⟨φ.mul_mem_finiteSquareDomain x y hyLeft, ?_⟩
  rw [star_mul]
  exact φ.mul_mem_finiteSquareDomain (star y) (star x) hxStar

/-- The genuine algebraic core under original complex operations, product and star. -/
def Weight.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra (φ : Weight A) : NonUnitalStarSubalgebra ℂ A where
  carrier := φ.finiteStarSquareDomain
  zero_mem' := φ.finiteStarSquareSubmodule.zero_mem
  add_mem' := by
    intro x y hx hy
    exact φ.finiteStarSquareSubmodule.add_mem hx hy
  smul_mem' := by
    intro c x hx
    exact φ.finiteStarSquareSubmodule.smul_mem c hx
  mul_mem' := by
    intro x y hx hy
    exact φ.mul_mem_finiteStarSquareDomain x y hx hy
  star_mem' := by
    intro x hx
    exact (φ.finiteStarSquareDomain_star_iff x).2 hx

/-- The actual nonunital star algebra has exactly the original finite-star-square carrier. -/
@[simp]
theorem Weight.coe_finiteStarSquareSubalgebra (φ : Weight A) :
    (φ.finiteStarSquareSubalgebra : Set A) = φ.finiteStarSquareDomain :=
  rfl

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
