module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight

/-!
# The literal two-square-finite domain of a global weight

The two-square-finite domain of a global scalar weight consists of the
original elements x for which both phi(x*x) and phi(xx*) are finite. This
module constructs that actual set and its inherited involution. It supplies
the domain carrier needed by the later weight left-Hilbert-algebra statement.

The original ambient norm is not the weight norm. Addition, multiplication,
weight inner products, completion and Tomita closure are not asserted here.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped NNReal ENNReal

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- Taking star exchanges the original right square and left square. -/
theorem rightSquare_star (x : A) : rightSquare (star x) = leftSquare x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [rightSquare, leftSquare, star_star]

/-- The actual core is finite for both original positive squares. -/
def Weight.finiteStarSquareDomain (φ : Weight A) : Set A :=
  {x | φ.value (leftSquare x) < ⊤ ∧ φ.value (rightSquare x) < ⊤}

/-- The two original finite-square conditions are exchanged by star. -/
theorem Weight.finiteStarSquareDomain_star_iff (φ : Weight A) (x : A) :
    star x ∈ φ.finiteStarSquareDomain ↔ x ∈ φ.finiteStarSquareDomain := by
  change φ.value (leftSquare (star x)) < ⊤ ∧ φ.value (rightSquare (star x)) < ⊤ ↔
    φ.value (leftSquare x) < ⊤ ∧ φ.value (rightSquare x) < ⊤
  rw [leftSquare_star, rightSquare_star, and_comm]

/-- The original elements satisfying both finite-square conditions, without an asserted weight norm. -/
abbrev Weight.FiniteStarSquareCarrier (φ : Weight A) : Type u :=
  φ.finiteStarSquareDomain

/-- The actual involution retains the original ambient algebra element. -/
instance Weight.instStarFiniteStarSquareCarrier (φ : Weight A) : Star φ.FiniteStarSquareCarrier where
  star x := ⟨star (x : A), (φ.finiteStarSquareDomain_star_iff (x : A)).2 x.property⟩

/-- The inherited carrier involution has exactly the original algebra values. -/
@[simp]
theorem Weight.finiteStarSquareCarrier_star_coe (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.FiniteStarSquareCarrier) :
    ((star x : φ.FiniteStarSquareCarrier) : A) = star (x : A) :=
  rfl

/-- The actual domain involution squares to the identity by the original star law. -/
instance Weight.instInvolutiveStarFiniteStarSquareCarrier (φ : Weight A) :
    InvolutiveStar φ.FiniteStarSquareCarrier where
  star_involutive x := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change star (star (x : A)) = (x : A)
    exact star_star (x : A)

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.FiniteSquareSubmodule
public import Mathlib.Basic.ENNReal.Real
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Abel
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
public import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/-!
# Finite-positive value relations for the actual weight pairing

The real coordinates of finite-positive weight values respect equality,
addition and real scaling of their original signed differences. Every
relation below is proved from the global positive weight's own laws;
no scalar extension or positive-inner certificate is supplied.

The final definitions polarize the actual finite-square values on the
literal complex domain. Their Hermitian and scalar laws are constructor
obligations for the weight pre-inner-product structure, not assumed data.
The imaginary coordinate uses the first argument multiplied by i, matching
a complex inner product linear in its second argument.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped NNReal ENNReal

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

attribute [local instance] CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing

/-- Finite positive additivity is actual additivity of the original real values. -/
theorem Weight.finite_toReal_add (φ : Weight A) (a b : PositiveElement A)
    (ha : φ.value a < ⊤) (hb : φ.value b < ⊤) :
    (φ.value (positiveAdd a b)).toReal = (φ.value a).toReal + (φ.value b).toReal := by
  rw [φ.add_value, ENNReal.toReal_add ha.ne hb.ne]

/-- Real coordinates of finite positive scaling obey the original scalar law. -/
theorem Weight.toReal_positiveSmul (φ : Weight A) (r : NNReal) (a : PositiveElement A) :
    (φ.value (positiveSmul r a)).toReal = (r : ℝ) * (φ.value a).toReal := by
  rw [φ.smul_value, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.coe_toReal]

/-- Equal original positive differences have equal differences of their finite weight values. -/
theorem Weight.finite_toReal_sub_eq_sub (φ : Weight A) (a b c d : PositiveElement A)
    (ha : φ.value a < ⊤) (hb : φ.value b < ⊤)
    (hc : φ.value c < ⊤) (hd : φ.value d < ⊤)
    (h : (a : A) - (b : A) = (c : A) - (d : A)) :
    (φ.value a).toReal - (φ.value b).toReal = (φ.value c).toReal - (φ.value d).toReal := by
  have hadd : (a : A) + (d : A) = (c : A) + (b : A) := by
    calc
      (a : A) + (d : A) = ((a : A) - (b : A)) + ((b : A) + (d : A)) := by abel
      _ = ((c : A) - (d : A)) + ((b : A) + (d : A)) := by rw [h]
      _ = (c : A) + (b : A) := by abel
  have hpositive : positiveAdd a d = positiveAdd c b := Subtype.ext hadd
  have hvalues := congrArg (fun z : PositiveElement A => (φ.value z).toReal) hpositive
  rw [φ.finite_toReal_add a d ha hd, φ.finite_toReal_add c b hc hb] at hvalues
  linarith

/-- The real values preserve addition of original finite-positive differences. -/
theorem Weight.finite_toReal_sub_eq_add_sub
    (φ : Weight A) (a b c d e f : PositiveElement A)
    (ha : φ.value a < ⊤) (hb : φ.value b < ⊤)
    (hc : φ.value c < ⊤) (hd : φ.value d < ⊤)
    (he : φ.value e < ⊤) (hf : φ.value f < ⊤)
    (h : (a : A) - (b : A) = ((c : A) - (d : A)) + ((e : A) - (f : A))) :
    (φ.value a).toReal - (φ.value b).toReal =
      ((φ.value c).toReal - (φ.value d).toReal) + ((φ.value e).toReal - (φ.value f).toReal) := by
  have hraw : (a : A) - (b : A) =
      (positiveAdd c e : A) - (positiveAdd d f : A) := by
    rw [h]
    change ((c : A) - (d : A)) + ((e : A) - (f : A)) =
      ((c : A) + (e : A)) - ((d : A) + (f : A))
    abel
  have hvalues := φ.finite_toReal_sub_eq_sub a b (positiveAdd c e) (positiveAdd d f)
    ha hb ((φ.finite_add_iff c e).2 ⟨hc, he⟩) ((φ.finite_add_iff d f).2 ⟨hd, hf⟩) hraw
  rw [φ.finite_toReal_add c e hc he, φ.finite_toReal_add d f hd hf] at hvalues
  linarith

/-- Original nonnegative-real scaling of finite-positive differences scales their real values. -/
theorem Weight.finite_toReal_sub_eq_nonneg_smul_sub
    (φ : Weight A) (r : NNReal) (a b c d : PositiveElement A)
    (ha : φ.value a < ⊤) (hb : φ.value b < ⊤)
    (hc : φ.value c < ⊤) (hd : φ.value d < ⊤)
    (h : (a : A) - (b : A) = (r : ℝ) • ((c : A) - (d : A))) :
    (φ.value a).toReal - (φ.value b).toReal =
      (r : ℝ) * ((φ.value c).toReal - (φ.value d).toReal) := by
  have hraw : (a : A) - (b : A) =
      (positiveSmul r c : A) - (positiveSmul r d : A) := by
    change (a : A) - (b : A) = (r : ℝ) • (c : A) - (r : ℝ) • (d : A)
    rw [← smul_sub]
    exact h
  have hvalues := φ.finite_toReal_sub_eq_sub a b (positiveSmul r c) (positiveSmul r d)
    ha hb (φ.finite_positiveSmul r c hc) (φ.finite_positiveSmul r d hd) hraw
  rw [φ.toReal_positiveSmul r c, φ.toReal_positiveSmul r d] at hvalues
  calc
    (φ.value a).toReal - (φ.value b).toReal =
        (r : ℝ) * (φ.value c).toReal - (r : ℝ) * (φ.value d).toReal := hvalues
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Every real scaling of an original finite-positive difference scales its real value. -/
theorem Weight.finite_toReal_sub_eq_real_smul_sub
    (φ : Weight A) (r : ℝ) (a b c d : PositiveElement A)
    (ha : φ.value a < ⊤) (hb : φ.value b < ⊤)
    (hc : φ.value c < ⊤) (hd : φ.value d < ⊤)
    (h : (a : A) - (b : A) = r • ((c : A) - (d : A))) :
    (φ.value a).toReal - (φ.value b).toReal =
      r * ((φ.value c).toReal - (φ.value d).toReal) := by
  by_cases hr : 0 ≤ r
  · exact φ.finite_toReal_sub_eq_nonneg_smul_sub (NNReal.mk r hr) a b c d ha hb hc hd h
  · have hrneg : 0 ≤ -r := le_of_lt (neg_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge hr))
    have hraw : (a : A) - (b : A) = (-r) • ((d : A) - (c : A)) := by
      rw [h]
      simp only [neg_smul, smul_sub]
      abel
    have hvalues := φ.finite_toReal_sub_eq_nonneg_smul_sub
      (NNReal.mk (-r) hrneg) a b d c ha hb hd hc hraw
    change (φ.value a).toReal - (φ.value b).toReal =
      (-r) * ((φ.value d).toReal - (φ.value c).toReal) at hvalues
    calc
      (φ.value a).toReal - (φ.value b).toReal =
          (-r) * ((φ.value d).toReal - (φ.value c).toReal) := hvalues
      _ = _ := by ring

/-- The actual finite-square value, where the original ENNReal weight value is finite. -/
def Weight.finiteSquareValue (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : ℝ :=
  (φ.value (leftSquare (x : A))).toReal

/-- The real polarization of actual finite-square values on the literal domain. -/
def Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe (φ : Weight A) (x y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : ℝ :=
  (φ.finiteSquareValue (x + y) - φ.finiteSquareValue (x - y)) / 4

/-- The original scalar-weight polarization, with the second-variable-linear complex sign. -/
def Weight.finiteSquarePolarInner (φ : Weight A) (x y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : ℂ :=
  ⟨φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x y, φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • x) y⟩

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.GNSLeftUnital
public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.RepresentationCoefficient
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Order

/-!
# Positive diagonal coefficients of the actual weight GNS map

The existing bounded representation coefficient at an original finite-square
vector has the original compressed positive-weight value. The actual positive
square root factors the original positive coefficient. The proved star law
and canonical dense values reduce its diagonal pairing to the original
finite-square weight value.

This is a prerequisite for ultraweak continuity of the same computed GNS
map. No normal-weight assumption or positive/normal functional certificate
is used. Positive-LUB preservation, representation normality/range, full
finite integration extension and Tomita/modular/polar data remain separate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped InnerProductSpace
open MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A]

attribute [local instance] CStarAlgebra.spectralOrder CStarAlgebra.spectralOrderedRing

/-- The actual positive diagonal GNS coefficient is the original finite compressed weight value. -/
theorem Weight.gnsCoefficient_positive_value (φ : Weight A) (a : A) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    representationCoefficient φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom (φ.gnsMap x) (φ.gnsMap x) a =
      (RCLike.ofReal ((φ.value
        ⟨star (x : A) * a * (x : A), star_left_conjugate_nonneg ha (x : A)⟩).toReal) : ℂ) := by
  let b : A := CFC.sqrt a
  have hstar : star b = b := IsSelfAdjoint.of_nonneg (CFC.sqrt_nonneg a)
  have hsquare : b * b = a := CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self a ha
  have hfactor : φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom a =
      star (φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom b) * φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom b := by
    have hraw : star b * b = a := by rw [hstar]; exact hsquare
    rw [← hraw, map_mul, map_star]
  have hweightSquare : leftSquare (b * (x : A)) =
      (⟨star (x : A) * a * (x : A), star_left_conjugate_nonneg ha (x : A)⟩ : PositiveElement A) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change star (b * (x : A)) * (b * (x : A)) = star (x : A) * a * (x : A)
    rw [star_mul, hstar]
    calc
      star (x : A) * b * (b * (x : A)) = star (x : A) * (b * b) * (x : A) := by
        simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = star (x : A) * a * (x : A) := by rw [hsquare]
  calc
    representationCoefficient φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom (φ.gnsMap x) (φ.gnsMap x) a =
        ⟪φ.gnsMap x, (star (φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom b) * φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom b) (φ.gnsMap x)⟫_ℂ := by
      rw [representationCoefficient_apply, hfactor]
    _ = ⟪φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom b (φ.gnsMap x), φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom b (φ.gnsMap x)⟫_ℂ := by
      rw [mul_apply_eq_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint,
        ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]
    _ = φ.finiteSquarePolarInner (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul b x) (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul b x) := by
      simp only [φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom_gnsMap, φ.gnsMap_inner]
    _ = (RCLike.ofReal (φ.finiteSquareValue (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul b x)) : ℂ) :=
      φ.finiteSquarePolarInner_self (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul b x)
    _ = (RCLike.ofReal ((φ.value
        ⟨star (x : A) * a * (x : A), star_left_conjugate_nonneg ha (x : A)⟩).toReal) : ℂ) := by
      change (RCLike.ofReal ((φ.value (leftSquare (b * (x : A)))).toReal) : ℂ) = _
      rw [hweightSquare]

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.PreGNSNorm
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Completion

/-!
# The literal completed weight GNS carrier

The original weight-induced pre-GNS seminorm and inner product have their
stock uniform completion. The complete normed Hilbert carrier and dense
canonical map are constructed from those actual structures. Original
norms and pairing values are preserved on the dense domain.

The map from the original finite-square submodule is complex linear. Its
ambient norm is not used to claim continuity of an unbounded weight map.
The original positive-weight faithfulness law makes the canonical map
injective. No source existence output, Hilbert model, chosen scalar
extension or positive-inner certificate is supplied.

This completion does not construct the faithful normal left representation,
full scalar extension or any Tomita/modular/polar object.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped InnerProductSpace

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The literal uniform completion of the actual weight pre-GNS type copy. -/
def Weight.GNS (φ : Weight A) : Type u := UniformSpace.Completion φ.PreGNS

/-- The completed carrier has the stock norm from the actual weight seminorm. -/
instance Weight.gnsNormedAddCommGroup (φ : Weight A) : NormedAddCommGroup φ.GNS :=
  inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup (UniformSpace.Completion φ.PreGNS))

/-- The original complex scalar action extends to the actual completed carrier. -/
instance Weight.gnsNormedSpace (φ : Weight A) : NormedSpace ℂ φ.GNS :=
  inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℂ (UniformSpace.Completion φ.PreGNS))

/-- The actual weight inner product extends through the stock uniform completion. -/
instance Weight.gnsInnerProductSpace (φ : Weight A) : InnerProductSpace ℂ φ.GNS :=
  inferInstanceAs (InnerProductSpace ℂ (UniformSpace.Completion φ.PreGNS))

/-- The literal weight completion is complete by its stock construction. -/
instance Weight.gnsCompleteSpace (φ : Weight A) : CompleteSpace φ.GNS :=
  inferInstanceAs (CompleteSpace (UniformSpace.Completion φ.PreGNS))

/-- The canonical original pre-GNS map is the stock completion linear isometry. -/
def Weight.toGNS (φ : Weight A) : φ.PreGNS →ₗᵢ[ℂ] φ.GNS :=
  UniformSpace.Completion.toComplₗᵢ

/-- The canonical map retains the literal stock completion value. -/
@[simp]
theorem Weight.toGNS_apply (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.PreGNS) :
    φ.toGNS x = (x : UniformSpace.Completion φ.PreGNS) :=
  rfl

/-- The canonical dense-domain map preserves the original weight-induced norm. -/
theorem Weight.toGNS_norm (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.PreGNS) : ‖φ.toGNS x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  change ‖(x : UniformSpace.Completion φ.PreGNS)‖ = ‖x‖
  exact UniformSpace.Completion.norm_coe x

/-- The actual completion map preserves the original weight inner product. -/
theorem Weight.toGNS_inner (φ : Weight A) (x y : φ.PreGNS) :
    ⟪φ.toGNS x, φ.toGNS y⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, y⟫_ℂ := by
  change ⟪(x : UniformSpace.Completion φ.PreGNS), (y : UniformSpace.Completion φ.PreGNS)⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, y⟫_ℂ
  exact UniformSpace.Completion.inner_coe x y

/-- The literal canonical pre-GNS completion map has dense range. -/
theorem Weight.toGNS_denseRange (φ : Weight A) : DenseRange φ.toGNS := by
  change DenseRange ((↑) : φ.PreGNS → UniformSpace.Completion φ.PreGNS)
  exact UniformSpace.Completion.denseRange_coe

/-- Original positive-weight faithfulness makes the canonical dense map injective. -/
theorem Weight.toGNS_injective (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    Function.Injective φ.toGNS := by
  let : NormedAddCommGroup φ.PreGNS := φ.faithfulPreGNSNormedAddCommGroup hφ
  exact φ.toGNS.injective

/-- The exact original finite-square domain maps linearly to the completed weight carrier. -/
def Weight.gnsMap (φ : Weight A) : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule →ₗ[ℂ] φ.GNS :=
  φ.toGNS.toLinearMap.comp φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.symm.toLinearMap

/-- The original-domain map is the canonical completion after the literal type-copy identity. -/
@[simp]
theorem Weight.gnsMap_apply (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.gnsMap x = φ.toGNS (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.symm x) :=
  rfl

/-- The norm square of the original-domain image is its original finite square weight value. -/
theorem Weight.gnsMap_norm_sq (φ : Weight A) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    ‖φ.gnsMap x‖ ^ 2 = φ.finiteSquareValue x := by
  rw [φ.gnsMap_apply, φ.toGNS_norm, φ.preGNS_norm_sq, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

/-- Completed original-domain inner products retain the actual scalar-weight polarization. -/
theorem Weight.gnsMap_inner (φ : Weight A) (x y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    ⟪φ.gnsMap x, φ.gnsMap y⟫_ℂ = φ.finiteSquarePolarInner x y := by
  rw [φ.gnsMap_apply, φ.gnsMap_apply, φ.toGNS_inner, φ.preGNS_inner,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

/-- The map of the exact original finite-square domain is dense in its literal completion. -/
theorem Weight.gnsMap_denseRange (φ : Weight A) : DenseRange φ.gnsMap := by
  have hrange : Set.range φ.gnsMap = Set.range φ.toGNS := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.symm x, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨φ.preGNSLinearEquiv x, ?_⟩
      rw [φ.gnsMap_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  change Dense (Set.range φ.gnsMap)
  rw [hrange]
  exact φ.toGNS_denseRange

/-- The original-domain GNS map is injective under exactly the original source faithfulness law. -/
theorem Weight.gnsMap_injective (φ : Weight A)
    (hφ : ∀ a : PositiveElement A, φ.value a = 0 → (a : A) = 0) :
    Function.Injective φ.gnsMap :=
  (φ.toGNS_injective hφ).comp φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.symm.injective

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.GNSLeftOperator
public import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint
public import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousLinearMap
public import Mathlib.Tactic.FunProp

/-!
# The original weight left action and its actual adjoint

The original star-product square differences match the left action at a
with the left action at star a. Finite-positive weight difference equality
therefore proves the real pairing identity. Complex linearity of the
literal finite-square left map proves the imaginary coordinate as well.

This constructs the pre-GNS adjoint pairing and its actual completed
operator adjoint law, needed by the star-representation constructor.
No full finite integration extension, source existence output or operator/
inner/norm certificate is supplied. Representation faithfulness, normality,
normal range and Tomita/modular/polar statements remain separate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

open scoped InnerProductSpace

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The original star-product difference matches left multiplication and its original star. -/
theorem leftSquare_difference_leftMul (a x y : A) :
    (leftSquare (a * x + y) : A) - (leftSquare (a * x - y) : A) =
      (leftSquare (x + star a * y) : A) - (leftSquare (x - star a * y) : A) := by
  simp only [leftSquare_difference, star_mul, star_star, mul_assoc]

/-- Actual finite-positive value relations give the original real adjoint pairing. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe_leftMul (φ : Weight A) (a : A)
    (x y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) y =
      φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul (star a) y) := by
  have hraw :
      (leftSquare (((φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) + y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) -
        (leftSquare (((φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) - y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) =
      (leftSquare ((x + φ.finiteSquareLeftMul (star a) y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) -
        (leftSquare ((x - φ.finiteSquareLeftMul (star a) y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A) : A) := by
    change (leftSquare (a * (x : A) + (y : A)) : A) -
      (leftSquare (a * (x : A) - (y : A)) : A) =
      (leftSquare ((x : A) + star a * (y : A)) : A) -
      (leftSquare ((x : A) - star a * (y : A)) : A)
    exact leftSquare_difference_leftMul a (x : A) (y : A)
  have h := φ.finite_toReal_sub_eq_sub
    (leftSquare (((φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) + y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare (((φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) - y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare ((x + φ.finiteSquareLeftMul (star a) y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    (leftSquare ((x - φ.finiteSquareLeftMul (star a) y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) : A))
    ((φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) + y).property ((φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) - y).property
    (x + φ.finiteSquareLeftMul (star a) y).property (x - φ.finiteSquareLeftMul (star a) y).property hraw
  dsimp only [Weight.finiteSquarePolarRe, Weight.finiteSquareValue]
  linarith [h]

/-- The actual complex weight pairing has the original left-star adjoint relation. -/
theorem Weight.finiteSquarePolarInner_leftMul (φ : Weight A) (a : A)
    (x y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.finiteSquarePolarInner (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) y =
      φ.finiteSquarePolarInner x (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul (star a) y) := by
  apply Complex.ext
  · change φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) y =
      φ.finiteSquarePolarRe x (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul (star a) y)
    exact φ.finiteSquarePolarRe_leftMul a x y
  · change φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) y =
      φ.finiteSquarePolarRe (Complex.I • x) (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul (star a) y)
    rw [← (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a).map_smul Complex.I x]
    exact φ.finiteSquarePolarRe_leftMul a (Complex.I • x) y

/-- The actual weight pre-GNS left operator is paired with left multiplication by star a. -/
theorem Weight.preGNSLeftMul_adjoint_pairing (φ : Weight A) (a : A) (x y : φ.PreGNS) :
    ⟪φ.preGNSLeftMul a x, y⟫_ℂ = ⟪x, φ.preGNSLeftMul (star a) y⟫_ℂ := by
  rw [φ.preGNS_inner, φ.preGNS_inner, φ.preGNSLeftMul_apply, φ.preGNSLeftMulLinear_apply,
    φ.preGNSLeftMul_apply, φ.preGNSLeftMulLinear_apply]
  exact φ.finiteSquarePolarInner_leftMul a (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv x) (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv y)

/-- The completed bounded left operators have the actual original star/adjoint law. -/
theorem Weight.gnsLeftMul_star (φ : Weight A) (a : A) :
    φ.gnsLeftMul (star a) = star (φ.gnsLeftMul a) := by
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
  refine (ContinuousLinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff (φ.gnsLeftMul (star a)) (φ.gnsLeftMul a)).2 ?_
  intro x y
  induction x, y using UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on₂ with
  | hp => apply isClosed_eq <;> fun_prop
  | ih x y =>
      change ⟪φ.gnsLeftMul (star a) (φ.toGNS x), φ.toGNS y⟫_ℂ =
        ⟪φ.toGNS x, φ.gnsLeftMul a (φ.toGNS y)⟫_ℂ
      rw [φ.gnsLeftMul_toGNS, φ.gnsLeftMul_toGNS, φ.toGNS_inner, φ.toGNS_inner]
      simpa only [star_star] using φ.preGNSLeftMul_adjoint_pairing (star a) x y

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.GNSCompletion
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.LinearMapCompletion

/-!
# The original bounded left operator on the actual weight GNS carrier

The literal finite-square left action is transported to the computed
weight pre-GNS norm. The original positive-square weight estimate gives
its genuine norm bound; this constructs the continuous linear left map.
The stock completion of that map acts on the actual weight GNS carrier
and preserves the original dense-domain multiplication values.

No supplied norm/model certificate or source existence output is used.
This module constructs bounded operators only. The kernel adjoint identity,
star representation, faithful normal range and Tomita/modular/polar objects
remain separate constructor obligations.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- Transport the literal original left action through the exact finite-square type-copy identity. -/
def Weight.preGNSLeftMulLinear (φ : Weight A) (a : A) : φ.PreGNS →ₗ[ℂ] φ.PreGNS :=
  φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.symm.toLinearMap.comp
    ((φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a).comp φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.toLinearMap)

/-- The transported linear action retains the original finite-square left multiplication. -/
theorem Weight.preGNSLeftMulLinear_apply (φ : Weight A) (a : A) (x : φ.PreGNS) :
    φ.preGNSLinearEquiv (φ.preGNSLeftMulLinear a x) = φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv x) := by
  change φ.preGNSLinearEquiv
    (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.symm (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv x))) = _
  exact φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _

/-- The original positive-square weight inequality gives the actual pre-GNS norm bound. -/
theorem Weight.preGNSLeftMulLinear_norm_le (φ : Weight A) (a : A) (x : φ.PreGNS) :
    ‖φ.preGNSLeftMulLinear a x‖ ≤ ‖a‖ * ‖x‖ := by
  let y : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule := φ.preGNSLinearEquiv x
  have hbound := φ.value_leftSquare_mul_le a (y : A)
  have hfinite : ENNReal.ofNNReal (NNReal.mk (‖a‖ ^ 2) (sq_nonneg ‖a‖)) *
      φ.value (leftSquare (y : A)) < ⊤ :=
    ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.coe_lt_top y.property
  have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono hfinite.ne hbound
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul] at hreal
  have hcoefficient :
      (ENNReal.ofNNReal (NNReal.mk (‖a‖ ^ 2) (sq_nonneg ‖a‖))).toReal = ‖a‖ ^ 2 := rfl
  rw [hcoefficient] at hreal
  rw [← sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg a) (norm_nonneg x)), mul_pow,
    φ.preGNS_norm_sq, φ.preGNS_norm_sq, φ.preGNSLeftMulLinear_apply]
  change (φ.value (leftSquare (a * (y : A)))).toReal ≤
    ‖a‖ ^ 2 * (φ.value (leftSquare (y : A))).toReal
  exact hreal

/-- The genuine weight-norm bound constructs the original continuous linear left map. -/
def Weight.preGNSLeftMul (φ : Weight A) (a : A) : φ.PreGNS →L[ℂ] φ.PreGNS :=
  (φ.preGNSLeftMulLinear a).mkContinuous ‖a‖ (φ.preGNSLeftMulLinear_norm_le a)

/-- The bounded pre-GNS operator is the same actual transported linear map. -/
theorem Weight.preGNSLeftMul_apply (φ : Weight A) (a : A) (x : φ.PreGNS) :
    φ.preGNSLeftMul a x = φ.preGNSLeftMulLinear a x :=
  rfl

/-- Forgetting the weight type copy gives exactly the original ambient left product. -/
theorem Weight.preGNSLeftMul_originalValue (φ : Weight A) (a : A) (x : φ.PreGNS) :
    (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv (φ.preGNSLeftMul a x) : A) = a * (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv x : A) := by
  rw [φ.preGNSLeftMul_apply, φ.preGNSLeftMulLinear_apply, φ.finiteSquareLeftMul_apply]

/-- The original bounded left action extends to the literal completed weight GNS carrier. -/
def Weight.gnsLeftMul (φ : Weight A) (a : A) : φ.GNS →L[ℂ] φ.GNS :=
  (φ.preGNSLeftMul a).completion

/-- The completed left operator preserves the actual canonical dense-domain values. -/
theorem Weight.gnsLeftMul_toGNS (φ : Weight A) (a : A) (x : φ.PreGNS) :
    φ.gnsLeftMul a (φ.toGNS x) = φ.toGNS (φ.preGNSLeftMul a x) := by
  change (φ.preGNSLeftMul a).completion (x : UniformSpace.Completion φ.PreGNS) =
    (φ.preGNSLeftMul a x : UniformSpace.Completion φ.PreGNS)
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.completion_apply_coe _ _

/-- The completed original-domain left action has exactly the original finite-square product. -/
theorem Weight.gnsLeftMul_gnsMap (φ : Weight A) (a : A) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.gnsLeftMul a (φ.gnsMap x) = φ.gnsMap (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) := by
  rw [φ.gnsMap_apply, φ.gnsLeftMul_toGNS, φ.gnsMap_apply]
  apply congrArg φ.toGNS
  apply φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.injective
  rw [φ.preGNSLeftMul_apply, φ.preGNSLeftMulLinear_apply,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.GNSLeftAdjoint

/-!
# The actual nonunital star representation of the original weight algebra

The actual completed left operators preserve zero, addition, complex
scalars and multiplication by their original canonical dense-domain values.
Together with the proved original adjoint law, these construct the literal
nonunital star algebra homomorphism into the bounded operators on the
actual weight Hilbert completion.

No normal/faithful representation or Hilbert/norm certificate is supplied.
Only the original possibly nonunital C-star algebra and its global positive
weight occur as input. Representation faithfulness/normality/range, the full
finite integration extension and Tomita/modular/polar constructions remain
separate; no original source theorem supplies chosen DATA.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [NonUnitalCStarAlgebra A]

/-- The actual completed original left representation sends the zero coefficient to zero. -/
theorem Weight.gnsLeftMul_zero (φ : Weight A) : φ.gnsLeftMul (0 : A) = 0 := by
  ext z
  induction z using UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on with
  | hp => apply isClosed_eq <;> fun_prop
  | ih x =>
      change φ.gnsLeftMul 0 (φ.toGNS x) = 0
      rw [φ.gnsLeftMul_toGNS]
      have hzero : φ.preGNSLeftMul 0 x = 0 := by
        apply φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.injective
        rw [map_zero]
        apply Subtype.ext
        rw [φ.preGNSLeftMul_originalValue]
        exact zero_mul _
      rw [hzero, map_zero]

/-- Addition of original coefficients is addition of the actual completed left operators. -/
theorem Weight.gnsLeftMul_add (φ : Weight A) (a b : A) :
    φ.gnsLeftMul (a + b) = φ.gnsLeftMul a + φ.gnsLeftMul b := by
  ext z
  induction z using UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on with
  | hp => apply isClosed_eq <;> fun_prop
  | ih x =>
      change φ.gnsLeftMul (a + b) (φ.toGNS x) =
        φ.gnsLeftMul a (φ.toGNS x) + φ.gnsLeftMul b (φ.toGNS x)
      rw [φ.gnsLeftMul_toGNS, φ.gnsLeftMul_toGNS, φ.gnsLeftMul_toGNS, ← map_add]
      apply congrArg φ.toGNS
      apply φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.injective
      rw [map_add]
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv (φ.preGNSLeftMul (a + b) x) : A) =
        (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv (φ.preGNSLeftMul a x) : A) +
          (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv (φ.preGNSLeftMul b x) : A)
      rw [φ.preGNSLeftMul_originalValue, φ.preGNSLeftMul_originalValue,
        φ.preGNSLeftMul_originalValue]
      exact add_mul a b _

/-- Original complex coefficient scaling scales the actual completed left operator. -/
theorem Weight.gnsLeftMul_smul (φ : Weight A) (c : ℂ) (a : A) :
    φ.gnsLeftMul (c • a) = c • φ.gnsLeftMul a := by
  ext z
  induction z using UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on with
  | hp =>
      change IsClosed {z : φ.GNS | φ.gnsLeftMul (c • a) z = c • φ.gnsLeftMul a z}
      have hscalar : Continuous (fun z : φ.GNS => c • φ.gnsLeftMul a z) :=
        (φ.gnsLeftMul a).continuous.const_smul c
      exact isClosed_eq (φ.gnsLeftMul (c • a)).continuous hscalar
  | ih x =>
      change φ.gnsLeftMul (c • a) (φ.toGNS x) = c • φ.gnsLeftMul a (φ.toGNS x)
      have hpre : φ.preGNSLeftMul (c • a) x = c • φ.preGNSLeftMul a x := by
        apply φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.injective
        rw [φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.map_smul c (φ.preGNSLeftMul a x)]
        apply Subtype.ext
        change (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv (φ.preGNSLeftMul (c • a) x) : A) =
          c • (φ.preGNSLinearEquiv (φ.preGNSLeftMul a x) : A)
        rw [φ.preGNSLeftMul_originalValue, φ.preGNSLeftMul_originalValue]
        exact smul_mul_assoc c a _
      calc
        φ.gnsLeftMul (c • a) (φ.toGNS x) = φ.toGNS (φ.preGNSLeftMul (c • a) x) :=
          φ.gnsLeftMul_toGNS (c • a) x
        _ = φ.toGNS (c • φ.preGNSLeftMul a x) := congrArg φ.toGNS hpre
        _ = c • φ.toGNS (φ.preGNSLeftMul a x) := φ.toGNS.map_smul c (φ.preGNSLeftMul a x)
        _ = c • φ.gnsLeftMul a (φ.toGNS x) :=
          congrArg (fun y : φ.GNS => c • y) (φ.gnsLeftMul_toGNS a x).symm

/-- Multiplication of original coefficients is composition of the actual completed left operators. -/
theorem Weight.gnsLeftMul_mul (φ : Weight A) (a b : A) :
    φ.gnsLeftMul (a * b) = φ.gnsLeftMul a * φ.gnsLeftMul b := by
  ext z
  induction z using UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on with
  | hp => apply isClosed_eq <;> fun_prop
  | ih x =>
      change φ.gnsLeftMul (a * b) (φ.toGNS x) =
        φ.gnsLeftMul a (φ.gnsLeftMul b (φ.toGNS x))
      rw [φ.gnsLeftMul_toGNS, φ.gnsLeftMul_toGNS, φ.gnsLeftMul_toGNS]
      apply congrArg φ.toGNS
      apply φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.injective
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [φ.preGNSLeftMul_originalValue, φ.preGNSLeftMul_originalValue,
        φ.preGNSLeftMul_originalValue]
      exact mul_assoc a b _

/-- The original global-weight left action as its actual nonunital star representation. -/
def Weight.gnsLeftRepresentation (φ : Weight A) : A →⋆ₙₐ[ℂ] (φ.GNS →L[ℂ] φ.GNS) where
  toFun := φ.gnsLeftMul
  map_zero' := φ.gnsLeftMul_zero
  map_add' a b := φ.gnsLeftMul_add a b
  map_smul' c a := φ.gnsLeftMul_smul c a
  map_mul' a b := φ.gnsLeftMul_mul a b
  map_star' a := φ.gnsLeftMul_star a

/-- The actual star representation retains every original completed left operator. -/
theorem Weight.gnsLeftRepresentation_apply (φ : Weight A) (a : A) :
    φ.gnsLeftRepresentation a = φ.gnsLeftMul a :=
  rfl

/-- The actual representation has the literal original finite-square multiplication values. -/
theorem Weight.gnsLeftRepresentation_gnsMap (φ : Weight A) (a : A) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.gnsLeftRepresentation a (φ.gnsMap x) = φ.gnsMap (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) :=
  φ.gnsLeftMul_gnsMap a x

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

/-
Author: @toskua
-/
module

public import MathlibExt.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.Weight.GNSLeftRepresentation
public import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Hom

/-!
# The original unital weight algebra has its actual unital GNS star map

The completed original left operator at one fixes the canonical dense
GNS map, because original left multiplication by one fixes each actual
finite-square element. This proves the identity operator law and turns
the existing nonunital star representation into a unital star algebra map.

The map is the same original completed left action. Unitality, a norm
certificate or a normal/faithful representation is not supplied as input.
The original zero algebra is allowed. Normality, faithful range, full
finite integration extension and Tomita/modular/polar data remain separate.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false

namespace CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A]

/-- Original multiplication by one gives the identity on the actual weight completion. -/
theorem Weight.gnsLeftMul_one (φ : Weight A) : φ.gnsLeftMul (1 : A) = 1 := by
  ext z
  induction z using UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on with
  | hp => apply isClosed_eq <;> fun_prop
  | ih x =>
      change φ.gnsLeftMul 1 (φ.toGNS x) = φ.toGNS x
      rw [φ.gnsLeftMul_toGNS]
      apply congrArg φ.toGNS
      apply φ.preGNSLinearEquiv.injective
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [φ.preGNSLeftMul_originalValue]
      exact one_mul _

/-- The actual unital star map packages the same original nonunital weight representation. -/
def Weight.gnsLeftStarAlgHom (φ : Weight A) : A →⋆ₐ[ℂ] (φ.GNS →L[ℂ] φ.GNS) where
  toAlgHom := AlgHom.mk'
    { toFun := φ.gnsLeftRepresentation
      map_zero' := map_zero φ.gnsLeftRepresentation
      map_one' := by
        change φ.gnsLeftMul (1 : A) = 1
        exact φ.gnsLeftMul_one
      map_add' a b := map_add φ.gnsLeftRepresentation a b
      map_mul' a b := map_mul φ.gnsLeftRepresentation a b }
    (fun c a => map_smul φ.gnsLeftRepresentation c a)
  map_star' a := map_star φ.gnsLeftRepresentation a

/-- The unital map retains exactly the existing original completed coefficient operator. -/
theorem Weight.gnsLeftStarAlgHom_apply (φ : Weight A) (a : A) :
    φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom a = φ.gnsLeftRepresentation a :=
  rfl

/-- The unital map has the same original finite-square dense-domain multiplication values. -/
theorem Weight.gnsLeftStarAlgHom_gnsMap (φ : Weight A) (a : A) (x : φ.finiteSquareSubmodule) :
    φ.gnsLeftStarAlgHom a (φ.gnsMap x) = φ.gnsMap (φ.finiteSquareLeftMul a x) :=
  φ.gnsLeftRepresentation_gnsMap a x

end

end CStarAlgebra.ScalarWeight
